import 'core/appearance.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'core/app_theme.dart';
import 'features/auth/auth_gate.dart';

class FinanzasApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const FinanzasApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: AppearanceController.instance,
      builder: (context, _) => MaterialApp(
        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
        title: 'Mi Billete',
        theme: createAppTheme(),
        builder: (context, child) => MediaQuery(
          data: MediaQuery.of(context).copyWith(
            textScaler: ReadableTextScaler(
              MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context),
              AppearanceController.instance.scale,
            ),
          ),
          child: child!,
        ),
        home: const AuthGate(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Apply the chosen size without forcing a minimum or an extra enlargement.
/// Preserve the operating system's accessibility scaling.
class ReadableTextScaler extends TextScaler {
  const ReadableTextScaler(this.system, this.preference);
  final TextScaler system;
  final double preference;
  @override
  double scale(double fontSize) {
    if (fontSize == 0) return 0;
    return system.scale(fontSize) * preference;
  }

  @override
  double get textScaleFactor => scale(14) / 14;
}

class AppearancePalette {
  const AppearancePalette(
    this.name,
    this.primary,
    this.navigation,
    this.background,
    this.tint,
  );
  final String name;
  final Color primary, navigation, background, tint;
  Color get selection => Color.lerp(navigation, primary, .65)!;
}

const appearancePalettes = {
  'slate': AppearancePalette(
    '1 Â· Pizarra + cian',
    Color(0xFF217E9F),

};
const appearanceFonts = {
  'noto': 'Noto Sans',
  'open': 'Open Sans',
  'serif': 'DejaVu Serif',
  'liberation': 'Liberation Sans',
};

class AppearanceController extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final instance = AppearanceController._();
  AppearanceController._();
  String theme = 'slate', font = 'noto';
  double scale = 1;
  bool compact = false;
  AppearancePalette get palette => appearancePalettes[theme]!;
  String get fontFamily => appearanceFonts[font]!;
  String get regularAsset => switch (font) {
    'liberation' => 'assets/fonts/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf',
    'open' => 'assets/fonts/OpenSans-Regular.ttf',
    'serif' => 'assets/fonts/DejaVuSerif.ttf',
    _ => 'assets/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf',
  };
  String get boldAsset => switch (font) {
    'liberation' => 'assets/fonts/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf',
    'open' => 'assets/fonts/OpenSans-Bold.ttf',
    'serif' => 'assets/fonts/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf',
    _ => 'assets/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf',
  };
  Future<void> load() async {
    try {
      final raw = (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).getString(
        'appearance.v1',
      );
      if (raw == null) return;
      final data = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      if (appearancePalettes.containsKey(data['theme'])) theme = data['theme'];
      if (appearanceFonts.containsKey(data['font'])) font = data['font'];
      if (data['scale'] is num &&
          const [
            .8,
            .9,
            1.0,
            1.1,
            1.2,
          ].contains((data['scale'] as num).toDouble())) {
        scale = (data['scale'] as num).toDouble();
      }
      compact = data['compact'] == true;
    } catch (_) {
      /* Keep usable defaults if stored settings are unavailable. */
    }
  }

  Future<void> update({
    String? theme,
    String? font,
    double? scale,
    bool? compact,
  }) async {
    final nextTheme = theme ?? this.theme, nextFont = font ?? this.font;
    final nextScale = (scale ?? this.scale).clamp(.8, 1.2).toDouble();
    final nextCompact = compact ?? this.compact;
    if (!appearancePalettes.containsKey(nextTheme) ||
        !appearanceFonts.containsKey(nextFont))
      throw ArgumentError('Apariencia no vÃ¡lida');
    final saved = await (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).setString(
      'appearance.v1',
      jsonEncode({
        'theme': nextTheme,
        'font': nextFont,
        'scale': nextScale,
        'compact': nextCompact,
      }),
    );
    if (!saved) throw StateError('No se pudo guardar la apariencia');
    this.theme = nextTheme;
    this.font = nextFont;
    this.scale = nextScale;
    this.compact = nextCompact;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> reset() =>
      update(theme: 'slate', font: 'noto', scale: 1, compact: false);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'app_theme.dart';

/// Uses calendar days; completed and inactive records override their due date.
Color appDueColor(
  DateTime? due, {
  bool settled = false,
  bool inactive = false,
  DateTime? now,
}) {
  if (inactive) return appMuted;
  if (settled) return appPositive;
  if (due == null) return appMuted;
  final today = now ?? DateTime.now();
  final days = DateTime.utc(
    due.year,
    due.month,
    due.day,
  ).difference(DateTime.utc(today.year, today.month, today.day)).inDays;
  if (days < 0) return appNegative;
  if (days == 0) return appDueToday;
  if (days <= 7) return appWarning;
  return appMuted;
}

class ShareBank {
  const ShareBank(this.id, this.name, this.ibanCode);
  final String id, name, ibanCode;
}

const shareBanks = [
  ShareBank('bac', 'BAC', 'BAMC'),
  ShareBank('banpro', 'Banpro', 'BAPR'),
  ShareBank('lafise', 'LAFISE', 'BCCE'),
  ShareBank('avanz', 'Avanz', 'PRCB'),
  ShareBank('ficohsa', 'Ficohsa', 'BUNO'),
  ShareBank('bdf', 'BDF', 'BBDF'),
  ShareBank('atlantida', 'AtlÃ¡ntida', 'ATTD'),
  ShareBank('bcn', 'Banco Central de Nicaragua', 'BCNI'),
];
String _bankText(String value) => value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll('Ã¡', 'a')
    .replaceAll('Ã©', 'e')
    .replaceAll('Ã­', 'i')
    .replaceAll('Ã³', 'o')
    .replaceAll('Ãº', 'u');
ShareBank? accountShareBank(String name, {String code = ''}) {
  final value = _bankText('$name $code').replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]+'), ' ');
  final tokens = value.split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
  for (final bank in shareBanks) {
    if (tokens.contains(bank.id) ||
        tokens.contains(bank.ibanCode.toLowerCase()))
      return bank;
  }
  if (value.contains('america central')) return shareBanks[0];
  if (value.contains('bancentro')) return shareBanks[2];
  if (value.contains('banco de finanzas')) return shareBanks[5];
  if (value.contains('banco de la produccion')) return shareBanks[1];
  if (value.contains('banco central de nicaragua')) return shareBanks[7];
  return null;
}

String normalizeAccountIban(String text) =>
    text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\s-]'), '').toUpperCase();
String? validateAccountIban(
  String? value, {
  String bankName = '',
  String bankCode = '',
  String accountNumber = '',
}) {
  final iban = normalizeAccountIban(value ?? '');
  if (iban.isEmpty) return null;
  if (!RegExp(r'^NI\d{2}[A-Z]{4}\d{20}$').hasMatch(iban))
    return 'El IBAN de Nicaragua debe tener 28 caracteres: NI, 2 dÃ­gitos, banco y 20 dÃ­gitos.';
  var remainder = 0;
  for (final code in '${iban.substring(4)}${iban.substring(0, 4)}'.codeUnits) {
    if (code >= 65 && code <= 90)
      remainder = (remainder * 100 + code - 55) % 97;
    else
      remainder = (remainder * 10 + code - 48) % 97;
  }
  if (remainder != 1)
    return 'Revisa el IBAN: sus dÃ­gitos de control no coinciden. CÃ³pialo nuevamente del banco.';
  final bank = accountShareBank(bankName, code: bankCode);
  if (bank != null && iban.substring(4, 8) != bank.ibanCode)
    return 'Ese IBAN no corresponde a ${bank.name}. Revisa el banco seleccionado.';
  final local = accountNumber.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\s-]'), '');
  if (RegExp(r'^\d{1,20}$').hasMatch(local) &&
      iban.substring(8) != local.padLeft(20, '0')) {
    return 'El IBAN no coincide con el nÃºmero de cuenta. Revisa ambos datos en el banco.';
  }
  return null;
}

String shareCurrency(String currency) => switch (currency) {
  'NIO' => 'CÃ³rdobas (NIO)',
  'USD' => 'DÃ³lares (USD)',
  _ => currency,
};
String _oneLine(dynamic value) =>
    '${value ?? ''}'.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\x00-\x1f\x7f]'), ' ').trim();

/// BAC follows the user's supplied copy example. Other banks use an app-owned
/// standard layout: public sources do not document their exact clipboard text.
String buildAccountShareText(Map<String, dynamic> account) {
  final institution = account['financial_institutions'];
  final bankName = institution is Map ? _oneLine(institution['name']) : '';
  final bankCode = institution is Map ? _oneLine(institution['code']) : '';
  final bank = accountShareBank(bankName, code: bankCode);
  final holder = _oneLine(account['account_holder']),
      number = _oneLine(account['account_number']);
  final iban = normalizeAccountIban('${account['account_iban'] ?? ''}'),
      currency = _oneLine(account['currency']);
  final lines = <String>[];
  if (holder.isNotEmpty)
    lines.add('${bank?.id == 'bac' ? 'Cliente' : 'Titular'}: $holder');
  if (bank?.id != 'bac' && (bank?.name ?? bankName).isNotEmpty)
    lines.add('Banco: ${bank?.name ?? bankName}');
  if (number.isNotEmpty)
    lines.add(
      '${bank?.id == 'bac' ? 'NÃºmero de cuenta BAC' : 'NÃºmero de cuenta'}: $number',
    );
  if (iban.isNotEmpty) lines.add('NÃºmero de cuenta IBAN: $iban');
  if (currency.isNotEmpty) lines.add('Moneda: ${shareCurrency(currency)}');
  return lines.join('\n');
}

List<String> missingAccountShareFields(Map<String, dynamic> account) {
  final missing = <String>[];
  if (_oneLine(account['account_holder']).isEmpty) missing.add('titular');
  if (_oneLine(account['account_number']).isEmpty &&
      normalizeAccountIban('${account['account_iban'] ?? ''}').isEmpty)
    missing.add('nÃºmero de cuenta o IBAN');
  if (!['NIO', 'USD'].contains(account['currency'])) missing.add('moneda');
  final institution = account['financial_institutions'];
  if (institution is! Map || _oneLine(institution['name']).isEmpty)
    missing.add('banco');
  return missing;
}

import 'period_logic.dart';

typedef AvanzAmounts = ({int minimum, int? overdue, int balance});
typedef AvanzStatement = ({
  DateTime closing,
  DateTime? bonus,
  DateTime due,
  String? cardEnding,
  Map<String, AvanzAmounts> amounts,
});

AvanzStatement? parseAvanzStatement(String text) {
  final normalized = text
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('Ã¡', 'a')
      .replaceAll('Ã­', 'i')
      .replaceAll('Ã³', 'o')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\s\u00a0]+'), ' ');
  if (!normalized.contains('avanzbanc.com')) return null;

  const day = r'(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})';
  const amount = r'((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)\.\d{2})';
  final header = RegExp(
    'fecha de corte $day (?:fecha de pago para bonificar $day )?'
    'fecha maxima de pago $day cordobas dolares '
    'pago minimo $amount $amount (?:pago atrasado $amount $amount )?'
    'pago de contado $amount $amount(?![0-9.,])',
  ).firstMatch(normalized);
  if (header == null) return null;

  DateTime? date(String? value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    final parts = value.split('/').map(int.parse).toList();
    final result = DateTime(parts[2], parts[1], parts[0]);
    return result.year >= 1900 &&
            result.year <= 2200 &&
            result.month == parts[1] &&
            result.day == parts[0]
        ? result
        : null;
  }

  int? cents(int index) {
    final value = header.group(index);
    return value == null
        ? null
        : int.tryParse(value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[,.]'), ''));
  }

  final closing = date(header.group(1));
  final bonus = date(header.group(2));
  final due = date(header.group(3));
  if (closing == null ||
      due == null ||
      due.isBefore(closing) ||
      (header.group(2) != null &&
          (bonus == null || !includesDay(bonus, closing, due)))) {
    return null;
  }
  final amounts = <String, AvanzAmounts>{};
  for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    final minimum = cents(4 + i),
        overdue = cents(6 + i),
        balance = cents(8 + i);
    if (minimum == null ||
        balance == null ||
        minimum > balance ||
        balance > 99999999999999 ||
        (header.group(6 + i) != null &&
            (overdue == null || overdue > 99999999999999))) {
      return null;
    }
    amounts[i == 0 ? 'NIO' : 'USD'] = (
      minimum: minimum,
      overdue: overdue,
      balance: balance,
    );
  }
  final cardEnding = RegExp(
    r'no\. de tarjeta\s+[0-9* x]*[*x]\s*(\d{4})(?!\d)',
  ).firstMatch(normalized)?.group(1);
  return (
    closing: closing,
    bonus: bonus,
    due: due,
    cardEnding: cardEnding,
    amounts: amounts,
  );
}

/// Movimientos del perÃ­odo con totales separados por moneda.
ExportReport creditCardsExport({
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> movements,
  required DateTime start,
  required DateTime end,
  required DateTime generatedAt,
  String currency = 'all',
  String? cardId,
}) {
  const charges = 'Cargos';
  const payments = 'Pagos';
  const refunds = 'Reembolsos';
  const net = 'Total neto';
  final sums = {
    for (final c in cardCurrencies)
      if (currency == 'all' || c == currency)
        c: {charges: 0, payments: 0, refunds: 0, net: 0},
  };
  final details = <List<Object?>>[];
  const labels = {
    'purchase': 'Compra',
    'payment': 'Pago',
    'refund': 'Reembolso',
    'insurance': 'Seguro de tarjeta',
    cardPointsRedemption: cardPointsRedemptionLabel,
    cardRebate: cardRebateLabel,
    'fee': 'ComisiÃ³n',
    'interest': 'Intereses',
  };
  for (final card in cards.where(
    (c) => cardId == null || '${c['id']}' == cardId,
  )) {
    final rows =
        movements
            .where(
              (m) =>
                  '${m['credit_card_id']}' == '${card['id']}' &&
                  m['is_voided'] != true,
            )
            .toList()
          ..sort(_order);
    for (final row in rows) {
      final date = _date(row['transaction_date']);
      final c = '${row['currency']}';
      if (!inReportRange(date, start, end) ||
          currency != 'all' && c != currency) {
        continue;
      }
      final type = row['transaction_type'];
      final effect = cardEffects[type];
      final totals = sums[c];
      if (totals == null || effect == null) {
        throw StateError('Movimiento de tarjeta pendiente de revisiÃ³n.');
      }
      final amount = effect * moneyCents(row['amount']);
      final group = switch (type) {
        'payment' => payments,
        'refund' => refunds,
        _ => charges,
      };
      totals[group] = totals[group]! + amount;
      totals[net] = totals[net]! + amount;
      details.add([
        reportDate(date),
        reportCreditMovementCardLabel(card, row),
        labels[cardMovementType(type, row['charge_kind'])],
        '${row['description'] ?? ''}',
        c == 'NIO' ? MoneyCell(amount) : null,
        c == 'USD' ? MoneyCell(amount) : null,
        '${row['reference'] ?? ''}',
      ]);
    }
  }
  return ExportReport(
    title: 'Tarjetas de crÃ©dito',
    period: '${reportDate(start)} al ${reportDate(end)}',
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    showTotalsSummary: false,
    tables: [
      ReportTable(
        'Movimientos de crÃ©dito',
        [
          'Fecha',
          'Tarjeta',
          'Movimiento',
          'DescripciÃ³n',
          'Importe C\$',
          'Importe \$',
          'Referencia',
        ],
        details,
        footerRows: [
          for (final label in [charges, payments, refunds, net])
            [
              null,
              null,
              label,
              null,
              for (final c in cardCurrencies)
                if (sums[c] case final totals?)
                  MoneyCell(totals[label]!, isTotal: true)
                else
                  null,
              null,
            ],
        ],
      ),
    ],
    totals: [
      for (final entry in sums.entries)
        for (final total in entry.value.entries)
          ReportTotal(entry.key, total.key, total.value),
    ],
    notes: const [
      'Los totales corresponden a los movimientos del perÃ­odo y a las tarjetas seleccionadas.',
      'Las compras, los intereses, las comisiones y el seguro se incluyen en Cargos. Los pagos y reembolsos restan del total neto.',
      'Los importes se muestran en su moneda original.',
    ],
  );
}

/// DÃ©bito: estado de la cuenta bancaria vinculada, no atribuciÃ³n inventada a una tarjeta.
ExportReport debitCardsExport({
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> transactions,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> cardPayments,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> debtPayments,
  required DateTime start,
  required DateTime end,
  required DateTime generatedAt,
  String currency = 'all',
  String? cardId,
  String? accountId,
  bool allAccounts = false,
  IncomeExpenseSelection selection = IncomeExpenseSelection.both,
}) {
  final cardsByAccount = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
  if (!allAccounts) {
    for (final card in cards) {
      if (cardId == null || '${card['id']}' == cardId) {
        (cardsByAccount['${card['account_id']}'] ??= []).add(card);
      }
    }
  }
  final detail = <List<Object?>>[], summary = <List<Object?>>[];
  final totals = {'NIO': 0, 'USD': 0};
  for (final account in accounts.where(
    (a) =>
        (allAccounts
            ? accountId == null || '${a['id']}' == accountId
            : cardsByAccount.containsKey('${a['id']}')) &&
        (currency == 'all' || a['currency'] == currency),
  )) {
    final id = '${account['id']}', c = '${account['currency']}';
    final linkedLabels = cardsByAccount[id]
        ?.map((card) => reportDebitCardLabel(card, account: account))
        .join('\n');
    var balance = moneyCents(account['opening_balance'] ?? 0);
    final events = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final tx in transactions.where((t) => t['is_voided'] != true)) {
      final type = tx['transaction_type'];
      if ('${tx['account_id']}' == id) {
        if (![
          'income',
          'deposit',
          'expense',
          'withdrawal',
          'transfer',
        ].contains(type))
          throw StateError('Hay un ajuste de cuenta sin efecto definido.');
        if (tx['currency'] != c)
          throw StateError(
            'La moneda de un movimiento no coincide con su cuenta.',
          );
        events.add({
          ...tx,
          'delta':
              (['income', 'deposit'].contains(type) ? 1 : -1) *
              moneyCents(tx['amount']),
          'label': switch (type) {
            'income' => 'Ingreso',
            'deposit' => 'DepÃ³sito',
            'transfer' => 'Transferencia enviada',
            _ => 'Gasto / retiro',
          },
        });
      }
      if (type == 'transfer' && '${tx['destination_account_id']}' == id) {
        if ((tx['destination_currency'] ?? tx['currency']) != c)
          throw StateError('La moneda recibida no coincide con su cuenta.');
        events.add({
          ...tx,
          'delta': moneyCents(tx['destination_amount'] ?? tx['amount']),
          'label': 'Transferencia recibida',
        });
      }
    }
    for (final p in cardPayments.where(
      (p) => '${p['account_id']}' == id && p['is_voided'] != true,
    )) {
      if ((p['account_debit_currency'] ?? p['currency']) != c)
        throw StateError('Moneda del pago de tarjeta invÃ¡lida.');
      events.add({
        ...p,
        'delta': -moneyCents(p['account_debit_amount'] ?? p['amount']),
        'label': 'Pago de tarjeta de crÃ©dito',
      });
    }
    for (final p in debtPayments.where(
      (p) => '${p['account_id']}' == id && p['is_voided'] != true,
    )) {
      if (p['currency'] != c) throw StateError('Moneda del abono invÃ¡lida.');
      events.add({
        ...p,
        'transaction_date': p['payment_date'],
        'delta': -debtPaymentTotalCents(p),
        'label': 'Abono de prÃ©stamo',
      });
    }
    events.sort(_order);
    for (final event in events) {
      final date = _date(event['transaction_date']);
      if (_after(date, end)) continue;
      final delta = event['delta'] as int;
      balance += delta;
      if (!inReportRange(date, start, end)) continue;
      if (selection == IncomeExpenseSelection.income && delta <= 0) continue;
      if (selection == IncomeExpenseSelection.expenses && delta >= 0) continue;
      detail.add([
        reportDate(date),
        '${account['name']}',
        event['label'],
        '${event['description'] ?? ''}',
        c == 'NIO' ? MoneyCell(delta) : null,
        c == 'USD' ? MoneyCell(delta) : null,
        c == 'NIO' ? MoneyCell(balance, isTotal: true) : null,
        c == 'USD' ? MoneyCell(balance, isTotal: true) : null,
        '${event['reference'] ?? ''}',
      ]);
    }
    totals[c] = totals[c]! + balance;
    summary.add([
      '${account['name']}',
      if (!allAccounts) linkedLabels,
      c,
      c == 'NIO' ? MoneyCell(balance, isTotal: true) : null,
      c == 'USD' ? MoneyCell(balance, isTotal: true) : null,
    ]);
  }
  return ExportReport(
    title: allAccounts
        ? 'Cuentas y efectivo${switch (selection) {
            IncomeExpenseSelection.both => '',
            IncomeExpenseSelection.income => ' Â· Solo ingresos',
            IncomeExpenseSelection.expenses => ' Â· Solo gastos',
          }}'
        : 'Tarjetas de dÃ©bito Â· cuentas vinculadas',
    period: '${reportDate(start)} al ${reportDate(end)}',
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    tables: [
      ReportTable(allAccounts ? 'Cuentas' : 'Cuentas vinculadas', [
        'Cuenta',
        if (!allAccounts) 'Tarjetas vinculadas',
        'Moneda',
        'Saldo C\$',
        'Saldo \$',
      ], summary),
      ReportTable('Movimientos de cuentas', [
        'Fecha',
        'Cuenta',
        'Movimiento',
        'DescripciÃ³n',
        'VariaciÃ³n C\$',
        'VariaciÃ³n \$',
        'Saldo C\$',
        'Saldo \$',
        'Referencia',
      ], detail),
    ],
    totals: [
      for (final c in ['NIO', 'USD'])
        if (currency == 'all' || c == currency)
          ReportTotal(c, 'Saldo bancario al cierre', totals[c]!),
    ],
    notes: [
      if (allAccounts && selection != IncomeExpenseSelection.both)
        'El filtro muestra ${selection == IncomeExpenseSelection.income ? 'entradas' : 'salidas'} de dinero de las cuentas, incluidas las transferencias. Los saldos se calculan con todos los movimientos.',
      if (!allAccounts)
        'Incluye todos los movimientos de las cuentas vinculadas a las tarjetas de dÃ©bito seleccionadas: el registro actual no identifica quÃ© tarjeta fÃ­sica originÃ³ cada gasto.',
      'Una cuenta vinculada a varias tarjetas se cuenta una sola vez. Los saldos incorporan el saldo inicial y movimientos anteriores al perÃ­odo. Positivo: dinero disponible; negativo: sobregiro.',
      'Las transferencias entre monedas usan el importe recibido guardado. NIO y USD no se mezclan.',
    ],
  );
}

DateTime _date(dynamic value) => DateTime.parse('$value').toLocal();
bool _after(DateTime a, DateTime b) =>
    DateTime(a.year, a.month, a.day).isAfter(DateTime(b.year, b.month, b.day));
int _order(Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {
  final byDate = _date(
    a['transaction_date'],
  ).compareTo(_date(b['transaction_date']));
  return byDate != 0 ? byDate : '${a['id']}'.compareTo('${b['id']}');
}

ExportReport creditCardExpensesExport({
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> movements,
  required DateTime start,
  required DateTime end,
  required DateTime generatedAt,
  String currency = 'all',
  String? cardId,
  String? additionalCardFilter,
  Map<String, dynamic>? additionalCard,
}) {
  final cardsById = {for (final card in cards) '${card['id']}': card};
  final card = cardsById[cardId];
  if (cardId != null && card == null) {
    throw StateError('La tarjeta seleccionada ya no estÃ¡ disponible.');
  }
  if (additionalCardFilter != null &&
      (card == null ||
          (additionalCardFilter.isNotEmpty &&
              additionalCard?['id']?.toString() != additionalCardFilter))) {
    throw StateError('La adicional seleccionada ya no estÃ¡ disponible.');
  }
  final showCardColumn = additionalCardFilter == null;
  final scopeLabel = card == null
      ? null
      : switch (additionalCardFilter) {
          null => '${agendaCardLabel(card)} Â· Titular y adicionales',
          '' => '${agendaCardLabel(card)} Â· Solo titular',
          _ => reportCreditMovementCardLabel(card, {
            'credit_card_additionals': additionalCard,
          }),
        };
  final rows = <List<Object?>>[];
  final charges = {'NIO': 0, 'USD': 0}, refunds = {'NIO': 0, 'USD': 0};
  final selected =
      movements
          .where(
            (tx) =>
                tx['is_voided'] != true &&
                tx['is_receivable_funding'] != true &&
                (cardId == null || '${tx['credit_card_id']}' == cardId) &&
                (additionalCardFilter == null ||
                    (tx['additional_card_id']?.toString() ?? '') ==
                        additionalCardFilter) &&
                [
                  'purchase',
                  'interest',
                  'fee',
                  'refund',
                ].contains(tx['transaction_type']) &&
                (currency == 'all' || tx['currency'] == currency),
          )
          .toList()
        ..sort(_order);
  for (final tx in selected) {
    final date = _date(tx['transaction_date']);
    if (!inReportRange(date, start, end)) continue;
    final c = '${tx['currency']}';
    if (!charges.containsKey(c)) throw StateError('Moneda no admitida.');
    final refund = tx['transaction_type'] == 'refund';
    final amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    if (refund) {
      refunds[c] = refunds[c]! + amount;
    } else {
      charges[c] = charges[c]! + amount;
    }
    final type = switch (cardMovementType(
      tx['transaction_type'],
      tx['charge_kind'],
    )) {
      'purchase' => 'Compra',
      'interest' => 'Intereses',
      'fee' => 'ComisiÃ³n',
      'insurance' => 'Seguro de tarjeta',
      cardPointsRedemption => cardPointsRedemptionLabel,
      cardRebate => cardRebateLabel,
      _ => 'Reembolso',
    };
    rows.add([
      reportDate(date),
      if (showCardColumn)
        card == null
            ? reportCreditMovementCardLabel(
                cardsById['${tx['credit_card_id']}'] ?? const {},
                tx,
              )
            : _cardholderLabel(tx),
      type,
      '${tx['description'] ?? ''}',
      c == 'NIO' ? MoneyCell(refund ? -amount : amount) : null,
      c == 'USD' ? MoneyCell(refund ? -amount : amount) : null,
      '${tx['reference'] ?? ''}',
    ]);
  }
  return ExportReport(
    title: 'Gastos de tarjetas de crÃ©dito',
    period: '${reportDate(start)} al ${reportDate(end)}',
    scopeLabel: scopeLabel,
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    tables: [
      ReportTable('Gastos y devoluciones', [
        'Fecha',
        if (showCardColumn) 'Tarjeta',
        'Tipo',
        'DescripciÃ³n',
        'Importe C\$',
        'Importe \$',
        'Referencia',
      ], rows),
    ],
    totals: [
      for (final c in ['NIO', 'USD'])
        if (currency == 'all' || c == currency) ...[
          ReportTotal(c, 'Gastos', charges[c]!),
          ReportTotal(c, 'Devoluciones', refunds[c]!),
          ReportTotal(c, 'Gasto neto', charges[c]! - refunds[c]!),
        ],
    ],
    notes: const [
      'Pagos de tarjeta y prÃ©stamos desde tarjeta se excluyen del gasto. Cada compra se cuenta una vez. Los reembolsos restan. Las monedas se presentan separadas.',
    ],
  );
}

  final additional = movement['credit_card_additionals'];
  if (additional is Map)
    return 'Adicional Â· ${additionalCardLabel(additional)}';
  return movement['additional_card_id'] == null
      ? 'Titular'
      : 'Adicional sin identificar';
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

typedef CardSpending = ({
  String cardId,
  String label,
  String bank,
  String tier,
  ExchangeRate? cardExchangeRate,
  String currency,
  int cents,
});

/// Gastos de tarjeta vigentes, descontando devoluciones y sin sumar pagos.
int cardSpendingCents(Map<String, dynamic> movement) {
  if (movement['is_voided'] == true ||
      movement['is_receivable_funding'] == true) {
    return 0;
  }
  return switch (movement['transaction_type']) {
    'purchase' || 'interest' || 'fee' => moneyCents(movement['amount']),
    'refund' => -moneyCents(movement['amount']),
    _ => 0,
  };
}

List<CardSpending> cardSpendingForPeriod({
  required Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> cards,
  required Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> movements,
  required DateTime start,
  required DateTime end,
}) {
  final cardsById = {for (final card in cards) card['id'].toString(): card};
  final ratesByCardId = {
    for (final entry in cardsById.entries)
      entry.key: ExchangeRate.tryParse(
        entry.value['limit_exchange_rate']?.toString() ?? '',
      ),
  };
  final totals = <(String, String), int>{
    for (final id in cardsById.keys)
      for (final currency in ['NIO', 'USD']) (id, currency): 0,
  };
  for (final movement in movements) {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse(
      '${movement['transaction_date']}',
    )?.toLocal();
    if (date == null || !includesDay(date, start, end)) continue;
    final cardId = movement['credit_card_id']?.toString();
    final currency = movement['currency']?.toString();
    if (cardId == null || (currency != 'USD' && currency != 'NIO')) continue;
    final cents = cardSpendingCents(movement);
    if (cents == 0) continue;
    final key = (cardId, currency!);
    totals.update(key, (amount) => amount + cents, ifAbsent: () => cents);
  }
  return totals.entries.map((entry) {
    final (id, currency) = entry.key;
    final card = cardsById[id];
    final institution = card?['financial_institutions'];
    final tier = card?['card_tier']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    final product = card?['card_product']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    return (
      cardId: id,
      label: card == null
          ? 'Tarjeta no disponible'
          : agendaCardLabel(card, includeName: false),
      bank: institution is Map ? institution['name']?.toString() ?? '' : '',
      tier: tier.isEmpty || tier == 'unspecified'
          ? product.split('_').last
          : tier,
      currency: currency,
      cents: entry.value,
      cardExchangeRate: ratesByCardId[id],
    );
  }).toList();
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

DateTime calendarDay(DateTime value) =>
    DateTime.utc(value.year, value.month, value.day);
DateTime? statementDate(dynamic value) {
  final date = DateTime.tryParse('$value')?.toLocal();
  return date == null ? null : DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day);
}

String shortStatementDate(dynamic value) {
  final d = statementDate(value);
  return d == null
      ? 'Sin fecha'
      : '${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.year}';
}

int daysUntil(DateTime date, DateTime today) =>
    calendarDay(date).difference(calendarDay(today)).inDays;
DateTime nextCalendarDay(int day, DateTime today) {
  DateTime inMonth(int y, int m) {
    final last = DateTime(y, m + 1, 0).day;
    return DateTime(y, m, day.clamp(1, last).toInt());
  }

  final current = inMonth(today.year, today.month);
  return daysUntil(current, today) >= 0
      ? current
      : inMonth(today.year, today.month + 1);
}

bool isCurrentStatement(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
    row['is_archived'] != true && row['is_voided'] != true;

/// Pairs separately saved currencies when they describe the same cut.
/// Each row keeps its own ID for payments, edits and existing documents.
List<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> groupCardStatements(
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> rows,
) {
  final documents = <(Object?, Object?), List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
  for (final row in rows) {
    final key = (row['credit_card_id'], row['statement_group_id'] ?? row['id']);
    documents.putIfAbsent(key, () => []).add(row);
  }

  final result = <List<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
  final byDates =
      <(Object?, Object?, Object?, Object?), List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
  for (final group in documents.values) {
    final row = group.first;
    if (group.length != 1 ||
        row['is_voided'] == true ||
        (row['currency'] != 'NIO' && row['currency'] != 'USD')) {
      result.add(group);
      continue;
    }
    final dates = (
      row['credit_card_id'],
      row['closing_date'],
      row['due_date'],
      row['bonus_payment_date'],
    );
    byDates.putIfAbsent(dates, () => []).add(row);
  }
  for (final candidates in byDates.values) {
    if (candidates.length == 2 &&
        candidates.first['currency'] != candidates.last['currency']) {
      result.add(candidates);
    } else {
      result.addAll(candidates.map((row) => [row]));
    }
  }
  for (final group in result) {
    group.sort((a, b) => '${a['currency']}'.compareTo('${b['currency']}'));
  }
  result.sort((a, b) {
    final byDate = '${b.first['closing_date']}'.compareTo(
      '${a.first['closing_date']}',
    );
    return byDate == 0
        ? '${a.first['id']}'.compareTo('${b.first['id']}')
        : byDate;
  });
  return result;
}

class StatementProgress {
  const StatementProgress({
    required this.statement,
    required this.paid,
    required this.remaining,
    required this.minimumRemaining,
    required this.known,
    this.balanceCredit = 0,
    this.minimumCredit = 0,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> statement;
  final int paid;
  final int balanceCredit, minimumCredit;
  final int? remaining, minimumRemaining;
  final bool known;
  int get balance => moneyCents(statement['balance_due']);
  int get adjustedBalance =>
      (balance - balanceCredit).clamp(0, balance).toInt();
  int get excessLinked => paid > adjustedBalance ? paid - adjustedBalance : 0;
  bool get settled => known && remaining == 0;
}

StatementProgress calculateStatementProgress(
  Map<String, dynamic> statement,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> links,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> payments, [
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> credits = const [],
]) {
  final byId = {for (final p in payments) '${p['id']}': p};
  var paid = 0, known = true;
  final seen = <String>{};
  for (final link in links) {
    if ('${link['statement_id']}' != '${statement['id']}') {
      continue;
    }
    final id = '${link['payment_id']}';
    if (!seen.add(id)) {
      continue;
    }
    final p = byId[id];
    if (p == null) {
      known = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (p['is_voided'] == true) {
      continue;
    }
    if (p['transaction_type'] != 'payment' ||
        p['currency'] != statement['currency'] ||
        '${p['credit_card_id']}' != '${statement['credit_card_id']}') {
      known = false;
      continue;
    }
    paid += moneyCents(p['amount']);
  }
  var balanceCredit = 0, minimumCredit = 0;
  final seenRefunds = <String>{};
  for (final c in credits) {
    if (c['is_removed'] == true ||
        '${c['statement_id']}' != '${statement['id']}')
      continue;
    final t = byId['${c['refund_id']}'];
    if (t == null) {
      known = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (t['is_voided'] == true) continue;
    final b = moneyCents(c['balance_credit']),
        m = moneyCents(c['minimum_credit']);
    if (!seenRefunds.add('${t['id']}') ||
        t['transaction_type'] != 'refund' ||
        t['currency'] != statement['currency'] ||
        '${t['credit_card_id']}' != '${statement['credit_card_id']}' ||
        b < 0 ||
        m < 0 ||
        b > moneyCents(t['amount']) ||
        m > moneyCents(t['amount'])) {
      known = false;
      continue;
    }
    balanceCredit += b;
    minimumCredit += m;
  }
  final balance = moneyCents(statement['balance_due']);
  final minimum = statement['minimum_due'] == null
      ? null
      : moneyCents(statement['minimum_due']);
  if (balanceCredit > balance ||
      (minimumCredit > 0 && (minimum == null || minimumCredit > minimum)))
    known = false;
  return StatementProgress(
    statement: statement,
    paid: paid,
    known: known,
    balanceCredit: balanceCredit,
    minimumCredit: minimumCredit,
    remaining: known
        ? (balance - balanceCredit - paid).clamp(0, balance).toInt()
        : null,
    minimumRemaining: known && minimum != null
        ? (minimum - minimumCredit - paid).clamp(0, minimum).toInt()
        : null,
  );
}

class CardStatementData {
  const CardStatementData({
    required this.statements,
    required this.links,
    required this.payments,
    this.credits = const [],
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> statements, links, payments;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> credits;
  StatementProgress progress(Map<String, dynamic> s) =>
      calculateStatementProgress(s, links, payments, credits);
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> currentFor(String cardId, {String? currency}) =>
      statements
          .where(
            (s) =>
                '${s['credit_card_id']}' == cardId &&
                s['is_voided'] != true &&
                s['is_archived'] != true &&
                (currency == null || s['currency'] == currency),
          )
          .toList()
        ..sort((a, b) => '${a['currency']}'.compareTo('${b['currency']}'));
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> payableFor(String cardId, String currency) =>
      currentFor(cardId, currency: currency).where((s) {
        final p = progress(s);
        return p.known && !p.settled;
      }).toList();
}

import 'avanz_statement_import.dart';

typedef ImportedCardStatement = ({
  DateTime closing,
  DateTime? bonus,
  DateTime due,
  String? cardEnding,
  Map<String, ({int minimum, int? overdue, int balance})> amounts,
});

String? statementPdfBankName(String bank) => switch (bank) {
  'avanz' => 'Avanz',
  'bac' => 'BAC',
  'ficohsa' => 'Ficohsa',
  'lafise' => 'LAFISE',
  _ => null,
};

bool statementShowsOverdue(String bank) =>
    bank == 'avanz' || bank == 'ficohsa' || bank == 'lafise';

const _day = r'(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})';
const _bacDay = r'(\d{2}/(?:[a-z]{3}|\d{2})/(?:\d{4}|\d{2}))';
const _money = r'((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d*)\.\d{2})(?![\d.,-])';
const _plainPair = '$_money $_money';
const _currencyPair =
    r'c\$\s*'
    '$_money '
    r'(?:us)?\$\s*'
    '$_money';

ImportedCardStatement? parseCardStatementPdf(String bank, String text) {
  if (bank == 'avanz') return parseAvanzStatement(text);
  final source = text
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('Ã¡', 'a')
      .replaceAll('Ã©', 'e')
      .replaceAll('Ã­', 'i')
      .replaceAll('Ã³', 'o')
      .replaceAll('Ãº', 'u')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\s\u00a0]+'), ' ')
      .trim();
  return switch (bank) {
    'bac' => _parseBac(source),
    'ficohsa' => _parseFicohsa(source),
    'lafise' => _parseLafise(source),
    _ => null,
  };
}

ImportedCardStatement? _parseBac(String source) {
  final account = RegExp(
    r'^estado de cuenta numero de cuenta [x*]+(\d{4})\b',
  ).firstMatch(source);
  final payments = RegExp(
    'fecha de corte $_bacDay (?:fecha limite para bonificar $_bacDay )?'
    'fecha limite para pagar $_bacDay cordobas dolares '
    'pago minimo $_currencyPair pago de contado $_currencyPair credito disponible ',
  ).firstMatch(source);
  if (account == null || payments == null) return null;
  return _statement(
    dates: payments,
    closing: 1,
    bonus: 2,
    due: 3,
    payments: payments,
    minimum: 4,
    balance: 6,
    cardEnding: account[1],
  );
}

ImportedCardStatement? _parseFicohsa(String source) {
  if (!source.startsWith('estado de cuenta ficohsa ') ||
      !source.contains('www.ficohsa.ni')) {
    return null;
  }
  final period = RegExp(
    'periodo: desde: $_day hasta: $_day ',
  ).firstMatch(source);
  final payments = RegExp(
    'pago de contado: $_currencyPair pago minimo: $_currencyPair '
    '(?:pago atrasado: $_currencyPair )?'
    r'\*?\s*'
    'fecha maxima de pago: $_day ',
  ).firstMatch(source);
  if (period == null || payments == null || _date(period[1]) == null)
    return null;
  final ending = RegExp(r'\bcuenta: [x*]+(\d{4})\b').firstMatch(source)?[1];
  return _statement(
    dates: period,
    closing: 2,
    due: 7,
    dueMatch: payments,
    payments: payments,
    minimum: 3,
    balance: 1,
    overdue: 5,
    cardEnding: ending,
  );
}

ImportedCardStatement? _parseLafise(String source) {
  // En el texto de la primera pÃ¡gina, PDFium separa los encabezados de sus valores.
  final dates = RegExp(
    r'^tit\.de cuenta: no\.de cuenta: modelo liquidacion: fecha de corte: '
    r'fecha lim\. de pago: estado de cuenta hoja: 1 tipo de tarjeta: .+? '
    r'tipo de tasa de interes: (?:fija|variable) \d+ '
    '$_day $_day ',
  ).firstMatch(source);
  final payments = RegExp(
    'cordobas dolares saldo actual $_money (?:$_money )?'
    'pago de contado (?:$_money )?$_plainPair '
    'pago minimo $_plainPair porcion principal pago minimo ',
  ).firstMatch(source);
  if (dates == null || payments == null) return null;
  final overdue = RegExp(
    r'\(\s*\d+\s*\)\s*pago\(s\) vencido\(s\) '
    '$_plainPair tasa de int\\. corriente anual',
  ).firstMatch(source);
  final endings = RegExp(
    r'\b[x*]{8,}(\d{4})\b',
  ).allMatches(source).map((match) => match[1]!).toSet();
  return _statement(
    dates: dates,
    closing: 1,
    due: 2,
    payments: payments,
    minimum: 6,
    balance: 4,
    overdue: overdue == null ? null : 1,
    overdueMatch: overdue,
    cardEnding: endings.length == 1 ? endings.single : null,
  );
}

DateTime? _date(String? text) {
  if (text == null) return null;
  const months = {
    'ene': 1,
    'jan': 1,
    'feb': 2,
    'mar': 3,
    'abr': 4,
    'apr': 4,
    'may': 5,
    'jun': 6,
    'jul': 7,
    'ago': 8,
    'aug': 8,
    'sep': 9,
    'oct': 10,
    'nov': 11,
    'dic': 12,
    'dec': 12,
  };
  final parts = text.split('/');
  final day = int.parse(parts[0]);
  final month = int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? months[parts[1]];
  final year = int.parse(parts[2]) + (parts[2].length == 2 ? 2000 : 0);
  if (month == null || year < 1900 || year > 2200) return null;
  final date = DateTime(year, month, day);
  return date.year == year && date.month == month && date.day == day
      ? date
      : null;
}

int? _cents(String? text) =>
    text == null ? null : int.tryParse(text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[,.]'), ''));

ImportedCardStatement? _statement({
  required RegExpMatch dates,
  required int closing,
  required int due,
  required RegExpMatch payments,
  required int minimum,
  required int balance,
  int? bonus,
  int? overdue,
  RegExpMatch? dueMatch,
  RegExpMatch? overdueMatch,
  String? cardEnding,
}) {
  final start = _date(dates[closing]);
  final end = _date((dueMatch ?? dates)[due]);
  final bonusText = bonus == null ? null : dates[bonus];
  final bonusDate = _date(bonusText);
  if (start == null ||
      end == null ||
      end.isBefore(start) ||
      (bonusText != null &&
          (bonusDate == null || !includesDay(bonusDate, start, end)))) {
    return null;
  }

  final amounts = <String, ({int minimum, int? overdue, int balance})>{};
  for (var index = 0; index < 2; index++) {
    final total = _cents(payments[balance + index]);
    final min = _cents(payments[minimum + index]);
    final lateText = overdue == null
        ? null
        : (overdueMatch ?? payments)[overdue + index];
    final late = _cents(lateText);
    if (total == null ||
        min == null ||
        min > total ||
        total > 99999999999999 ||
        (lateText != null && (late == null || late > 99999999999999))) {
      return null;
    }
    amounts[index == 0 ? 'NIO' : 'USD'] = (
      minimum: min,
      overdue: late,
      balance: total,
    );
  }
  return (
    closing: start,
    bonus: bonusDate,
    due: end,
    cardEnding: cardEnding,
    amounts: amounts,
  );
}

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> statementRows(
  String table,
  String columns,
  String userId, {
  String? cardId,
}) async {
  final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final order = table == 'credit_card_statement_payments' ? 'payment_id' : 'id';
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
    var query = supabase.from(table).select(columns).eq('user_id', userId);
    if (cardId != null) query = query.eq('credit_card_id', cardId);
    final result = await query.order(order).range(offset, offset + 499);
    final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
    rows.addAll(page);
    if (page.length < 500) {
      break;
    }
  }
  return rows;
}

Future<CardStatementData> loadCardStatements(String userId) async {
  final rows = await Future.wait([
    statementRows(
      'credit_card_statements',

      userId,
    ),
    statementRows(
      'credit_card_statement_payments',
      'payment_id,statement_id,user_id',
      userId,
    ),
    statementRows(
      'credit_card_transactions',
      'id,credit_card_id,transaction_type,amount,currency,transaction_date,reference,description,is_voided',
      userId,
    ),
    statementRows('credit_card_statement_credits', '*', userId),
  ]);
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Actualiza la pantalla.');
  }
  return CardStatementData(
    statements: rows[0],
    links: rows[1],
    payments: rows[2],
    credits: rows[3],
  );
}

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> loadUserCardExpenses(String userId) async {
  final expenses = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
    final result = await supabase
        .from('credit_card_transactions')
        .select(
          'id, transaction_type, charge_kind, amount, currency, transaction_date, created_at, category_id, description, reference, '
          'credit_cards(card_reference, financial_institutions(name))',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .eq('is_voided', false)
        .eq('is_receivable_funding', false)

        .range(offset, offset + 499);
    final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
    for (final tx in page) {
      final amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
      final card = tx['credit_cards'];
      expenses.add({
        'id': tx['id'],
        'transaction_type': 'expense',
        'amount':
            (tx['transaction_type'] == 'refund' ? -amount : amount) /
            moneyScale,
        'currency': tx['currency'],
        'transaction_date': tx['transaction_date'],
        'created_at': tx['created_at'],
        'category_id': tx['category_id'],
        'description': tx['description'],
        'reference': tx['reference'],
        'source': 'credit_card',
        'card_transaction_type': tx['transaction_type'],
        'charge_kind': tx['charge_kind'],
        'card_label': card is Map<String, dynamic>
            ? agendaCardLabel(card, includeName: false)
            : null,
      });
    }
    if (page.length < 500) break;
  }
  return expenses;
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

class InstallmentProgress {
  const InstallmentProgress({
    required this.installment,
    required this.paid,
    required this.remaining,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> installment;
  final int paid;
  final int? remaining;
  bool get settled => remaining == 0;
}

InstallmentProgress installmentProgress(
  Map<String, dynamic> i,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> links,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> payments,
) {
  final byId = {for (final p in payments) '${p['id']}': p};
  final seen = <String>{};
  var paid = 0, known = true;
  for (final link in links) {
    if ('${link['installment_id']}' != '${i['id']}' ||
        !seen.add('${link['payment_id']}')) {
      continue;
    }
    final p = byId['${link['payment_id']}'];
    if (p == null) {
      known = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (p['is_voided'] == true) {
      continue;
    }
    if ('${p['debt_id']}' != '${i['debt_id']}' ||
        p['currency'] != i['currency']) {
      known = false;
      continue;
    }
    paid += debtPaymentTotalCents(p);
  }
  final amount = moneyCents(i['amount']);
  return InstallmentProgress(
    installment: i,
    paid: paid,
    remaining: known ? (amount - paid).clamp(0, amount).toInt() : null,
  );
}

class DebtInstallmentData {
  const DebtInstallmentData({
    required this.installments,
    required this.links,
    required this.payments,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> installments, links, payments;
  InstallmentProgress progress(Map<String, dynamic> i) =>
      installmentProgress(i, links, payments);
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> currentFor(String debtId) =>
      installments
          .where(
            (i) =>
                '${i['debt_id']}' == debtId &&
                i['is_archived'] != true &&
                i['is_voided'] != true,
          )
          .toList()
        ..sort((a, b) {
          final d = '${a['due_date']}'.compareTo('${b['due_date']}');
          return d != 0 ? d : '${a['id']}'.compareTo('${b['id']}');
        });
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> payableFor(String debtId) =>
      currentFor(debtId).where((i) => !progress(i).settled).toList();
}

Future<DebtInstallmentData> loadDebtInstallments(String userId) async {
  final rows = await Future.wait([
    statementRows(
      'debt_installments',
      'id,user_id,debt_id,plan_id,number,due_date,currency,amount,notes,is_archived,is_voided',
      userId,
    ),
    _links(userId),
    statementRows(
      'debt_payments',
      'id,debt_id,account_id,currency,principal_amount,interest_amount,fee_amount,insurance_amount,payment_date,reference,is_voided',
      userId,
    ),
  ]);
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
  }
  return DebtInstallmentData(
    installments: rows[0],
    links: rows[1],
    payments: rows[2],
  );
}

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _links(String userId) async {
  final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
    final result = await supabase
        .from('debt_installment_payments')
        .select('payment_id,installment_id,user_id')
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('payment_id')
        .range(offset, offset + 499);
    final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
    rows.addAll(page);
    if (page.length < 500) {
      break;
    }
  }
  return rows;
}

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> loadUserDebtPayments(String userId) async {

        )

        .eq('is_voided', false)

List<Map<String, dynamic>> debtPaymentExpenses(
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> payments,
) {
  final expenses = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  for (final payment in payments) {
    final total = debtPaymentTotalCents(payment);
    if (total <= 0) continue;
    final debt = payment['debts'];
    final name = debt is Map ? debt['description']?.toString() ?? '' : '';
    expenses.add({
      'id': payment['id'],
      'transaction_type': 'expense',
      'amount': total / moneyScale,
      'currency': payment['currency'],
      'transaction_date': payment['payment_date'],
      'created_at': payment['created_at'],
      'category_id': null,
      'description': name.isEmpty ? 'Abono de deuda' : 'Abono de deuda: $name',
      'reference': payment['reference'],
      'source': 'debt_payment',
      'principal_amount': payment['principal_amount'],
      'interest_amount': payment['interest_amount'],
      'fee_amount': payment['fee_amount'],
      'insurance_amount': payment['insurance_amount'] ?? 0,
    });
  }
  return expenses;
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\data\exchange_rate.dart
// ==========================================
/// Tasa manual: cÃ³rdobas por un dÃ³lar, con hasta seis decimales.
/// Se usa BigInt para redondear centavos sin errores de coma flotante.
class ExchangeRate {
  ExchangeRate._(this.micros);
  final int micros;

  static ExchangeRate? tryParse(String text) {
    final normalized = text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.');
    if (!RegExp(r'^\d{1,7}(\.\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(normalized)) {
      return null;
    }
    final parts = normalized.split('.');
    final whole = int.parse(parts.first);
    final fraction = parts.length == 1
        ? 0
        : int.parse(parts[1].padRight(6, '0'));
    final value = whole * 1000000 + fraction;
    if (value <= 0 || value > 1000000 * 1000000) {
      return null;
    }
    return ExchangeRate._(value);
  }

  String get decimal {
    final whole = micros ~/ 1000000;
    final fraction = (micros % 1000000)
        .toString()
        .padLeft(6, '0')
        .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'0+$'), '');
    return fraction.isEmpty ? '$whole' : '$whole.$fraction';
  }

  int convert(int cents, String from, String to) {
    if (!['NIO', 'USD'].contains(from) || !['NIO', 'USD'].contains(to)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Solo se admiten NIO y USD.');
    }
    if (from == to) {
      return cents;
    }
    final amount = BigInt.from(cents);
    final rate = BigInt.from(micros);
    final scale = BigInt.from(1000000);
    final numerator = from == 'USD' ? amount * rate : amount * scale;
    final denominator = from == 'USD' ? scale : rate;
    final absolute = numerator.abs();
    final rounded = (absolute + denominator ~/ BigInt.from(2)) ~/ denominator;
    final signed = numerator.isNegative ? -rounded : rounded;
    // Dart web almacena los int como nÃºmeros JS: conservar precisiÃ³n exacta.
    if (signed.abs() > BigInt.parse('9007199254740991')) {
      throw StateError('El importe convertido excede el rango de precisiÃ³n.');
    }
    return signed.toInt();
  }
}

const expenseReportCategoryLabels = {
  'debt_costs': 'Abonos de deuda',
  'card_purchases': 'Compras de tarjeta',
  'card_interest': 'Intereses de tarjeta',
  'card_fees': 'Comisiones y cargos de tarjeta',
  'card_insurance': 'Seguros de tarjeta',
  'card_refunds': 'Devoluciones de tarjeta',
  'card_other': 'Otros gastos de tarjeta',
  'uncategorized': 'Sin categorÃ­a',
};

bool isCardInsuranceExpense(Map<String, dynamic> expense) =>
    expense['expense_kind'] == 'card_insurance' ||
    (expense['source'] == 'credit_card' &&
        expense['charge_kind'] == 'insurance');

String expenseReportCategoryKey(Map<String, dynamic> expense) {
  if (expense['source'] == 'debt_payment') return 'debt_costs';

  final assigned = expense['category_id']?.toString().trim();
  if (assigned != null && assigned.isNotEmpty) return assigned;

  if (isCardInsuranceExpense(expense)) return 'card_insurance';
  if (expense['source'] != 'credit_card') return 'uncategorized';

  return switch (expense['card_transaction_type']) {
    'purchase' => 'card_purchases',
    'interest' => 'card_interest',
    'fee' => 'card_fees',
    'refund' => 'card_refunds',
    _ => 'card_other',
  };
}

class ExportMovement {
  const ExportMovement({
    required this.date,
    required this.values,
    required this.currency,
    required this.categoryId,
    required this.income,
    required this.expense,
    required this.unknown,
  });
  final DateTime date;
  final List<Object?> values;
  final String currency;
  final String? categoryId;
  final int income, expense;
  final bool unknown;
}

String reportDate(DateTime date) =>
    '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';
bool inReportRange(DateTime date, DateTime start, DateTime end) =>
    daysUntil(date, start) >= 0 && daysUntil(date, end) <= 0;
String _lookup(
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows,
  dynamic id,
  String key,
  String fallback,
) {
  for (final row in rows) {
    if ('${row['id']}' == '$id') {
      return row[key]?.toString() ?? fallback;
    }
  }
  return fallback;
}

List<ExportMovement> normalizeExportMovements({
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> accountMovements,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> cardMovements,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> debtPayments,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> debts,
}) {
  final result = <ExportMovement>[];
  void add(
    Map<String, dynamic> row,
    String type,
    String account,
    int amount,
    int income,
    int expense, {
    bool unknown = false,
    String? description,
  }) {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse(
      '${row['transaction_date'] ?? row['payment_date']}',
    )?.toLocal();
    if (date == null) {
      throw FormatException('Hay un movimiento con fecha invÃ¡lida.');
    }
    final currency = '${row['currency']}';
    if (!['NIO', 'USD'].contains(currency)) {
      throw StateError('Moneda no admitida: $currency');
    }
    final category = row['category_id']?.toString();
    result.add(
      ExportMovement(
        date: date,
        currency: currency,
        categoryId: category,
        income: income,
        expense: expense,
        unknown: unknown,
        values: [
          reportDate(date),
          type,
          account,
          _lookup(categories, category, 'name', 'Sin categorÃ­a'),
          description ?? row['description']?.toString() ?? '',
          currency,
          MoneyCell(amount),
          row['reference']?.toString() ?? '',
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  const native = {
    'income': 'Ingreso',
    'expense': 'Gasto',
    'transfer': 'Transferencia',
    'deposit': 'DepÃ³sito',
    'withdrawal': 'Retiro',
  };
  for (final tx in accountMovements) {
    if (tx['is_voided'] == true) {
      continue;
    }
    final type = '${tx['transaction_type']}', amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    var account = _lookup(
      accounts,
      tx['account_id'],
      'name',
      'Cuenta no disponible',
    );
    if (type == 'transfer') {
      account +=
          ' â†’ ${_lookup(accounts, tx['destination_account_id'], 'name', 'Cuenta no disponible')}';
    }
    add(
      tx,
      tx['expense_kind'] == 'card_insurance'
          ? 'Seguro de tarjeta'
          : native[type] ?? 'Movimiento por revisar',
      account,
      amount,
      type == 'income' ? amount : 0,
      type == 'expense' ? amount : 0,
      unknown: !native.containsKey(type),
      description: tx['destination_amount'] == null
          ? null
          : '${tx['description'] ?? ''} Â· Recibido: ${formatMoneyCents(moneyCents(tx['destination_amount']), '${tx['destination_currency']}')} Â· Tasa C\$ ${tx['exchange_rate']} por \$1',
    );
  }
  const cardTypes = {
    cardCashAdvance: cardCashAdvanceLabel,
    'purchase': 'Compra con tarjeta',
    'refund': 'DevoluciÃ³n de tarjeta',
    'insurance': 'Seguro de tarjeta',
    cardPointsRedemption: cardPointsRedemptionLabel,
    cardRebate: cardRebateLabel,
    'interest': 'Intereses de tarjeta',
    'fee': 'ComisiÃ³n de tarjeta',
    'payment': 'Pago de tarjeta',
  };
  for (final tx in cardMovements) {
    if (tx['is_voided'] == true) {
      continue;
    }
    final type = '${tx['transaction_type']}', amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    final funding = tx['is_receivable_funding'] == true;
    final expense = funding || type == 'payment'
        ? 0
        : type == 'refund'
        ? -amount
        : isCardCashAdvance(tx)
        ? cardCashAdvanceFee(tx)
        : ['purchase', 'interest', 'fee'].contains(type)
        ? amount
        : 0;
    add(
      tx,
      funding
          ? 'PrÃ©stamo desde tarjeta'
          : cardTypes[cardMovementType(type, tx['charge_kind'])] ??
                'Ajuste de tarjeta por revisar',
      _lookup(cards, tx['credit_card_id'], 'name', 'Tarjeta no disponible'),
      type == 'refund' ? -amount : amount,
      0,
      expense,
      unknown: !cardTypes.containsKey(type),
      description: isCardCashAdvance(tx)
          ? '${tx['description'] ?? ''} Â· ${cardCashAdvanceBreakdown(tx)}'
          : type == 'payment' && tx['account_debit_amount'] != null
          ? '${tx['description'] ?? ''} Â· DÃ©bito de cuenta: ${formatMoneyCents(moneyCents(tx['account_debit_amount']), '${tx['account_debit_currency']}')}'
                '${tx['payment_exchange_rate'] == null ? '' : ' Â· Tasa C\$ ${tx['payment_exchange_rate']} por \$1'}'
          : null,
    );
  }
  for (final p in debtPayments) {
    if (p['is_voided'] == true) {
      continue;
    }
    final currency = '${p['currency']}';
    final capital = moneyCents(p['principal_amount']),
        interest = moneyCents(p['interest_amount']),
        fee = moneyCents(p['fee_amount']);
    final debt = _lookup(
      debts,
      p['debt_id'],
      'description',
      'PrÃ©stamo no disponible',
    );
    add(
      p,
      'Abono de prÃ©stamo',
      p['account_id'] == null
          ? 'Registro manual'
          : _lookup(accounts, p['account_id'], 'name', 'Cuenta no disponible'),
      capital + interest + fee,
      0,
      interest + fee,
      description:
          '$debt Â· Capital: ${formatMoneyCents(capital, currency)}; '
          'intereses: ${formatMoneyCents(interest, currency)}; seguro: ${formatMoneyCents(moneyCents(p['insurance_amount'] ?? 0), currency)}; otros cargos: ${formatMoneyCents(fee - moneyCents(p['insurance_amount'] ?? 0), currency)}',
    );
  }
  result.sort((a, b) => b.date.compareTo(a.date));
  return result;
}

enum IncomeExpenseSelection { both, income, expenses }

ExportReport movementsReport(
  List<ExportMovement> all,
  DateTime start,
  DateTime end,
  String currency,
  DateTime generatedAt, {
  IncomeExpenseSelection selection = IncomeExpenseSelection.both,
}) {
  final rows = all
      .where(
        (m) =>
            (currency == 'all' || m.currency == currency) &&
            inReportRange(m.date, start, end) &&
            ((selection != IncomeExpenseSelection.expenses && m.income != 0) ||
                (selection != IncomeExpenseSelection.income && m.expense != 0)),
      )
      .toList();
  final totals = <ReportTotal>[];
  for (final c in ['NIO', 'USD']) {
    if (currency != 'all' && currency != c) {
      continue;
    }
    final selected = rows.where((m) => m.currency == c);
    var income = 0, expense = 0;
    for (final row in selected) {
      income += row.income;
      expense += row.expense;
    }
    totals.addAll([
      if (selection != IncomeExpenseSelection.expenses)
        ReportTotal(c, 'Ingresos', income),
      if (selection != IncomeExpenseSelection.income)
        ReportTotal(c, 'Gasto neto', expense),
      if (selection == IncomeExpenseSelection.both)
        ReportTotal(c, 'Ingresos menos gastos', income - expense),
    ]);
  }
  rows.sort((a, b) => a.date.compareTo(b.date));
  return ExportReport(
    title: switch (selection) {
      IncomeExpenseSelection.both => 'Ingresos y gastos',
      IncomeExpenseSelection.income => 'Ingresos',
      IncomeExpenseSelection.expenses => 'Gastos',
    },
    period: '${reportDate(start)} al ${reportDate(end)}',
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    tables: [
      ReportTable(
        'Detalle',
        const [
          'Fecha',
          'Tipo',
          'Cuenta / tarjeta',
          'CategorÃ­a',
          'DescripciÃ³n',
          'Moneda',
          'Monto',
          'Referencia',
        ],
        [
          for (final row in rows)
            [
              ...row.values.take(6),
              MoneyCell(switch (selection) {
                IncomeExpenseSelection.both => row.income + row.expense,
                IncomeExpenseSelection.income => row.income,
                IncomeExpenseSelection.expenses => row.expense,
              }),
              row.values[7],
            ],
        ],
      ),
    ],
    totals: totals,
    notes: [
      'Los totales separan NIO y USD; no se convierten ni se suman monedas diferentes.',
      'Pagos de tarjeta y capital de prÃ©stamos no se vuelven a contar como gasto. Los intereses y comisiones pagados sÃ­ se incluyen. Las transferencias y prÃ©stamos por cobrar no se consideran ingresos o gastos personales.',
    ],
  );
}

/// Uses the same normalized source as movements, excluding linked account
/// entries in the repository so a loan payment appears only once.
ExportReport consolidatedExpensesReport(
  List<ExportMovement> all,
  DateTime start,
  DateTime end,
  String currency,
  DateTime generatedAt,
) {
  final expenses = movementsReport(
    all,
    start,
    end,
    currency,
    generatedAt,
    selection: IncomeExpenseSelection.expenses,
  );
  final capital = all
      .where(
        (m) =>
            m.values[1] == 'Abono de prÃ©stamo' &&
            (currency == 'all' || m.currency == currency) &&
            inReportRange(m.date, start, end),
      )
      .toList();
  int principal(ExportMovement m) =>
      (m.values[6] as MoneyCell).cents - m.expense;
  return ExportReport(
    title: 'Gastos consolidados',
    period: expenses.period,
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    tables: [
      ...expenses.tables,
      if (capital.isNotEmpty)
        ReportTable(
          'Capital de cuotas y prÃ©stamos',
          const ['Fecha', 'Cuenta', 'Detalle', 'Moneda', 'Capital pagado'],
          [
            for (final m in capital)
              [
                m.values[0],
                m.values[2],
                m.values[4],
                m.currency,
                MoneyCell(principal(m)),
              ],
          ],
        ),
    ],
    totals: [
      for (final c in ['USD', 'NIO'])
        if (currency == 'all' || currency == c) ...[
          ReportTotal(
            c,
            'Gasto neto total',
            expenses.totals
                .where((t) => t.currency == c)
                .fold(0, (n, t) => n + t.cents),
          ),
          ReportTotal(
            c,
            'Capital de cuotas y prÃ©stamos (separado)',
            capital
                .where((m) => m.currency == c)
                .fold(0, (n, m) => n + principal(m)),
          ),
        ],
    ],
    notes: [
      ...expenses.notes,
      'Incluye gastos de cuentas y efectivo, compras de todas las tarjetas, cargos, seguros e intereses; las devoluciones restan. Los movimientos anulados se excluyen.',
      'Los pagos de tarjeta no se suman: la compra ya se contÃ³ en su fecha. Las compras financiadas se cuentan al registrarlas; sus pagos no vuelven a sumarse.',
      'El capital pagado de cuotas y prÃ©stamos se muestra separado del gasto. Sus intereses y cargos sÃ­ forman parte del gasto neto.',
      'Los gastos fijos previstos y ajustes del mes no son movimientos reales y no se suman. Registra su pago una sola vez en Movimientos.',
      'No se detectan duplicados ingresados manualmente como registros independientes: usa los pagos y vÃ­nculos de la aplicaciÃ³n.',
    ],
  );
}

ExportReport debtsReport({
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> debts,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> payments,
  required DebtInstallmentData installments,
  required String currency,
  required DateTime generatedAt,
}) {
  final rows = <List<Object?>>[], quotas = <List<Object?>>[];
  final totals = <ReportTotal>[];
  final sums = <String, int>{'NIO': 0, 'USD': 0};
  const status = {
    'active': 'Activa',
    'overdue': 'Vencida',
    'paused': 'Pausada',
    'paid': 'Pagada',
    'cancelled': 'Cancelada',
  };
  for (final debt in debts) {
    if (currency != 'all' && debt['currency'] != currency) {
      continue;
    }
    final c = '${debt['currency']}';
    var paid = 0;
    for (final p in payments) {
      if ('${p['debt_id']}' == '${debt['id']}' && p['is_voided'] != true) {
        if (p['currency'] != c) {
          throw StateError('Un abono tiene moneda diferente al prÃ©stamo.');
        }
        paid += moneyCents(p['principal_amount']);
      }
    }
    final original = moneyCents(debt['original_amount']),
        pending = debt['status'] == 'paid' ? 0 : original - paid;
    if (pending < 0) {
      throw StateError('Los abonos superan el capital de un prÃ©stamo.');
    }
    if (debt['status'] != 'cancelled') {
      sums[c] = (sums[c] ?? 0) + pending;
    }
    rows.add([
      debt['description'] ?? '',
      debt['creditor_name'] ?? '',
      c,
      MoneyCell(original, isTotal: true),
      MoneyCell(paid, isTotal: true),
      MoneyCell(pending, isTotal: true),
      status[debt['status']] ?? '${debt['status']}',
      debt['due_date'] == null
          ? 'Sin fecha'
          : shortStatementDate(debt['due_date']),
    ]);
    for (final i in installments.currentFor('${debt['id']}')) {
      final p = installments.progress(i);
      quotas.add([
        debt['description'] ?? '',
        i['number'],
        shortStatementDate(i['due_date']),
        c,
        MoneyCell(moneyCents(i['amount'])),
        MoneyCell(p.paid, isTotal: true),
        p.remaining == null
            ? 'Por revisar'
            : MoneyCell(p.remaining!, isTotal: true),
        p.settled ? 'Cubierta' : 'Pendiente',
      ]);
    }
  }
  for (final c in ['NIO', 'USD']) {
    if (currency == 'all' || currency == c) {
      totals.add(
        ReportTotal(c, 'Capital pendiente no cancelado', sums[c] ?? 0),
      );
    }
  }
  return ExportReport(
    title: 'Deudas y cuotas',
    period: 'Saldos actuales al ${reportDate(generatedAt)}',
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    tables: [
      ReportTable('Prestamos', const [
        'PrÃ©stamo',
        'Acreedor',
        'Moneda',
        'Capital original',
        'Abonado a capital',
        'Capital pendiente',
        'Estado',
        'Vencimiento',
      ], rows),
      ReportTable('Cuotas', const [
        'PrÃ©stamo',
        'Cuota',
        'Vencimiento',
        'Moneda',
        'Programado',
        'Abonado',
        'Pendiente',
        'Estado',
      ], quotas),
      ReportTable(
        'Desglose de abonos',
        const [
          'Fecha',
          'PrÃ©stamo',
          'Moneda',
          'Capital',
          'Intereses',
          'Seguro',
          'Otros cargos',
          'Total',
        ],
        [
          for (final p in payments)
            if (p['is_voided'] != true &&
                (currency == 'all' || p['currency'] == currency))
              [
                shortStatementDate(p['payment_date']),
                _lookup(
                  debts,
                  p['debt_id'],
                  'description',
                  'PrÃ©stamo no disponible',
                ),
                '${p['currency']}',
                MoneyCell(moneyCents(p['principal_amount'])),
                MoneyCell(moneyCents(p['interest_amount'])),
                MoneyCell(moneyCents(p['insurance_amount'] ?? 0)),
                MoneyCell(
                  moneyCents(p['fee_amount']) -
                      moneyCents(p['insurance_amount'] ?? 0),
                ),
                MoneyCell(debtPaymentTotalCents(p), isTotal: true),
              ],
        ],
      ),
    ],
    totals: totals,
    notes: const [
      'Los saldos son actuales, no una reconstrucciÃ³n histÃ³rica. Las deudas canceladas se muestran pero no integran el total pendiente.',
      'Las cuotas son pagos programados y pueden incluir intereses, seguro y otros cargos; no se suman de nuevo al capital pendiente. Si un prÃ©stamo figura pagado con capital restante, revisa su historial.',
    ],
  );
}

ExportReport budgetsReport({
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> budgets,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories,
  required List<ExportMovement> movements,
  required DateTime month,
  required String currency,
  required DateTime generatedAt,
}) {
  final rows = <List<Object?>>[], totals = <ReportTotal>[];
  final limits = <String, int>{}, expenses = <String, int>{};
  final counted = <String>{};
  for (final b in budgets) {
    final from = budgetStart(b), until = budgetEnd(b);
    if (until.isBefore(DateTime(month.year, month.month)) ||
        from.isAfter(DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1, 0)) ||
        (currency != 'all' && b['currency'] != currency)) {
      continue;
    }
    final c = '${b['currency']}',
        limit = moneyCents(b['budget_amount']),
        spent = movements
            .where(
              (m) =>
                  m.categoryId == b['category_id'] &&
                  m.currency == c &&
                  includesDay(m.date, from, until),
            )
            .fold<int>(0, (total, m) => total + m.expense);
    limits[c] = (limits[c] ?? 0) + limit;
    if (counted.add('${b['id']}')) {
      expenses[c] = (expenses[c] ?? 0) + spent;
    }
    rows.add([
      _lookup(categories, b['category_id'], 'name', 'CategorÃ­a no disponible'),
      '${reportDate(from)} al ${reportDate(until)}',
      c,
      MoneyCell(limit, isTotal: true),
      MoneyCell(spent, isTotal: true),
      MoneyCell(limit - spent, isTotal: true),
      spent > limit ? 'Excedido' : 'Dentro del lÃ­mite',
    ]);
  }
  for (final c in ['NIO', 'USD']) {
    if (currency == 'all' || currency == c) {
      totals.addAll([
        ReportTotal(c, 'Presupuestado', limits[c] ?? 0),
        ReportTotal(c, 'Gasto de categorÃ­as presupuestadas', expenses[c] ?? 0),
        ReportTotal(
          c,
          'Disponible neto',
          (limits[c] ?? 0) - (expenses[c] ?? 0),
        ),
      ]);
    }
  }
  return ExportReport(
    title: 'Presupuestos',
    period: '${month.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${month.year}',
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    tables: [
      ReportTable('Presupuestos', const [
        'CategorÃ­a',
        'PerÃ­odo',
        'Moneda',
        'LÃ­mite',
        'Gasto neto',
        'Disponible',
        'Estado',
      ], rows),
    ],
    totals: totals,
    notes: const [
      'Incluye presupuestos que coinciden con el mes seleccionado. El gasto de cada presupuesto corresponde a todas sus fechas. Descuenta devoluciones. Importes originales, sin conversiÃ³n de monedas.',
    ],
  );
}

import '../core/supabase_client.dart';
import 'card_export_reports.dart';
import 'credit_card_additional_repository.dart';
