Future<ExportReport> loadExportReport({
  required String kind,
  IncomeExpenseSelection selection = IncomeExpenseSelection.both,
  String? cardId,
  String? additionalCardFilter,
  String? accountId,
  required String currency,
  required DateTime start,
  required DateTime end,
  required DateTime month,
}) async {
  final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  if (uid == null) {
    throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
  }
  if (!['all', 'NIO', 'USD'].contains(currency) ||
      ![
        'movements',
        'consolidated_expenses',
        'debts',
        'budgets',
        'credit_cards',
        'credit_card_expenses',
        'accounts',
        'debit_cards',
      ].contains(kind)) {
    throw ArgumentError('Tipo de reporte o moneda invÃ¡lidos.');
  }
  if (kind == 'credit_card_expenses') {
    final values = await Future.wait([
      statementRows('credit_cards', '*,financial_institutions(name)', uid),
      statementRows(
        'credit_card_transactions',
        '*,credit_card_additionals(holder_name,last_four)',
        uid,
      ),
      if (cardId != null && additionalCardFilter?.isNotEmpty == true)
        loadAdditionalCards(cardId, uid),
    ]);
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
    }
    return creditCardExpensesExport(
      cards: values[0],
      movements: values[1],
      start: start,
      end: end,
      generatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      currency: currency,
      cardId: cardId,
      additionalCardFilter: additionalCardFilter,
      additionalCard: values.length == 3
          ? values[2]
                .where((card) => card['id']?.toString() == additionalCardFilter)
                .firstOrNull
          : null,
    );
  }
  if (['credit_cards', 'debit_cards', 'accounts'].contains(kind)) {
    final credit = kind == 'credit_cards';
    final values = await Future.wait([
      statementRows(
        credit ? 'credit_cards' : 'debit_cards',
        kind == 'accounts' ? '*' : '*,financial_institutions(name)',
        uid,
      ),
      statementRows(
        'accounts',
        kind == 'debit_cards'
            ? 'id,name,currency,opening_balance,financial_institutions(name)'
            : 'id,name,currency,opening_balance',
        uid,
      ),
      loadUserTransactions(uid),
      statementRows(
        'credit_card_transactions',
        credit ? '*,credit_card_additionals(holder_name,last_four)' : '*',
        uid,
      ),
      statementRows('debt_payments', '*', uid),
    ]);
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid)
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
    return credit
        ? creditCardsExport(
            cards: values[0],
            movements: values[3],
            start: start,
            end: end,
            generatedAt: DateTime.now(),
            currency: currency,
            cardId: cardId,
          )
        : debitCardsExport(
            cards: values[0],
            accounts: values[1],
            transactions: values[2],
            cardPayments: values[3]
                .where((p) => p['transaction_type'] == 'payment')
                .toList(),
            debtPayments: values[4],
            start: start,
            end: end,
            generatedAt: DateTime.now(),
            currency: currency,
            cardId: cardId,
            accountId: accountId,
            allAccounts: kind == 'accounts',
            selection: kind == 'accounts'
                ? selection
                : IncomeExpenseSelection.both,
          );
  }
  if (kind == 'debts') {
    final values = await Future.wait<Object>([
      statementRows(
        'debts',
        'id,description,creditor_name,currency,original_amount,status,due_date',
        uid,
      ),
      loadDebtInstallments(uid),
    ]);
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
    }
    final data = values[1] as DebtInstallmentData;
    return debtsReport(
      debts: values[0] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>,
      payments: data.payments,
      installments: data,
      currency: currency,
      generatedAt: DateTime.now(),
    );
  }
  final data = await loadIncomeExpenseData(
    includeBudgets: kind == 'budgets',
    userId: uid,
  );
  if (kind == 'consolidated_expenses') {
    return consolidatedExpensesReport(
      data.movements,
      start,
      end,
      currency,
      DateTime.now(),
    );
  }
  return kind == 'movements'
      ? movementsReport(
          data.movements,
          start,
          end,
          currency,
          DateTime.now(),
          selection: selection,
        )
      : budgetsReport(
          budgets: data.budgets,
          categories: data.categories,
          movements: data.movements,
          month: month,
          currency: currency,
          generatedAt: DateTime.now(),
        );
}

Future<
  ({
    List<ExportMovement> movements,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> budgets,
  })
>
loadIncomeExpenseData({bool includeBudgets = false, String? userId}) async {
  final uid = userId ?? supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  if (uid == null || supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid) {
    throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
  }
  final values = await Future.wait([
    loadUserTransactions(uid),
    statementRows('accounts', 'id,name,currency', uid),
    statementRows('categories', 'id,name', uid),
    statementRows('credit_cards', 'id,name,currency', uid),
    statementRows(
      'credit_card_transactions',
      'id,credit_card_id,account_id,category_id,transaction_type,charge_kind,cash_advance_fee,amount,currency,transaction_date,description,reference,is_voided,is_receivable_funding,account_debit_amount,account_debit_currency,payment_exchange_rate',
      uid,
    ),
    statementRows('debts', 'id,description,currency', uid),
    statementRows(
      'debt_payments',
      'id,debt_id,account_id,principal_amount,interest_amount,fee_amount,insurance_amount,currency,payment_date,reference,is_voided',
      uid,
    ),
    if (includeBudgets)
      statementRows(
        'budgets',
        'id,category_id,currency,budget_amount,month,start_date,end_date',
        uid,
      ),
  ]);
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
  }
  final normalized = normalizeExportMovements(
    accountMovements: values[0],
    accounts: values[1],
    categories: values[2],
    cards: values[3],
    cardMovements: values[4],
    debts: values[5],
    debtPayments: values[6],
  );
  return (
    movements: normalized,
    categories: values[2],
    budgets: includeBudgets ? values[7] : <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
  );
}

      }

String reportCellText(Object? v) => v is MoneyCell
    ? (v.isTotal
          ? formatAmountCents(v.cents)
          : formatRecordAmountCents(v.cents))
    : (v?.toString() ?? '').replaceAll('âˆ’', '-');
List<List<String>> _pdfRows(List<List<Object?>> rows) {
  final output = <List<String>>[];
  for (final row in rows) {
    final chunks = row.map((v) {
      final codes = reportCellText(v).runes.toList();
      if (codes.isEmpty) {
        return <String>[''];
      }
      return [
        for (var n = 0; n < codes.length; n += 220)
          String.fromCharCodes(
            codes.sublist(n, (n + 220).clamp(0, codes.length).toInt()),
          ),
      ];
    }).toList();
    final count = chunks.fold<int>(1, (n, c) => c.length > n ? c.length : n);
    for (var index = 0; index < count; index++) {
      output.add(chunks.map((c) => index < c.length ? c[index] : '').toList());
    }
  }
  return output;
}

String _totalLabel(ExportReport report, String label, String currency) {
  final total = report.totals
      .where((t) => t.label == label && t.currency == currency)
      .firstOrNull;
  return total == null ? 'â€”' : formatAmountCents(total.cents);
}

// Total al pie del detalle. Suma Ãºnicamente las columnas de importes visibles;
// la tasa no se suma y el saldo neto conserva su cÃ¡lculo independiente.
List<List<Object?>> _exportTableRows(ReportTable table, bool person) {
  if (table.footerRows.isNotEmpty) {
    return [
      ...table.rows,
      for (final row in table.footerRows)
        [
          for (final cell in row)
            if (cell is MoneyCell)
              MoneyCell(cell.cents, isTotal: true)
            else
              cell,
        ],
    ];
  }
  if (!person) return table.rows;
  final amountColumns = <int>[
    for (var i = 0; i < table.columns.length; i++)
      if (['Importe C\$', 'Importe original'].contains(table.columns[i])) i,
  ];
  if (amountColumns.isEmpty) return table.rows;
  final footer = List<Object?>.filled(table.columns.length, null);
  footer[0] = 'Total';
  for (final column in amountColumns) {
    var sum = 0;
    for (final row in table.rows) {
      final value = row[column];
      if (value is MoneyCell) sum += value.cents;
    }
    footer[column] = MoneyCell(sum, isTotal: true);
  }
  return [...table.rows, footer];
}

import '../core/supabase_client.dart';
import 'exchange_rate.dart';

class FinancialSettings {
  const FinancialSettings({required this.rate, this.updatedAt});
  final ExchangeRate rate;
  final DateTime? updatedAt;
}

Future<FinancialSettings?> loadFinancialSettings() async {
  final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  if (userId == null) {
    throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
  }
  final row = await supabase
      .from('user_financial_settings')
      .select('usd_to_nio, updated_at')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .maybeSingle();
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Actualiza la pantalla.');
  }
  if (row == null) {
    return null;
  }
  final rate = ExchangeRate.tryParse('${row['usd_to_nio']}');
  if (rate == null) {
    throw StateError(
      'La tasa guardada no es vÃ¡lida. ActualÃ­zala en Configuraciones.',
    );
  }
  return FinancialSettings(
    rate: rate,
    updatedAt: DateTime.tryParse('${row['updated_at']}')?.toLocal(),
  );
}

Future<void> saveFinancialSettings(
  ExchangeRate rate,
  String expectedUserId,
) async {
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != expectedUserId) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Abre nuevamente Configuraciones.');
  }
  await supabase
      .from('user_financial_settings')
      .upsert({
        'user_id': expectedUserId,
        'usd_to_nio': rate.decimal,
      }, onConflict: 'user_id')
      .select('user_id')
      .single();
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != expectedUserId) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Abre nuevamente Configuraciones.');
  }
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

class MovementTotals {
  int income = 0, expenses = 0, cardPayments = 0, debtPayments = 0;
  int deposits = 0, withdrawals = 0, transfers = 0, adjustments = 0;
}

Map<String, MovementTotals> movementTotals(
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> rows, {
  bool includeDebtCharges = true,
}) {
  final totals = {
    for (final c in ['NIO', 'USD']) c: MovementTotals(),
  };
  for (final row in rows) {
    if (row['is_voided'] == true) continue;
    final group = totals[row['currency']];
    if (group == null) throw StateError('Moneda no admitida en el historial.');
    final amount = moneyCents(row['amount']);
    switch (row['transaction_type']) {
      case 'income':
        group.income += amount;
      case 'expense':
        group.expenses += amount;
      case 'card_payment':
        group.cardPayments += amount;
      case 'debt_payment':
        group.debtPayments += amount;
        if (includeDebtCharges) {
          group.expenses +=
              moneyCents(row['interest_amount'] ?? 0) +
              moneyCents(row['fee_amount'] ?? 0);
        }
      case 'deposit':
        group.deposits += amount;
      case 'withdrawal':
        group.withdrawals += amount;
      case 'transfer':
        group.transfers += amount;
      case 'adjustment':
        group.adjustments += amount;
    }
  }
  return totals;
}

/// Rich-text runs use UTF-16 offsets, matching Flutter's text selections.
class NoteStyle {
  const NoteStyle({this.bold = false, this.color, this.size = 16});
  final bool bold;
  final int? color;
  final double size;
  NoteStyle copyWith({
    bool? bold,
    int? color,
    bool clearColor = false,
    double? size,
  }) => NoteStyle(
    bold: bold ?? this.bold,
    color: clearColor ? null : color ?? this.color,
    size: size ?? this.size,
  );
  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is NoteStyle &&
      bold == other.bold &&
      color == other.color &&
      size == other.size;
  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(bold, color, size);
}

class NoteDocument {
  String text = '';
  List<NoteStyle> styles = [];
  void load(String value, Object? raw) {
    text = value;
    styles = List.filled(text.length, const NoteStyle(), growable: true);
    if (raw is! List) return;
    for (final run in raw) {
      if (run is! Map) continue;
      final start = run['start'], length = run['length'];
      if (start is! int ||
          length is! int ||
          start < 0 ||
          length < 1 ||
          start + length > text.length)
        continue;
      final color = run['color'];
      final size = run['size'];
      final style = NoteStyle(
        bold: run['bold'] == true,
        color: color is int && color >= 0 && color <= 0xffffffff ? color : null,
        size: size is num && [14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32].contains(size)
            ? size.toDouble()
            : 16,
      );
      styles.fillRange(start, start + length, style);
    }
  }

  void replace(
    String next,
    NoteStyle insertionStyle, {
    int? selectionStart,
    int? selectionEnd,
    int? caret,
  }) {
    bool replaceAt(int start, int end) {
      final inserted = next.length - text.length + end - start;
      if (start < 0 ||
          end < start ||
          end > text.length ||
          inserted < 0 ||
          start + inserted > next.length)
        return false;
      if (next.substring(0, start) != text.substring(0, start) ||
          next.substring(start + inserted) != text.substring(end))
        return false;
      styles.replaceRange(start, end, List.filled(inserted, insertionStyle));
      text = next;
      return true;
    }

    if (selectionStart != null &&
        selectionEnd != null &&
        replaceAt(selectionStart, selectionEnd))
      return;
    if (caret != null &&
        next.length < text.length &&
        replaceAt(caret, caret + text.length - next.length))
      return;

    var start = 0;
    while (start < text.length &&
        start < next.length &&
        text.codeUnitAt(start) == next.codeUnitAt(start)) {
      start++;
    }
    var oldEnd = text.length, newEnd = next.length;
    while (oldEnd > start &&
        newEnd > start &&
        text.codeUnitAt(oldEnd - 1) == next.codeUnitAt(newEnd - 1)) {
      oldEnd--;
      newEnd--;
    }
    styles.replaceRange(
      start,
      oldEnd,
      List.filled(newEnd - start, insertionStyle),
    );
    text = next;
  }

  void format(int start, int end, NoteStyle Function(NoteStyle) change) {
    if (start < 0 || end > styles.length || start >= end) return;
    for (var i = start; i < end; i++) {
      styles[i] = change(styles[i]);
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> toJson() {
    final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (var start = 0; start < styles.length;) {
      var end = start + 1;
      final style = styles[start];
      while (end < styles.length && styles[end] == style) {
        end++;
      }
      if (style != const NoteStyle()) {
        result.add({
          'start': start,
          'length': end - start,
          'bold': style.bold,
          if (style.color != null) 'color': style.color,
          'size': style.size,
        });
      }
      start = end;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

String _agendaText(dynamic value) => value?.toString().trim() ?? '';

String agendaCardLabel(Map<String, dynamic>? card, {bool includeName = true}) {
  final institution = card?['financial_institutions'];
  final bank = institution is Map ? _agendaText(institution['name']) : '';
  final name = _agendaText(card?['name']);
  final digits = _agendaText(
    card?['card_reference'],
  ).replaceAll(RegExp(r'\D'), '');
  return [
    bank.isEmpty ? 'Banco sin asignar' : bank,
    if (includeName) name.isEmpty ? 'Tarjeta' : name,
    if (digits.length >= 4) 'â€¢â€¢${digits.substring(digits.length - 4)}',
  ].join(' Â· ');
}

String agendaDebtCreditor(Map<String, dynamic> debt) {
  final name = _agendaText(debt['creditor_name']);
  return name.isEmpty ? 'Acreedor sin registrar' : 'Acreedor: $name';
}

String additionalCardLabel(Map card) =>
    "${card['holder_name']} Â· â€¢â€¢${card['last_four']}";

String reportDebitCardLabel(Map<String, dynamic> card, {Map? account}) {
  final ownBank = card['financial_institutions'];
  final linkedBank = account?['financial_institutions'];
  final bank = ownBank is Map && _agendaText(ownBank['name']).isNotEmpty
      ? ownBank
      : linkedBank;
  final name = _agendaText(card['name']);
  final network = _agendaText(card['network']);
  final accountName = _agendaText(account?['name']);
  return agendaCardLabel({
    'financial_institutions': bank,
    'name': [
      if (name.isNotEmpty) name else if (accountName.isNotEmpty) accountName,
      network.isEmpty ? 'DÃ©bito' : network,
    ].join(' Â· '),
    'card_reference': card['card_reference'],
  });
}

String reportCreditMovementCardLabel(
  Map<String, dynamic> card,
  Map<String, dynamic> movement,
) {
  final additional = movement['credit_card_additionals'];
  return additional is Map
      ? '${agendaCardLabel(card)}\nAdicional Â· ${additionalCardLabel(additional)}'
      : agendaCardLabel(card);
}

// ==========================================
// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\data\payment_agenda_logic.dart

import '../utils/money.dart';
import 'card_statement_logic.dart';
import 'debt_installment_logic.dart';

enum AgendaKind { cardPayment, cardCut, loanMaturity, loanInstallment }

class AgendaItem {
  const AgendaItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.kind,
    required this.date,
    required this.title,
    required this.entity,
    this.currency,
    this.amount,
    this.minimumRemaining,
    this.needsStatement = false,
  });
  final String id, title;
  final AgendaKind kind;
  final DateTime date;
  final Map<String, dynamic> entity;
  final String? currency;
  final int? amount, minimumRemaining;
  final bool needsStatement;
}

List<AgendaItem> buildPaymentAgenda({
  required DateTime today,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards,
  required CardStatementData statements,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> debts,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> debtPayments,
  int horizon = 7,
  DebtInstallmentData? installments,
}) {
  final result = <AgendaItem>[];
  bool visible(DateTime d) => daysUntil(d, today) <= horizon;
  for (final card in cards) {
    final current = statements.currentFor('${card['id']}');
    for (final s in current) {
      final p = statements.progress(s), date = statementDate(s['due_date']);
      if (p.settled || date == null || !visible(date)) {
        continue;
      }
      result.add(
        AgendaItem(
          id: 'statement:${s['id']}',
          kind: AgendaKind.cardPayment,
          date: date,
          title: card['name']?.toString() ?? 'Tarjeta',
          entity: card,
          currency: '${s['currency']}',
          amount: p.remaining,
          minimumRemaining: p.minimumRemaining,
        ),
      );
    }
    final paymentDay = int.tryParse('${card['payment_day']}');
    if (current.isEmpty &&
        card['is_active'] == true &&
        paymentDay != null &&
        paymentDay >= 1 &&
        paymentDay <= 31) {
      final date = nextCalendarDay(paymentDay, today);
      if (visible(date)) {
        result.add(
          AgendaItem(
            id: 'payment-date:${card['id']}',
            kind: AgendaKind.cardPayment,
            date: date,
            title: card['name']?.toString() ?? 'Tarjeta',
            entity: card,
            needsStatement: true,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
    final closingDay = int.tryParse('${card['closing_day']}');
    if (card['is_active'] == true &&
        closingDay != null &&
        closingDay >= 1 &&
        closingDay <= 31) {
      final date = nextCalendarDay(closingDay, today);
      if (visible(date)) {
        result.add(
          AgendaItem(
            id: 'closing:${card['id']}',
            kind: AgendaKind.cardCut,
            date: date,
            title: card['name']?.toString() ?? 'Tarjeta',
            entity: card,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }
  for (final debt in debts) {
    if (!['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status'])) {
      continue;
    }
    final current = installments?.payableFor('${debt['id']}') ?? [];
    if (current.isNotEmpty) {
      for (final i in current) {
        final date = statementDate(i['due_date']);
        if (date == null || !visible(date)) {
          continue;
        }
        result.add(
          AgendaItem(
            id: 'installment:${i['id']}',
            kind: AgendaKind.loanInstallment,
            date: date,
            title: debt['description']?.toString() ?? 'PrÃ©stamo',
            entity: debt,
            currency: '${i['currency']}',
            amount: installments!.progress(i).remaining,
          ),
        );
      }
      continue;
    }
    final date = statementDate(debt['due_date']);
    if (date == null || !visible(date)) {
      continue;
    }
    var paid = 0;
    for (final p in debtPayments) {
      if ('${p['debt_id']}' != '${debt['id']}' || p['is_voided'] == true) {
        continue;
      }
      if (p['currency'] != debt['currency']) {
        throw StateError('Un abono no coincide con la moneda de su deuda.');
      }
      paid += moneyCents(p['principal_amount']);
    }
    final pending = moneyCents(debt['original_amount']) - paid;
    if (pending < 0) {
      throw StateError('Una deuda tiene abonos superiores a su capital.');
    }
    if (pending == 0) {
      continue;
    }
    result.add(
      AgendaItem(
        id: 'debt:${debt['id']}',
        kind: AgendaKind.loanMaturity,
        date: date,
        title: debt['description']?.toString() ?? 'PrÃ©stamo',
        entity: debt,
        currency: '${debt['currency']}',
        amount: pending,
      ),
    );
  }
  return sortPaymentAgenda(result, today);
}

int agendaUrgency(AgendaItem item, DateTime today) {
  if (item.kind == AgendaKind.cardCut) return 3;
  return switch (daysUntil(item.date, today)) {
    < 0 => 0,
    0 => 1,
    _ => 2,
  };
}

List<AgendaItem> sortPaymentAgenda(Iterable<AgendaItem> items, DateTime today) {
  return [...items]..sort((a, b) {
    final group = agendaUrgency(a, today).compareTo(agendaUrgency(b, today));
    if (group != 0) return group;
    final date = a.date.compareTo(b.date);
    return date != 0 ? date : a.id.compareTo(b.id);
  });
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

String isoDay(DateTime date) =>
    '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

DateTime dayOnly(DateTime date) => DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day);

bool includesDay(DateTime date, DateTime start, DateTime end) =>
    !dayOnly(date).isBefore(dayOnly(start)) &&
    !dayOnly(date).isAfter(dayOnly(end));

DateTime budgetStart(Map<String, dynamic> budget) =>
    DateTime.parse('${budget['start_date'] ?? budget['month']}');

DateTime budgetEnd(Map<String, dynamic> budget) {
  final value = budget['end_date'];
  if (value != null) return DateTime.parse('$value');
  final start = budgetStart(budget);
  return DateTime(start.year, start.month + 1, 0);
}

int budgetSpent(
  Map<String, dynamic> budget,
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> expenses,
) {
  final start = budgetStart(budget), end = budgetEnd(budget);
  var total = 0;
  for (final tx in expenses) {
    if (tx['is_voided'] == true ||
        tx['transaction_type'] != 'expense' ||
        tx['category_id'] != budget['category_id'] ||
        tx['currency'] != budget['currency'])
      continue;
    final date = DateTime.parse('${tx['transaction_date']}').toLocal();
    if (includesDay(date, start, end)) total += moneyCents(tx['amount']);
  }
  return total;
}

bool recurringInMonth(Map<String, dynamic> expense, DateTime month) {
  final start = DateTime.parse('${expense['starts_on']}');
  final end = expense['ends_on'] == null
      ? null
      : DateTime.parse('${expense['ends_on']}');
  return expense['is_active'] == true &&
      !start.isAfter(DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1, 0)) &&
      (end == null || !end.isBefore(DateTime(month.year, month.month)));
}

DateTime recurringDue(Map<String, dynamic> expense, DateTime month) {
  final last = DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1, 0).day;
  final day = int.parse('${expense['due_day']}').clamp(1, last);
  return DateTime(month.year, month.month, day);
}

/// El saldo conserva el signo del registro; los nombres aclaran la direcciÃ³n
/// para quien reciba el archivo, sin depender de interpretar un + o un -.
class PersonAccountExportReport extends ExportReport {
  const PersonAccountExportReport({
    required super.title,
    required super.period,
    required super.generatedAt,
    required super.tables,
    required super.totals,
    required super.notes,
    required this.ownerName,
    required this.personName,

    this.settlementRate,
  });
  final String ownerName, personName;
  final int closingCents;
  final ExchangeRate? settlementRate;
  bool get settled => closingCents == 0;
  String get debtor => closingCents > 0 ? ownerName : personName;
  String get creditor => closingCents > 0 ? personName : ownerName;
  String get direction =>
      settled ? 'Ninguno le debe al otro' : '$debtor le debe a $creditor';
  String get amountLabel => formatMoneyCents(closingCents.abs(), 'NIO');
  int? get paymentUsdCents =>
      settled ? 0 : settlementRate?.convert(closingCents.abs(), 'NIO', 'USD');
  String get paymentNioLabel => 'Si paga en cÃ³rdobas: $amountLabel';
  String get paymentUsdLabel => paymentUsdCents == null
      ? 'Si paga en dÃ³lares: indica una tasa de pago'
      : 'Si paga en dÃ³lares: ${formatMoneyCents(paymentUsdCents!, 'USD')}';
  String get paymentRateLabel => settlementRate == null
      ? 'Sin tasa de pago indicada'
      : 'Tasa de pago: C\$ ${settlementRate!.decimal} por \$ 1';
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

/// Positive: I owe the person. Negative: the person owes me.
int personAccountBalance(Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> entries) {
  var total = 0;
  for (final row in entries) {
    if (row['is_voided'] == true) continue;
    final direction = int.tryParse('${row['direction']}');
    if (direction != 1 && direction != -1) {
      throw StateError('Un movimiento tiene un signo invÃ¡lido.');
    }
    final cents = moneyCents(row['amount_nio']);
    if (cents <= 0)
      throw StateError('Un movimiento tiene un importe invÃ¡lido.');
    total += cents * direction!;
    if (total.abs() > 9007199254740991) {
      throw StateError('El saldo excede el rango de precisiÃ³n.');
    }
  }
  return total;
}

String personBalanceLabel(int cents) => cents > 0
    ? 'Le debes'
    : cents < 0
    ? 'Te debe'
    : 'EstÃ¡n a mano';

String personEntryLabel(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
  final plus = row['direction'].toString() == '1';
  return switch (row['kind']) {
    'payment' => plus ? 'Te pagÃ³ (+)' : 'TÃº pagaste (âˆ’)',
    'opening' =>
      plus ? 'Saldo anterior: le debÃ­as (+)' : 'Saldo anterior: te debÃ­a (âˆ’)',
    _ => plus ? 'Compra de la otra persona (+)' : 'Compra tuya (âˆ’)',
  };
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\data\person_account_report.dart
// ==========================================
import '../utils/money.dart';
import 'person_account_logic.dart';
import 'export_report_models.dart';
import 'person_account_export_report.dart';
import 'exchange_rate.dart';

/// Report from the ledger owner's perspective. Counterparty data stays scoped
/// to a single person_account_id, including when the caller passes other rows.
ExportReport personAccountReport({
  required Map<String, dynamic> account,
  required List<Map<String, dynamic>> entries,
  required DateTime generatedAt,
  String? ownerName,
  ExchangeRate? settlementRate,
  DateTime? start,
  DateTime? end,
}) {
  final owner = (ownerName ?? '').trim().isEmpty
      ? 'Titular del registro'
      : ownerName!.trim();
  final name = '${account['name']}'.trim();
  DateTime day(DateTime d) => DateTime(d.year, d.month, d.day);
  if ((start == null) != (end == null))
    throw ArgumentError('Selecciona ambas fechas.');
  final from = start == null ? null : day(start),
      to = end == null ? null : day(end);
  if (from != null && to!.isBefore(from))
    throw ArgumentError('El perÃ­odo no es vÃ¡lido.');
  final rows = entries
      .where(
        (e) =>
            '${e['person_account_id']}' == '${account['id']}' &&
            e['is_voided'] != true,
      )
      .toList();
  DateTime date(Map<String, dynamic> e) {
    final d = DateTime.tryParse('${e['entry_date']}');
    if (d == null) throw StateError('Un movimiento tiene fecha invÃ¡lida.');
    return day(d);
  }

  for (final e in rows) {
    date(e);
  }
  rows.sort((a, b) {
    final cmp = date(a).compareTo(date(b));
    return cmp != 0
        ? cmp
        : '${a['created_at']}:${a['id']}'.compareTo(
            '${b['created_at']}:${b['id']}',
          );
  });
  personAccountBalance(rows);
  var closing = 0,
      otherPurchases = 0,
      myPurchases = 0,
      myPayments = 0,
      receivedPayments = 0,
      previousEntries = 0;
  // Las columnas de conversiÃ³n aparecen solo si el detalle visible contiene USD.
  final showExchange = rows.any((e) {
    final d = date(e);
    return e['currency'] == 'USD' &&
        (from == null || !d.isBefore(from)) &&
        (to == null || !d.isAfter(to));
  });
  final detail = <List<Object?>>[];
  for (final e in rows) {
    final d = date(e), effect = personAccountBalance([e]);
    if (from != null && d.isBefore(from)) {
      closing += effect;
      continue;
    }
    if (to != null && d.isAfter(to)) continue;
    closing += effect;
    switch (e['kind']) {
      case 'purchase':
        if (effect > 0)
          otherPurchases += effect;
        else
          myPurchases -= effect;
      case 'payment':
        if (effect > 0)
          receivedPayments += effect;
        else
          myPayments -= effect;
      case 'opening':
        previousEntries += effect;
      default:
        throw StateError('Tipo de movimiento no reconocido.');
    }
    detail.add([
      reportDate(d),
      switch (e['kind']) {
        'payment' =>
          effect > 0 ? 'Pago de ${account['name']} (+)' : 'Pago de $owner (-)',
        'opening' =>
          effect > 0
              ? 'Saldo anterior a favor de ${account['name']} (+)'
              : 'Saldo anterior a favor de $owner (-)',
        _ =>
          effect > 0
              ? 'Compra de ${account['name']} (+)'
              : 'Compra de $owner (-)',
      },
      '${e['description'] ?? ''}',
      '${e['currency']}',
      if (showExchange) ...[
        e['currency'] == 'USD'
            ? MoneyCell(
                moneyCents(e['amount']) * int.parse('${e['direction']}'),
              )
            : null,
        e['currency'] == 'USD' ? '${e['exchange_rate']}' : 'â€”',
        // Usa el equivalente guardado, con el redondeo original del registro.
        MoneyCell(effect),
      ] else
        MoneyCell(effect),
    ]);
  }

  return PersonAccountExportReport(
    ownerName: owner,
    personName: name,
    closingCents: closing,
    settlementRate: settlementRate,
    title: 'Cuenta con $name',
    period: from == null
        ? 'Historial completo Â· saldo de todos los movimientos registrados'
        : 'Del ${reportDate(from)} al ${reportDate(to!)} Â· saldo al cierre del perÃ­odo',
    generatedAt: generatedAt,
    tables: [
      ReportTable('Detalle', [
        'Fecha',
        'Movimiento',
        'DescripciÃ³n',
        'Moneda',
        if (showExchange) ...[
          'Importe \$',
          'Tasa C\$/\$',
          'Importe C\$',
        ] else
          'Importe C\$',
      ], detail),
    ],
    totals: [
      ReportTotal('NIO', 'Compras de $name (+)', otherPurchases),
      ReportTotal('NIO', 'Compras de $owner (-)', -myPurchases),
      ReportTotal('NIO', 'Pagos hechos por $owner (-)', -myPayments),
      ReportTotal('NIO', 'Pagos recibidos por $owner (+)', receivedPayments),
      if (previousEntries != 0)
        ReportTotal(
          'NIO',
          'Saldos anteriores registrados en el perÃ­odo',
          previousEntries,
        ),
      ReportTotal('NIO', 'Saldo neto al cierre', closing),
    ],
    notes: [
      'Cada movimiento en USD usa su tasa guardada y se redondea a centavos. No se aplica la tasa actual a movimientos anteriores.',
      if (detail.isEmpty)
        'No hay movimientos vigentes para el perÃ­odo seleccionado.',
    ],
  );
}

String personUserId() {
  final id = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  if (id == null) throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');

void checkPersonSession(String id) {
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != id)
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Abre nuevamente esta pantalla.');
}

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> personRows(
  String table,
  String userId, {
  String? accountId,
  bool includeShared = false,
}) async {
  final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
    var query = supabase.from(table).select();
    if (!includeShared) query = query.eq('user_id', userId);
    if (accountId != null) query = query.eq('person_account_id', accountId);
    final result = await query.order('id').range(offset, offset + 499);
    checkPersonSession(userId);
    final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
    rows.addAll(page);
    if (page.length < 500) break;
  }
  return rows;
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

String receivableMoney(int cents, String currency) =>
    formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

int receivablePrincipalPaid(
  String loanId,
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> payments,
) => payments
    .where((p) => p['loan_id'].toString() == loanId && p['is_voided'] != true)
    .fold<int>(0, (sum, p) => sum + moneyCents(p['principal_amount']));

int receivablePending(
  Map<String, dynamic> loan,
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> payments,
) {
  final own = payments.where(
    (p) =>
        p['loan_id'].toString() == loan['id'].toString() &&
        p['is_voided'] != true,
  );
  if (own.any((p) => p['currency'] != loan['currency'])) {
    throw StateError('Hay un cobro con moneda diferente al prÃ©stamo.');
  }
  final pending =
      moneyCents(loan['principal_amount']) -
      receivablePrincipalPaid(loan['id'].toString(), own);
  if (pending < 0) {
    throw StateError('Los cobros superan el capital del prÃ©stamo.');
  }
  return pending;
}

bool receivableOverdue(Map<String, dynamic> loan, int pending, DateTime now) {
  if (loan['is_voided'] == true || pending <= 0) {
    return false;
  }
  final due = DateTime.tryParse('${loan['due_date']}');
  if (due == null) {
    return false;
  }
  return DateTime(
    due.year,
    due.month,
    due.day,
  ).isBefore(DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day));
}

// Filas derivadas en memoria: nunca se insertan en public.transactions.
List<Map<String, dynamic>> receivableAccountMovements(
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> loans,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> payments,
) {
  final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final activeLoans = {
    for (final l in loans.where((l) => l['is_voided'] != true))
      l['id'].toString(): l,
  };
  Map<String, dynamic> row({
    required String id,
    required String loanId,
    required String accountId,
    required String type,
    required dynamic amount,
    required String currency,
    required dynamic date,
    dynamic createdAt,
    required String description,
    dynamic reference,
  }) => {
    'id': id,
    'account_id': accountId,
    'destination_account_id': null,
    'category_id': null,
    'transaction_type': type,
    'amount': amount,
    'currency': currency,
    'transaction_date': date,
    'created_at': createdAt,
    'description': description,
    'reference': reference,
    'is_reconciled': false,
    'source': 'receivable_loan',
    'loan_id': loanId,
  };
  for (final loan in activeLoans.values) {
    receivablePending(loan, payments);
    if (loan['is_historical'] == true || loan['credit_card_id'] != null) {
      continue;
    }
    if (loan['account_id'] == null) {
      throw StateError('Un prÃ©stamo nuevo no tiene cuenta de origen.');
    }
    result.add(
      row(
        id: 'receivable:loan:${loan['id']}',
        loanId: loan['id'].toString(),
        accountId: loan['account_id'].toString(),
        type: 'withdrawal',
        amount: loan['principal_amount'],
        currency: loan['currency'].toString(),
        date: loan['loan_date'],
        createdAt: loan['created_at'],
        description: 'Dinero prestado a ${loan['borrower_name']}',
        reference: loan['reference'],
      )..['principal_amount'] = loan['principal_amount'],
    );
  }
  for (final payment in payments.where((p) => p['is_voided'] != true)) {
    final loan = activeLoans[payment['loan_id'].toString()];
    if (loan == null) {
      throw StateError('Hay un cobro vigente sin prÃ©stamo vigente.');
    }
    for (final component in ['principal_amount', 'interest_amount']) {
      if (moneyCents(payment[component]) == 0) {
        continue;
      }
      final capital = component == 'principal_amount';
      result.add(
        row(
            id: 'receivable:payment:${payment['id']}:$component',
            loanId: loan['id'].toString(),
            accountId: payment['account_id'].toString(),
            type: capital ? 'deposit' : 'income',
            amount: payment[component],
            currency: payment['currency'].toString(),
            date: payment['payment_date'],
            createdAt: payment['created_at'],
            description:
                '${capital ? 'Capital devuelto por' : 'Intereses cobrados a'} ${loan['borrower_name']}',
            reference: payment['reference'],
          )
          ..['principal_amount'] = payment['principal_amount']
          ..['interest_amount'] = payment['interest_amount']
          ..['payment_total'] =
              (moneyCents(payment['principal_amount']) +
                  moneyCents(payment['interest_amount'])) /
              moneyScale,
      );
    }
  }
  return result;
}

/// Returns the user's monthly share in the same fixed monetary units as the input.
int recurringOwnShare(int total, int discount, int people) {
  if (total <= 0 ||
      discount < 0 ||
      discount >= total ||
      people < 1 ||
      people > 100) {
    throw ArgumentError('Revisa el monto, descuento y nÃºmero de personas.');
  }
  final share =
      ((BigInt.from(total - discount) + BigInt.from(people ~/ 2)) ~/
              BigInt.from(people))
          .toInt();
  if (share <= 0) throw ArgumentError('Tu parte debe ser mayor que cero.');
  return share;
}

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> loadUserTransactions(String userId) async {
  const pageSize = 500;
  final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += pageSize) {
    final result = await supabase
        .from('transactions')
        .select(
          'id, account_id, destination_account_id, category_id, transaction_type, amount, '
          'currency, expense_kind, transaction_date, description, reference, created_at, '
          'linked_payments:debt_payments!debt_payments_linked_transaction_id_fkey(id)',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .eq('linked_payments.is_voided', false)
        .isFilter('linked_payments', null)
        .order('created_at', ascending: false)
        .order('id', ascending: false)
        .range(offset, offset + pageSize - 1);
    final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
    rows.addAll(page);
    if (page.length < pageSize) {
      break;
    }
  }
  // Una transferencia FX equivale a una salida y una entrada en una sola fila.
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += pageSize) {
    final result = await supabase
        .from('app_fx_transfers')
        .select()
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('id')
        .range(offset, offset + pageSize - 1);
    final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
    rows.addAll(
      page.map(
        (row) => <String, dynamic>{
          ...row,
          'transaction_type': 'transfer',
          'source': 'fx_transfer',
        },
      ),
    );
    if (page.length < pageSize) break;
  }
  // The card record is the source of truth for the associated cash deposit.
  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += pageSize) {
    final result = await supabase
        .from('credit_card_transactions')
        .select(
          'id,cash_advance_account_id,cash_advance_fee,amount,currency,transaction_date,created_at,reference,description',
        )
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .eq('charge_kind', cardCashAdvance)
        .eq('is_voided', false)
        .not('cash_advance_account_id', 'is', null)
        .order('id')
        .range(offset, offset + pageSize - 1);
    for (final row in result) {
      rows.add({
        ...row,
        'account_id': row['cash_advance_account_id'],
        'amount': cardCashAdvancePrincipal(row) / moneyScale,
        'transaction_type': 'deposit',
        'description': row['description'] == null
            ? 'Efectivo recibido de tarjeta'
            : 'Efectivo recibido de tarjeta Â· ${row['description']}',
        'source': cashAdvanceDepositSource,
      });
    }
    if (result.length < pageSize) break;
  }
  rows.addAll(await loadReceivableAccountMovements(userId));
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Actualiza la pantalla.');
  }
  rows.sort(compareNewestEntry);
  return rows;
}

// ==========================================
// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\data\transfer_exchange.dart
// ==========================================
/// CÃ³rdobas por un dÃ³lar. Redondea Ãºnicamente el importe recibido.
int transferReceivedCents(
  int sentCents,
  String source,
  String destination,
  double rate,
) {
  if (!['NIO', 'USD'].contains(source) ||
      !['NIO', 'USD'].contains(destination) ||
      sentCents <= 0 ||
      !rate.isFinite ||
      rate <= 0 ||
      rate > 1000000) {
    throw ArgumentError('Monto, moneda o tasa invÃ¡lidos.');
  }
  final received = source == destination
      ? sentCents
      : (source == 'USD' ? sentCents * rate : sentCents / rate).round();
  if (received <= 0 || received > 100000000000000) {
    throw ArgumentError('El monto recibido queda fuera del rango permitido.');
  }
  return received;
}

import '../utils/money.dart';

String zeroDate(DateTime d) =>
    '${d.year}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
String zeroDateLabel(dynamic value) {
  final d = DateTime.tryParse('$value')?.toLocal();
  return d == null
      ? 'Sin fecha'
      : '${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.year}';
}

DateTime zeroMonthlyDate(DateTime first, int offset) => DateTime(
  first.year,
  first.month + offset,
  first.day
      .clamp(1, DateTime(first.year, first.month + offset + 1, 0).day)
      .toInt(),
);
List<int> zeroSplit(int total, int count, {int? monthly}) {
  if (count < 1 || count > 120 || total <= 0)
    throw ArgumentError('Plan invÃ¡lido.');
  final quota = monthly ?? total ~/ count, last = total - quota * (count - 1);
  if (quota <= 0 || last <= 0)
    throw ArgumentError('La cuota mensual no corresponde al monto y al plazo.');
  return List.generate(count, (i) => i == count - 1 ? last : quota);
}

class ZeroPlanData {
  const ZeroPlanData({
    required this.plans,
    required this.installments,
    required this.allocations,
    required this.transactions,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> plans,
      installments,
      allocations,
      transactions;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> forPlan(String id) =>
      installments.where((i) => i['plan_id'] == id).toList()
        ..sort((a, b) => (a['number'] as num).compareTo(b['number'] as num));
  Map<String, dynamic>? payment(dynamic id) =>
      transactions.where((t) => t['id'] == id).firstOrNull;
  bool live(Map<String, dynamic> a) =>
      a['is_removed'] != true &&
      payment(a['payment_id'])?['is_voided'] == false;
  int paid(Map<String, dynamic> i) => i['historical_paid'] == true
      ? moneyCents(i['amount'])
      : allocations
            .where((a) => a['installment_id'] == i['id'] && live(a))
            .fold<int>(0, (s, a) => s + moneyCents(a['amount']));
  int remaining(Map<String, dynamic> i) => (moneyCents(i['amount']) - paid(i))
      .clamp(0, moneyCents(i['amount']))
      .toInt();
  int pending(String id) =>
      forPlan(id).fold<int>(0, (s, i) => s + remaining(i));
  bool includedInCut(
    Map<String, dynamic> installment,
    Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> statements,
  ) =>
      installment['statement_id'] != null &&
      statements.any(
        (s) => s['id'] == installment['statement_id'] && s['is_voided'] != true,
      );

  int pendingOutsideCuts(
    String id,
    Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> statements,
  ) => forPlan(id)
      .where((i) => !includedInCut(i, statements))
      .fold<int>(0, (sum, i) => sum + remaining(i));

  String planState(
    Map<String, dynamic> plan,
    Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> statements,
  ) {
    if (plan['is_voided'] == true) return 'voided';
    final id = '${plan['id']}';
    if (pendingOutsideCuts(id, statements) > 0) return 'active';
    return pending(id) > 0 ? 'in_cuts' : 'paid';
  }

  int unassigned(Map<String, dynamic> p) =>
      (moneyCents(p['amount']) -
              allocations
                  .where((a) => a['payment_id'] == p['id'] && live(a))
                  .fold<int>(0, (s, a) => s + moneyCents(a['amount'])))
          .clamp(0, moneyCents(p['amount']))
          .toInt();
}

import 'dart:convert';

String zeroUser() {
  final id = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  if (id == null) throw StateError('Inicia sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
  return id;
}

void zeroSession(String id) {
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != id)
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Vuelve a abrir la pantalla.');
}

Future<ZeroPlanData> loadZeroPlans(String uid) async {
  final rows = await Future.wait([
    statementRows('card_zero_plans', '*', uid),
    statementRows('card_zero_installments', '*', uid),
    statementRows('card_zero_allocations', '*', uid),
    statementRows(
      'credit_card_transactions',
      'id,credit_card_id,account_id,transaction_type,amount,currency,transaction_date,description,is_voided,'
          'charge_kind,cash_advance_fee,excludes_from_limit',
      uid,
    ),
  ]);
  zeroSession(uid);
  return ZeroPlanData(
    plans: rows[0],
    installments: rows[1],
    allocations: rows[2],
    transactions: rows[3],
  );
}

String _uuid() {
  final r = Random.secure();
  final b = List.generate(16, (_) => r.nextInt(256));
  b[6] = (b[6] & 15) | 64;
  b[8] = (b[8] & 63) | 128;
  final h = b.map((x) => x.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
  return '${h.substring(0, 8)}-${h.substring(8, 12)}-${h.substring(12, 16)}-${h.substring(16, 20)}-${h.substring(20)}';
}

class ZeroCommands {
  final pending = <String, String>{};
  Future<dynamic> run(
    String rpc,
    Map<String, dynamic> params, {
    bool operation = false,
  }) async {
    final uid = zeroUser(), key = '$uid:$rpc:${jsonEncode(params)}';
    final id = operation ? pending.putIfAbsent(key, _uuid) : null;
    final result = await supabase.rpc(
      rpc,
      params: {if (id != null) 'p_id': id, ...params},
    );
    zeroSession(uid);
    pending.remove(key);
    return result;
  }
}

    if (!mounted) return;
    final request = ++requestId;

      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) throw Exception('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      final result = await supabase
          .from('accounts')
          .select(
            'id, name, account_type, currency, opening_balance, '
            'institution_id, account_reference, account_number, account_holder, account_iban, is_active, notes, card_design, '
            'created_at, financial_institutions(name, code)',
          )
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .order('created_at', ascending: false);
      final accountRows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
      final rows = await loadUserTransactions(user.id);
      final payments = await loadUserCardPayments(user.id);
      final debtPayments = await loadUserDebtPayments(user.id);
      final balances = calculateBalances(
        accountRows,
        rows,
        cardPayments: payments,
        debtPayments: debtPayments,
      );
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) return;

      final sortedAccounts = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result)
        ..sort((a, b) {
          final balanceA = balances[a['id'].toString()] ?? 0;
          final balanceB = balances[b['id'].toString()] ?? 0;
          final hasMoneyA = balanceA > 0;
          final hasMoneyB = balanceB > 0;

          if (hasMoneyA != hasMoneyB) {
            return hasMoneyA ? -1 : 1;
          }

          return a['name'].toString().toLowerCase().compareTo(
            b['name'].toString().toLowerCase(),
          );
        });

      setState(() {
        accounts = sortedAccounts;
        currentBalances = balances;
        if (!accounts.any(
          (account) => account['id'].toString() == selectedAccountId,
        )) {
          selectedAccountId = accounts.isEmpty
              ? null
              : accounts.first['id'].toString();
        }
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) return;
      setState(() {
        error = e.toString();
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

    if (user == null) {

class AccountCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const AccountCard({
    super.key,
    required this.account,
    required this.balanceCents,
    this.balanceLabel = 'Saldo registrado',
    this.centerOnMobile = false,
    this.onEdit,
    this.onToggle,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> account;
  final int balanceCents;
  final String balanceLabel;
  final bool centerOnMobile;
  final VoidCallback? onEdit, onToggle;

  Widget bankLogo(String bank, bool cash) => BankLogo(
    name: bank,
    fallbackIcon: cash
        ? Icons.payments_outlined
        : Icons.account_balance_outlined,
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final compact = compactLayout(context);
    final centered = compact && centerOnMobile;
    final textAlign = centered ? TextAlign.center : TextAlign.start;
    final raw = account['card_design'];
    final design = raw is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final type = account['account_type']?.toString() ?? '';
    final debit =
        design['enabled'] == true && ['savings', 'checking'].contains(type);
    final active = account['is_active'] != false;
    final institution = account['financial_institutions'];
    final bank = institution is Map
        ? institution['name']?.toString() ?? ''
        : '';
    final network = design['network']?.toString() ?? '';
    final digits = design['last_four']?.toString() ?? '';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'account_card.dart';

class AccountDesignFields extends StatelessWidget {
  const AccountDesignFields({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> value;
  final ValueChanged<Map<String, dynamic>> onChanged;

  void update(String key, dynamic data) => onChanged({...value, key: data});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final enabled = value['enabled'] == true;
    final network = value['network']?.toString() ?? '';
    final networks = <String, String>{
      '': 'Sin especificar',
      'visa': 'Visa',
      'mastercard': 'Mastercard',
    };
    if (!networks.containsKey(network)) networks[network] = network;
    final style = value['style']?.toString() ?? 'classic';

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        SwitchListTile(
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          title: const Text('Mostrar tarjeta de dÃ©bito'),
          subtitle: const Text('Asociada al saldo de esta cuenta.'),
          value: enabled,
          onChanged: (checked) => update('enabled', checked),
        ),
        if (enabled) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            initialValue: network,
            isExpanded: true,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Marca de la tarjeta'),
            items: networks.entries
                .map(
                  (e) => DropdownMenuItem(value: e.key, child: Text(e.value)),
                )
                .toList(),
            onChanged: (v) {
              if (v != null) update('network', v);
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          TextFormField(
            initialValue: value['last_four']?.toString() ?? '',
            keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
            maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
            maxLength: 4,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Ãšltimos 4 dÃ­  gitos (opcional)',
            ),
            onChanged: (v) => update('last_four', v.trim()),
            validator: (v) =>
                (v ?? '').trim().isEmpty ||
                    RegExp(r'^\d{4}$').hasMatch(v!.trim())
                ? null
                : 'Escribe exactamente 4 dÃ­gitos',
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
          initialValue: debitDesignLabels.containsKey(style)
              ? style
              : 'classic',
          decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'DiseÃ±o visual'),
          items: debitDesignLabels.entries
              .map((e) => DropdownMenuItem(value: e.key, child: Text(e.value)))
              .toList(),
          onChanged: (v) {
            if (v != null) update('style', v);
          },
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\accounts\account_form_dialog.dart
// ==========================================
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted;
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';
import '../../data/account_share_logic.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import 'account_card.dart';
import 'account_design_fields.dart';

class AccountFormDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const AccountFormDialog({super.key, this.account});
  final Map<String, dynamic>? account;
  @override
  State<AccountFormDialog> createState() => _AccountFormDialogState();
}

class _AccountFormDialogState extends State<AccountFormDialog> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final nameController = TextEditingController();
  final balanceController = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final referenceController = TextEditingController();
  final numberController = TextEditingController();
  final holderController = TextEditingController(),
      ibanController = TextEditingController();
  final notesController = TextEditingController();
  String accountType = 'savings', currency = 'NIO';
  String? institutionId, institutionError;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> institutions = [];
  Map<String, dynamic> cardDesign = {};
  bool loadingInstitutions = true;
  bool get editing => widget.account != null;
  bool get supportsDebit => ['savings', 'checking'].contains(accountType);
  bool get requiresInstitution => supportsDebit;
  bool get canSave =>
      !requiresInstitution ||
      (!loadingInstitutions && institutionError == null);

  static const types = {
    'savings': 'Cuenta de ahorro',
    'checking': 'Cuenta corriente',
    'cash': 'Efectivo',
    'wallet': 'Billetera digital',
    'investment': 'InversiÃ³n',
    'other': 'Otra cuenta',
  };

  Map<String, dynamic> get preview {
    final banks = institutions.where(
      (b) => b['id'].toString() == institutionId,
    );
    final original = widget.account;
    dynamic institution;
    if (institutionId != null) {
      if (banks.isNotEmpty) {
        institution = banks.first;
      } else if (original != null &&
          institutionId == original['institution_id']?.toString()) {
        institution = original['financial_institutions'];
      }
    }
    return {
      'name': nameController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? 'Mi cuenta'
          : nameController.text.trim(),
      'account_type': accountType,
      'currency': currency,
      'is_active': original?['is_active'] ?? true,
      'financial_institutions': institution,
      'card_design': {
        ...cardDesign,
        'enabled': supportsDebit && cardDesign['enabled'] == true,
      },
    };
  }

  int get previewBalance {
    final amount = double.tryParse(
      balanceController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
    );
    final cents = amount == null ? null : amount * moneyScale;
    return cents != null && cents.isFinite ? cents.round() : 0;
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final account = widget.account;
    if (account != null) {
      nameController.text = account['name']?.toString() ?? '';
      balanceController.text = '${account['opening_balance'] ?? 0}';
      referenceController.text = account['account_reference']?.toString() ?? '';
      numberController.text = account['account_number']?.toString() ?? '';
      holderController.text = account['account_holder']?.toString() ?? '';
      ibanController.text = account['account_iban']?.toString() ?? '';
      notesController.text = account['notes']?.toString() ?? '';
      accountType = account['account_type'].toString();
      currency = account['currency'].toString();
      institutionId = account['institution_id']?.toString();
      final design = account['card_design'];
      if (design is Map) cardDesign = Map<String, dynamic>.from(design);
    }
    loadInstitutions();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    nameController.dispose();
    balanceController.dispose();
    referenceController.dispose();
    numberController.dispose();
    holderController.dispose();
    ibanController.dispose();
    notesController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> loadInstitutions() async {
    setState(() {
      loadingInstitutions = true;
      institutionError = null;
    });
    try {
      final result = await supabase
          .from('financial_institutions')
          .select('id, name')
          .eq('is_active', true)
          .order('name');
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
      if (institutionId != null &&
          !rows.any((row) => row['id'].toString() == institutionId)) {
        final current = widget.account?['financial_institutions'];
        rows.add({
          'id': institutionId,
          'name': current is Map
              ? current['name'] ?? 'InstituciÃ³n actual'
              : 'InstituciÃ³n actual',
        });
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        institutions = rows;
        loadingInstitutions = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        institutionError = e.toString();
        loadingInstitutions = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void save() {
    if (!canSave || !formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    final data = <String, dynamic>{
      'name': nameController.text.trim(),
      'institution_id': institutionId,
      'opening_balance': double.parse(
        balanceController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
      ),
      'account_holder': holderController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : holderController.text.trim(),
      'account_iban': normalizeAccountIban(ibanController.text).isEmpty
          ? null
          : normalizeAccountIban(ibanController.text),
      'account_number': numberController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : numberController.text.trim(),
      'account_reference': referenceController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : referenceController.text.trim(),
      'notes': notesController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : notesController.text.trim(),
      'card_design': {
        ...cardDesign,
        'enabled': supportsDebit && cardDesign['enabled'] == true,
      },
    };
    if (!editing) {
      data.addAll({'account_type': accountType, 'currency': currency});
    }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../dashboard/dashboard_page.dart';
import 'login_page.dart';

class AuthGate extends StatelessWidget {
  const AuthGate({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return StreamBuilder<AuthState>(
      stream: supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final user = supabase.auth.currentSession?.user;
        if (user != null) {
          return DashboardPage(key: ValueKey(user.id));
        }

        return const LoginPage();
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';

class ChangeEmailPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChangeEmailPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<ChangeEmailPage> createState() => _ChangeEmailPageState();
}

class _ChangeEmailPageState extends State<ChangeEmailPage> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final email = TextEditingController();
  final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  User? user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
  String? requestedEmail;
  String? message;
  String? error;
  bool busy = false;

  String? get pendingEmail {
    final pending = user?.newEmail?.trim();
    return pending == null || pending.isEmpty ? requestedEmail : pending;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    email.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> save() async {
    if (busy || !formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final newEmail = email.text.trim();
    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    await run(() async {
      final response = await supabase.auth.updateUser(
        UserAttributes(email: newEmail),
      );
      final updated = response.user;
      if (!mounted || !checkSession(updated)) return;
      final confirmed = updated?.email?.toLowerCase() == newEmail.toLowerCase();
      email.clear();
      setState(() {
        user = updated;
        requestedEmail = confirmed ? null : newEmail;
        message = confirmed
            ? 'Correo de acceso actualizado.'
            : 'Solicitud enviada. Revisa el correo actual y el nuevo para completar la confirmaciÃ³n.';
      });
    });
  }

  Future<void> refresh() => run(() async {
    final response = await supabase.auth.refreshSession();
    final updated = response.user;
    if (!mounted || !checkSession(updated)) return;
    final confirmed =
        updated?.email?.toLowerCase() == pendingEmail?.toLowerCase();
    setState(() {
      user = updated;
      if (confirmed) requestedEmail = null;
      message = confirmed
          ? 'Correo de acceso actualizado.'
          : 'La confirmaciÃ³n sigue pendiente. Revisa los enlaces recibidos.';
    });
  });

  bool checkSession(User? current) {
    if (userId != null &&
        supabase.auth.currentUser?.id == userId &&
        current?.id == userId) {
      return true;
    }
    setState(() => error = 'La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Vuelve a abrir esta pantalla.');
    return false;
  }

  Future<void> run(Future<void> Function() action) async {
    if (busy || !checkSession(supabase.auth.currentUser)) return;
    setState(() {
      busy = true;
      error = null;
      message = null;
    });
    try {
      await action();
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => error = 'No se pudo completar la solicitud. ${e.message}',
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () =>
              error = 'No se pudo completar la solicitud. Intenta nuevamente.',
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final pending = pendingEmail;
    return PopScope(
      canPop: !busy,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Correo electrÃ³nico')),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Card(
                  margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Form(
                      key: formKey,
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          const Text('Correo de acceso actual'),
                          SelectableText(
                            user?.email ?? 'Sin correo registrado',
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          const Text(
                            'Este es el correo que usas para iniciar sesiÃ³n. Tu nombre de perfil se edita por separado.',
                          ),
                          if (pending != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 16),
                            Text('Correo pendiente de confirmaciÃ³n: $pending'),
                            const Text(
                              'Sigue usando el correo actual hasta que se confirme el cambio.',
                            ),
                            TextButton(
                              onPressed: busy ? null : refresh,
                              child: const Text('Verificar confirmaciÃ³n'),
                            ),
                          ],
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          TextFormField(
                            controller: email,
                            enabled: !busy,
                            keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                            textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                            onFieldSubmitted: (_) => save(),
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Nuevo correo electrÃ³nico',
                            ),
                            validator: (value) {
                              final text = value?.trim() ?? '';
                              if (!RegExp(
                                r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$',
                              ).hasMatch(text)) {
                                return 'Escribe un correo vÃ¡lido.';
                              }
                              if (text.toLowerCase() ==
                                  user?.email?.toLowerCase()) {
                                return 'Escribe un correo distinto del actual.';
                              }
                              return null;
                            },
                          ),
                          if (message != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                            Text(message!),
                          ],
                          if (error != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                            Text(
                              error!,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          FilledButton(
                            onPressed: busy ? null : save,
                            child: Text(
                              busy ? 'Procesandoâ€¦' : 'Solicitar cambio',
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';

Future<String?> fetchProfileName(String userId) async {
  final profile = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('full_name')
      .eq('id', userId)
      .maybeSingle();
  final name = profile?['full_name']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
  return name.isEmpty ? null : name;
}

class ChangeNamePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChangeNamePage({super.key});

  @override
  State<ChangeNamePage> createState() => _ChangeNamePageState();
}

class _ChangeNamePageState extends State<ChangeNamePage> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final name = TextEditingController();
  final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  String? error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    loadName();
  }

  Future<void> loadName() async {
    try {
      final id = userId;
      if (id == null) return;
      final currentName = await fetchProfileName(id);
      if (mounted && supabase.auth.currentUser?.id == id) {
        name.text = currentName ?? '';
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() => error = 'No se pudo cargar el nombre actual.');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    name.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> save() async {
    if (loading || saving || !formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    if (userId == null || supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
      setState(() => error = 'La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Vuelve a abrir esta pantalla.');
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() {
      saving = true;
      error = null;
    });

    try {
      final updated = await supabase.rpc<String>(
        'update_my_profile_name',
        params: {'p_full_name': name.text.trim()},
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
        setState(
          () => error = 'La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Vuelve a abrir esta pantalla.',
        );
        return;
      }
      Navigator.pop(context, updated);
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() => error = 'No se pudo guardar el nombre. ${e.message}');
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(
          () => error = 'No se pudo guardar el nombre. Intenta nuevamente.',
        );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => PopScope(
    canPop: !saving,
    child: Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Cambiar nombre')),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Card(
                margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                  child: Form(
                    key: formKey,
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      children: [
                        Icon(
                          Icons.badge_outlined,
                          size: 48,
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        const Text(
                          'Elige el nombre que aparecerÃ¡ en Mi Billete.',
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        TextFormField(
                          controller: name,
                          enabled: !loading && !saving,
                          textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                          textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                          onFieldSubmitted: (_) => save(),
                          maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                          maxLength: 100,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(
                            labelText: 'Nombre',
                          ),
                          validator: (value) {
                            final text = value?.trim() ?? '';
                            if (text.isEmpty) return 'Ingresa tu nombre.';
                            if (text.runes.length > 100)
                              return 'Usa hasta 100 caracteres.';
                            return null;
                          },
                        ),
                        if (error != null)
                          Text(
                            error!,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                            ),
                          ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        FilledButton(
                          onPressed: loading || saving ? null : save,
                          child: Text(saving ? 'Guardandoâ€¦' : 'Guardar nombre'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
