import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted, primaryColor;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';

class ChangePasswordPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChangePasswordPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<ChangePasswordPage> createState() => _ChangePasswordPageState();
}

class _ChangePasswordPageState extends State<ChangePasswordPage> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final currentPassword = TextEditingController();
  final newPassword = TextEditingController();
  final confirmation = TextEditingController();
  bool saving = false, completed = false;
  bool hideCurrent = true, hideNew = true, hideConfirmation = true;
  String? error;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    currentPassword.dispose();
    newPassword.dispose();
    confirmation.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String authError(AuthException exception) {
    final message = exception.message.toLowerCase();
    if (message.contains('invalid login credentials') ||
        message.contains('invalid credentials')) {
      return 'La contraseÃ±a actual no es correcta.';
    }
    if (message.contains('same_password') ||
        message.contains('different from the old') ||
        message.contains('different from the previous')) {
      return 'La nueva contraseÃ±a debe ser diferente de la actual.';
    }
    if (message.contains('rate limit') ||
        message.contains('too many requests')) {
      return 'Hay demasiados intentos. Espera un momento y vuelve a intentarlo.';
    }
    if (message.contains('reauthentication') ||
        message.contains('session') ||
        message.contains('jwt')) {
      return 'Debes volver a iniciar sesiÃ³n antes de cambiar tu contraseÃ±a.';
    }
    if (message.contains('password')) {
      return 'El servicio de acceso rechazÃ³ la contraseÃ±a. ${exception.message}';
    }
    return 'No se pudo cambiar la contraseÃ±a. Comprueba tu conexiÃ³n e intenta nuevamente.';
  }

  Future<void> save() async {
    if (saving || completed || !formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    final email = user?.email;
    if (user == null || email == null || email.isEmpty) {
      setState(
        () => error = 'Inicia sesiÃ³n con tu correo para cambiar la contraseÃ±a.',
      );
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() {
      saving = true;
      error = null;
    });
    var verifyingCurrent = true;
    try {
      final verified = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(
        email: email,
        password: currentPassword.text,
      );
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      if (verified.user?.id != user.id ||
          supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != user.id) {
        setState(
          () => error = 'La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Abre nuevamente esta pantalla.',
        );
        return;
      }
      verifyingCurrent = false;
      final result = await supabase.auth.updateUser(
        UserAttributes(password: newPassword.text),
      );
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      if (result.user?.id != user.id) {
        setState(
          () => error =
              'No se pudo confirmar el cambio. Inicia sesiÃ³n nuevamente.',
        );
        return;
      }
      currentPassword.clear();
      newPassword.clear();
      confirmation.clear();
      setState(() => completed = true);
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => error =
              verifyingCurrent &&
                  e.message.toLowerCase().contains('invalid login credentials')
              ? 'La contraseÃ±a actual no es correcta.'
              : authError(e),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => error =
              'No se pudo completar el cambio. Comprueba tu conexiÃ³n e intenta nuevamente.',
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Widget passwordField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required bool hidden,
    required VoidCallback toggle,
    required String? Function(String?) validator,
    bool last = false,
    bool isCurrent = false,
  }) => TextFormField(
    controller: controller,
    enabled: !saving,
    obscureText: hidden,
    autocorrect: false,
    enableSuggestions: false,
    autofillHints: [
      isCurrent ? AutofillHints.password : AutofillHints.newPassword,
    ],
    textInputAction: last ? TextInputAction.done : TextInputAction.next,
    onFieldSubmitted: last
        ? (_) {
            save();
          }
        : null,
    validator: validator,
    decoration: InputDecoration(
      labelText: label,
      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline_rounded),
      suffixIcon: IconButton(
        tooltip: hidden ? 'Mostrar contraseÃ±a' : 'Ocultar contraseÃ±a',
        onPressed: saving ? null : toggle,
        icon: Icon(
          hidden ? Icons.visibility_outlined : Icons.visibility_off_outlined,
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final blue = primaryColor, green = Color(0xFF397455), muted = appMuted;
    return PopScope(
      canPop: !saving,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Cambiar contraseÃ±a')),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Card(
                  margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: completed
                        ? Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                            children: [
                              Icon(
                                Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded,
                                color: green,
                                size: 58,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 18),
                              const Text(
                                'ContraseÃ±a actualizada',
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 22,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
                              Text(
                                'Usa tu nueva contraseÃ±a la prÃ³xima vez que inicies sesiÃ³n.',
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: TextStyle(color: muted, height: 1.5),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 24),
                              FilledButton(
                                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                                child: const Text('Volver al inicio'),
                              ),
                            ],
                          )
                        : AutofillGroup(
                            child: Form(
                              key: formKey,
                              child: Column(
                                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                children: [
                                  Icon(
                                    Icons.lock_reset_rounded,
                                    color: blue,
                                    size: 48,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                                  const Text(
                                    'Actualiza tu contraseÃ±a',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 22,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                  Text(
                                    supabase.auth.currentUser?.email ?? '',
                                    style: TextStyle(color: muted),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                  Text(
                                    'Ingresa tu contraseÃ±a actual y confirma la nueva.',
                                    style: TextStyle(color: muted, height: 1.5),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                                  passwordField(
                                    controller: currentPassword,
                                    label: 'ContraseÃ±a actual',
                                    hidden: hideCurrent,
                                    isCurrent: true,
                                    toggle: () => setState(
                                      () => hideCurrent = !hideCurrent,
                                    ),
                                    validator: (v) => (v ?? '').isEmpty
                                        ? 'Ingresa tu contraseÃ±a actual'
                                        : null,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                                  passwordField(
                                    controller: newPassword,
                                    label: 'Nueva contraseÃ±a',
                                    hidden: hideNew,
                                    toggle: () =>
                                        setState(() => hideNew = !hideNew),
                                    validator: (v) {
                                      if ((v ?? '').isEmpty) {
                                        return 'Ingresa la nueva contraseÃ±a';
                                      }
                                      if (v == currentPassword.text) {
                                        return 'Debe ser diferente de la contraseÃ±a actual';
                                      }
                                      return null;
                                    },
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                                  passwordField(
                                    controller: confirmation,
                                    label: 'Confirmar nueva contraseÃ±a',
                                    hidden: hideConfirmation,
                                    last: true,
                                    toggle: () => setState(
                                      () =>
                                          hideConfirmation = !hideConfirmation,
                                    ),
                                    validator: (v) =>
                                        (v ?? '').isEmpty ||
                                            v != newPassword.text
                                        ? 'Las contraseÃ±as deben coincidir'
                                        : null,
                                  ),
                                  if (error != null)
                                    Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
                                      child: Text(
                                        error!,
                                        style: TextStyle(

                                            context,

                                            height: 18,
                                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                              strokeWidth: 2,
                                            ),
                                          )
                                        : const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
                                    label: Text(
                                      saving
                                          ? 'Guardando...'
                                          : 'Guardar contraseÃ±a',
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),

  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class LoginPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<LoginPage> createState() => _LoginPageState();
}

class _LoginPageState extends State<LoginPage> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final emailController = TextEditingController();
  final passwordController = TextEditingController();

  bool isRegister = false;
  bool loading = false;
  bool obscurePassword = true;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    emailController.dispose();
    passwordController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> submit() async {
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();

    setState(() => loading = true);

    try {
      final email = emailController.text.trim();
      final password = passwordController.text;

      if (isRegister) {
        final response = await supabase.auth.signUp(
          email: email,
          password: password,
        );

        if (!mounted) return;

        if (response.session == null) {
          showMessage(
            'Registro enviado. Revisa tu correo para confirmar la cuenta.',
          );
        } else {
          showMessage('Â¡Cuenta creada correctamente!');
        }
      } else {
        await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(
          email: email,
          password: password,
        );
      }
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showMessage(e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showMessage('OcurriÃ³ un error: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  void showMessage(String text) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final loginForm = Card(
      child: Padding(

                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),

                    'assets/branding/mi_billete.png',
                    width: 80,
                    height: 80,

                    semanticLabel: 'Mi Billete',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),

                'Mi Billete',

                    ? 'Crea tu cuenta personal'
                    : 'Ingresa con el correo de tu cuenta',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 28),
              TextFormField(
                controller: emailController,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.email],
                textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Correo electrÃ³nico',

                ),
                validator: (value) {
                  final email = (value ?? '').trim();

                  if (email.isEmpty) {
                    return 'Escribe tu correo electrÃ³nico';

                  if (!RegExp(r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$').hasMatch(email)) {

              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: loading ? null : submit,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),

              TextButton(
                onPressed: loading

                        });
                      },

import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../widgets/page_intro.dart';
import '../../widgets/date_period_field.dart';
import '../../data/period_logic.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/transaction_repository.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'budget_form_dialog.dart';
import 'budget_summary.dart';
import '../../data/credit_card_repository.dart';
import 'budget_card.dart';

class BudgetsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const BudgetsPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<BudgetsPage> createState() => _BudgetsPageState();
}

class _BudgetsPageState extends State<BudgetsPage> {
  DateTime month = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month);
  DateTime get periodStart => month;
  DateTime? customEnd;
  DateTime get periodEnd =>
      customEnd ?? DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1, 0);
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> budgets = [], categories = [];
  Map<String, int> spent = {};
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    loadData();
  }

  String monthDate(DateTime date) =>
      '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-01';
  String money(int cents, String currency) => formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);
  void message(String text) =>
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    final from = periodStart, until = periodEnd;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) throw Exception('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      final categoryRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('categories')
            .select('id, name, is_active, icon, color')
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .eq('category_type', 'expense')
            .order('name')
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        categoryRows.addAll(page);
        if (page.length < 500) break;
      }
      final budgetRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('budgets')
            .select(
              'id, category_id, currency, budget_amount, month, start_date, end_date',
            )
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .lte('start_date', isoDay(until))
            .gte('end_date', isoDay(from))
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        budgetRows.addAll(page);
        if (page.length < 500) break;
      }
      final transactions = [
        ...await loadUserTransactions(user.id),
        ...await loadUserCardExpenses(user.id),
      ];
      final totals = {
        for (final budget in budgetRows)
          '${budget['id']}': budgetSpent(budget, transactions),
      };
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) return;
      setState(() {
        categories = categoryRows;
        budgets = budgetRows;
        spent = totals;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> changeMonth(int offset) async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    setState(() {
      month = DateTime(month.year, month.month + offset);
      customEnd = null;
    });
    await loadData();
  }

  Future<void> editBudget([Map<String, dynamic>? budget]) async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    final available = categories
        .where(
          (c) =>
              c['is_active'] == true ||
              c['id'].toString() == budget?['category_id']?.toString(),
        )
        .toList();
    if (budget != null &&
        !available.any(
          (c) => c['id'].toString() == budget['category_id'].toString(),
        )) {
      available.add({
        'id': budget['category_id'],
        'name': 'CategorÃ­a no disponible',
      });
    }
    if (available.isEmpty) {
      message('Primero crea una categorÃ­a activa de gasto.');
      return;
    }
    final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => BudgetFormDialog(
        categories: available,
        budget: budget,
        initialStart: periodStart,
        initialEnd: periodEnd,
      ),
    );
    if (data == null || !mounted) return;
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      if (budget == null) {
        await supabase.from('budgets').insert({...data, 'user_id': user.id});
      } else {
        await supabase
            .from('budgets')
            .update({
              'budget_amount': data['budget_amount'],
              'start_date': data['start_date'],
              'end_date': data['end_date'],
              'month': data['month'],
            })
            .eq('id', budget['id'])
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .select('id')
            .single();
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      message('Presupuesto guardado.');
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        message(
          e.code == '23505'
              ? 'Ya existe un presupuesto con estas fechas o superpuesto.'
              : 'No se pudo guardar: ${e.message}',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteBudget(Map<String, dynamic> budget) async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Eliminar presupuesto'),
        content: const Text(
          'Se eliminarÃ¡ este lÃ­mite del perÃ­odo. Los movimientos registrados se conservan.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Eliminar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed != true || !mounted || loading || saving) return;
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final deleted = await supabase
          .from('budgets')
          .delete()
          .eq('id', budget['id'])
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .select('id');
      if (!mounted) return;
      message(
        deleted.isEmpty
            ? 'No se eliminÃ³: el registro cambiÃ³ o faltan permisos.'
            : 'Presupuesto eliminado.',
      );
      await loadData();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo eliminar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Widget budgetCard(Map<String, dynamic> budget) {
    final categoryId = budget['category_id'].toString();
    final currency = budget['currency'].toString();
    Map<String, dynamic>? categoryStyle;
    for (final category in categories) {
      if (category['id'].toString() == categoryId) {
        categoryStyle = category;
        break;
      }
    }
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Text(
          'Desde ${isoDay(budgetStart(budget))} hasta ${isoDay(budgetEnd(budget))}',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
        ),
        BudgetCard(
          name: categoryStyle?['name']?.toString() ?? 'CategorÃ­a no disponible',
          currency: currency,
          categoryStyle: categoryStyle,
          limitCents: moneyCents(budget['budget_amount']),
          usedCents: spent['${budget['id']}'] ?? 0,
          onEdit: saving ? null : () => editBudget(budget),
          onDelete: saving ? null : () => deleteBudget(budget),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GuideScope(
    topic: 'budgets',
    ready: !loading && error == null,
    child: Scaffold(

import '../../core/app_theme.dart'
    show appBorder, appMuted, appSurfaceSubtle, appText;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../widgets/category_style.dart';

class BudgetCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const BudgetCard({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.currency,
    required this.limitCents,
    required this.usedCents,
    this.onEdit,
    this.onDelete,
    this.categoryStyle,
  });
  final String name, currency;
  final int limitCents, usedCents;
  final VoidCallback? onEdit, onDelete;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? categoryStyle;

  String money(int cents) => formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final muted = appMuted;
    final border = appBorder;
    final remaining = limitCents - usedCents;
    final exceeded = remaining < 0;
    final ratio = limitCents > 0 ? usedCents / limitCents : 0.0;
    final nearLimit = !exceeded && limitCents > 0 && ratio >= 0.8;
    final color = exceeded
        ? const Color(0xFFB13D32)
        : nearLimit
        ? const Color(0xFF946200)
        : const Color(0xFF397455);

    final categoryAccent = categoryStyle == null
        ? color
        : categoryColor(categoryStyle?['color']);
    final categorySymbol = categoryStyle == null
        ? Icons.donut_large_rounded
        : categoryIcon(categoryStyle?['icon']);

    final status = exceeded
        ? 'Excedido'
        : usedCents < 0
        ? 'Devoluciones netas'
        : limitCents == 0
        ? 'Sin importe asignado'
        : nearLimit
        ? 'Cerca del lÃ­mite'
        : 'Dentro del lÃ­mite';
    final progress = limitCents > 0
        ? ratio.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble()
        : usedCents > 0
        ? 1.0
        : 0.0;

    Widget detail(String label, int amount) => Expanded(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14)),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: Text(
              money(amount),
              style: TextStyle(
                color: appText,
                fontSize: 17,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
        border: Border.all(color: exceeded ? color.withAlpha(90) : border),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withAlpha(6),
            blurRadius: 16,
            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(11),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: categoryAccent.withAlpha(15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
                ),
                child: Icon(categorySymbol, color: categoryAccent, size: 24),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      name,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: appText,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      'Presupuesto mensual Â· $currency',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              IconButton(
                tooltip: 'Editar presupuesto',
                onPressed: onEdit,
                icon: Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, color: muted, size: 20),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          Text(
            exceeded ? 'EXCESO' : 'DISPONIBLE NETO',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: muted,
              fontSize: 14,
              letterSpacing: 1.2,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: Text(
              money(remaining.abs()),
              style: TextStyle(
                color: color,
                fontSize: 30,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                letterSpacing: -0.8,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: appSurfaceSubtle,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    detail('Asignado', limitCents),
                    const SizedBox(width: 16),
                    detail('Gasto neto', usedCents),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: progress,
                    minHeight: 9,
                    color: color,
                    backgroundColor: border,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 9),
                Text(
                  limitCents > 0
                      ? '${(ratio * 100).toStringAsFixed(0)}% de gasto neto sobre el lÃ­mite'
                      : 'Sin porcentaje: el lÃ­mite asignado es cero',
                  style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 14),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
            crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
            spacing: 12,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 10,
                  vertical: 7,
                ),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: color.withAlpha(15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  status,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: color,
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              TextButton.icon(
                onPressed: onDelete,
                style: TextButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: muted),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded, size: 18),
                label: const Text('Eliminar'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../widgets/date_period_field.dart';
import '../../data/period_logic.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class BudgetFormDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const BudgetFormDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.categories,
    this.budget,
    this.initialStart,
    this.initialEnd,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? budget;
  final DateTime? initialStart, initialEnd;
  @override
  State<BudgetFormDialog> createState() => _BudgetFormDialogState();
}

class _BudgetFormDialogState extends State<BudgetFormDialog> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final amountController = TextEditingController();
  String? categoryId;
  String currency = 'NIO';
  late DateTime start, end;
  bool get editing => widget.budget != null;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    start =
        widget.initialStart ??
        DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month);
    end = widget.initialEnd ?? DateTime(start.year, start.month + 1, 0);
    final budget = widget.budget;
    if (budget != null) {
      start = budgetStart(budget);
      end = budgetEnd(budget);
      categoryId = budget['category_id'].toString();
      currency = budget['currency'].toString();
      amountController.text = budget['budget_amount'].toString();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    amountController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void save() {
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'start_date': isoDay(start),
      'end_date': isoDay(end),
      'month': isoDay(DateTime(start.year, start.month)),
      'category_id': categoryId,
      'currency': currency,
      'budget_amount': double.parse(
        amountController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
      ),
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    title: Text(editing ? 'Editar presupuesto' : 'Nuevo presupuesto'),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 420,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Form(
          key: formKey,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              DatePeriodField(
                start: start,
                end: end,
                onChanged: (range) => setState(() {
                  start = range.start;
                  end = range.end;
                }),
              ),

              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: categoryId,
                isExpanded: true,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'CategorÃ­a de gasto',
                ),
                items: widget.categories
                    .map(
                      (c) => DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: c['id'].toString(),
                        child: Text(
                          c['name'].toString(),
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                    .toList(),
                onChanged: editing
                    ? null
                    : (value) => setState(() => categoryId = value),
                validator: (value) =>
                    value == null ? 'Selecciona una categorÃ­a' : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: currency,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Moneda'),
                items: const [
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'NIO', child: Text('CÃ³rdobas (C\$)')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'USD', child: Text('DÃ³lares (\$)')),
                ],
                onChanged: editing
                    ? null
                    : (value) {
                        if (value != null) setState(() => currency = value);
                      },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextFormField(
                controller: amountController,
                keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                  decimal: true,
                ),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'LÃ­mite del perÃ­odo',
                ),
                validator: (value) {
                  final text = (value ?? '').trim();
                  final amount = double.tryParse(text.replaceAll(',', '.'));
                  if (amount == null || !amount.isFinite || amount <= 0)
                    return 'Introduce un monto mayor que cero';
                  if (!RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text))
                    return 'Usa como mÃ¡ximo seis decimales, sin separadores de miles';
                  return null;
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cancelar'),
      ),
      FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Guardar')),
    ],
  );
}

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted, appPrimaryDeep, primaryColor;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';

class BudgetSummary extends StatelessWidget {
  const BudgetSummary({super.key, required this.budgets, required this.spent});
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> budgets;
  final Map<String, int> spent;

  String money(int cents, String currency) => formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

  Widget currencyCard(String currency) {
    final selected = budgets.where((b) => b['currency'] == currency).toList();
    final categories = <String>{};
    int limit = 0, used = 0, exceeded = 0;
    for (final budget in selected) {
      final amount = moneyCents(budget['budget_amount']);
      final key = '${budget['id']}';
      final expense = spent[key] ?? 0;
      limit += amount;
      if (categories.add(key)) used += expense;
      if (expense > amount) exceeded++;
    }
    final remaining = limit - used;
    final colors = remaining < 0
        ? const [Color(0xFF881337), Color(0xFFBE123C)]
        : [appPrimaryDeep, primaryColor];

    Widget detail(String label, int amount) => Expanded(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white.withAlpha(200), fontSize: 14),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: Text(
              money(amount, currency),
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white,
                fontSize: 17,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: colors,
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.savings_outlined, color: Colors.white, size: 23),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  currency == 'USD' ? 'DÃ³lares' : 'CÃ³rdobas',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white.withAlpha(24),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  currency,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 22),
          Text(
            remaining < 0 ? 'EXCESO NETO' : 'DISPONIBLE NETO',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: Colors.white.withAlpha(200),
              fontSize: 14,
              letterSpacing: 1.3,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 7),
          FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: Text(
              money(remaining.abs(), currency),
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.white,
                fontSize: 32,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                letterSpacing: -0.8,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 22),
          Row(
            children: [
              detail('Presupuestado', limit),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              detail('Gasto neto', used),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Divider(color: Colors.white.withAlpha(40), height: 1),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Text(
            selected.isEmpty
                ? 'Sin presupuestos en esta moneda'
                : '${selected.length} presupuestos Â· $exceeded excedidos',
            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white.withAlpha(220), fontSize: 14),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (budgets.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, box) {
            final nio = currencyCard('NIO');
            final usd = currencyCard('USD');
            if (box.maxWidth < 700) {
              return Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [nio, const SizedBox(height: 14), usd],
              );
            }
            return Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Expanded(child: nio),
                const SizedBox(width: 14),
                Expanded(child: usd),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
        Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          child: Text(
            'Incluye los presupuestos visibles y el gasto de cada uno en su perÃ­odo. '
            'El disponible neto puede coexistir con categorÃ­as excedidas.',
            style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14, height: 1.5),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\categories\categories_page.dart
// ==========================================
import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted, primaryColor;
import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../widgets/page_intro.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import 'category_form_dialog.dart';
import 'category_tile.dart';

enum _CategoryStatus { all, active, inactive }

class CategoriesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const CategoriesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<CategoriesPage> createState() => _CategoriesPageState();
}

class _CategoriesPageState extends State<CategoriesPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories = [];
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  String? error;
  String filter = 'all';
  _CategoryStatus statusFilter = _CategoryStatus.all;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    loadCategories();
  }

  void message(String text) =>
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
  Future<void> loadCategories() async {
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) throw Exception('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('categories')
            .select('id, name, category_type, is_active, icon, color')
            .order('name')
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        rows.addAll(page);
        if (page.length < 500) break;
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        categories = rows;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  Future<void> editCategory([Map<String, dynamic>? category]) async {
    if (saving || loading) return;
    final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) =>
          CategoryFormDialog(category: category, categories: categories),
    );
    if (data == null || !mounted) return;
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      message('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      if (category == null) {
        await supabase.from('categories').insert({...data, 'user_id': user.id});
      } else {
        await supabase
            .from('categories')
            .update({
              'name': data['name'],
              'icon': data['icon'],
              'color': data['color'],
            })
            .eq('id', category['id'])
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .select('id')
            .single();
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      message(
        category == null ? 'CategorÃ­a creada.' : 'CategorÃ­a actualizada.',
      );
      await loadCategories();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        message(
          e.code == '23505'
              ? 'Ya existe una categorÃ­a de ese tipo con ese nombre.'
              : 'No se pudo guardar: ${e.message}',
        );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> toggleCategory(Map<String, dynamic> category) async {
    if (saving || loading) return;
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      message('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      return;
    }
    final active = category['is_active'] != true;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await supabase
          .from('categories')
          .update({'is_active': active})
          .eq('id', category['id'])
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .select('id')
          .single();
      if (!mounted) return;
      message(
        active
            ? 'CategorÃ­a activada.'
            : 'CategorÃ­a desactivada. Se conserva en el historial.',
      );
      await loadCategories();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo actualizar: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo actualizar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

      final matchesType =
          filter == 'all' || category['category_type'] == filter;

        _CategoryStatus.all => true,
        _CategoryStatus.active => active,

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('CategorÃ­as'),
        actions: [
          const AppHelpButton(topic: 'budgets'),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Actualizar',
            onPressed: loading || saving ? null : loadCategories,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
        onPressed: loading || saving ? null : () => editCategory(),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
        label: Text(saving ? 'Guardando...' : 'Nueva categorÃ­a'),
      ),
      body: PageFrame(
        maxWidth: 940,
        child: loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
            : error != null
            ? Center(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),

                onRefresh: loadCategories,
                child: ListView(
                  physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 100),
                  children: [
                    const PageIntro(
                      icon: Icons.category_outlined,
                      title: 'Organiza tus movimientos',

                              initialValue: filter,
                              isExpanded: true,
                              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                labelText: 'Tipo',
                              ),
                              items: const [
                                DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'all',
                                  child: Text('Todos'),
                                ),
                                DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'income',
                                  child: Text('Ingresos'),
                                ),

                                  value: 'expense',

                              initialValue: statusFilter,

                                labelText: 'Estado',

                                  value: _CategoryStatus.all,

                                  value: _CategoryStatus.inactive,
                                  child: Text('Inactivas'),
                                ),
                              ],
                              onChanged: (value) {
                                if (value != null)
                                  setState(() => statusFilter = value);
                              },
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    if (visible.isEmpty)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                        child: Text(
                          categories.isEmpty
                              ? 'No hay categorÃ­as. Crea una como Salario, AlimentaciÃ³n o Transporte.'
                              : 'No hay categorÃ­as que coincidan con los filtros.',
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        ),
                      ),

                    for (final type in ['income', 'expense'])
                      if (visible.any((c) => c['category_type'] == type)) ...[
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(2, 16, 2, 12),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(
                                type == 'income'
                                    ? Icons.south_west_rounded
                                    : Icons.north_east_rounded,
                                size: 18,
                                color: type == 'income'
                                    ? const Color(0xFF047857)
                                    : primaryColor,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                  type == 'income' ? 'Ingresos' : 'Gastos',
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 17,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted, appSurfaceMuted;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../widgets/category_style.dart';

class CategoryFormDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const CategoryFormDialog({
    super.key,
    this.category,
    required this.categories,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic>? category;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories;
  @override
  State<CategoryFormDialog> createState() => _CategoryFormDialogState();
}

class _CategoryFormDialogState extends State<CategoryFormDialog> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late final TextEditingController nameController;
  late String type, iconKey, colorHex;
  bool get editing => widget.category != null;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final category = widget.category;
    nameController = TextEditingController(
      text: category?['name']?.toString() ?? '',
    );
    type = category?['category_type']?.toString() ?? 'expense';
    iconKey = category?['icon']?.toString() ?? 'category';
    final hex = category?['color']?.toString().replaceAll('#', '').trim() ?? '';
    colorHex = RegExp(r'^[a-fA-F0-9]{6}$').hasMatch(hex)
        ? '#${hex.toUpperCase()}'
        : type == 'income'
        ? '#047857'
        : '#3C70AA';
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    nameController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void save() {
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'name': nameController.text.trim(),
      'category_type': type,
      'icon': iconKey,
      'color': colorHex,
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = categoryColor(colorHex);
    return AlertDialog(
      title: Text(editing ? 'Editar categorÃ­a' : 'Nueva categorÃ­a'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 440,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: formKey,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: color.withAlpha(12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    border: Border.all(color: color.withAlpha(40)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: color,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
                        ),
                        child: Icon(
                          categoryIcon(iconKey),
                          color: Colors.white,
                          size: 28,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 14),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              nameController.text.trim().isEmpty
                                  ? 'Tu categorÃ­a'
                                  : nameController.text.trim(),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 17,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Text(
                              type == 'income' ? 'Ingreso' : 'Gasto',
                              style: TextStyle(color: color, fontSize: 14),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: nameController,
                  onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Nombre',
                    hintText: 'Ej. AlimentaciÃ³n',
                  ),
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                  onFieldSubmitted: (_) => save(),
                  validator: (value) {
                    final name = (value ?? '').trim();
                    if (name.isEmpty)
                      return 'Escribe el nombre de la categorÃ­a';
                    final editingId = widget.category?['id'];
                    final duplicate = widget.categories.any(
                      (c) =>
                          c['id'] != editingId &&
                          c['category_type'] == type &&
                          c['name'].toString().trim().toLowerCase() ==
                              name.toLowerCase(),
                    );
                    return duplicate
                        ? 'Ya existe una categorÃ­a de este tipo con ese nombre'
                        : null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: type,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Tipo'),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'income', child: Text('Ingreso')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'expense', child: Text('Gasto')),
                  ],
                  onChanged: editing
                      ? null
                      : (value) {
                          if (value != null) setState(() => type = value);
                        },
                ),
                if (editing)
                  Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                    child: Text(
                      'El tipo se conserva para mantener la clasificaciÃ³n del historial.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                  ),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),
                const Text(
                  'Icono',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: [
                    ...categoryIconOptions.entries.map((entry) {
                      final selected = iconKey == entry.key;
                      return Semantics(
                        selected: selected,
                        child: IconButton(
                          tooltip: entry.value.$2,
                          onPressed: () => setState(() => iconKey = entry.key),
                          style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: selected ? color : appSurfaceMuted,
                            foregroundColor: selected ? Colors.white : appMuted,
                            minimumSize: const Size(48, 48),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                          ),
                          icon: Icon(entry.value.$1, size: 23),
                        ),
                      );
                    }),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),
                const Text(
                  'Color',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: [
                    ...categoryColorOptions.map((hex) {
                      final selected = colorHex == hex;
                      return Semantics(
                        label: 'Color $hex',
                        selected: selected,
                        child: Material(
                          color: categoryColor(hex),
                          shape: const CircleBorder(),
                          child: InkWell(
                            customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                            onTap: () => setState(() => colorHex = hex),
                            child: SizedBox(
                              width: 44,
                              height: 44,
                              child: selected
                                  ? const Icon(
                                      Icons.check_rounded,
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                    )
                                  : null,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    }),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cancelar'),
        ),
        FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Guardar')),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\credit_cards\card_payment_sheet_page.dart
// ==========================================
import '../../core/status_colors.dart';
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_repository.dart';
import '../../data/payment_agenda_labels.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import 'credit_card_statements_page.dart';
import 'credit_card_face.dart';
import 'register_statement_payment.dart';

enum _Period { all, overdue, nextWeek }

enum _PaymentAmount { minimum, total, custom }

typedef _Sheet = ({
  String userId,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards,
  CardStatementData statements,
});

class CardPaymentSheetPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const CardPaymentSheetPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<CardPaymentSheetPage> createState() => _CardPaymentSheetPageState();
}

class _CardPaymentSheetPageState extends State<CardPaymentSheetPage> {
  static const _currencies = ['NIO', 'USD'];
  late Future<_Sheet> _sheet = _load();
  _Period _period = _Period.all;
  bool _paying = false;

  Future<_Sheet> _load() async {
    final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (userId == null) throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
    final (cards, statements) = await (
      statementRows(
        'credit_cards',
        'id,name,currency,is_active,card_reference,network,card_tier,card_product,financial_institutions(name)',
        userId,
      ),
      loadCardStatements(userId),
    ).wait;
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
    }
    return (userId: userId, cards: cards, statements: statements);
  }

  void _refresh() => setState(() => _sheet = _load());

  Future<void> _pay(
    String userId,
    StatementProgress cut,
    _PaymentAmount amount,
  ) async {
    if (_paying) return;
    setState(() => _paying = true);
    try {
      final cents = switch (amount) {
        _PaymentAmount.minimum => cut.minimumRemaining,
        _PaymentAmount.total => cut.remaining,
        _PaymentAmount.custom => null,
      };
      final saved = await registerStatementPayment(
        context,
        userId,
        cut.statement,
        initialAmountCents: cents,
      );
      if (mounted && saved) {
        _refresh();
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Pago registrado.')));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo completar el pago: $error')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _paying = false);
    }
  }

  DateTime? _due(StatementProgress cut) =>
      statementDate(cut.statement['due_date']);

  bool _includes(StatementProgress cut, DateTime today) {
    if (_period == _Period.all) return true;
    final due = _due(cut);
    if (cut.settled || due == null) return false;
    final days = daysUntil(due, today);
    return _period == _Period.overdue ? days < 0 : days >= 0 && days <= 7;
  }

  int _dateOrder(List<StatementProgress> cuts) =>
      cuts.fold(8640000000000000, (first, cut) {
        final due = cut.settled ? null : _due(cut)?.millisecondsSinceEpoch;
        return due != null && due < first ? due : first;
      });

  String _amount(int? cents, String currency) =>
      cents == null ? 'Sin dato' : formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

  Widget _cutRow(_Sheet sheet, String currency, StatementProgress cut) {
    final due = _due(cut);
    final overdue =
        !cut.settled && due != null && daysUntil(due, DateTime.now()) < 0;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Text(
          cut.settled
              ? 'Corte cubierto'
              : due == null
              ? 'Fecha lÃ­mite sin registrar'
              : '${overdue ? 'VenciÃ³ el' : 'Vence el'} ${shortStatementDate(cut.statement['due_date'])}',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
            color: appDueColor(due, settled: cut.settled),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        AdaptiveColumns(
          minColumnWidth: 112,
          children: [
            _amountLabel(
              'MÃ­nimo pendiente',
              _amount(cut.settled ? 0 : cut.minimumRemaining, currency),
            ),
            _amountLabel('Saldo del corte', _amount(cut.remaining, currency)),
          ],
        ),
        if ((cut.remaining ?? 0) > 0)
          Align(
            alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
            child: PopupMenuButton<_PaymentAmount>(
              enabled: !_paying,
              tooltip: 'Pagar en ${currency == 'NIO' ? 'cÃ³rdobas' : 'dÃ³lares'}',
              onSelected: (amount) => _pay(sheet.userId, cut, amount),
              itemBuilder: (_) => [
                if ((cut.minimumRemaining ?? 0) > 0)
                  const PopupMenuItem(
                    value: _PaymentAmount.minimum,
                    child: Text('Pagar mÃ­nimo'),
                  ),
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: _PaymentAmount.total,
                  child: Text('Pagar total del corte'),
                ),
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: _PaymentAmount.custom,
                  child: Text('Otro monto'),
                ),
              ],
              child: Chip(
                avatar: const Icon(Icons.payments_outlined, size: 17),
                label: const Text('Pagar'),
                backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _amountLabel(String label, String amount) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(label, style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall),
        Text(
          amount,
          style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
            color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _moneyPanel(String title, List<Widget> children) => Container(
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerLow,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
    ),
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
    child: Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        ...children,
      ],
    ),
  );

  Widget _content(_Sheet sheet) {
    final today = DateTime.now();
    final rows =
        [
          for (final card in sheet.cards)
            (
              card: card,
              cuts: sheet.statements
                  .currentFor('${card['id']}')
                  .map(sheet.statements.progress)
                  .where((cut) => _includes(cut, today))
                  .toList(),
            ),
        ]..sort((a, b) {
          final byDate = _dateOrder(a.cuts).compareTo(_dateOrder(b.cuts));
          return byDate != 0
              ? byDate
              : agendaCardLabel(a.card).compareTo(agendaCardLabel(b.card));
        });
    final allCuts = rows.expand((row) => row.cuts).toList();
    final visible = rows.where(
      (row) => _period == _Period.all || row.cuts.isNotEmpty,
    );
    String label(String currency) => currency == 'NIO' ? 'CÃ³rdobas' : 'DÃ³lares';

    return ListView(
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(pageGutter(context)),
      children: [
        DropdownButtonFormField<_Period>(
          initialValue: _period,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Vencimientos'),
          items: const [
            DropdownMenuItem(value: _Period.all, child: Text('Todas')),
            DropdownMenuItem(value: _Period.overdue, child: Text('Vencidas')),
            DropdownMenuItem(
              value: _Period.nextWeek,
              child: Text('Hoy y prÃ³ximos 7 dÃ­as'),
            ),
          ],
          onChanged: (value) {
            if (value != null) setState(() => _period = value);
          },
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Text(
          'Totales pendientes',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
        ),
        const Text('SegÃºn los cortes registrados en este filtro.'),
        AdaptiveColumns(
          minColumnWidth: 260,
          children: [
            for (final currency in _currencies)
              Card(
                child: _moneyPanel(label(currency), [
                  for (final (title, select)
                      in <(String, int? Function(StatementProgress))>[
                        ('MÃ­nimos', (cut) => cut.minimumRemaining),
                        ('Cortes completos', (cut) => cut.remaining),
                      ])
                    Builder(
                      builder: (_) {
                        final cuts = allCuts.where(
                          (cut) =>
                              cut.statement['currency'] == currency &&
                              !cut.settled,
                        );
                        final values = cuts.map(select).toList();
                        final total = values.whereType<int>().fold(
                          0,
                          (sum, value) => sum + value,
                        );
                        return _amountLabel(
                          values.contains(null) ? '$title Â· parcial' : title,
                          formatMoneyCents(total, currency),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                ]),
              ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        if (visible.isEmpty) const Text('No hay tarjetas para este filtro.'),
        for (final row in visible)
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  ListTile(
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    leading: SizedBox(
                      width: 82,
                      child: CreditCardFace(
                        card: row.card,
                        compact: true,
                        imageOnly: true,
                      ),
                    ),
                    title: Text(
                      agendaCardLabel(row.card, includeName: false),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                    trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _paying
                        ? null
                        : () async {
                            await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
                              MaterialPageRoute(
                                builder: (_) =>
                                    CreditCardStatementsPage(card: row.card),
                              ),
                            );
                            if (mounted) _refresh();
                          },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  AdaptiveColumns(
                    minColumnWidth: 320,
                    children: [
                      for (final currency in _currencies)
                        _moneyPanel(label(currency), [
                          if (row.cuts.any(
                            (cut) => cut.statement['currency'] == currency,
                          ))
                            for (final cut in row.cuts.where(
                              (cut) => cut.statement['currency'] == currency,
                            ))
                              _cutRow(sheet, currency, cut)
                          else
                            Text(
                              _period == _Period.all
                                  ? 'Sin corte registrado'
                                  : 'Sin vencimientos en este filtro',
                            ),
                        ]),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(
      title: const Text('Hoja de pagos de tarjetas'),
      actions: [
        IconButton(
          onPressed: _paying ? null : _refresh,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
          tooltip: 'Actualizar',
        ),
      ],
    ),
    body: PageFrame(
      maxWidth: 1120,
      child: FutureBuilder<_Sheet>(
        future: _sheet,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          final data = snapshot.data;
          if (data == null) {
            return Center(
              child: TextButton(
                onPressed: _refresh,
                child: const Text('No se pudo cargar la hoja. Reintentar'),
              ),
            );
          }
          return _content(data);
        },
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class _CreditCardsPageState extends State<CreditCardsPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards = [], transactions = [];
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  bool showPending = false;
  int historyRevision = 0;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> holds = [];
  bool hasLoaded = false;

  @override

    scrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  CardStatementData? statementData;
  String? error, selectedCardId;
  int requestId = 0;
  Map<String, dynamic>? get selectedCard {
    for (final c in cards) {
      if (c['id'].toString() == selectedCardId) {

      }

    return null;
