  void message(String text) {
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
    }
  }

  void checkSession(String id) {
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != id) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Intenta nuevamente.');
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> readRows(
    String table,
    String columns,
    String userId,
  ) async {
    final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
      var query = supabase.from(table).select(columns).eq('user_id', userId);
      if (table == 'credit_card_holds') query = query.eq('status', 'active');
      final result = await query.order('id').range(offset, offset + 499);
      final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
      rows.addAll(page);
      if (page.length < 500) {
        break;
      }
    }
    return rows;
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final cardFuture = readRows(
        'credit_cards',
        'id, name, card_reference, currency, credit_limit, opening_balance, opening_balance_nio, '
            'opening_balance_usd, limit_exchange_rate, closing_day, payment_day, is_active, '
            'institution_id, network, card_tier, card_product, financial_institutions(name, code)',
        user.id,
      );
      final txFuture = readRows(
        'credit_card_transactions',
        'id, credit_card_id, transaction_type, amount, currency, is_voided, '
            'charge_kind, cash_advance_fee, excludes_from_limit',
        user.id,
      );
      final pendingFuture = readRows('credit_card_holds', '*', user.id);
      final periodsFuture = loadCardStatements(user.id);
      final result = await Future.wait<Object>([
        cardFuture,
        txFuture,
        pendingFuture,
        periodsFuture,
      ]);
      final cardRows = result[0] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      final txRows = result[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      final pending = result[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      final periods = result[3] as CardStatementData;
      checkSession(user.id);
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        hasLoaded = true;
        cards = cardRows;
        transactions = [
          ...txRows,
          ...cardBonifiableReservations(periods.statements),
        ];
        holds = pending
            .where((h) => h['status'] == 'active')
            .map(
              (h) => <String, dynamic>{
                ...h,
                'transaction_type': 'pending_purchase',
              },
            )
            .toList();
        statementData = periods;
        if (!cards.any((c) => c['id'].toString() == selectedCardId)) {
          final visibleCards = orderedCards;
          selectedCardId = visibleCards.isEmpty
              ? null
              : visibleCards.first['id'].toString();
        }
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          if (!hasLoaded) error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
        if (hasLoaded) message('No se pudieron actualizar las tarjetas: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  int? balanceFor(Map<String, dynamic> card, String currency) =>
      cardBalance(card, transactions, currency);

  Future<void> payCard(Map<String, dynamic> card) async {
    if (loading || saving) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final currency = await chooseCurrency('Â¿En quÃ© moneda pagarÃ¡s?');
      if (currency == null || !mounted) {
        return;
      }
      final rows = await readRows(
        'accounts',
        'id, name, currency, is_active',
        user.id,
      );
      final accounts = rows
          .where((a) => a['is_active'] == true && a['currency'] == currency)
          .toList();
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      if (accounts.isEmpty) {
        message('Necesitas una cuenta activa en $currency.');
        return;
      }
      final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) => CreditCardPaymentDialog(
          accounts: accounts,
          currency: currency,
          statements:
              statementData?.payableFor('${card['id']}', currency) ?? [],
        ),
      );
      if (data == null || !mounted) {
        return;
      }
      checkSession(user.id);
      final statementId = data['statement_id'];
      final receipt = data.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
      final saved = await supabase.rpc(
        statementId == null
            ? 'register_credit_card_payment'
            : 'register_credit_card_payment_for_statement',
        params: {
          'p_card_id': card['id'],
          'p_account_id': data['account_id'],
          'p_amount': data['amount'],
          'p_reference': data['reference'],
          if (statementId != null) 'p_statement_id': statementId,
        },
      );
      if (mounted)
        await attachFinancialReceipt(
          context,
          receipt,
          user.id,
          'credit_card_transactions',
          saved,
        );
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      message('Pago registrado en $currency.');
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo registrar: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo registrar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> addMovement(Map<String, dynamic> card) async {
    if (loading || saving || card['is_active'] != true) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final categories = await readRows(
        'categories',
        'id, name, category_type, is_active',
        user.id,
      );
      final available =
          categories
              .where(

              )
              .toList()
            ..sort(
              (a, b) => a['name'].toString().compareTo(b['name'].toString()),
            );
      final additionalCards = await loadAdditionalCards(
        card['id'].toString(),
        user.id,
      );
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      final cashAccounts = (await readRows(
        'accounts',
        'id,name,currency,is_active,account_type',
        user.id,
      )).where((a) => a['account_type'] == 'cash').toList();
      if (!mounted) return;
      final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        context: context,

          additionalCards: additionalCards,
        ),
      );
      if (data == null || !mounted) {
        return;
      }
      checkSession(user.id);
      final current = await supabase
          .from('credit_cards')
          .select('is_active')
          .eq('id', card['id'])
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .single();
      if (current['is_active'] != true) {
        throw StateError('La tarjeta ya no estÃ¡ activa.');
      }
      final receipt = data.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
      final saved = await supabase
          .from('credit_card_transactions')
          .insert({...data, 'credit_card_id': card['id'], 'user_id': user.id})
          .select('id')
          .single();
      if (mounted)
        await attachFinancialReceipt(
          context,
          receipt,
          user.id,
          'credit_card_transactions',
          saved['id'],
        );
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      message('Movimiento registrado.');
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo guardar: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> addCard([Map<String, dynamic>? card]) async {
    if (loading || saving) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('financial_institutions')
            .select('id, name, is_active')
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        rows.addAll(page);
        if (page.length < 500) {
          break;
        }
      }
      final institutions =
          rows
              .where(
                (b) =>
                    b['is_active'] == true ||
                    b['id'] == card?['institution_id'],
              )
              .toList()
            ..sort(
              (a, b) => a['name'].toString().compareTo(b['name'].toString()),
            );
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) =>
            CreditCardFormDialog(card: card, institutions: institutions),
      );
      if (data == null || !mounted) {
        return;
      }
      checkSession(user.id);
      if (card == null) {
        await supabase.from('credit_cards').insert({
          ...data,
          'user_id': user.id,
        });
      } else {
        final changes = <String, dynamic>{
          for (final key in [
            'name',
            'card_reference',
            'credit_limit',
            'currency',
            'closing_day',
            'payment_day',
            'institution_id',
            'network',
            'card_tier',
            'card_product',
            'limit_exchange_rate',
          ])
            if (data.containsKey(key)) key: data[key],
        };
        // Los saldos sin cambios se conservan en la base de datos. El trigger
        // sincroniza opening_balance con la moneda del lÃ­mite seleccionada.
        for (final c in cardCurrencies) {
          final key = 'opening_balance_${c.toLowerCase()}';
          if (data.containsKey(key) &&
              moneyCents(data[key]) != cardOpening(card, c)) {
            changes[key] = data[key];
          }
        }
        await supabase
            .from('credit_cards')
            .update(changes)
            .eq('id', card['id'])
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .select('id')
            .single();
      }
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      message(card == null ? 'Tarjeta registrada.' : 'Tarjeta actualizada.');
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo guardar: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> toggleCard(Map<String, dynamic> card) async {
    if (loading || saving) {

    }
    final active = card['is_active'] != true;
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(

    if (confirmed != true || !mounted || loading || saving) {

    }
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      message('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      final updated = await supabase
          .from('credit_cards')

          .eq('is_active', !active)

      if (!mounted) {

      message(
        updated.isEmpty
            ? 'El registro cambiÃ³ o faltan permisos.'

            ? 'Tarjeta activada.'
            : 'Tarjeta desactivada.',
      );
      await loadData();
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo actualizar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  String cardOrder = 'bank';
  String orderCurrency = 'USD';

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get orderedCards {
    final result = [...cards];

    int compareNames(Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {
      final comparison = a['name'].toString().toLowerCase().compareTo(
        b['name'].toString().toLowerCase(),
      );
      return comparison != 0
          ? comparison
          : a['id'].toString().compareTo(b['id'].toString());
    }

    result.sort((a, b) {
      if (cardOrder == 'bank') {
        final bankA = cardBankName(a).trim().toLowerCase();
        final bankB = cardBankName(b).trim().toLowerCase();
        // Las tarjetas sin banco aparecen despuÃ©s de las que sÃ­ tienen uno.
        if (bankA.isEmpty != bankB.isEmpty) return bankA.isEmpty ? 1 : -1;
        final byBank = bankA.compareTo(bankB);
        return byBank != 0 ? byBank : compareNames(a, b);
      }
      if (cardOrder == 'name') {
        return compareNames(a, b);
      }

      final balanceA = balanceFor(a, orderCurrency);
      final balanceB = balanceFor(b, orderCurrency);

      // Los saldos pendientes de revisiÃ³n quedan al final.
      if (balanceA == null || balanceB == null) {
        if (balanceA == null && balanceB == null) {
          return compareNames(a, b);
        }
        return balanceA == null ? 1 : -1;
      }

      final debtA = balanceA > 0 ? balanceA : 0;
      final debtB = balanceB > 0 ? balanceB : 0;

      final comparison = cardOrder == 'debt_asc'
          ? debtA.compareTo(debtB)
          : debtB.compareTo(debtA);

      return comparison != 0 ? comparison : compareNames(a, b);
    });

    return result;
  }

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\credit_cards\credit_cards_summary.dart
// ==========================================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import 'credit_card_balances.dart';

class CreditCardsSummary extends StatelessWidget {
  const CreditCardsSummary({
    super.key,
    required this.cards,
    required this.balanceFor,
  });

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards;
  final int? Function(Map<String, dynamic>, String) balanceFor;

  Widget currencyCard(BuildContext context, String currency) {
    var debt = 0, credit = 0, unknown = 0;
    for (final card in cards) {
      final balance = balanceFor(card, currency);
      if (balance == null) {
        unknown++;
        continue;
      }
      if (balance > 0) {
        debt += balance;
      }
      if (balance < 0) {
        credit -= balance;
      }
    }

    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Card(
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              currency == 'USD' ? 'DÃ³lares Â· USD' : 'CÃ³rdobas Â· NIO',
              style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text('Deuda total', style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium),
            Text(
              unknown > 0 ? 'Por revisar' : cardMoney(debt, currency),
              style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              'Saldo a favor Â· ${unknown > 0 ? 'Por revisar' : cardMoney(credit, currency)}',
            ),
            if (unknown > 0)
              Text(
                unknown == 1
                    ? '1 tarjeta con ajustes pendientes de revisiÃ³n.'
                    : '$unknown tarjetas con ajustes pendientes de revisiÃ³n.',
                style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (cards.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Text('Deuda total de tus tarjetas', style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text(
          'Incluye tarjetas activas e inactivas. Los saldos a favor se muestran por separado.',
          style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        AdaptiveColumns(
          minColumnWidth: 280,
          children: [
            currencyCard(context, 'NIO'),
            currencyCard(context, 'USD'),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import '../../data/payment_agenda_labels.dart' show additionalCardLabel;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/credit_card_additional_repository.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'credit_card_movements_page.dart';

class CreditCardAdditionalsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreditCardAdditionalsPage({super.key, required this.card});

  final Map<String, dynamic> card;

  @override
  State<CreditCardAdditionalsPage> createState() =>
      _CreditCardAdditionalsPageState();
}

class _CreditCardAdditionalsPageState extends State<CreditCardAdditionalsPage> {
  late final String? userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> cards = load();
  bool saving = false;

  String get cardId => widget.card['id'].toString();
  String get currency => widget.card['currency'].toString();
  int get maxLimit => moneyCents(widget.card['credit_limit'] ?? 0);

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> load() async {
    final uid = userId;
    if (uid == null) throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
    return loadAdditionalCards(cardId, uid, includeControls: true);
  }

  void reload() {
    final next = load();
    setState(() {
      cards = next;
    });
  }

  Future<void> edit([Map<String, dynamic>? card]) async {
    if (saving) return;
    final values = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => _AdditionalCardForm(
        card: card,
        currency: currency,
        maxLimit: maxLimit,
      ),
    );
    if (values == null || !mounted) return;
    final uid = userId;
    if (uid == null || supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final table = supabase.from('credit_card_additionals');
      if (card == null) {
        await table.insert({
          ...values,
          'credit_card_id': cardId,
          'user_id': uid,
        });
      } else {
        await table
            .update(values)
            .eq('id', card['id'])
            .eq('credit_card_id', cardId)
            .eq('user_id', uid)
            .select('id')
            .single();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        final message = error is PostgrestException ? error.message : '$error';
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo guardar. $message')));
      }
      return;
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    reload();
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(content: Text('Tarjeta adicional guardada.')),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Tarjetas compartidas')),
    body: FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      future: cards,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                const Text('No se pudieron cargar las tarjetas adicionales.'),
                TextButton(onPressed: reload, child: const Text('Reintentar')),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }
        final rows = snapshot.data!;
        return Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 760),
            child: ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              children: [
                Text(
                  '${widget.card['name']} Â· Tarjeta titular',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                ),
                Text('LÃ­mite titular: ${formatMoneyCents(maxLimit, currency)}'),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                const Text(
                  'Las adicionales usan el crÃ©dito de la titular. Los permisos y lÃ­mites aquÃ­ registran la configuraciÃ³n de tu banco.',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                Align(
                  alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                  child: FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: saving ? null : () => edit(),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add_card_outlined),
                    label: const Text('Nueva adicional'),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                if (rows.isEmpty)
                  const Text('TodavÃ­a no hay tarjetas adicionales.'),
                for (final card in rows)
                  Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      title: Text(additionalCardLabel(card)),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        [
                          card['is_active'] == true ? 'Activa' : 'Archivada',
                          if (card['credit_limit'] == null)
                            'Sin lÃ­mite registrado por corte'
                          else
                            '${formatMoneyCents(moneyCents(card['credit_limit']), currency)} por corte',
                        ].join(' Â· '),
                      ),
                      onTap: saving ? null : () => edit(card),
                      trailing: IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Ver movimientos',
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.history),
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
                          context,
                          MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                            builder: (_) => CreditCardMovementsPage(
                              cardId: cardId,
                              initialAdditionalId: card['id'].toString(),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

class _AdditionalCardForm extends StatefulWidget {
  const _AdditionalCardForm({
    required this.card,
    required this.currency,
    required this.maxLimit,
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic>? card;
  final String currency;
  final int maxLimit;

  @override
  State<_AdditionalCardForm> createState() => _AdditionalCardFormState();
}

class _AdditionalCardFormState extends State<_AdditionalCardForm> {
  final form = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late final holder = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.card?['holder_name']?.toString(),
  );
  late final digits = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.card?['last_four']?.toString(),
  );
  late final limit = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.card?['credit_limit']?.toString(),
  );
  late final merchants = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.card?['merchant_restrictions']?.toString(),
  );
  late bool active = widget.card?['is_active'] != false;
  late bool allowsInternational = widget.card?['allows_international'] != false;
  late bool allowsOnline = widget.card?['allows_online'] != false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    holder.dispose();
    digits.dispose();
    limit.dispose();
    merchants.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void save() {
    if (!form.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final amount = limit.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.');
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'holder_name': holder.text.trim(),
      'last_four': digits.text.trim(),
      'credit_limit': amount.isEmpty ? null : amount,
      'limit_currency': amount.isEmpty ? null : widget.currency,
      'is_active': active,
      'allows_international': allowsInternational,
      'allows_online': allowsOnline,
      'merchant_restrictions': merchants.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : merchants.text.trim(),
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    title: Text(
      widget.card == null ? 'Nueva tarjeta adicional' : 'Editar adicional',
    ),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 420,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Form(
          key: form,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              TextFormField(
                controller: holder,
                maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                maxLength: 100,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Nombre en la tarjeta',
                ),
                validator: (value) =>
                    value!.trim().isEmpty ? 'Escribe el nombre.' : null,
              ),
              TextFormField(
                controller: digits,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                maxLength: 4,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Ãšltimos 4 dÃ­gitos',
                ),
                validator: (value) =>
                    RegExp(r'^[0-9]{4}$').hasMatch(value!.trim())
                    ? null
                    : 'Ingresa los cuatro dÃ­gitos.',
              ),
              const Divider(),
              const Text('Estado de la tarjeta'),
              SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: const Text('Tarjeta activa'),
                value: active,
                onChanged: (value) => setState(() => active = value),
              ),
              const Divider(),
              const Text('Puede consumir en'),
              SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                secondary: const Icon(Icons.language),
                title: const Text('Compras internacionales'),
                value: allowsInternational,
                onChanged: (value) =>
                    setState(() => allowsInternational = value),
              ),
              SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                secondary: const Icon(Icons.computer_outlined),
                title: const Text('Compras por internet'),
                value: allowsOnline,
                onChanged: (value) => setState(() => allowsOnline = value),
              ),
              const Divider(),
              const Text('Restricciones'),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextFormField(
                controller: limit,
                keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                  decimal: true,
                ),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Consumo mÃ¡ximo por corte (${widget.currency})',
                  helperText:
                      'Opcional Â· Hasta ${formatMoneyCents(widget.maxLimit, widget.currency)}',
                  helperMaxLines: 2,
                ),
                validator: (value) {
                  final text = value!.trim().replaceAll(',', '.');
                  if (text.isEmpty) return null;
                  final amount = double.tryParse(text);
                  if (amount == null ||
                      !amount.isFinite ||
                      amount <= 0 ||
                      !RegExp(r'^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text)) {
                    return 'Ingresa un monto positivo con hasta seis decimales.';
                  }
                  return amount > widget.maxLimit / moneyScale
                      ? 'El lÃ­mite supera el de la tarjeta titular.'
                      : null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextFormField(
                controller: merchants,
                maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                maxLength: 500,
                minLines: 1,
                maxLines: 3,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Restricciones por tipo de comercio',
                  hintText: 'Ej. Solo supermercados',
                ),
              ),
              const Text(
                'Los cambios en el banco se realizan desde su propia app.',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cancelar'),
      ),
      FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Guardar')),
    ],
  );

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'credit_card_face.dart';
import 'credit_card_products.dart';

class CreditCardAppearanceDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreditCardAppearanceDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.card,
    required this.institutions,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> card;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> institutions;
  @override
  State<CreditCardAppearanceDialog> createState() =>
      _CreditCardAppearanceDialogState();
}

class _CreditCardAppearanceDialogState
    extends State<CreditCardAppearanceDialog> {
  late String bankId, network, tier;
  String product = 'standard';
  final networks = <String, String>{
    '': 'Sin especificar',
    'visa': 'Visa',
    'mastercard': 'Mastercard',
    'amex': 'American Express',
  };

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    bankId = widget.card['institution_id']?.toString() ?? '';
    network = widget.card['network']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    tier = widget.card['card_tier']?.toString() ?? 'unspecified';
    product = widget.card['card_product']?.toString() ?? 'standard';
    if (creditCardProduct(product) == null) {
      product = 'standard';
    }
    if (!networks.containsKey(network)) networks[network] = network;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> get preview {
    final banks = widget.institutions.where(
      (b) => b['id'].toString() == bankId,
    );
    return {
      ...widget.card,
      'network': network,
      'card_tier': tier,
      'card_product': product,
      'financial_institutions': banks.isEmpty ? null : banks.first,
    };
  }

  String get selectedBank {
    for (final b in widget.institutions) {
      if (b['id'].toString() == bankId) {
        return cardBankKey(b['name'].toString());
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  void selectProduct(String value) {
    final design = creditCardProduct(value);
    setState(() {
      product = value;
      if (design != null) {
        network = design.network;
        tier = design.tier;
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    title: const Text('Personalizar tarjeta'),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 420,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            CreditCardFace(card: preview),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: bankId,
              isExpanded: true,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Banco emisor'),
              items: [
                const DropdownMenuItem(value: '', child: Text('Sin banco')),
                ...widget.institutions.map(
                  (b) => DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: b['id'].toString(),
                    child: Text(
                      b['name'].toString(),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              onChanged: (value) {
                if (value != null)
                  setState(() {
                    bankId = value;
                    product = 'standard';
                  });
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            CreditCardProductField(
              bank: selectedBank,
              value: product,
              onChanged: selectProduct,

                      }
                    },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              key: ValueKey('tier-$tier'),

                  .map(
                    (e) => DropdownMenuItem(value: e.key, child: Text(e.value)),
                  )
                  .toList(),
              onChanged: product != 'standard'
                  ? null
                  : (value) {
                      if (value != null) {
                        setState(() => tier = value);
                      }
                    },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'Selecciona los datos de tu tarjeta. La imagen es una referencia visual.',
              style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cancelar'),
      ),
      FilledButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
          'institution_id': bankId.isEmpty ? null : bankId,
          'network': network.isEmpty ? null : network,
          'card_tier': tier,
          'card_product': product,
        }),
        child: const Text('Guardar'),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\credit_cards\credit_card_balances.dart
// ==========================================
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../utils/card_cash_advance.dart';

const cardCurrencies = ['NIO', 'USD'];
const cardEffects = {
  'purchase': 1,
  'interest': 1,
  'fee': 1,
  'payment': -1,
  'refund': -1,
};

const cardRebate = 'rebate';
const cardRebateLabel = 'Rebate / descuento de tarjeta';

const cardPointsRedemption = 'points_redemption';
const cardPointsRedemptionLabel = 'RedenciÃ³n de puntos';

String cardMovementType(Object? transactionType, Object? chargeKind) =>
    switch (chargeKind) {
      'insurance' => 'insurance',
      cardPointsRedemption => cardPointsRedemption,
      cardRebate => cardRebate,
      _ => transactionType.toString(),
    };

String cardMoney(int? cents, String currency) =>
    formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

int cardOpening(Map<String, dynamic> card, String currency) {
  final value = card['opening_balance_${currency.toLowerCase()}'];
  if (value != null) {
    return moneyCents(value);
  }
  return card['currency'] == currency
      ? moneyCents(card['opening_balance'] ?? 0)
      : 0;
}

int? cardBalance(
  Map<String, dynamic> card,
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> transactions,
  String currency, {
  bool forLimit = false,
}) {
  var balance = cardOpening(card, currency);
  for (final tx in transactions) {
    if (tx['credit_card_id'].toString() != card['id'].toString() ||
        tx['is_voided'] == true) {
      continue;
    }
    if (!cardCurrencies.contains(tx['currency'])) {
      return null;
    }
    if (tx['currency'] != currency) {
      continue;
    }
    if (tx['transaction_type'] == 'bonifiable_interest') {
      balance += moneyCents(tx['amount']);
      continue;
    }
    if (tx['transaction_type'] == 'pending_purchase') {
      if (forLimit) balance += moneyCents(tx['amount']);
      continue;
    }
    final effect = cardEffects[tx['transaction_type']];
    if (effect == null) {
      return null;
    }
    var amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    if (forLimit && tx['excludes_from_limit'] == true) {
      if (isCardCashAdvance(tx)) {
        amount -= cardCashAdvanceFee(tx);
      } else if (tx['transaction_type'] == 'interest' ||
          tx['transaction_type'] == 'fee') {
        continue;
      }
    }
    balance += effect * amount;
  }
  return balance;
}

// Uso neto del lÃ­mite compartido: incluye saldos a favor en ambas monedas.
// Esta conversiÃ³n solo estima el disponible; no altera las deudas por moneda.
int? cardLimitUsed(Map<String, dynamic> card, int? nio, int? usd) {
  if (nio == null || usd == null) {
    return null;
  }
  final n = nio;
  final u = usd;
  final base = card['currency'].toString();
  final foreign = base == 'USD' ? n : u;
  if (foreign == 0) {
    return base == 'USD' ? u : n;
  }
  final rate = double.tryParse('${card['limit_exchange_rate']}');
  if (rate == null || !rate.isFinite || rate <= 0) {
    return null;
  }
  final converted = base == 'USD' ? n / rate : u * rate;
  if (!converted.isFinite) {
    return null;
  }
  return (base == 'USD' ? u : n) + converted.round();
}

int? cardUsed(
  Map<String, dynamic> card,
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> transactions,
) => cardLimitUsed(
  card,
  cardBalance(card, transactions, 'NIO', forLimit: true),
  cardBalance(card, transactions, 'USD', forLimit: true),
);

int? cardAvailable(Map<String, dynamic> card, int? used) {
  if (used == null) {
    return null;
  }
  final limit = moneyCents(card['credit_limit']);
  return limit - used;
}

/// Reservation from the statement, not a second finalized expense.
/// Archived statements retain the reservation until explicitly resolved.
List<Map<String, dynamic>> cardBonifiableReservations(
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> statements,
) => [
  for (final s in statements)
    if (s['is_voided'] != true &&
        (s['bonifiable_interest_status'] ?? 'pending') == 'pending' &&
        moneyCents(s['bonifiable_interest_due'] ?? 0) > 0)
      {
        'credit_card_id': s['credit_card_id'],
        'currency': s['currency'],
        'amount': s['bonifiable_interest_due'],
        'transaction_type': 'bonifiable_interest',
      },
];

class CreditCardFormDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreditCardFormDialog({
    super.key,
    this.card,
    required this.institutions,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic>? card;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> institutions;
  @override
  State<CreditCardFormDialog> createState() => _CreditCardFormDialogState();
}

class _CreditCardFormDialogState extends State<CreditCardFormDialog> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final name = TextEditingController(), reference = TextEditingController();
  final limit = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final nio = TextEditingController(text: '0.00'),
      usd = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final rate = TextEditingController(),
      closing = TextEditingController(),
      payment = TextEditingController();
  String currency = 'USD', bankId = '', network = '', tier = 'unspecified';
  String product = 'standard';
  final limitsByCurrency = <String, String>{};

  void selectCurrency(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value == currency) return;
    setState(() {
      limitsByCurrency[currency] = limit.text;
      currency = value;
      limit.text = limitsByCurrency[value] ?? '';
    });
  }

  final networks = <String, String>{
    '': 'Sin especificar',
    'visa': 'Visa',
    'mastercard': 'Mastercard',
    'amex': 'American Express',
  };
  bool get editing => widget.card != null;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final c = widget.card;
    if (c == null) {
      return;
    }
    name.text = c['name']?.toString() ?? '';
    reference.text = c['card_reference']?.toString() ?? '';
    bankId = c['institution_id']?.toString() ?? '';
    network = c['network']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (!networks.containsKey(network)) {
      networks[network] = network;
    }
    tier = c['card_tier']?.toString() ?? 'unspecified';
    product = c['card_product']?.toString() ?? 'standard';
    if (creditCardProduct(product) == null) {
      product = 'standard';
    }
    if (!cardTierLabels.containsKey(tier)) {
      tier = 'unspecified';
    }
    currency = c['currency'].toString();
    limit.text = '${c['credit_limit'] ?? 0}';
    nio.text = (cardOpening(c, 'NIO') / moneyScale).toStringAsFixed(6);
    usd.text = (cardOpening(c, 'USD') / moneyScale).toStringAsFixed(6);
    rate.text = c['limit_exchange_rate']?.toString() ?? '';
    closing.text = c['closing_day']?.toString() ?? '';
    payment.text = c['payment_day']?.toString() ?? '';
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in [
      name,
      reference,
      limit,
      nio,
      usd,
      rate,
      closing,
      payment,
    ]) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> get preview {
    final banks = widget.institutions.where(
      (b) => b['id'].toString() == bankId,
    );
    return {
      'name': name.text.trim().isEmpty ? 'Mi tarjeta' : name.text.trim(),
      'card_reference': reference.text.trim(),
      'network': network,
      'card_tier': tier,
      'card_product': product,
      'financial_institutions': banks.isEmpty ? null : banks.first,
    };
  }

  String get selectedBank {
    for (final b in widget.institutions) {
      if (b['id'].toString() == bankId) {
        return cardBankKey(b['name'].toString());
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  void selectProduct(String value) {
    final design = creditCardProduct(value);
    setState(() {
      product = value;
      if (design != null) {
        network = design.network;
        tier = design.tier;
      }
    });
  }

  String? validateAmount(String? value, {bool allowNegative = false}) {
    final text = (value ?? '').trim();
    final amount = double.tryParse(text.replaceAll(',', '.'));
    if (amount == null || !amount.isFinite || (!allowNegative && amount < 0)) {
      return 'Introduce un monto vÃ¡lido';
    }
    return RegExp(
          allowNegative ? r'^-?\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$' : r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$',
        ).hasMatch(text)
        ? null
        : 'Usa mÃ¡ximo seis decimales, sin separadores de miles';
  }

  double number(TextEditingController c) =>
      double.parse(c.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));
  Widget amountField(
    String label,
    TextEditingController controller, {
    bool allowNegative = false,
  }) => TextFormField(
    controller: controller,
    decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: label),
    keyboardType: TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
      decimal: true,
      signed: allowNegative,
    ),
    validator: (value) => validateAmount(value, allowNegative: allowNegative),
  );
  Widget dayField(String label, TextEditingController controller) =>
      TextFormField(
        controller: controller,
        decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: label),
        keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
        validator: (v) {
          if ((v ?? '').trim().isEmpty) {
            return null;
          }
          final day = int.tryParse(v!.trim());
          return day == null || day < 1 || day > 31
              ? 'Introduce un dÃ­a del 1 al 31'
              : null;
        },
      );
  void save() {
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'name': name.text.trim(),
      'card_reference': reference.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : reference.text.trim(),
      'institution_id': bankId.isEmpty ? null : bankId,
      'network': network.isEmpty ? null : network,
      'card_tier': tier,
      'card_product': product,
      'currency': currency,
      'credit_limit': number(limit),
      'opening_balance_nio': number(nio),
      'opening_balance_usd': number(usd),
      'opening_balance': currency == 'USD' ? number(usd) : number(nio),
      'limit_exchange_rate': rate.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : number(rate),
      'closing_day': int.tryParse(closing.text.trim()),
      'payment_day': int.tryParse(payment.text.trim()),
    });
  }

import 'zero_plan_form.dart';
