import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_logic.dart';
import 'credit_card_balances.dart';

class CreditCardPaymentEditDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreditCardPaymentEditDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.preview,
    required this.accounts,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> preview;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts;
  @override
  State<CreditCardPaymentEditDialog> createState() =>
      _CreditCardPaymentEditDialogState();
}

class _CreditCardPaymentEditDialogState
    extends State<CreditCardPaymentEditDialog> {
  final form = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final amount = TextEditingController(),
      reference = TextEditingController(),
      description = TextEditingController(),
      rate = TextEditingController();
  late Map<String, dynamic> payment;
  late DateTime date, originalDate;
  late String currency;
  String? accountId;
  bool unlink = false;
  int get allocated => moneyCents(widget.preview['allocated']);
  Map<String, dynamic>? get bank =>
      widget.accounts.where((a) => '${a['id']}' == accountId).firstOrNull;
  String get bankCurrency =>
      '${bank?['currency'] ?? payment['account_debit_currency'] ?? payment['currency']}';
  String get oldBankCurrency =>
      '${payment['account_debit_currency'] ?? payment['currency']}';
  bool get cross => bank != null && bankCurrency != currency;
  bool get incompatible =>
      currency != payment['currency'] &&
      (allocated > 0 || (widget.preview['links'] as List).isNotEmpty);
  double? get parsedRate =>
      double.tryParse(rate.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));
  int? get cardCents {
    final n = double.tryParse(amount.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));
    return n == null || !n.isFinite || n < 0 || n > 999999999999.99
        ? null
        : (n * moneyScale).round();
  }

  int? get debitCents {
    final c = cardCents;
    if (c == null || bank == null) return null;
    if (!cross) return c;
    final r = parsedRate;
    if (r == null || !r.isFinite || r <= 0 || r > 1000000) return null;
    final v = bankCurrency == 'USD' ? c / r : c * r;
    return !v.isFinite || v > 99999999999999 ? null : v.round();
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    payment = Map<String, dynamic>.from(widget.preview['payment'] as Map);
    currency = '${payment['currency']}';
    amount.text = (moneyCents(payment['amount']) / moneyScale).toStringAsFixed(
      6,
    );
    reference.text = payment['reference']?.toString() ?? '';
    description.text = payment['description']?.toString() ?? '';
    rate.text = payment['payment_exchange_rate']?.toString() ?? '';
    originalDate = DateTime.parse('${payment['transaction_date']}').toLocal();
    date = DateTime(originalDate.year, originalDate.month, originalDate.day);
    final id = payment['account_id']?.toString();
    accountId = widget.accounts.any((a) => '${a['id']}' == id) ? id : null;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in [amount, reference, description, rate]) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void save() {
    if (!form.currentState!.validate()) return;
    if (debitCents == null || debitCents! <= 0 || (incompatible && !unlink)) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Revisa el dÃ©bito y confirma retirar los vÃ­nculos incompatibles.',
          ),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    final sameDate =
        date.year == originalDate.year &&
        date.month == originalDate.month &&
        date.day == originalDate.day;
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'p_account_id': accountId,
      'p_amount': double.parse(amount.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')),
      'p_currency': currency,
      'p_rate': cross ? parsedRate : null,
      'p_unlink_incompatible': incompatible && unlink,
      'p_date': sameDate
          ? payment['transaction_date']
          : DateTime(
              date.year,
              date.month,
              date.day,
              12,
            ).toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'p_reference': reference.text.trim(),
      'p_description': description.text.trim(),
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final original = moneyCents(
          payment['account_debit_amount'] ?? payment['amount'],
        ),
        current = debitCents;
    final sameAccount = accountId == payment['account_id']?.toString();
    return AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('Editar pago de tarjeta'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 460,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: form,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Indica lo aplicado a la tarjeta y la cuenta desde donde pagaste. Si las monedas son distintas, introduce la tasa aplicada por el banco.',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: currency,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Moneda del pago aplicado a la tarjeta',
                  ),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'NIO',
                      child: Text('CÃ³rdobas (NIO)'),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'USD',
                      child: Text('DÃ³lares (USD)'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (v) {
                    if (v != null) setState(() => currency = v);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: amount,
                  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                    decimal: true,
                  ),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Monto aplicado a la tarjeta ($currency)',
                  ),
                  onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                  validator: (v) {
                    final text = (v ?? '').trim(),
                        n = double.tryParse(
                          (v ?? '').trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
                        );
                    if (n == null ||
                        !n.isFinite ||
                        n <= 0 ||
                        n > 999999999999.99 ||
                        !RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text))
                      return 'Monto positivo con mÃ¡ximo seis decimales';
                    return currency == payment['currency'] &&
                            (n * moneyScale).round() < allocated
                        ? 'Ya hay ${cardMoney(allocated, currency)} asignados a cuotas'
                        : null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: accountId,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Cuenta de origen',
                  ),
                  items: widget.accounts
                      .map(
                        (a) => DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: '${a['id']}',
                          child: Text(
                            '${a['name']} Â· ${a['currency']}${a['is_active'] != true ? ' Â· Inactiva' : ''}',
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                      )
                      .toList(),
                  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => accountId = v),
                  validator: (v) => v == null ? 'Selecciona una cuenta' : null,
                ),
                if (cross) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: rate,
                    keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                      decimal: true,
                    ),
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Tasa: cÃ³rdobas por \$1',
                      helperText:
                          'El dÃ©bito de cuenta se redondea a seis decimales.',
                      helperMaxLines: 2,
                    ),
                    onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                    validator: (v) {
                      final text = (v ?? '').trim(), r = parsedRate;
                      return r == null ||
                              !r.isFinite ||
                              r <= 0 ||
                              r > 1000000 ||
                              !RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text)
                          ? 'Tasa positiva con mÃ¡ximo seis decimales'
                          : null;
                    },
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Text(
                  'DÃ©bito de cuenta: ${cardMoney(current, bankCurrency)}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                  label: Text(
                    'Fecha: ${shortStatementDate(date.toIso8601String())}',
                  ),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final today = DateTime.now();
                    final d = await showDatePicker(
                      context: context,
                      initialDate: date,
                      firstDate: date.isBefore(DateTime(1900))
                          ? date
                          : DateTime(1900),
                      lastDate: date.isAfter(today) ? date : today,
                    );
                    if (d != null && mounted) setState(() => date = d);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: reference,
                  maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                  maxLength: 200,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Referencia (opcional)',
                  ),
                ),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: description,
                  maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                  maxLength: 1000,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'DescripciÃ³n (opcional)',
                  ),
                ),
                if (allocated > 0)
                  Text(
                    'Asignado a tasa cero: ${cardMoney(allocated, '${payment['currency']}')}. Conserva sus importes si mantienes la moneda.',
                  ),
                if (incompatible)
                  CheckboxListTile(
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    value: unlink,
                    title: const Text(
                      'Retirar los vÃ­nculos al corte y cuotas de la moneda anterior',
                    ),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'Esos pendientes volverÃ¡n a quedar sin cubrir. Luego podrÃ¡s aplicar el pago corregido al corte o cuotas de la nueva moneda.',
                    ),
                    onChanged: (v) => setState(() => unlink = v ?? false),
                  ),
                const Divider(height: 24),
                Text(
                  'DÃ©bito anterior: ${cardMoney(original, oldBankCurrency)}',
                ),
                Text(
                  'Aplicado a la tarjeta: ${cardMoney(cardCents, currency)}',
                ),
                if (current != null && current > 0)
                  Text(
                    sameAccount
                        ? current > original
                              ? 'DÃ©bito adicional de cuenta: ${cardMoney(current - original, bankCurrency)}.'
                              : current < original
                              ? 'La cuenta recuperarÃ¡ ${cardMoney(original - current, bankCurrency)}.'
                              : 'El dÃ©bito de la cuenta mantiene su importe.'
                        : 'La cuenta anterior recuperarÃ¡ ${cardMoney(original, oldBankCurrency)} y la seleccionada tendrÃ¡ un dÃ©bito de ${cardMoney(current, bankCurrency)}.',
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cancelar'),
        ),
        FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Guardar cambios')),
      ],
    );
  }
}

    show PendingReceipt, PersonReceiptsDialog;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'credit_card_balances.dart';
import 'zero_plan_form.dart';

class CreditCardPendingPanel extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreditCardPendingPanel({
    super.key,
    required this.card,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onProcessed,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> card;
  final Future<void> Function() onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onProcessed;
  @override
  State<CreditCardPendingPanel> createState() => _CreditCardPendingPanelState();
}

class _CreditCardPendingPanelState extends State<CreditCardPendingPanel> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> additions = [];
  bool busy = false, loading = true;
  String? error;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    try {
      final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
      if (uid == null) throw StateError('Inicia sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      final results = await Future.wait([
        _cardRows('credit_card_holds', uid),
        _cardRows('credit_card_additionals', uid),
      ]);
      final all = results[0];
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid)
        throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
      final list = all
          .where(
            (r) =>
                r['credit_card_id'] == widget.card['id'] &&
                r['status'] == 'active',
          )
          .toList();
      list.sort((a, b) => '${b['hold_date']}'.compareTo('${a['hold_date']}'));
      setState(() {
        additions = results[1];
        rows = list;
        loading = false;
        error = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          loading = false;
          error = '$e';
        });
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _cardRows(String table, String uid) async {
    final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
      var query = supabase
          .from(table)
          .select()
          .eq('user_id', uid)
          .eq('credit_card_id', widget.card['id']);
      if (table == 'credit_card_holds') query = query.eq('status', 'active');
      final page = await query.order('id').range(offset, offset + 499);
      result.addAll(List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(page));
      if (page.length < 500) break;
    }
    return result;
  }

  String cardLabel(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final id = row['additional_card_id'];
    if (id == null) return 'Tarjeta titular';
    final a = additions.where((a) => a['id'] == id).firstOrNull;
    return a == null
        ? 'Tarjeta adicional'
        : '${a['holder_name']} Â· â€¢â€¢${a['last_four']}';
  }

  Future<void> run(Future<void> Function() action) async {
    if (busy) return;
    setState(() => busy = true);
    try {
      await action();
      await load();
      await widget.onChanged();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo completar: $e')));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> edit([Map<String, dynamic>? row]) async {
    final v = await zeroForm(
      context,
      row == null ? 'Nuevo flotante' : 'Editar flotante',
      [
        ZeroField(
          'additional_card_id',
          'Tarjeta que hizo la compra',
          type: 'choice',
          options: {
            'primary': 'Tarjeta titular',
            for (final a in additions)
              if (a['is_active'] == true ||
                  a['id'] == row?['additional_card_id'])
                '${a['id']}': '${a['holder_name']} Â· â€¢â€¢${a['last_four']}',
          },
        ),
        const ZeroField('description', 'DescripciÃ³n'),
        ZeroField('amount', 'Monto retenido', type: 'money', zero: true),
        ZeroField(
          'currency',
          'Moneda',
          type: 'choice',
          options: {'USD': 'DÃ³lares (USD)', 'NIO': r'CÃ³rdobas (C$)'},
        ),
        ZeroField('date', 'Fecha', type: 'date'),
        ZeroField('reference', 'Referencia (opcional)', required: false),
      ],
      initial: {
        'description': row?['description'] ?? 'Compra en proceso',
        'amount': row?['amount'] ?? '',
        'currency': row?['currency'] ?? widget.card['currency'],
        'date':
            row?['hold_date'] ??
            DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10),
        'reference': row?['reference'] ?? '',
        'additional_card_id': row?['additional_card_id'] ?? 'primary',
      },
      attachReceipt: true,
    );
    if (v == null || !mounted) return;
    await run(() async {
      final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser!.id;
      final holdId = await supabase.rpc(
        'save_card_hold',
        params: {
          'p_additional_id': v['additional_card_id'] == 'primary'
              ? null
              : v['additional_card_id'],
          'p_id': row?['id'],
          'p_card_id': widget.card['id'],
          'p_date': v['date'],
          'p_amount': moneyCents(v['amount']) / moneyScale,
          'p_currency': v['currency'],
          'p_description': v['description'],
          'p_reference': v['reference'] ?? '',
        },
      );
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid)
        throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
      if (mounted)
        await attachFinancialReceipt(
          context,
          v[receiptDraftKey] as PendingReceipt?,
          uid,
          'credit_card_holds',
          holdId,
        );
    });
  }

  Future<void> release(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final yes = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Liberar flotante'),
        content: const Text(
          'La retenciÃ³n dejarÃ¡ de consumir disponible. No se registrarÃ¡ una compra.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Liberar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (yes == true && mounted)
      await run(() async {
        await supabase.rpc('release_card_hold', params: {'p_id': row['id']});
      });
  }

  Future<void> process(Map<String, dynamic> row) async {
    final v = await zeroForm(
      context,
      'Pasar flotante a procesado',
      const [
        ZeroField('description', 'DescripciÃ³n'),
        ZeroField('amount', 'Monto final', type: 'money'),
        ZeroField('date', 'Fecha de publicaciÃ³n', type: 'date'),
      ],
      initial: {
        'description': row['description'],
        'amount': row['amount'],
        'date': DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10),
      },
      attachReceipt: true,
      info:
          'Ãšsalo cuando el banco publique la compra. Si ya la registraste en Movimientos, cancela y libera este flotante para evitar duplicarla.',
    );
    if (v == null || !mounted) return;
    var processedSuccessfully = false;
    await run(() async {
      final txId = await supabase.rpc(
        'process_card_hold',
        params: {
          'p_id': row['id'],
          'p_date': v['date'],
          'p_amount': moneyCents(v['amount']) / moneyScale,
          'p_description': v['description'],
        },
      );
      if (mounted)
        await attachFinancialReceipt(
          context,
          v[receiptDraftKey] as PendingReceipt?,
          supabase.auth.currentUser!.id,
          'credit_card_transactions',
          txId,
        );
      processedSuccessfully = true;
    });
    if (mounted && processedSuccessfully) widget.onProcessed();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Card(
    margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
    child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
            crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              Text(
                'Flotantes Â· ${rows.length}',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
              ),
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: busy || loading ? null : () => edit(),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                label: const Text('Agregar flotante'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          const Text(
            'Reducen el disponible. Se suman al gasto cuando pasan a procesados.',
          ),
          if (loading) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
          if (error != null) ...[
            Text(error!),
            TextButton(onPressed: load, child: const Text('Reintentar')),
          ],
          if (!loading && error == null && rows.isEmpty)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Text('No hay flotantes registrados.'),
            ),
          for (final row in rows)
            LayoutBuilder(
              builder: (context, constraints) => ExpansionTile(
                key: ValueKey(row['id']),
                tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '${row['description']}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                    ),
                    if (constraints.maxWidth < 550)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                        child: Text(
                          formatRecordMoneyCents(
                            moneyCents(row['amount']),
                            '${row['currency']}',
                          ),
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                subtitle: Text(
                  '${cardLabel(row)} Â· ${row['hold_date']}${'${row['reference']}'.isEmpty ? '' : ' Â· ${row['reference']}'}',
                ),
                trailing: constraints.maxWidth < 550
                    ? null
                    : Text(
                        formatRecordMoneyCents(
                          moneyCents(row['amount']),
                          '${row['currency']}',
                        ),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 18,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        ),
                      ),
                children: [
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 8,
                    runSpacing: 4,
                    children: [
                      TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: busy
                            ? null
                            : () => showDialog<void>(
                                context: context,
                                builder: (_) => PersonReceiptsDialog.movement(
                                  table: 'credit_card_holds',
                                  entryId: '${row['id']}',
                                  writable: true,
                                ),
                              ),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.attach_file),
                        label: const Text('Comprobantes'),
                      ),
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: busy ? null : () => edit(row),
                        child: const Text('Editar'),
                      ),
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: busy ? null : () => release(row),
                        child: const Text('Liberar'),
                      ),
                      OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: busy ? null : () => process(row),
                        child: const Text('Pasar a procesado'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  );
}

import '../../core/status_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../data/card_statement_logic.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'credit_card_balances.dart';

class CreditCardPeriodSummary extends StatelessWidget {
  const CreditCardPeriodSummary({
    super.key,
    required this.cardId,
    required this.data,
    required this.onManage,
  });

  final String cardId;
  final CardStatementData data;
  final VoidCallback? onManage;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final current = data.currentFor(cardId);
    final first = current.firstOrNull;
    final sharedDates =
        first != null &&
        current.every(
          (row) =>
              row['closing_date'] == first['closing_date'] &&
              row['due_date'] == first['due_date'] &&
              row['bonus_payment_date'] == first['bonus_payment_date'],
        );
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    return Card(
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(
                  Icons.receipt_long_outlined,
                  color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'Cortes de esta tarjeta',
                    style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium,
                  ),
                ),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: onManage,
                  child: const Text('Ver cortes y pagos'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            if (first == null)
              const Text('Esta tarjeta no tiene cortes vigentes.'),
            if (first != null && sharedDates) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              _StatementDates(statement: first),
            ],
            if (current.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              AdaptiveColumns(
                minColumnWidth: 280,
                children: [
                  for (final statement in current)
                    _CurrencyPeriod(
                      key: ValueKey(statement['id']),
                      progress: data.progress(statement),
                      showDates: !sharedDates,
                      now: now,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _StatementDates extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatementDates({required this.statement});

  final Map<String, dynamic> statement;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Wrap(
    spacing: 16,
    runSpacing: 4,
    children: [
      Text(
        'Fecha mÃ¡xima de pago Â· ${shortStatementDate(statement['due_date'])}',
        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
      ),
      Text('Corte Â· ${shortStatementDate(statement['closing_date'])}'),
      if (statement['bonus_payment_date'] != null)
        Text(
          'Para bonificar Â· ${shortStatementDate(statement['bonus_payment_date'])}',
        ),
    ],
  );
}

class _CurrencyPeriod extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CurrencyPeriod({
    super.key,
    required this.progress,
    required this.showDates,
    required this.now,
  });

  final StatementProgress progress;
  final bool showDates;
  final DateTime now;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final statement = progress.statement;
    final currency = '${statement['currency']}';
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final due = statementDate(statement['due_date']);
    final past = due != null && daysUntil(due, now) < 0;
    final late = past && (progress.minimumRemaining ?? 0) > 0;
    final status = !progress.known
        ? 'Por revisar'
        : progress.settled
        ? 'Corte cubierto'
        : late
        ? 'MÃ­nimo vencido'
        : progress.minimumRemaining == 0
        ? 'MÃ­nimo cubierto'
        : past
        ? 'Fecha de pago pasada'
        : 'Vigente';
    final stateColor = appDueColor(due, settled: progress.settled, now: now);
    return Material(
      color: stateColor.withValues(alpha: .06),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        side: BorderSide(color: stateColor.withValues(alpha: .3)),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 14, 4),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
              crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 6,
              children: [
                Text(
                  currency == 'USD' ? 'DÃ³lares Â· USD' : 'CÃ³rdobas Â· NIO',
                  style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium,
                ),
                DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: stateColor.withValues(alpha: .12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  ),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 10,
                      vertical: 4,
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      status,
                      style: theme.textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                        color: stateColor,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            AdaptiveColumns(
              minColumnWidth: 130,
              spacing: 8,
              children: [
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text('MÃ­nimo pendiente', style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall),
                    Text(
                      statement['minimum_due'] == null
                          ? 'Sin registrar'
                          : cardMoney(progress.minimumRemaining, currency),
                      style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text('Saldo pendiente', style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall),
                    Text(
                      cardMoney(progress.remaining, currency),
                      style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (showDates) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              _StatementDates(statement: statement),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text('Saldo al corte Â· ${cardMoney(progress.balance, currency)}'),
            ExpansionTile(
              initiallyExpanded: false,
              dense: true,
              visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
              shape: const Border(),
              collapsedShape: const Border(),
              tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              childrenPadding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
              expandedCrossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              title: const Text('Ver desglose'),
              children: [
                Text(
                  'MÃ­nimo informado Â· ${statement['minimum_due'] == null ? 'Sin registrar' : cardMoney(moneyCents(statement['minimum_due']), currency)}',
                ),
                Text(
                  'Pagos vinculados Â· ${cardMoney(progress.paid, currency)}',
                ),
                if (progress.balanceCredit > 0)
                  Text(
                    'Reversiones al saldo Â· ${cardMoney(progress.balanceCredit, currency)}',
                  ),
                if (progress.minimumCredit > 0)
                  Text(
                    'Reversiones al mÃ­nimo Â· ${cardMoney(progress.minimumCredit, currency)}',
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

CreditCardProduct? creditCardProduct(String? id) {
  for (final p in creditCardProducts) {
    if (p.id == id) {
      return p;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

CreditCardProduct? creditCardVisual(Map<String, dynamic> card, String bank) {
  final id = card['card_product']?.toString() ?? 'standard';
  if (id != 'standard') {
    final product = creditCardProduct(id);
    return product?.bank == bank ? product : null;
  }
  final network = card['network']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
  final tier = card['card_tier']?.toString() ?? 'unspecified';
  for (final product in creditCardProducts) {
    if (product.standard &&
        product.bank == bank &&
        product.network == network &&
        product.tier == tier) {
      return product;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

class CreditCardProductField extends StatelessWidget {
  const CreditCardProductField({
    super.key,
    required this.bank,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final String bank, value;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final options = creditCardProducts.where((p) => p.bank == bank).toList();
    final selected = options.any((p) => p.id == value) ? value : 'standard';
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
          key: ValueKey('product-$bank-$selected'),
          initialValue: selected,
          isExpanded: true,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
            labelText: 'Producto / diseÃ±o fÃ­sico',
            prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.style_outlined),
          ),
          items: [
            const DropdownMenuItem(
              value: 'standard',
              child: Text('SegÃºn marca y categorÃ­a / otro producto'),
            ),
            ...options.map(
              (p) => DropdownMenuItem(
                value: p.id,
                child: Text(p.label, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
              ),
            ),
          ],
          onChanged: (v) {
            if (v != null) {
              onChanged(v);
            }
          },
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          options.isEmpty
              ? 'Para este banco se conserva el diseÃ±o general. Selecciona marca y categorÃ­a.'
              : 'Elige el producto que coincide con tu tarjeta. La marca y categorÃ­a se completan segÃºn el diseÃ±o elegido.',
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Color(0xFF64748B),
            fontSize: 14,
            height: 1.4,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class CreditCardStatementsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreditCardStatementsPage({super.key, required this.card});
  final Map<String, dynamic> card;
  @override
  State<CreditCardStatementsPage> createState() =>
      _CreditCardStatementsPageState();
}

class _CreditCardStatementsPageState extends State<CreditCardStatementsPage> {
  final pendingCredits = <String, String>{};
  String operationId() {
    final r = Random.secure();
    final bytes = List.generate(16, (_) => r.nextInt(256));
    bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 15) | 64;
    bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 63) | 128;
    // UUID de la misma operaciÃ³n se conserva si se pierde la respuesta.
    final h = bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
    return '${h.substring(0, 8)}-${h.substring(8, 12)}-${h.substring(12, 16)}-${h.substring(16, 20)}-${h.substring(20)}';
  }

  CardStatementData? data;
  bool loading = true, saving = false, showHistory = false;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;
  String get cardId => '${widget.card['id']}';
  String get bank => cardBankKey(cardBankName(widget.card));
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  void message(String text) {
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
    }
  }

  String owner() {
    final id = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (id == null) {
      throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
    }
    return id;
  }

  void sameOwner(String id) {
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != id) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Abre nuevamente la pantalla.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final result = await loadCardStatements(owner());
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        data = result;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> perform(Future<void> Function(String) action) async {
    if (loading || saving) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await action(owner());
      if (mounted) {
        await load();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo completar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  String documentId(Map<String, dynamic> statement) =>
      '${statement['statement_group_id'] ?? statement['id']}';

  Future<void> edit([Map<String, dynamic>? statement]) =>
      perform((userId) async {
        final editable = statement == null
            ? <Map<String, dynamic>>[]
            : [
                statement,
                for (final row in data!.statements)
                  if (row['id'] != statement['id'] &&
                      row['credit_card_id'] == statement['credit_card_id'] &&
                      documentId(row) == documentId(statement) &&
                      row['is_archived'] != true &&
                      row['is_voided'] != true)
                    row,
              ];
        final result = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
          context: context,
          builder: (_) =>
              CreditCardStatementForm(statements: editable, bank: bank),
        );
        if (result == null || !mounted) return;
        sameOwner(userId);
        final folderId = await supabase.rpc(
          'save_credit_card_statement_with_bonifiable',
          params: {
            'p_card_id': cardId,
            'p_closing_date': result['closing_date'],
            'p_bonus_payment_date': result['bonus_payment_date'],
            'p_due_date': result['due_date'],
            'p_notes': result['notes'],
            'p_rows': result['rows'],
            'p_edit_id': statement?['id'],
          },
        );
        if (!mounted) return;
        sameOwner(userId);
        await attachFinancialReceipt(
          context,
          result[receiptDraftKey] as PendingReceipt?,
          userId,
          'credit_card_statements',
          folderId,
        );
        message('Estado de cuenta guardado.');
      });

  Future<void> openStatementFiles(List<Map<String, dynamic>> group) {
    final documents = <String, bool>{};
    for (final row in group) {
      final id = documentId(row);
      documents[id] = documents[id] == true || row['is_voided'] != true;
    }
    final target =
        group.where(isCurrentStatement).firstOrNull ??
        group.where((row) => row['is_voided'] != true).firstOrNull ??
        group.first;
    return showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => PersonReceiptsDialog.statement(
        entryId: documentId(target),
        statementDocuments: documents,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> credit(Map<String, dynamic> s) => perform((userId) async {
    final result = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => StatementCreditDialog(statement: s, data: data!),
    );
    if (result == null || !mounted) return;
    sameOwner(userId);
    final params = <String, dynamic>{'p_statement_id': s['id'], ...result};
    final key = '$userId:${jsonEncode(params)}';
    final id = pendingCredits.putIfAbsent(key, operationId);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'register_card_statement_credit',
      params: {'p_id': id, ...params},
    );
    pendingCredits.remove(key);
    message('ReversiÃ³n aplicada. No se debitÃ³ ninguna cuenta bancaria.');
  });
  Future<void> removeCredit(Map<String, dynamic> c) => perform((userId) async {
    final yes = await confirm(
      'Quitar aplicaciÃ³n al corte',
      'Se restaurarÃ¡ el pendiente de este corte. El reembolso seguirÃ¡ registrado y la deuda total no cambiarÃ¡. '
          'Si el reembolso era incorrecto, despuÃ©s puedes anularlo en el historial de movimientos.',
    );
    if (!yes || !mounted) return;
    sameOwner(userId);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'remove_card_statement_credit',
      params: {'p_id': c['id']},
    );
  });
  Future<void> pay(Map<String, dynamic> s, int cents) =>
      perform((userId) async {
        if (await registerStatementPayment(
          context,
          userId,
          s,
          initialAmountCents: cents,
        )) {
          message('Pago registrado.');
        }
      });
  Future<void> assign(Map<String, dynamic> s) => perform((userId) async {
    final used = data!.links.map((l) => '${l['payment_id']}').toSet();
    final available =
        data!.payments
            .where(
              (p) =>
                  p['is_voided'] != true &&
                  p['transaction_type'] == 'payment' &&
                  '${p['credit_card_id']}' == cardId &&
                  p['currency'] == s['currency'] &&
                  !used.contains('${p['id']}'),
            )
            .toList()
          ..sort(
            (a, b) => '${b['transaction_date']}'.compareTo(
              '${a['transaction_date']}',
            ),
          );
    if (available.isEmpty) {
      message('No hay pagos registrados sin asignar en esta moneda.');
      return;
    }
    final selected = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Vincular un pago ya registrado'),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 440,
          height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .45,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              const Text(
                'Elige solo un pago que no estÃ© descontado del saldo al corte. Vincularlo no vuelve a descontar dinero de tu cuenta.',
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: ListView(
                  children: available
                      .map(
                        (p) => ListTile(
                          title: Text(
                            cardMoney(
                              moneyCents(p['amount']),
                              '${p['currency']}',
                            ),
                          ),
                          subtitle: Text(
                            '${shortStatementDate(p['transaction_date'])} Â· ${p['reference'] ?? 'Sin referencia'}',
                          ),
                          onTap: () =>
                              Navigator.pop(dialogContext, '${p['id']}'),
                        ),
                      )
                      .toList(),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (selected == null || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    sameOwner(userId);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'assign_credit_card_statement_payment',
      params: {'p_statement_id': s['id'], 'p_payment_id': selected},
    );
    message('Pago vinculado al corte.');
  });
  Future<void> unlink(String paymentId) => perform((userId) async {
    final yes = await confirm(
      'Quitar vÃ­nculo',
      'El pago seguirÃ¡ registrado y descontado de su cuenta. Solo dejarÃ¡ de aplicarse a este corte.',
    );
    if (!yes || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    sameOwner(userId);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'unassign_credit_card_statement_payment',
      params: {'p_payment_id': paymentId},
    );
  });
  Future<bool> confirm(String title, String text) async =>
      await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (c) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(title),
          content: Text(text),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, false),
              child: const Text('Cancelar'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, true),
              child: const Text('Confirmar'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ) ??
      false;
  Future<void> voidStatement(Map<String, dynamic> s) => perform((userId) async {
    final yes = await confirm(
      'Anular corte en ${currencyName(s)}',
      'Esta moneda pasarÃ¡ al historial. Los pagos registrados siguen aplicados a la deuda de la tarjeta.',
    );
    if (!yes || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    sameOwner(userId);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'void_credit_card_statement',
      params: {'p_statement_id': s['id']},
    );
  });
  String currencyName(Map<String, dynamic> row) => switch (row['currency']) {
    'NIO' => 'cÃ³rdobas',
    'USD' => 'dÃ³lares',
    final value => '$value',
  };

  Widget dates(Map<String, dynamic> row) => Wrap(
    spacing: 20,
    runSpacing: 4,
    children: [
      Text('Corte Â· ${shortStatementDate(row['closing_date'])}'),
      Text('Fecha mÃ¡xima de pago Â· ${shortStatementDate(row['due_date'])}'),

        Text(
          'Para bonificar Â· ${shortStatementDate(row['bonus_payment_date'])}',
        ),

  );

  Widget statementCard(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> group,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> visible,
  ) {
    final first = visible.first;
    final current = visible.where(isCurrentStatement).toList();
    final sharedDates = visible.every(
      (row) =>
          row['closing_date'] == first['closing_date'] &&
          row['due_date'] == first['due_date'] &&
          row['bonus_payment_date'] == first['bonus_payment_date'],
    );
    final sharedNotes = visible.every((row) => row['notes'] == first['notes']);
    final sharedEdit =
        current.isNotEmpty &&
        current.every((row) => documentId(row) == documentId(current.first));
    final note = first['notes']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    return Card(
      key: ValueKey(documentId(group.first)),
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              'Estado de cuenta',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
            ),
            if (sharedDates) ...[const SizedBox(height: 6), dates(first)],
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              children: [
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: saving ? null : () => openStatementFiles(group),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.attach_file),
                  label: const Text('Documento del banco'),
                ),
                if (sharedEdit)
                  TextButton.icon(
                    onPressed: saving ? null : () => edit(current.first),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined),
                    label: Text(
                      group.length == current.length
                          ? 'Editar corte'
                          : 'Editar ${currencyName(current.first)}',
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            if (sharedNotes && note.isNotEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                child: Text('Notas Â· $note'),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            AdaptiveColumns(
              minColumnWidth: 330,
              children: [
                for (final row in visible)
                  currencyPanel(
                    row,
                    showDates: !sharedDates,
                    showNotes: !sharedNotes,
                    editSeparately: !sharedEdit,
                    showPlanLink: row == first,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

                              'Cada corte reÃºne el documento del banco y sus montos en cÃ³rdobas y dÃ³lares. '

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../data/card_statement_pdf.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_logic.dart';
import '../../data/period_logic.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../person_accounts/receipt_draft_field.dart';

class CreditCardStatementForm extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreditCardStatementForm({
    super.key,
    this.statements = const [],
    this.bank = '',
  });

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> statements;
  final String bank;

  @override
  State<CreditCardStatementForm> createState() =>
      _CreditCardStatementFormState();
}

class _CreditCardStatementFormState extends State<CreditCardStatementForm> {
  static const currencies = ['NIO', 'USD'];
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final receipt = ReceiptDraft();
  final balances = {for (final c in currencies) c: TextEditingController()};
  final minimums = {for (final c in currencies) c: TextEditingController()};
  final overdues = {for (final c in currencies) c: TextEditingController()};
  final charges = {for (final c in currencies) c: TextEditingController()};
  final financing = {for (final c in currencies) c: TextEditingController()};
  final bonusInterest = {
    for (final c in currencies) c: TextEditingController(),
  };
  final bonusStates = {for (final c in currencies) c: 'pending'};
  final notes = TextEditingController();
  final existing = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
  DateTime closing = DateTime.now();
  DateTime due = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 20));
  DateTime? bonus;
  String? error;

  bool get usesPaymentFields => statementPdfBankName(widget.bank) != null;
  bool get showsOverdue => statementShowsOverdue(widget.bank);

  bool get editing => existing.isNotEmpty;
  Iterable<String> get shownCurrencies =>
      editing ? currencies.where(existing.containsKey) : currencies;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    for (final row in widget.statements) {
      final currency = '${row['currency']}';
      existing[currency] = row;
      bonusInterest[currency]!.text =
          row['bonifiable_interest_due']?.toString() ?? '';
      bonusStates[currency] =
          row['bonifiable_interest_status']?.toString() ?? 'pending';
      charges[currency]!.text = row['charges_interest_due']?.toString() ?? '';
      financing[currency]!.text = row['intra_financing_due']?.toString() ?? '';
      balances[currency]!.text = '${row['balance_due']}';
      minimums[currency]!.text = row['minimum_due']?.toString() ?? '';
      overdues[currency]!.text = row['overdue_due']?.toString() ?? '';
    }
    final statement = widget.statements.firstOrNull;
    if (statement != null) {
      closing = statementDate(statement['closing_date'])!;
      due = statementDate(statement['due_date'])!;
      bonus = statementDate(statement['bonus_payment_date']);
      notes.text = statement['notes']?.toString() ?? '';
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final controller in [
      ...balances.values,
      ...minimums.values,
      ...overdues.values,
      ...charges.values,
      ...financing.values,
      ...bonusInterest.values,
      notes,
    ]) {
      controller.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  double? amount(String? text) =>
      double.tryParse((text ?? '').trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));

  String? validateAmount(String? value) {
    final text = (value ?? '').trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return null;
    final parsed = amount(text);
    if (!RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text) ||
        parsed == null ||
        !parsed.isFinite ||
        parsed > 999999999999.99) {
      return 'Ingresa un monto no negativo con hasta seis decimales.';
    }
    return null;
  }

  void save() {
    if (receipt.picking || !formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
      for (final currency in shownCurrencies)
        if (balances[currency]!.text.trim().isNotEmpty)
          {
            'currency': currency,
            'balance': amount(balances[currency]!.text),
            'minimum': amount(minimums[currency]!.text),
            'bonifiable_interest': amount(bonusInterest[currency]!.text) ?? 0,
            'bonifiable_status': bonusStates[currency],
            'charges_interest': amount(charges[currency]!.text),
            'intra_financing': amount(financing[currency]!.text),
            if (showsOverdue) 'overdue': amount(overdues[currency]!.text),
            if (existing[currency] case final row?) 'id': row['id'],
          },
    ];
    final bonusDate = bonus;
    if (rows.isEmpty) {
      setState(
        () => error =
            'Ingresa el ${balanceLabel.toLowerCase()} de al menos una moneda.',
      );
      return;
    }
    if (dayOnly(due).isBefore(dayOnly(closing))) {
      setState(
        () => error = 'La fecha mÃ¡xima de pago no puede ser anterior al corte.',
      );
      return;
    }
    if (bonusDate != null && !includesDay(bonusDate, closing, due)) {
      setState(
        () => error =
            'La fecha para bonificar debe quedar entre el corte y la fecha mÃ¡xima de pago.',
      );
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'rows': rows,
      'closing_date': isoDay(closing),
      'bonus_payment_date': bonusDate == null ? null : isoDay(bonusDate),
      'due_date': isoDay(due),
      'notes': notes.text.trim(),
      ...receipt.fields,
    });
  }

  Widget dateField(
    String title,
    DateTime? date,
    ValueChanged<DateTime> change,
  ) => OutlinedButton.icon(
    icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today_outlined),
    label: Text(
      date == null ? title : '$title\n${shortStatementDate(isoDay(date))}',
      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
    ),
    onPressed: () async {
      final selected = await showDatePicker(
        context: context,
        initialDate: date ?? closing,
        firstDate: DateTime(1900),
        lastDate: DateTime(2200),
      );
      if (selected != null && mounted)
        setState(() {
          change(selected);
          error = null;
        });
    },
  );

  String currencyLabel(String currency) =>
      currency == 'NIO' ? 'CÃ³rdobas (C\$)' : 'DÃ³lares (\$)';

      errorMaxLines: 3,
    ),
    validator: (value) {

      if (invalid != null) return invalid;
      final parsed = amount(value);
      if (controllers == balances) {
        return editing && parsed == null
            ? 'Ingresa el ${balanceLabel.toLowerCase()}.'
            : null;

      if (parsed == null) return null;
      final balance = amount(balances[currency]!.text);
      if (balance == null) return 'Ingresa primero el saldo de esta moneda.';
      return controllers == minimums && parsed > balance
          ? 'El mÃ­nimo no puede superar el saldo.'
          : null;
    },

  Widget amounts(String currency) => Column(

      ],
      amountField(currency, minimums, 'Pago mÃ­nimo (opcional)'),
      if (showsOverdue) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        amountField(currency, overdues, 'Pago atrasado (opcional)'),
      ],
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      amountField(currency, charges, 'Cargos e intereses (opcional)'),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      amountField(currency, financing, 'Intrafinanciamientos (opcional)'),

  Widget amountsLayout() => LayoutBuilder(

          for (final (label, controllers) in [
            ('Pago mÃ­nimo', minimums),
            if (showsOverdue) ('Pago atrasado', overdues),
            ('Cargos e intereses', charges),
            ('Intrafinanciamientos', financing),
            ('Intereses bonificables', bonusInterest),
            (balanceLabel, balances),
          ])
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),

                    child: Padding(

                    ),
                  ),
                  for (final currency in currencies) ...[
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),

  Widget attachment() => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

        'Documento del banco (opcional)',
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall,

      const Text('Adjunta un PDF o una foto para todo el corte. Hasta 10 MB.'),

    ],

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 20),
    title: Text(
      editing ? 'Editar estado de cuenta' : 'Registrar estado de cuenta',
    ),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 1040,

        child: Form(
          key: formKey,

            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

                'Copia los importes y las fechas del banco. Los montos se guardan por moneda.',

                  for (final currency in shownCurrencies)
                    DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      initialValue: bonusStates[currency],
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Bonificables Â· ${currencyLabel(currency)}',
                      ),
                      items: const [
                        DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: 'pending',
                          child: Text('Pendientes de bonificar'),

                        DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: 'bonified',
                          child: Text('Bonificados por el banco'),

                          value: 'recorded',

                            'Cobrados: ya registrados en movimientos',

              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 8),

class _MobileCardSummary extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MobileCardSummary({required this.card});

  final Map<String, dynamic> card;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final bank = cardBankName(card);
    final visual = creditCardVisual(card, cardBankKey(bank));
    final digits = (card['card_reference']?.toString() ?? '').replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'\D'),
      '',
    );
    final ending = digits.length >= 4
        ? 'â€¢â€¢${digits.substring(digits.length - 4)}'
        : '';
    final icon = Icon(
      Icons.credit_card_outlined,
      color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
    );
    final identity = Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Text(
          bank.isEmpty ? '${card['name']}' : bank,
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall?.copyWith(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
        ),
        if (visual != null ||
            ending.isNotEmpty ||
            card['is_active'] != true) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
            [
              if (visual != null) visual.label,
              if (ending.isNotEmpty) ending,
              if (card['is_active'] != true) 'Inactiva',
            ].join(' Â· '),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium,
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
    final artwork = SizedBox(
      height: 112,
      child: visual == null
          ? Center(child: icon)
          : visual.asset.toLowerCase().endsWith('.svg')
          ? SvgPicture.asset(visual.asset, fit: BoxFit.contain)
          : Image.asset(
              visual.asset,
              fit: BoxFit.contain,
              errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Center(child: icon),
            ),
    );
    return AdaptiveColumns(
      minColumnWidth: 110,
      spacing: 10,
      children: [
        artwork,
        Center(child: identity),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_repository.dart';
import '../person_accounts/person_receipts_dialog.dart';
import '../person_accounts/receipt_draft_field.dart';
import 'credit_card_payment_dialog.dart';

Future<bool> registerStatementPayment(
  BuildContext context,
  String userId,
  Map<String, dynamic> s, {
  int? initialAmountCents,
}) async {
  final rows = await statementRows(
    'accounts',
    'id,name,currency,is_active',
    userId,
  );
  final accounts = rows
      .where((a) => a['is_active'] == true && a['currency'] == s['currency'])
      .toList();
  if (!context.mounted) {
    return false;
  }
  if (accounts.isEmpty) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text('Necesitas una cuenta activa en ${s['currency']}.'),
      ),
    );
    return false;
  }
  final result = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
    context: context,
    builder: (_) => CreditCardPaymentDialog(
      accounts: accounts,
      currency: '${s['currency']}',
      statements: [s],
      initialStatementId: '${s['id']}',
      initialAmountCents: initialAmountCents,
    ),
  );
  if (result == null || !context.mounted) {
    return false;
  }
  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
  }
  final linked = result['statement_id'];
  final receipt = result.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
  final saved = await supabase.rpc(
    linked == null
        ? 'register_credit_card_payment'
        : 'register_credit_card_payment_for_statement',
    params: {
      'p_card_id': s['credit_card_id'],
      'p_account_id': result['account_id'],
      'p_amount': result['amount'],
      'p_reference': result['reference'],
      if (linked != null) 'p_statement_id': linked,
    },
  );
  if (context.mounted)
    await attachFinancialReceipt(
      context,
      receipt,
      userId,
      'credit_card_transactions',
      saved,
    );
  return true;
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_logic.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';

class StatementCreditDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const StatementCreditDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.statement,
    required this.data,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> statement;
  final CardStatementData data;
  @override
  State<StatementCreditDialog> createState() => _StatementCreditDialogState();
}

class _StatementCreditDialogState extends State<StatementCreditDialog> {
  final form = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final amount = TextEditingController(),
      balance = TextEditingController(text: '0.00'),
      minimum = TextEditingController(),
      description = TextEditingController(text: 'ReversiÃ³n de anualidad');
  String refundId = 'new';
  DateTime date = DateTime.now();
  Map<String, dynamic> get s => widget.statement;
  String get currency => '${s['currency']}';
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get available {
    final used = widget.data.credits
        .where((c) => c['is_removed'] != true)
        .map((c) => '${c['refund_id']}')
        .toSet();
    return widget.data.payments
        .where(
          (p) =>
              p['transaction_type'] == 'refund' &&
              p['is_voided'] != true &&
              '${p['credit_card_id']}' == '${s['credit_card_id']}' &&
              p['currency'] == currency &&
              !used.contains('${p['id']}') &&
              '${p['transaction_date']}'.compareTo('${s['closing_date']}') >= 0,
        )
        .toList();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in [amount, balance, minimum, description]) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  double? number(TextEditingController c) =>
      double.tryParse(c.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));
  String? validate(String? v) {
    final text = (v ?? '').trim(),
        n = double.tryParse((v ?? '').trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));
    return n == null ||
            !n.isFinite ||
            n < 0 ||
            n > 999999999999.99 ||
            !RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text)
        ? 'Usa un monto positivo o cero, con mÃ¡ximo seis decimales'
        : null;
  }

  Widget field(String label, TextEditingController c, {bool enabled = true}) =>
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
        child: TextFormField(
          controller: c,
          enabled: enabled,
          decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: '$label ($currency)'),
          keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
          validator: validate,
          onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
        ),
      );
  void save() {
    if (!form.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final a = number(amount)!, b = number(balance)!, m = number(minimum)!;
    final p = widget.data.progress(s);
    String? error;
    if (a <= 0 || b > a || m > a || b + m <= 0)
      error =
          'Indica una reversiÃ³n mayor que cero y reducciones entre cero y su monto.';
    if (m > 0 && s['minimum_due'] == null)
      error = 'Primero registra el mÃ­nimo informado del corte.';
    if ((b * moneyScale).round() + p.balanceCredit > p.balance ||
        (s['minimum_due'] != null &&
            (m * moneyScale).round() + p.minimumCredit >
                moneyCents(s['minimum_due']))) {
      error =
          'Las reducciones superarÃ­an el saldo o mÃ­nimo informado del corte.';
    }
    if (error != null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error)));
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'p_amount': a,
      'p_balance_credit': b,
      'p_minimum_credit': m,
      'p_refund_id': refundId == 'new' ? null : refundId,
      'p_date': DateTime(
        date.year,
        date.month,
        date.day,
        12,
      ).toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'p_description': description.text.trim(),
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final p = widget.data.progress(s),
        b = number(balance) ?? 0,
        m = number(minimum) ?? 0;
    final nextBalance = p.remaining == null
        ? null
        : (p.remaining! - (b * moneyScale).round()).clamp(0, p.balance).toInt();
    final nextMinimum = p.minimumRemaining == null
        ? null
        : (p.minimumRemaining! - (m * moneyScale).round())
              .clamp(0, p.balance)
              .toInt();
    return AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('ReversiÃ³n aplicada al corte'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 460,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: form,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text(
                  '$currency Â· Corte ${shortStatementDate(s['closing_date'])}',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                const Text(
                  'Registra lo que el banco confirmÃ³. Si ya ingresaste la devoluciÃ³n, selecciÃ³nala para usar el mismo movimiento.',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: refundId,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Origen de la reversiÃ³n',
                  ),
                  items: [
                    const DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'new',
                      child: Text('Registrar nueva reversiÃ³n'),
                    ),
                    ...available.map(
                      (t) => DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: '${t['id']}',
                        child: Text(
                          '${cardMoney(moneyCents(t['amount']), currency)} Â· ${shortStatementDate(t['transaction_date'])} Â· ${t['description'] ?? 'Reembolso'}',
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (v) {
                    if (v == null) return;
                    setState(() {
                      refundId = v;
                      if (v != 'new') {
                        final t = available.firstWhere(
                          (t) => '${t['id']}' == v,
                        );
                        amount.text = '${t['amount']}';
                      } else {
                        amount.clear();
                      }
                    });
                  },
                ),
                field(
                  'Monto total de la reversiÃ³n',
                  amount,
                  enabled: refundId == 'new',
                ),
                field('ReducciÃ³n del mÃ­nimo confirmada por el banco', minimum),
                field('ReducciÃ³n del saldo del corte confirmada', balance),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                const Text(
                  'Las reducciones son independientes: no se suman como dos reembolsos. Usa 0 en lo que el banco no haya ajustado. No vuelvas a editar el corte para descontar estos mismos importes.',
                ),
                if (refundId == 'new') ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: description,
                    maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                    maxLength: 200,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Concepto'),
                    validator: (v) =>
                        (v ?? '').trim().isEmpty ? 'Escribe un concepto' : null,
                  ),
                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                    label: Text(
                      'Fecha: ${shortStatementDate(date.toIso8601String())}',
                    ),
                    onPressed: () async {
                      final first = statementDate(s['closing_date'])!,
                          today = DateTime.now();
                      if (first.isAfter(today)) return;
                      final chosen = await showDatePicker(
                        context: context,
                        initialDate: date.isBefore(first) ? first : date,
                        firstDate: first,
                        lastDate: today,
                      );
                      if (chosen != null && mounted)
                        setState(() => date = chosen);
                    },
                  ),
                ],
                const Divider(height: 24),
                Text(
                  'MÃ­nimo pendiente: ${cardMoney(p.minimumRemaining, currency)} â†’ ${cardMoney(nextMinimum, currency)}',
                ),
                Text(
                  'Pendiente del perÃ­odo: ${cardMoney(p.remaining, currency)} â†’ ${cardMoney(nextBalance, currency)}',
                ),
                Text(
                  refundId == 'new'
                      ? 'TambiÃ©n bajarÃ¡ la deuda de la tarjeta por el monto total de la reversiÃ³n.'
                      : 'La deuda de la tarjeta ya refleja este reembolso; no se descontarÃ¡ de nuevo.',
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cancelar'),
        ),
        FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Aplicar reversiÃ³n')),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class ZeroPlansPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ZeroPlansPage({super.key, required this.card});
  final Map<String, dynamic> card;
  @override
  State<ZeroPlansPage> createState() => _ZeroPlansPageState();
}

class _ZeroPlansPageState extends State<ZeroPlansPage> {
  final commands = ZeroCommands();
  ZeroPlanData? data;
  Map<String, dynamic>? card;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts = [],
      categories = [],
      statements = [],
      availableCards = [],
      charges = [];
  bool loading = true, busy = false;
  String planFilter = 'active';
  static const planStates = {
    'active': 'Vigentes',
    'in_cuts': 'Incluidos en cortes',
    'paid': 'Pagados',
    'voided': 'Anulados',
    'all': 'Todos',
  };
  String? error;
  int request = 0;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  void message(String s) {
    if (mounted)
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(s)));
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final req = ++request;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = zeroUser();
      final rows = await Future.wait<Object>([
        loadZeroPlans(uid),
        supabase
            .from('credit_cards')
            .select()
            .eq('user_id', uid)
            .eq('id', widget.card['id'])
            .single(),
        statementRows('accounts', 'id,name,currency,is_active', uid),
        statementRows('categories', 'id,name,category_type,is_active', uid),
        statementRows(
          'credit_card_statements',
          'id,credit_card_id,currency,closing_date,due_date,is_archived,is_voided',
          uid,
        ),
        statementRows('credit_cards', 'id,name,currency,is_active', uid),
        loadZeroInstallmentCharges(uid),
      ]);
      zeroSession(uid);
      if (!mounted || req != request) return;
      setState(() {
        data = rows[0] as ZeroPlanData;
        card = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rows[1] as Map);
        accounts = rows[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        categories = rows[3] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        statements = rows[4] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        availableCards = rows[5] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        charges = rows[6] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && req == request)
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  Future<void> run(Future<void> Function() f) async {
    if (busy || loading) return;
    setState(() => busy = true);
    try {
      await f();
      if (mounted) await load();
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo completar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }
