  Future<void> pay(
    Map<String, dynamic> p,
    Map<String, dynamic> i, {
    bool existing = false,
  }) => run(() async {
    final receiptUser = zeroUser();
    final curr = '${p['currency']}', pending = data!.remaining(i);
    final availablePayments = data!.transactions
        .where(
          (t) =>
              t['credit_card_id'] == p['credit_card_id'] &&
              t['currency'] == curr &&
              t['transaction_type'] == 'payment' &&
              t['is_voided'] != true &&
              data!.unassigned(t) > 0,
        )
        .toList();
    final options = {
      for (final a in accounts.where(
        (a) => a['is_active'] == true && a['currency'] == curr,
      ))
        '${a['id']}': '${a['name']} ($curr)',
    };
    if (existing && availablePayments.isEmpty)
      throw StateError(
        'No hay pagos con importe libre en esta tarjeta y moneda.',
      );
    if (!existing && options.isEmpty)
      throw StateError('Necesitas una cuenta activa en $curr.');
    final v = await zeroForm(
      context,
      existing ? 'Vincular pago registrado' : 'Registrar pago de cuota',
      [
        if (existing)
          ZeroField(
            'payment_id',
            'Pago ya registrado',
            type: 'choice',
            options: {
              for (final t in availablePayments)
                '${t['id']}':
                    '${zeroDateLabel(t['transaction_date'])} Â· Libre ${formatMoneyCents(data!.unassigned(t), curr)} Â· ${t['description'] ?? ''}',
            },
          )
        else
          ZeroField(
            'account_id',
            'Cuenta de dÃ©bito / efectivo',
            type: 'choice',
            options: options,
          ),
        const ZeroField(
          'amount',
          'Monto que corresponde a esta cuota',
          type: 'money',
        ),
        if (!existing)
          const ZeroField('date', 'Fecha real del pago', type: 'date'),
      ],
      initial: {
        'amount': (pending / moneyScale).toStringAsFixed(6),
        'date': zeroDate(DateTime.now()),
      },
      attachReceipt: !existing,
      info: existing
          ? 'Solo clasifica parte de un pago existente: NO vuelve a descontar tu cuenta ni la tarjeta.'
          : 'Registra el pago una sola vez: descuenta esta cuenta y reduce la deuda de tarjeta y el pendiente de esta cuota. Si ya anotaste el pago, cancela y usa Vincular pago registrado.',
    );
    if (v == null) return;
    final amount = moneyCents(v['amount']);
    if (amount > pending)
      throw StateError('El monto supera lo pendiente de la cuota.');
    final date = existing ? null : DateTime.parse('${v['date']}');
    final receipt = v.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
    final saved = await commands.run('zero_plan_allocate', {
      'p_installment_id': i['id'],
      'p_amount': v['amount'],
      'p_payment_id': existing ? v['payment_id'] : null,
      'p_account_id': existing ? null : v['account_id'],
      'p_payment_date': date == null
          ? null
          : DateTime(
              date.year,
              date.month,
              date.day,
              12,
            ).toUtc().toIso8601String(),
    }, operation: true);
    if (mounted)
      await attachFinancialReceipt(
        context,
        receipt,
        receiptUser,
        'credit_card_transactions',
        saved,
      );
    message(
      existing ? 'Pago vinculado sin otro descuento.' : 'Pago registrado.',
    );
  });
  Future<void> registerCharge(
    Map<String, dynamic> p,
    Map<String, dynamic> i,
  ) => run(() async {
    final existing = charges
        .where((c) => c['installment_id'] == i['id'])
        .firstOrNull;
    final values = await zeroForm(
      context,
      existing == null ? 'Registrar cargo de cuota' : 'Editar cargo de cuota',
      const [
        ZeroField('description', 'DescripciÃ³n'),
        ZeroField('amount', 'Monto cobrado por el banco', type: 'money'),
        ZeroField('date', 'Fecha publicada por el banco', type: 'date'),
        ZeroField('reference', 'Referencia (opcional)', required: false),
      ],
      attachReceipt: true,
      initial: {
        'description':
            existing?['description'] ??
            'Cuota ${i['number']}/${p['total_installments']} Â· ${p['description']}',
        'amount':
            existing?['amount'] ??
            (moneyCents(i['amount']) / moneyScale).toStringAsFixed(6),
        'date': existing?['charge_date'] ?? zeroDate(DateTime.now()),
        'reference': existing?['reference'] ?? '',
      },
      info:
          '${p['description']} Â· Cuota ${i['number']} Â· ${cardMoney(moneyCents(i['amount']), '${p['currency']}')}\nRegistro informativo: la compra completa ya consume el lÃ­mite. El monto es editable y solo informativo; no modifica la cuota programada. No crea otra compra, no cambia la deuda ni marca la cuota como pagada. Cuando llegue el corte, usa Vincular / quitar corte.',
    );
    if (values == null) return;
    final date = DateTime.parse('${values['date']}');
    if (date.isAfter(DateUtils.dateOnly(DateTime.now())))
      throw StateError('La fecha no puede ser futura.');
    final receipt = values[receiptDraftKey] as PendingReceipt?;
    final uid = zeroUser();
    final saved = await commands.run('register_zero_installment_charge', {
      'p_installment_id': i['id'],
      'p_date': zeroDate(date),
      'p_amount': moneyCents(values['amount']) / moneyScale,
      'p_description': '${values['description']}'.trim(),
      'p_reference': values['reference'] ?? '',
    });
    if (mounted)
      await attachFinancialReceipt(
        context,
        receipt,
        uid,
        'card_zero_installment_charges',
        saved,
      );
    message('Cargo de cuota registrado sin duplicar deuda ni gasto.');
  });

          FilledButton(

            child: const Text('Quitar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed == true)
      await commands.run('remove_zero_installment_charge', {
        'p_installment_id': i['id'],
      });
  });
  Future<void> linkStatement(
    Map<String, dynamic> p,
    Map<String, dynamic> i,
  ) => run(() async {
    final v = await zeroForm(
      context,
      'Cuota incluida en un corte',
      [
        ZeroField(
          'statement_id',
          'Estado de cuenta',
          type: 'choice',
          required: false,
          options: {
            '': 'Sin corte vinculado',
            for (final s in statements.where(
              (s) =>
                  s['credit_card_id'] == p['credit_card_id'] &&
                  s['currency'] == p['currency'] &&
                  s['is_voided'] != true &&
                  s['is_archived'] != true,
            ))
              '${s['id']}':
                  'Corte ${zeroDateLabel(s['closing_date'])} Â· vence ${zeroDateLabel(s['due_date'])}',
          },
        ),
      ],
      initial: {
        'statement_id':
            statements.any(
              (s) =>
                  s['id'] == i['statement_id'] &&
                  s['is_voided'] != true &&
                  s['is_archived'] != true,
            )
            ? i['statement_id']
            : null,
      },
      info:
          'El saldo al corte que registraste del banco debe incluir esta cuota. Vincularla NO aumenta ese saldo ni crea otra compra. Al pagar desde aquÃ­, el pago se vincula tambiÃ©n al corte.',
    );
    if (v != null)
      await commands.run('zero_plan_statement', {
        'p_installment_id': i['id'],
        'p_statement_id': v['statement_id'],
      });
  });
  Future<void> voidPlan(Map<String, dynamic> p) => run(() async {
    final v = await zeroForm(
      context,
      'Anular plan creado por error',
      const [ZeroField('reason', 'Motivo')],
      info: p['entry_mode'] == 'included'
          ? 'Se anula el control del plan. La deuda que ya tenÃ­as registrada se conserva. Los pagos bancarios se conservan.'
          : 'Se retirarÃ¡ el cargo o deuda inicial que creÃ³ este plan. No se anulan los pagos bancarios: si hubo pagos, revisa su historial y corrige esos registros por separado. No uses esta opciÃ³n para liquidar un plan real.',
    );
    if (v != null)
      await commands.run('zero_plan_void', {
        'p_id': p['id'],
        'p_reason': v['reason'],
      });
  });
  Widget installment(Map<String, dynamic> p, Map<String, dynamic> i) {
    final remaining = data!.remaining(i),
        paid = data!.paid(i),
        curr = '${p['currency']}',
        historical = i['historical_paid'] == true;
    final links = data!.allocations
        .where((a) => a['installment_id'] == i['id'] && a['is_removed'] != true)
        .toList();
    final charge = charges
        .where((c) => c['installment_id'] == i['id'])
        .firstOrNull;
    final statement = statements
        .where((s) => s['id'] == i['statement_id'])
        .firstOrNull;
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 5),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              'Cuota ${i['number']} de ${p['total_installments']} Â· ${zeroDateLabel(i['due_date'])}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            Text(
              'Monto: ${formatMoneyCents(moneyCents(i['amount']), curr)} Â· Pagado: ${formatMoneyCents(paid, curr)}',
            ),
            Text(
              historical
                  ? 'Pagada antes de ingresar el plan'
                  : data!.includedInCut(i, statements) && remaining > 0
                  ? 'Incluida en el corte Â· Se paga desde la tarjeta'
                  : remaining == 0
                  ? 'Cuota cubierta'
                  : 'Pendiente: ${formatMoneyCents(remaining, curr)}',
            ),
            if (charge != null)
              Text(
                'Cargo publicado: ${cardMoney(moneyCents(charge['amount']), curr)} Â· ${zeroDateLabel(charge['charge_date'])} Â· Sin efecto adicional en deuda, gasto o lÃ­mite',
              ),
            if (charge != null)
              MovementReceiptsButton(
                table: 'card_zero_installment_charges',
                record: {...charge, 'is_voided': p['is_voided'] == true},
              ),
            if (i['statement_id'] != null)

                'Incluida en corte ${zeroDateLabel(statement?['closing_date'])}${statement?['is_voided'] == true ? ' Â· ANULADO: revisar vÃ­nculo' : ''}',

              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,

                    icon: const Icon(Icons.receipt_long_outlined),

                      charge == null

                  if (charge != null)
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: busy ? null : () => removeCharge(i),
                      child: const Text('Quitar cargo'),
                    ),
                  if (remaining > 0 && !data!.includedInCut(i, statements)) ...[

                      onPressed: busy ? null : () => pay(p, i),

                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: busy ? null : () => pay(p, i, existing: true),
                      child: const Text('Vincular pago registrado'),
                    ),

                    onPressed: busy ? null : () => linkStatement(p, i),
                    child: const Text('Vincular / quitar corte'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ...links.map(

                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: Text(

  Widget discrepancyNotice() {
    final currencies = <String>[];
    for (final currency in cardCurrencies) {
      final tracked = data!.plans
          .where(
            (p) =>
                p['credit_card_id'] == card!['id'] &&
                p['currency'] == currency &&
                p['is_voided'] != true,
          )
          .fold<int>(0, (sum, p) => sum + data!.pending('${p['id']}'));
      final balance = cardBalance(card!, data!.transactions, currency);
      if (balance != null && tracked > balance) currencies.add(currency);
    }
    if (currencies.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Card(
      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.errorContainer,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Text(
          'Revisa los pagos o el origen de los planes en ${currencies.join(' / ')}: su pendiente supera la deuda total registrada. Puede haber pagos de tarjeta todavÃ­a sin vincular a las cuotas, devoluciones o un plan ingresado dos veces. Vincular un pago existente no vuelve a descontar dinero.',
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget planCard(Map<String, dynamic> p) {
    final list = data!.forPlan('${p['id']}'),
        pending = data!.pendingOutsideCuts('${p['id']}', statements),
        curr = '${p['currency']}';
    final source = data!.transactions
        .where((t) => t['id'] == p['source_transaction_id'])
        .firstOrNull;
    final inCuts = list
        .where((i) => data!.includedInCut(i, statements))
        .fold<int>(0, (sum, i) => sum + data!.remaining(i));
    final covered = list.where((i) => data!.remaining(i) == 0).length,
        next = list
            .where(
              (i) =>
                  data!.remaining(i) > 0 && !data!.includedInCut(i, statements),
            )
            .firstOrNull;
    final included = list
        .where(
          (i) => data!.remaining(i) > 0 && data!.includedInCut(i, statements),
        )
        .length;
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              '${p['description']}${p['is_voided'] == true ? ' Â· ANULADO' : ''}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            Text(
              'Original: ${formatMoneyCents(moneyCents(p['original_amount']), curr)} Â· InterÃ©s: 0%',
            ),
            Align(
              alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
              child: Chip(
                label: Text(planStates[data!.planState(p, statements)]!),
              ),
            ),
            Text(
              '$covered cuotas pagadas Â· $included incluidas en corte Â· ${p['total_installments']} en total',
            ),
            Text(
              'Pendiente del plan: ${formatMoneyCents(pending, curr)}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 23, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
            Text(
              'Incluido en cortes, por pagar al banco: ${formatMoneyCents(inCuts, curr)}',
            ),
            if (next != null)
              Text(
                'PrÃ³xima cuota: ${zeroDateLabel(next['due_date'])} Â· ${formatMoneyCents(data!.remaining(next), curr)}',
              ),
            Text(
              p['entry_mode'] == 'new'
                  ? 'Origen: compra nueva registrada una sola vez'
                  : p['entry_mode'] == 'opening'
                  ? 'Origen: pendiente aÃ±adido a deuda inicial'
                  : 'Origen: pendiente ya incluido en tu tarjeta',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
            ),
            if (source != null)
              MovementReceiptsButton(
                table: 'credit_card_transactions',
                record: source,
              ),
            if (p['is_voided'] == true) Text('Motivo: ${p['void_reason']}'),
            ExpansionTile(
              title: const Text('Ver cuotas, pagos y cortes'),
              children: list.map((i) => installment(p, i)).toList(),
            ),
            if (p['is_voided'] != true)
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                child: TextButton.icon(
                  onPressed: busy ? null : () => editPlan(p),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined),
                  label: const Text('Editar plan'),
                ),
              ),
            if (p['is_voided'] != true)
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                child: TextButton(
                  onPressed: busy ? null : () => voidPlan(p),
                  child: const Text('Anular plan por error'),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final plans =
        data?.plans
            .where(
              (p) =>
                  p['credit_card_id'] == widget.card['id'] &&
                  (planFilter == 'all' ||
                      data!.planState(p, statements) == planFilter),
            )
            .toList() ??
        [];
    return GuideScope(
      topic: 'zero',
      ready: !loading && error == null,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: GuideAnchor(
            id: 'title',
            child: const Text('Planes tasa cero'),
          ),
          actions: [
            const AppHelpButton(topic: 'zero'),
            IconButton(
              onPressed: loading || busy ? null : load,
              tooltip: 'Actualizar',
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: GuideAnchor(
              id: 'add',
              child: FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: loading || busy || error != null ? null : add,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                label: Text(busy ? 'Procesandoâ€¦' : 'Agregar plan tasa cero'),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 850),
              child: loading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : ListView(
                      physics: const ClampingScrollPhysics(
                        parent: AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                      ),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          '${card?['name'] ?? widget.card['name']}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 22,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          ),
                        ),
                        GuideAnchor(
                          id: 'explanation',
                          child: const Text(
                            'La deuda total y el uso del lÃ­mite incluyen el capital pendiente de los planes. Las cuotas distribuyen ese capital: no vuelven a sumarlo. El disponible es una estimaciÃ³n; usa la tasa del banco en la tarjeta.',
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (error != null) ...[
                          SelectableText(error!),
                          TextButton(
                            onPressed: load,
                            child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                          ),
                        ] else ...[
                          for (final curr in cardCurrencies)
                            Card(
                              child: Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment:
                                      CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                  children: [
                                    Text(
                                      'Deuda TOTAL ${curr == 'NIO' ? 'en cÃ³rdobas' : 'en dÃ³lares'}: ${cardMoney(cardBalance(card!, data!.transactions, curr), curr)}',
                                    ),
                                    Text(
                                      'De esa deuda, pendiente del plan sin incluir en cortes: ${cardMoney(data!.plans.where((p) => p['credit_card_id'] == card!['id'] && p['currency'] == curr && p['is_voided'] != true).fold<int>(0, (s, p) => s + data!.pendingOutsideCuts('${p['id']}', statements)), curr)}',
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          Text(
                            'Disponible estimado: ${cardMoney(cardAvailable(card!, cardUsed(card!, data!.transactions)), '${card!['currency']}')}',
                          ),
                          const Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                            child: Text(
                              'Al vincular una cuota a un corte, sale del pendiente del plan y queda incluida en ese corte. La deuda de la tarjeta se reduce al registrar el pago. Quitar el vÃ­nculo devuelve la cuota al pendiente del plan.',
                            ),
                          ),
                          CollapsibleFilters(
                            children: [
                              GuideAnchor(
                                id: 'voided',
                                child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                                  initialValue: planFilter,
                                  isExpanded: true,
                                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                    labelText: 'Estado del plan',
                                  ),
                                  items: [
                                    for (final state in planStates.entries)
                                      DropdownMenuItem(
                                        value: state.key,
                                        child: Text(state.value),
                                      ),
                                  ],
                                  onChanged: (value) {
                                    if (value != null)
                                      setState(() => planFilter = value);
                                  },
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (plans.isEmpty)
                            const Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                              child: Text(
                                'No hay planes en el estado seleccionado.',
                              ),
                            ),
                          discrepancyNotice(),
                          ...plans.map(planCard),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import '../person_accounts/receipt_draft_field.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/zero_plan_logic.dart';

class ZeroField {
  const ZeroField(
    this.key,
    this.label, {
    this.type = 'text',
    this.options,
    this.required = true,
    this.zero = false,
    this.signed = false,
    this.readOnly = false,
  });
  final String key, label, type;
  final Map<String, String>? options;
  final bool required, zero, signed, readOnly;
}

class ZeroForm extends StatefulWidget {
  const ZeroForm({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.fields,
    this.initial = const {},
    this.info,
    this.attachReceipt = false,
  });
  final String title;
  final List<ZeroField> fields;
  final Map<String, dynamic> initial;
  final String? info;
  final bool attachReceipt;
  @override
  State<ZeroForm> createState() => _ZeroFormState();
}

class _ZeroFormState extends State<ZeroForm> {
  final _receipt = ReceiptDraft();
  final form = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final controllers = <String, TextEditingController>{};
  final values = <String, dynamic>{};
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    values.addAll(widget.initial);
    for (final f in widget.fields) {
      controllers[f.key] = TextEditingController(
        text: '${values[f.key] ?? ''}',
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in controllers.values) c.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GuideScope(
    topic: 'zero_form',
    ready: true,
    excludedTargets: {
      for (final id in [
        'mode',
        'original_amount',
        'total_installments',
        'historical_paid',
      ])
        if (!widget.fields.any((f) => f.key == id)) id,
    },
    child: AlertDialog(
      insetPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 40,
        vertical: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 24,
      ),
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
        compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
        12,
        compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
        16,
      ),
      title: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: Text(widget.title)),
          const AppHelpButton(topic: 'zero'),
        ],
      ),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 460,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: form,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                if (widget.info != null)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
                    child: Text(widget.info!),
                  ),
                ...widget.fields.map(
                  (f) => Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
                    child: GuideAnchor(id: f.key, child: field(f)),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        if (widget.attachReceipt) ReceiptDraftField(draft: _receipt),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cancelar'),
        ),
        GuideAnchor(
          id: 'save',
          child: FilledButton(
            onPressed: () {
              if (_receipt.picking || !form.currentState!.validate()) return;
              final result = <String, dynamic>{..._receipt.fields};
              for (final f in widget.fields) {
                if (f.type == 'bool')
                  result[f.key] = values[f.key] ?? false;
                else if (f.type == 'choice' || f.type == 'date')
                  result[f.key] = values[f.key] == '' ? null : values[f.key];
                else {
                  final text = controllers[f.key]!.text.trim();
                  result[f.key] = text.isEmpty
                      ? null
                      : f.type == 'money'
                      ? text.replaceAll(',', '.')
                      : text;
                }
              }
              Navigator.pop(context, result);
            },
            child: const Text('Guardar'),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  Widget field(ZeroField f) {
    if (f.type == 'bool')
      return SwitchListTile(
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        title: Text(f.label),
        value: values[f.key] == true,
        onChanged: f.readOnly ? null : (v) => setState(() => values[f.key] = v),
      );
    if (f.type == 'choice')
      return DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
        initialValue: values[f.key]?.toString(),
        isExpanded: true,
        decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: f.label),
        items: f.options!.entries
            .map(
              (e) => DropdownMenuItem(
                value: e.key,
                child: Text(e.value, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
              ),
            )
            .toList(),
        onChanged: f.readOnly ? null : (v) => values[f.key] = v,
        validator: (v) => f.required && (v == null || v.isEmpty)
            ? 'Selecciona una opciÃ³n'
            : null,
      );
    if (f.type == 'date')
      return FormField<String>(
        initialValue: values[f.key]?.toString(),
        validator: (_) =>
            f.required && values[f.key] == null ? 'Selecciona una fecha' : null,
        builder: (state) => Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
              label: Text(
                '${f.label}: ${values[f.key] == null ? 'Sin fecha' : zeroDateLabel(values[f.key])}',
              ),
              onPressed: f.readOnly
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final d = await showDatePicker(
                        context: context,
                        initialDate:
                            DateTime.tryParse('${values[f.key]}') ??
                            DateTime.now(),
                        firstDate: DateTime(2000),
                        lastDate: DateTime(2100),
                      );
                      if (d != null && mounted)
                        setState(() {
                          values[f.key] = zeroDate(d);
                          state.didChange(values[f.key]);
                        });
                    },
            ),
            if (!f.required && values[f.key] != null)
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => setState(() {
                  values[f.key] = null;
                  state.didChange(null);
                }),
                child: const Text('Quitar fecha'),
              ),
            if (state.hasError)
              Text(
                state.errorText!,
                style: TextStyle(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controllers[f.key],
      readOnly: f.readOnly,
      maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
      maxLength: f.type == 'money'
          ? null
          : f.key == 'description'
          ? 200
          : f.key == 'notes'
          ? 1000
          : 120,
      maxLines: f.key == 'notes' || f.key == 'description' ? 2 : 1,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: f.label,
        helperText: f.type == 'money' ? 'Sin separadores de miles' : null,
        suffixIcon: f.type == 'money' && f.signed
            ? IconButton(
                tooltip: 'Cambiar signo (+/âˆ’)',
                onPressed: f.readOnly
                    ? null
                    : () {
                        final controller = controllers[f.key]!;
                        final current = controller.text.trim();
                        final next = current.startsWith('-')
                            ? current.substring(1)
                            : '-$current';
                        controller.value = TextEditingValue(
                          text: next,
                          selection: TextSelection.collapsed(
                            offset: next.length,
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                icon: const Text('+ / âˆ’'),
              )
            : null,
      ),
      keyboardType: f.type == 'money'
          ? const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true)
          : TextInputType.text,
      validator: (v) {
        final s = (v ?? '').trim();
        if (s.isEmpty) return f.required ? 'Completa este campo' : null;
        if (f.type == 'money') {
          final n = num.tryParse(s.replaceAll(',', '.'));
          final pattern = f.signed
              ? r'^-?\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$'
              : r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$';
          if (!RegExp(pattern).hasMatch(s) ||
              n == null ||
              !n.isFinite ||
              n.abs() > 1000000000 ||
              (!f.signed && (n < 0 || (!f.zero && n == 0))))
            return 'Monto invÃ¡lido. Usa mÃ¡ximo seis decimales.';
        }
        return null;
      },
    );
  }
}

  context: context,
  builder: (_) => ZeroForm(
    title: title,
    fields: fields,
    initial: initial,

    attachReceipt: attachReceipt,
  ),
);

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\dashboard\dashboard_aggregation.dart

import '../../data/expense_report_categories.dart';
import '../../data/card_spending.dart';
import '../../data/payment_agenda_labels.dart' show agendaCardLabel;
import '../../data/period_logic.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../credit_cards/credit_card_balances.dart';
import 'dashboard_models.dart';

DateTime _dashboardDate(dynamic value) {
  final date = DateTime.tryParse('$value')?.toLocal();

  if (date == null) {
    throw const FormatException('Hay un movimiento con fecha invÃ¡lida.');
  }

  return date;
}

DashboardOverview buildDashboardOverview(
  DashboardPeriod period, {
  required List<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> rows,
  required DateTime today,
}) {
  final accounts = rows[0];
  final transactions = rows[1];
  final debts = rows[4];
  final cards = rows[6];

  final debtPayments = rows[5].where((p) => p['is_voided'] != true).toList();

  final cardTransactions = rows[7]
      .where((p) => p['is_voided'] != true)
      .toList();

  final cardPayments = cardTransactions
      .where((p) => p['transaction_type'] == 'payment')
      .toList();

  final balances = calculateBalances(
    accounts,
    transactions,
    cardPayments: cardPayments,
    debtPayments: debtPayments,
  );

  final data = DashboardOverview(
    DateTime(period.start.year, period.start.month),
    period: period,
  );
  data.cardSpending = cardSpendingForPeriod(
    cards: cards,
    movements: cardTransactions,
    start: period.start,
    end: period.end,
  );
  final previous = period.previous;
  today = DateTime(today.year, today.month, today.day);
  final monthlyExpenses = <String, int>{};

  final accountMap = {
    for (final account in accounts) account['id'].toString(): account,
  };

  final debtMap = {for (final debt in debts) debt['id'].toString(): debt};

  final cardMap = {for (final card in cards) card['id'].toString(): card};

  DashboardCurrency metric(String currency) {
    final result = data.currencies[currency];

    if (result == null) {
      throw StateError('Moneda no reconocida: $currency');
    }

    return result;
  }

  void expense(int cents, DateTime date, String currency, dynamic categoryId) {
    if (cents == 0) {
      return;
    }

    for (final budget in rows[3]) {
      if (budget['category_id'] == categoryId &&
          budget['currency'] == currency &&
          includesDay(date, budgetStart(budget), budgetEnd(budget))) {
        final key = '${budget['id']}';
        monthlyExpenses[key] = (monthlyExpenses[key] ?? 0) + cents;
      }
    }
    final total = metric(currency);

    if (period.contains(date)) {
      total.expense += cents;
      final key = categoryId?.toString() ?? 'none';
      total.categories[key] = (total.categories[key] ?? 0) + cents;
    } else if (previous.contains(date)) {
      total.previousExpense += cents;
    }
  }

  void event(DashboardEvent item) {
    if (period.contains(item.date)) {
      data.events.add(item);
      metric(item.currency).movements++;
    }
  }

  data.categoryNames.addAll(expenseReportCategoryLabels);
  for (final category in rows[2]) {
    final id = category['id'].toString();
    data.categoryNames[id] = category['name'].toString();
    data.categoryStyles[id] = category;
  }

  for (final account in accounts) {
    if (account['is_active'] != true) {
      continue;
    }

    final balance = balances[account['id'].toString()]!;
    final total = metric(account['currency'].toString());

    total.cash += balance;
    total.activeAccounts++;

    data.accounts.add({...account, 'balance_cents': balance});
  }

  const nativeLabels = {
    'income': 'Ingreso',
    'expense': 'Gasto',
    'transfer': 'Transferencia',
    'deposit': 'DepÃ³sito',
    'withdrawal': 'Retiro',
    'adjustment': 'Ajuste',
  };

  for (final tx in transactions) {
    final currency = tx['currency'].toString();
    final type = tx['transaction_type'].toString();
    final account = accountMap[tx['account_id'].toString()];

    if (account == null || account['currency'] != currency) {
      throw StateError('Un movimiento no coincide con la moneda de su cuenta.');
    }

    final destination = accountMap[tx['destination_account_id']?.toString()];

    if (type == 'transfer' &&
        (destination == null ||
            destination['currency'] !=
                (tx['destination_currency'] ?? currency))) {
      throw StateError(
        'Una transferencia tiene cuentas de monedas diferentes.',
      );
    }

    final date = _dashboardDate(tx['transaction_date']);
    final amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);

    if (type == 'income') {
      if (period.contains(date)) {
        metric(currency).income += amount;
      }

      if (previous.contains(date)) {
        metric(currency).previousIncome += amount;
      }
    }

    if (type == 'expense') {
      expense(amount, date, currency, tx['category_id']);
    }

    final description = tx['description']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final label = nativeLabels[type] ?? type;

    final detail = type == 'transfer'
        ? '${account['name']} â†’ ${destination?['name']}'
        : '$label Â· ${account['name']}';

    final flow = ['income', 'deposit'].contains(type)
        ? 1
        : ['expense', 'withdrawal'].contains(type)
        ? -1
        : 0;

    event(
      DashboardEvent(
        'account:${tx['id']}',
        date,
        description.isEmpty ? label : description,
        detail,
        currency,
        amount,
        flow,
        DashboardTarget.transactions,
        null,
        tx['category_id']?.toString(),
      ),
    );
  }

  final cardBalances = <String, Map<String, int?>>{
    for (final card in cards)
      card['id'].toString(): {
        for (final currency in cardCurrencies)
          currency: cardOpening(card, currency),
      },
  };

  const cardLabels = {
    'purchase': 'Compra con tarjeta',
    'interest': 'Intereses de tarjeta',
    'fee': 'ComisiÃ³n de tarjeta',
    'payment': 'Pago de tarjeta',
    'refund': 'DevoluciÃ³n de tarjeta',
    'adjustment': 'Ajuste de tarjeta',
  };

  for (final tx in cardTransactions) {
    final id = tx['credit_card_id'].toString();
    final currency = tx['currency'].toString();
    final card = cardMap[id];

    if (card == null || !cardCurrencies.contains(currency)) {
      throw StateError('Movimiento de tarjeta no vÃ¡lido.');
    }

    final type = tx['transaction_type'].toString();
    final effect = cardEffects[type];
    final amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    final current = cardBalances[id]![currency];

    cardBalances[id]![currency] = effect == null || current == null
        ? null
        : current + effect * amount;

    final date = _dashboardDate(tx['transaction_date']);

    final category = expenseReportCategoryKey({
      ...tx,
      'source': 'credit_card',
      'card_transaction_type': type,
    });
    if (effect != null &&
        type != 'payment' &&
        tx['is_receivable_funding'] != true) {
      expense(effect * amount, date, currency, category);
    }

    final description = tx['description']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final label = cardLabels[type] ?? type;
    final cardLabel = agendaCardLabel(card, includeName: false);

    event(
      DashboardEvent(
        'card:${tx['id']}',
        date,
        type == 'payment' || description.isEmpty ? label : description,
        '$label Â· $cardLabel',
        currency,
        amount,
        type == 'refund'
            ? 1
            : effect == null
            ? 0
            : -1,
        DashboardTarget.cards,
        id,
        category,
      ),
    );
  }

  for (final card in cards) {
    final values = cardBalances[card['id'].toString()]!;

    for (final currency in cardCurrencies) {
      final total = metric(currency);
      final balance = values[currency];

      if (balance == null) {
        total.cardKnown = false;
        continue;
      }

      if (balance > 0) {
        total.cardDebt += balance;
      }

      if (balance < 0) {
        total.cardCredit -= balance;
      }
    }

    if (card['is_active'] == true) {
      final total = metric(card['currency'].toString());
      final available = cardAvailable(card, cardUsed(card, cardTransactions));
      final previousAvailable = total.cardAvailable;

      total.cardAvailable = previousAvailable == null || available == null
          ? null
          : previousAvailable + available;
    }
  }

  final principalPaid = <String, int>{};

  for (final payment in debtPayments) {
    final id = payment['debt_id'].toString();
    final currency = payment['currency'].toString();
    final debt = debtMap[id];

    if (debt == null || debt['currency'] != currency) {
      throw StateError('Un abono tiene moneda diferente a su deuda.');
    }

    principalPaid[id] =
        (principalPaid[id] ?? 0) + moneyCents(payment['principal_amount']);

    final date = _dashboardDate(payment['payment_date']);

    expense(
      moneyCents(payment['interest_amount']) +
          moneyCents(payment['fee_amount']),
      date,
      currency,
      'debt_costs',
    );

    event(
      DashboardEvent(
        'debt:${payment['id']}',
        date,
        'Abono de deuda',
        '${debt['description']}'
            '${payment['account_id'] == null ? ' Â· Registro manual' : ''}',
        currency,
        debtPaymentTotalCents(payment),
        payment['account_id'] == null ? 0 : -1,
        DashboardTarget.debts,
        id,
        'debt_costs',
      ),
    );
  }

  for (final debt in debts) {
    if (['cancelled', 'paid'].contains(debt['status'])) {
      continue;
    }

    final pending =
        moneyCents(debt['original_amount']) -
        (principalPaid[debt['id'].toString()] ?? 0);

    if (pending < 0) {
      throw StateError('Hay una deuda con abonos superiores a su capital.');
    }

    final total = metric(debt['currency'].toString());
    total.loans += pending;

    final due = DateTime.tryParse('${debt['due_date']}');

    if (pending == 0 ||
        due == null ||
        !['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status'])) {
      continue;
    }

    final day = DateTime(due.year, due.month, due.day);

    if (day.isBefore(today)) {
      total.overdue += pending;
      total.overdueCount++;
    }

    if (day == today) {
      total.dueToday += pending;
      total.todayCount++;
    }
  }

  for (final budget in rows[3]) {
    final start = budgetStart(budget), end = budgetEnd(budget);
    if (end.isBefore(period.start) || start.isAfter(period.end)) {
      continue;
    }

    final total = metric(budget['currency'].toString());
    final limit = moneyCents(budget['budget_amount']);
    final spent = monthlyExpenses['${budget['id']}'] ?? 0;

    if (spent > limit) {
      total.exceededBudgets++;
    }

    data.budgets.add({
      ...budget,
      'name':
          '${data.categoryNames[budget['category_id'].toString()] ?? 'CategorÃ­a no disponible'} Â· ${isoDay(start)} a ${isoDay(end)}',
      'limit_cents': limit,
      'spent_cents': spent,
    });
  }

  data.accounts.sort(
    (a, b) => (b['balance_cents'] as int).compareTo(a['balance_cents'] as int),
  );

  data.events.sort((a, b) {
    final byDate = b.date.compareTo(a.date);
    return byDate != 0 ? byDate : a.id.compareTo(b.id);
  });

  return data;
}

    void details(String kind, String title, int total) {
      List<TotalPart> parts(String key) => (data.totalParts[key] ?? [])

      _Metric(

        onDetails: () => details('income', 'Ingresos del perÃ­odo', c.income),
        amount: dashboardMoney(c.income, currency),
        footer: delta(c.income - c.previousIncome),
        icon: Icons.south_west,
        iconColor: _green,
        footerColor: c.income >= c.previousIncome ? _green : _red,
        compact: compact,
      ),
      _Metric(
        title: compact ? 'Gastos' : 'Gastos del perÃ­odo',
        onDetails: () => details('expense', 'Gastos del perÃ­odo', c.expense),
        amount: dashboardMoney(c.expense, currency),
        footer: delta(c.expense - c.previousExpense),
        icon: Icons.north_east,
        iconColor: const Color(0xFFA45F48),
        footerColor: c.expense <= c.previousExpense ? _green : _red,
        compact: compact,
      ),
      _Metric(
        title: 'Ingresos âˆ’ gastos',
        onDetails: () => details('net', 'Ingresos âˆ’ gastos', c.net),
        amount: dashboardMoney(c.net, currency),
        footer: delta(c.net - c.previousNet),
        icon: Icons.insights_outlined,
        footerColor: c.net >= c.previousNet ? _green : _red,
        compact: compact,
      ),
    ];
    if (compact) {
      return Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          cards[0],
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          AdaptiveColumns(
            minColumnWidth: 136,
            spacing: 8,
            children: [cards[1], cards[2]],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          cards[3],
        ],
      );
    }
    return AdaptiveColumns(
      minColumnWidth: 230,
      maxColumns: 4,
      spacing: 14,
      children: cards,
    );
  }
}

class DashboardPanels extends StatelessWidget {
  const DashboardPanels({
    super.key,
    required this.data,
    required this.currency,
    required this.onOpen,
    required this.onEvent,
    this.receivablesPanel,
  });
  final Widget? receivablesPanel;
  final DashboardOverview data;
  final String currency;
  final ValueChanged<DashboardTarget> onOpen;
  final ValueChanged<DashboardEvent> onEvent;
  DashboardCurrency get c => data.currencies[currency]!;
  String money(int? value) => dashboardMoney(value, currency);

  Widget amountRow(
    String label,
    int? amount, {
    Color? color,
    bool bold = false,
  }) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 7),
    child: LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) {
        final caption = Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14));
        final value = Text(
          money(amount),
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 15,
            color: color,
            fontWeight: bold ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w600,
          ),
        );
        if (box.maxWidth < 300 ||
            MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(14) > 17.5) {
          return Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [caption, const SizedBox(height: 4), value],
          );
        }
        return Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Expanded(child: caption),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Flexible(
              child: Align(alignment: Alignment.centerRight, child: value),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    ),
  );

  Widget categoriesPanel() {
    final entries = c.categories.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final byAmount = b.value.compareTo(a.value);
        return byAmount != 0 ? byAmount : a.key.compareTo(b.key);
      });
    final positiveTotal = entries.fold<int>(
      0,
      (sum, entry) => sum + (entry.value > 0 ? entry.value : 0),
    );

    return _Panel(
      title: 'Gasto neto por categorÃ­a',
      icon: Icons.bar_chart_rounded,
      action: 'Ver reporte',
      onAction: () => onOpen(DashboardTarget.reports),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          if (entries.isEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18),
              child: Text(
                'TodavÃ­a no hay gastos en este rango y moneda.',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: TextStyle(color: _muted),
              ),
            ),
          ...entries.take(5).map((entry) {
            final style = data.categoryStyles[entry.key];
            final uncategorized = entry.key == 'none';
            final color = uncategorized
                ? _muted
                : categoryColor(style?['color']);
            final icon = uncategorized
                ? Icons.help_outline_rounded
                : categoryIcon(style?['icon']);
            final name = uncategorized
                ? 'Sin categorÃ­a'
                : data.categoryNames[entry.key] ?? 'CategorÃ­a no disponible';
            final ratio = entry.value > 0 && positiveTotal > 0
                ? entry.value / positiveTotal
                : 0.0;

            return Padding(

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Card(

    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
      side: BorderSide(color: _border),
    ),
    child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, box) {
              final heading = Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(9),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: appSurfaceSubtle,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: Icon(icon, color: _blue, size: 20),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      title,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),

                ],
              );
              final button = box.maxWidth < 360
                  ? IconButton(

              return Row(

                  button,
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
          Divider(height: 22, color: _border),

  );
}

import '../../data/exchange_rate.dart';
import 'dashboard_overview.dart';

/// Crea una vista equivalente. Nunca modifica los registros ni el original.
DashboardOverview convertDashboard(
  DashboardOverview source,
  String target,
  ExchangeRate rate,
) {
  final result = DashboardOverview(
    source.month,
    period: source.period,
    loadedAt: source.loadedAt,
  );
  final total = result.currencies[target];
  if (total == null) {
    throw ArgumentError('Moneda de presentaciÃ³n invÃ¡lida.');
  }
  result.categoryNames.addAll(source.categoryNames);
  result.categoryStyles.addAll(source.categoryStyles);

  for (final entry in source.currencies.entries) {
    final c = entry.value;
    int convert(int value) => rate.convert(value, entry.key, target);
    total.cash += convert(c.cash);
    total.income += convert(c.income);
    total.expense += convert(c.expense);
    total.previousIncome += convert(c.previousIncome);
    total.previousExpense += convert(c.previousExpense);
    total.loans += convert(c.loans);
    total.overdue += convert(c.overdue);
    total.dueToday += convert(c.dueToday);
    total.cardDebt += convert(c.cardDebt);
    total.cardCredit += convert(c.cardCredit);
    total.cardAvailable = total.cardAvailable == null || c.cardAvailable == null
        ? null
        : total.cardAvailable! + convert(c.cardAvailable!);
    total.cardKnown = total.cardKnown && c.cardKnown;
    total.overdueCount += c.overdueCount;
    total.todayCount += c.todayCount;
    total.activeAccounts += c.activeAccounts;
    total.exceededBudgets += c.exceededBudgets;
    total.movements += c.movements;
    for (final category in c.categories.entries) {
      total.categories[category.key] =
          (total.categories[category.key] ?? 0) + convert(category.value);
    }
  }
  for (final account in source.accounts) {
    final currency = account['currency'].toString();
    result.accounts.add({
      ...account,
      // Conservar valores originales para mostrar las cuentas sin conversiÃ³n.
      'original_currency': currency,
      'original_balance_cents': account['balance_cents'],
      'currency': target,
      'balance_cents': rate.convert(
        account['balance_cents'] as int,
        currency,
        target,
      ),
    });
  }
  for (final budget in source.budgets) {
    final currency = budget['currency'].toString();
    result.budgets.add({
      ...budget,
      'name': '${budget['name']} Â· $currency',
      'currency': target,
      'limit_cents': rate.convert(
        budget['limit_cents'] as int,
        currency,
        target,
      ),
      'spent_cents': rate.convert(
        budget['spent_cents'] as int,
        currency,
        target,
      ),
    });
  }
  // La actividad reciente muestra siempre el monto y la moneda originales.
  // No convertir los eventos al filtro global ni agregar "Original:" al detalle.
  result.events.addAll(source.events);
  result.accounts.sort(
    (a, b) => (b['balance_cents'] as int).compareTo(a['balance_cents'] as int),
  );
  return result;
}

import '../../widgets/bank_brand.dart' show bankKey;
import '../../data/card_spending.dart';
import '../../data/exchange_rate.dart';
import '../../core/app_theme.dart'
    show appBorder, appMuted, appSurfaceMuted, primaryColor;
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'dashboard_overview.dart';

Color get _blue => primaryColor;
const _green = Color(0xFF397455);
const _red = Color(0xFFB13D32);
const _amber = Color(0xFF946200);
Color get _muted => appMuted;
Color get _border => appBorder;

class DashboardFinancialHealth extends StatelessWidget {
  const DashboardFinancialHealth({
    super.key,
    required this.data,
    required this.currency,
    this.trailingChart,
  });

  final Widget? trailingChart;
  final DashboardOverview data;
  final String currency;

  String money(int value) => dashboardMoney(value, currency);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = data.currencies[currency]!;
    final debt = c.liabilities;

    final savingsBalance = data.accounts
        .where(
          (a) =>
              a['currency'] == currency &&
              a['account_type'] == 'savings' &&
              a['is_active'] == true,
        )
        .fold<int>(0, (sum, a) => sum + (a['balance_cents'] as int));

    final savings = math.max(0, savingsBalance);

    final positiveCategories =
        c.categories.entries.where((e) => e.value > 0).toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));

              : data.categoryNames[entry.key] ?? 'CategorÃ­a no disponible',
          entry.value,
          palette[i],
        ),
      );
    }

        .skip(5)
        .fold<int>(0, (sum, e) => sum + e.value);

    if (otherCategories > 0) {
      categorySlices.add(
        _Slice('Otras categorÃ­as', otherCategories, palette.last),
      );
    }

    final positiveCategoryTotal = positiveCategories.fold<int>(
      0,
      (sum, e) => sum + e.value,
    );

    final hasNegativeCategories = c.categories.values.any((value) => value < 0);

    return Column(

  Widget _statusCard({
    required DashboardCurrency c,
    required int? debt,
    required int savings,
    required int savingsBalance,
  }) {
    final hasMonthlyActivity = c.income != 0 || c.expense != 0;
    final alerts = <String>[];

    if (c.overdueCount > 0) {
      alerts.add(
        '${c.overdueCount} deudas tienen capital vencido: ${money(c.overdue)}.',
      );
    }

    if (c.todayCount > 0) {
      alerts.add('${c.todayCount} deudas vencen hoy: ${money(c.dueToday)}.');
    }

    if (c.cash < 0) {
      alerts.add('El saldo total de tus cuentas activas es negativo.');
    }

    if (savingsBalance < 0) {
      alerts.add('El saldo conjunto de tus cuentas de ahorro es negativo.');
    }

    if (!c.cardKnown) {
      alerts.add('Hay ajustes de tarjeta que requieren revisiÃ³n.');
    }

    final deficit = hasMonthlyActivity && c.net < 0;
    final color = deficit || c.cash < 0 || c.overdueCount > 0
        ? _red
        : alerts.isNotEmpty
        ? _amber
        : hasMonthlyActivity
        ? _green
        : _blue;

    final title = deficit
        ? 'Tus gastos superan tus ingresos este perÃ­odo'
        : hasMonthlyActivity
        ? 'Tu perÃ­odo mantiene un resultado positivo o equilibrado'
        : 'AÃºn falta actividad para evaluar este perÃ­odo';

    final description = deficit
        ? 'La diferencia es de ${money(-c.net)}. '
              'Revisa las categorÃ­as con mayor gasto para identificar dÃ³nde ajustar.'
        : hasMonthlyActivity
        ? 'Ingresos menos gastos: ${money(c.net)}. '
              'Este resultado incluye los movimientos registrados del rango seleccionado.'
        : 'Al registrar ingresos y gastos podrÃ¡s ver cÃ³mo evoluciona el perÃ­odo.';

    final savingsText = debt == null
        ? 'La comparaciÃ³n entre ahorro y deuda estÃ¡ pendiente de revisiÃ³n.'
        : debt == 0
        ? 'No tienes deuda registrada en esta moneda.'
        : savings >= debt
        ? 'Tus ahorros registrados alcanzan para cubrir la deuda de esta moneda.'
        : 'Tus ahorros cubren ${(savings / debt * 100).toStringAsFixed(0)}% '
              'de la deuda registrada en esta moneda.';

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color.withAlpha(10),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withAlpha(45)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Icon(
                color == _red
                    ? Icons.warning_amber_rounded
                    : Icons.insights_rounded,
                color: color,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: color,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    fontSize: 16,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(description, style: const TextStyle(height: 1.5)),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(savingsText, style: const TextStyle(height: 1.5)),
          if (alerts.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const Divider(height: 24),
            for (final alert in alerts)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                child: Text(
                  'â€¢ $alert',
                  style: TextStyle(color: color, height: 1.4),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DonutPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _DonutPainter(this.slices);

  final List<_Slice> slices;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    const stroke = 19.0;
    final radius = math.min(size.width, size.height) / 2 - stroke / 2;
    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
    final rect = Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius);

    final paint = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.butt;

    paint.color = appSurfaceMuted;
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius, paint);

    final positive = slices.where((slice) => slice.value > 0).toList();
    final total = positive.fold<int>(0, (sum, slice) => sum + slice.value);

    if (total == 0) {
      return;
    }

    var start = -math.pi / 2;

    for (final slice in positive) {
      final sweep = slice.value / total * math.pi * 2;
      final gap = positive.length > 1 ? math.min(0.035, sweep * 0.15) : 0.0;

      paint.color = slice.color;
      canvas.drawArc(rect, start + gap / 2, sweep - gap, false, paint);
      start += sweep;
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _DonutPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.slices != slices;
}

class CreditCardSpendingChart extends StatelessWidget {
  const CreditCardSpendingChart({
    super.key,
    required this.spending,
    required this.currency,
    this.exchangeRate,
  });

  final List<CardSpending> spending;
  final String currency;
  final ExchangeRate? exchangeRate;

  static const _red = Color(0xFFC5223A);
  static const _gold = Color(0xFFA66D00);
  static const _teal = Color(0xFF007B73);
  static const _cardBlue = Color(0xFF175DC0);
  static const _purple = Color(0xFF7641A7);
  static const _green = Color(0xFF477B22);
  static const _orange = Color(0xFFC04F19);
  static const _charcoal = Color(0xFF293241);
  static const _slate = Color(0xFF667687);

  static const _palette = [
    _purple,
    _teal,
    _cardBlue,
    _red,
    _gold,
    _charcoal,
    _green,
    _orange,
    _slate,
  ];

  Map<String, Color> _cardColors() {
    final cards = <String, CardSpending>{
      for (final part in spending) part.cardId: part,
    };
    final ids = cards.keys.toList()..sort();
    final colors = <String, Color>{};
    final used = <Color>{};

    // Give every card a chance to use its tier color before bank colors.
    for (final id in ids) {
      final tierColor = switch (cards[id]!.tier) {
        'gold' => _gold,
        'black' => _charcoal,
        'platinum' => _slate,
        'signature' => _purple,
        'infinite' => _cardBlue,
        _ => null,
      };
      if (tierColor != null && used.add(tierColor)) colors[id] = tierColor;
    }
    for (final id in ids.where((id) => !colors.containsKey(id))) {
      final bankColor = switch (bankKey(cards[id]!.bank)) {
        'bac' || 'atlantida' => _red,
        'lafise' || 'bfp' => _teal,
        'ficohsa' || 'bdf' => _cardBlue,
        'avanz' => _gold,
        'banpro' => _green,
        _ => null,
      };
      if (bankColor != null && used.add(bankColor)) colors[id] = bankColor;
    }

    final alternatives = _palette
        .where((color) => !used.contains(color))
        .iterator;
    for (final id in ids.where((id) => !colors.containsKey(id))) {
      if (alternatives.moveNext()) {
        colors[id] = alternatives.current;
        used.add(alternatives.current);
        continue;
      }

      // Extend the palette for wallets with more cards than base colors.
      var key = (colors.length * 0x9E3779) & 0xFFFFFF;
      var variant = Color(0xFF000000 | key);
      while (!used.add(variant)) {
        key = (key + 0x9E3779) & 0xFFFFFF;
        variant = Color(0xFF000000 | key);
      }
      colors[id] = variant;
    }
    return colors;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colors = _cardColors();
    final totals = <String, ({String label, int cents})>{};
    var usedGeneralRate = false;
    var omittedForeignSpending = false;
    for (final part in spending) {
      var cents = part.cents;
      if (part.currency != currency && cents != 0) {
        final rate = part.cardExchangeRate ?? exchangeRate;
        if (rate == null) {
          omittedForeignSpending = true;
          continue;
        }
        usedGeneralRate = usedGeneralRate || part.cardExchangeRate == null;
        cents = rate.convert(cents, part.currency, currency);
      }
      totals[part.cardId] = (
        label: part.label,
        cents: (totals[part.cardId]?.cents ?? 0) + cents,
      );
    }
    final sorted = totals.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final byAmount = b.value.cents.compareTo(a.value.cents);
        return byAmount == 0 ? a.key.compareTo(b.key) : byAmount;
      });
    final slices = [
      for (final item in sorted)
        _Slice(item.value.label, item.value.cents, colors[item.key]!),
    ];
    final total = slices
        .where((slice) => slice.value > 0)
        .fold<int>(0, (sum, slice) => sum + slice.value);
    return _ChartPanel(
      title: 'Gasto por tarjeta de crÃ©dito',
      subtitle: 'Gasto neto positivo Â· $currency',
      icon: Icons.credit_card_outlined,
      center: '${slices.length}',
      centerLabel: slices.length == 1 ? 'tarjeta' : 'tarjetas',
      centerColor: _blue,
      slices: slices,
      emptyText: 'Sin tarjetas con gasto neto positivo en el perÃ­odo.',
      legend: [
        for (final slice in slices)
          _Legend(
            slice.label,
            '${dashboardMoney(slice.value, currency)}'
            '${slice.value > 0 ? ' Â· ${(100 * slice.value / total).toStringAsFixed(0)}%' : ''}',
            slice.color,
          ),
      ],
      footer: [
        'Solo los gastos netos positivos forman parte de la dona. Los pagos de tarjeta quedan fuera del gasto.',
        'La conversiÃ³n usa la tasa configurada en cada tarjeta.',
        if (usedGeneralRate)
          'Para tarjetas sin tasa propia se usÃ³ la tasa general.',
        if (omittedForeignSpending)
          'Los gastos en otra moneda sin una tasa disponible quedaron fuera del cÃ¡lculo.',
      ].join(' '),
    );
  }
}

                  states.contains(WidgetState.selected) ? colors.primary : null,
            ),
            foregroundColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith<Color?>(
              (states) => states.contains(WidgetState.selected)
                  ? colors.onPrimary
                  : null,
            ),
          ),
          segments: const [
            ButtonSegment(value: 'NIO', label: Text('CÃ³rdobas')),
            ButtonSegment(value: 'USD', label: Text('DÃ³lares')),
          ],
          selected: {currency},
          onSelectionChanged: (values) => onCurrencyChanged(values.first),
        ),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: loading ? null : onCurrent,
          child: const Text('Mes actual'),
        ),
      ],
    );
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            final scale = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(14) / 14;
            if (constraints.maxWidth >= 740 * scale.clamp(1, 1.6)) {
              return Row(
                children: [
                  SizedBox(width: 340.0 * scale.clamp(1.0, 1.6), child: dates),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(child: options),
                ],
              );
            }
            return Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [dates, const SizedBox(height: 4), options],
            );
          },
        ),
        Text(
          'ComparaciÃ³n: ${period.previous.label}',
          style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import '../../data/card_spending.dart';
import '../../utils/total_parts.dart';
import '../credit_cards/credit_card_balances.dart';
import 'dashboard_period.dart';
export 'dashboard_period.dart';

enum DashboardTarget {
  accounts,
  transactions,
  categories,
  budgets,
  debts,
  cards,
  reports,
}

class DashboardCurrency {
  int cash = 0;
  int income = 0;
  int expense = 0;
  int previousIncome = 0;
  int previousExpense = 0;
  int loans = 0;
  int overdue = 0;
  int dueToday = 0;
  int overdueCount = 0;
  int todayCount = 0;
  int cardDebt = 0;
  int cardCredit = 0;
  int activeAccounts = 0;
  int? cardAvailable = 0;
  int exceededBudgets = 0;
  int movements = 0;
  bool cardKnown = true;

  final categories = <String, int>{};

  int get net => income - expense;
  int get previousNet => previousIncome - previousExpense;
  int? get liabilities => cardKnown ? loans + cardDebt : null;
  int? get position => cardKnown ? cash + cardCredit - loans - cardDebt : null;
}

class DashboardEvent {
  const DashboardEvent(
    this.id,
    this.date,
    this.title,
    this.detail,
    this.currency,
    this.cents,
    this.flow,
    this.target, [
    this.entityId,
    this.categoryId,
  ]);

  final String id;
  final DateTime date;
  final String title;
  final String detail;
  final String currency;
  final int cents;
  final int flow;
  final DashboardTarget target;
  final String? entityId;
  final String? categoryId;
}

class DashboardOverview {
  DashboardOverview(this.month, {DashboardPeriod? period, DateTime? loadedAt})
    : period = period ?? DashboardPeriod.forMonth(month),
      loadedAt = loadedAt ?? DateTime.now();

  final DateTime month;
  final DateTime loadedAt;
  final DashboardPeriod period;

  final currencies = {'NIO': DashboardCurrency(), 'USD': DashboardCurrency()};

  final categoryNames = <String, String>{};
  final categoryStyles = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
  List<CardSpending> cardSpending = const [];
  final Map<String, List<TotalPart>> totalParts = {};

  String rateNote = '';
  final accounts = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final budgets = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final events = <DashboardEvent>[];
}

String dashboardMoney(int? cents, String currency) =>
    cardMoney(cents, currency);

String dashboardMonth(DateTime date) {
  const names = [
    'Enero',
    'Febrero',
    'Marzo',
    'Abril',
    'Mayo',
    'Junio',
    'Julio',
    'Agosto',
    'Septiembre',
    'Octubre',
    'Noviembre',
    'Diciembre',
  ];

  return '${names[date.month - 1]} ${date.year}';
}

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted, appSurfaceMuted, primaryColor;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'dashboard_overview.dart';

class DashboardMonthlyBalance extends StatelessWidget {
  const DashboardMonthlyBalance({
    super.key,
    required this.data,
    required this.currency,
  });
  final DashboardOverview data;
  final String currency;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final summary = data.currencies[currency]!;
    final income = summary.income;
    final expense = summary.expense;
    final net = income - expense;
    final difference = net - summary.previousNet;
    final maximum = [
      income.abs(),
      expense.abs(),
    ].reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
    final positive = net >= 0;
    final color = positive ? const Color(0xFF397455) : const Color(0xFFB13D32);

    Widget bar(String label, int amount, Color color) => Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: appMuted)),
              ),
              Text(
                dashboardMoney(amount, currency),
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              value: maximum == 0 ? 0 : amount.abs() / maximum,
              minHeight: 10,
              backgroundColor: appSurfaceMuted,
              color: color,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    return Card(
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.bar_chart_rounded, color: primaryColor),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'Balance del perÃ­odo',
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(data.period.label, style: TextStyle(color: appMuted)),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            bar('Ingresos', income, const Color(0xFF397455)),
            bar(
              expense < 0
                  ? 'Gastos netos Â· devoluciones superiores'
                  : 'Gastos netos',
              expense,
              const Color(0xFFA45F48),
            ),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: positive
                    ? const Color(0xFFECFDF5)
                    : const Color(0xFFFEF2F2),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Resultado: ingresos menos gastos',
                    style: TextStyle(color: color),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    dashboardMoney(net, currency),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: color,
                      fontSize: 25,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    difference == 0
                        ? 'Sin diferencia frente al perÃ­odo anterior.'
                        : '${difference > 0 ? 'MejorÃ³' : 'DisminuyÃ³'} '
                              '${dashboardMoney(difference.abs(), currency)} '
                              'frente al perÃ­odo anterior.',
                    style: TextStyle(color: appMuted),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'Las barras comparan magnitudes. El resultado excluye transferencias y pagos de capital.',
              style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../data/transaction_repository.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import 'dashboard_models.dart';
import 'dashboard_aggregation.dart';
export 'dashboard_models.dart';

Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _dashboardRows(
  String table,
  String columns,
  String userId,
) async {
  final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

  for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
    final result = await supabase
        .from(table)
        .select(columns)
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .order('id')
        .range(offset, offset + 499);

    final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
    rows.addAll(page);

    if (page.length < 500) {
      break;
    }
  }

  return rows;
}

Future<DashboardOverview> loadDashboardOverview(
  DateTime month, {
  DateTime? until,
}) async {
  final period = until == null
      ? DashboardPeriod.forMonth(month)
      : DashboardPeriod(month, until);
  final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;

  if (user == null) {
    throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
  }

  final rows = await Future.wait([
    _dashboardRows(
      'accounts',
      'id, name, account_type, currency, opening_balance, is_active',
      user.id,
    ),
    loadUserTransactions(user.id),
    _dashboardRows('categories', 'id, name, icon, color', user.id),
    _dashboardRows(
      'budgets',
      'id, category_id, currency, budget_amount, month, start_date, end_date',
      user.id,
    ),
    _dashboardRows(
      'debts',
      'id, description, currency, original_amount, status, due_date',
      user.id,
    ),
    _dashboardRows(
      'debt_payments',
      'id, debt_id, account_id, principal_amount, interest_amount, '
          'fee_amount, insurance_amount, currency, payment_date, is_voided',
      user.id,
    ),
    _dashboardRows(
      'credit_cards',
      'id, name, currency, credit_limit, opening_balance, '
          'opening_balance_nio, opening_balance_usd, '
          'limit_exchange_rate, is_active, card_reference, card_tier, card_product, financial_institutions(name)',
      user.id,
    ),
    _dashboardRows(
      'credit_card_transactions',
      'id, credit_card_id, account_id, category_id, '
          'transaction_type, amount, currency, transaction_date, '
          'charge_kind, cash_advance_fee, excludes_from_limit, '
          'description, is_voided, is_receivable_funding, account_debit_amount, account_debit_currency, payment_exchange_rate',
      user.id,
    ),
  ]);

  if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != user.id) {
    throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Actualiza el panel.');
  }

  return buildDashboardOverview(period, rows: rows, today: DateTime.now());
}
