class DashboardPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const DashboardPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<DashboardPage> createState() => _DashboardPageState();
}

class _DashboardPageState extends State<DashboardPage> {
  DashboardOverview? data;
  List<ExportMovement>? consolidatedMovements;
  DashboardPeriod period = DashboardPeriod.forMonth(DateTime.now());
  String currency = 'NIO';
  FinancialSettings? financialSettings;
  String? settingsError;
  String? error;
  bool loading = true;
  bool signingOut = false;
  String? activeName;
  int profileRequestId = 0;
  int requestId = 0;

  final scrollController = ScrollController();
  bool showBackToTop = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    scrollController.addListener(updateScrollButton);
    loadData();
    loadProfileName();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    scrollController.removeListener(updateScrollButton);
    scrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }

    final request = ++requestId;
    final selectedPeriod = period;

    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });

    try {
      final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
      final results = await Future.wait<Object?>([
        loadDashboardOverview(selectedPeriod.start, until: selectedPeriod.end),
        readSettings(),
        loadIncomeExpenseData().then<List<ExportMovement>?>(
          (value) => value.movements,
          onError: (Object _) => null,
        ),
      ]);
      final result = results[0] as DashboardOverview;
      final settingsResult = results[1] as (FinancialSettings?, String?);
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
        throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Actualiza el inicio.');
      }

      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        data = result;
        consolidatedMovements = results[2] as List<ExportMovement>?;
        financialSettings = settingsResult.$1;
        settingsError = settingsResult.$2;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<(FinancialSettings?, String?)> readSettings() async {
    try {
      return (await loadFinancialSettings(), null);
    } catch (e) {
      return (null, '$e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> openSettings() async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SettingsPage()),
    );
    if (mounted) await Future.wait([loadData(), loadProfileName()]);
  }

  Future<void> chooseDate(bool from) async {
    if (loading) return;
    final selected = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      helpText: from ? 'Desde' : 'Hasta',
      initialDate: from ? period.start : period.end,
      firstDate: DateTime(2000),
      lastDate: DateTime(2100, 12, 31),
    );
    if (selected == null || !mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      period = from
          ? DashboardPeriod(
              selected,
              selected.isAfter(period.end) ? selected : period.end,
            )
          : DashboardPeriod(
              selected.isBefore(period.start) ? selected : period.start,
              selected,
            );
    });
    await loadData();
  }

  Future<void> pushPage(Widget page) async {
    await Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => page),
    );

    if (mounted) {
      await loadData();
    }
  }

  Future<void> openReceivableLoans() => pushPage(const ReceivableLoansPage());

  Future<void> openTarget(DashboardTarget target) {
    final Widget page = switch (target) {
      DashboardTarget.accounts => const AccountsPage(),
      DashboardTarget.transactions => const TransactionsPage(),
      DashboardTarget.categories => const CategoriesPage(),
      DashboardTarget.budgets => const BudgetsPage(),
      DashboardTarget.debts => const DebtsPage(),
      DashboardTarget.cards => const CreditCardsPage(),
      DashboardTarget.reports => const MonthlyExpensesPage(),
    };

    return pushPage(page);
  }

  Future<void> openEvent(DashboardEvent event) {
    if (event.entityId != null && event.target == DashboardTarget.cards) {
      return pushPage(CreditCardMovementsPage(cardId: event.entityId!));
    }

    if (event.entityId != null && event.target == DashboardTarget.debts) {
      return pushPage(DebtPaymentsPage(debtId: event.entityId!));
    }

    return openTarget(event.target);
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    if (signingOut) return;
    setState(() => signingOut = true);
    try {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo cerrar sesiÃ³n: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => signingOut = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadProfileName() async {
    final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (userId == null) return;
    final request = ++profileRequestId;
    try {
      final name = await fetchProfileName(userId);
      if (mounted &&
          request == profileRequestId &&
          supabase.auth.currentUser?.id == userId &&
          activeName != name) {
        setState(() => activeName = name);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // El correo sigue identificando la cuenta si el perfil no estÃ¡ disponible.
    }
  }

  void updateScrollButton() {
    if (!mounted || scrollController.positions.length != 1) {
      return;
    }

    final visible = scrollController.offset > 500;

    if (visible != showBackToTop) {
      setState(() => showBackToTop = visible);
    }
  }

  void backToTop() {
    if (scrollController.positions.length != 1) {
      return;
    }

    scrollController.animateTo(
      0,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );
  }

// ==========================================
/// Calendar-day interval, inclusive on both ends. No UTC conversion is applied
/// to a date chosen in the UI; timestamps are localized by the loader.
class DashboardPeriod {
  DashboardPeriod(DateTime from, DateTime until)
    : start = DateTime(from.year, from.month, from.day),
      end = DateTime(until.year, until.month, until.day) {
    if (end.isBefore(start))
      throw ArgumentError('La fecha Hasta debe ser igual o posterior a Desde.');
  }
  factory DashboardPeriod.forMonth(DateTime date) => DashboardPeriod(
    DateTime(date.year, date.month, 1),
    DateTime(date.year, date.month + 1, 0),
  );
  final DateTime start, end;
  static int _ordinal(DateTime d) =>
      DateTime.utc(d.year, d.month, d.day).millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/
      Duration.millisecondsPerDay;
  int get days => _ordinal(end) - _ordinal(start) + 1;
  bool contains(DateTime date) =>
      _ordinal(date) >= _ordinal(start) && _ordinal(date) <= _ordinal(end);
  bool get isFullMonth =>
      start.day == 1 &&
      start.year == end.year &&
      start.month == end.month &&
      end.day == DateTime(end.year, end.month + 1, 0).day;
  bool overlapsMonth(DateTime month) =>
      !DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1, 0).isBefore(start) &&
      !DateTime(month.year, month.month).isAfter(end);
  DashboardPeriod get previous {
    if (isFullMonth)
      return DashboardPeriod.forMonth(DateTime(start.year, start.month - 1));
    // UTC day arithmetic prevents DST transitions from shortening a day.
    final previousEnd = DateTime.utc(
      start.year,
      start.month,
      start.day,
    ).subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
    return DashboardPeriod(
      previousEnd.subtract(Duration(days: days - 1)),
      previousEnd,
    );
  }

  String get label => '${dateLabel(start)} â€“ ${dateLabel(end)}';
  static String dateLabel(DateTime d) =>
      '${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.year}';
}

import '../../utils/money.dart';

class CurrencySummary {
  int balance = 0, income = 0, expense = 0;
  int get net => income - expense;
}

class DashboardSummary {
  DashboardSummary(this.currencies, this.recent, this.accountNames, this.month);
  final Map<String, CurrencySummary> currencies;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> recent;
  final Map<String, String> accountNames;
  final DateTime month;

  factory DashboardSummary.calculate(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> transactions,
    DateTime now, {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> cardExpenses = const [],
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> cardPayments = const [],
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> debtPayments = const [],
  }) {
    final totals = {'NIO': CurrencySummary(), 'USD': CurrencySummary()};
    final balances = calculateBalances(
      accounts,
      transactions,
      cardPayments: cardPayments,
      debtPayments: debtPayments,
    );
    final names = <String, String>{};
    for (final account in accounts) {
      final id = account['id'].toString();
      names[id] = account['name']?.toString() ?? 'Cuenta';
      if (account['is_active'] == true) {
        final total = totals[account['currency']];
        if (total != null) total.balance += balances[id] ?? 0;
      }
    }
    final dated = <MapEntry<DateTime, Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
    for (final tx in transactions) {
      final date = DateTime.tryParse('${tx['transaction_date']}')?.toLocal();
      if (date == null)
        throw FormatException('Un movimiento tiene una fecha invÃ¡lida.');
      dated.add(MapEntry(date, tx));
      if (date.year != now.year || date.month != now.month) continue;
      final total = totals[tx['currency']];
      if (total == null) continue;
      if (tx['transaction_type'] == 'income')
        total.income += moneyCents(tx['amount']);
      if (tx['transaction_type'] == 'expense')
        total.expense += moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    }
    for (final expense in cardExpenses) {
      final date = DateTime.tryParse(
        '${expense['transaction_date']}',
      )?.toLocal();
      if (date == null)
        throw FormatException(
          'Un movimiento de tarjeta tiene una fecha invÃ¡lida.',
        );
      if (date.year != now.year || date.month != now.month) continue;
      final total = totals[expense['currency']];
      if (total != null) total.expense += moneyCents(expense['amount']);
    }
    for (final payment in debtPayments) {
      final date = DateTime.tryParse('${payment['payment_date']}')?.toLocal();
      if (date == null)
        throw FormatException('Un abono tiene una fecha invÃ¡lida.');
      if (date.year != now.year || date.month != now.month) continue;
      final total = totals[payment['currency']];
      if (total != null) {
        total.expense +=
            moneyCents(payment['interest_amount']) +
            moneyCents(payment['fee_amount']);
      }
    }
    dated.sort((a, b) {
      final byDate = b.key.compareTo(a.key);
      return byDate != 0
          ? byDate
          : a.value['id'].toString().compareTo(b.value['id'].toString());
    });
    return DashboardSummary(
      totals,
      dated.take(5).map((e) => e.value).toList(),
      names,
      DateTime(now.year, now.month),
    );
  }
}

String formatMoney(int cents, String currency) =>
    formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

class RecentTransactionCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const RecentTransactionCard({
    super.key,
    required this.transaction,
    required this.accountNames,
    required this.onTap,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> transaction;
  final Map<String, String> accountNames;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tx = transaction;
    final type = tx['transaction_type'];
    final income = type == 'income' || type == 'deposit';
    final expense = type == 'expense' || type == 'withdrawal';
    final label = switch (type) {
      'income' => 'Ingreso',
      'expense' => 'Gasto',
      'transfer' => 'Transferencia',
      'deposit' => 'DepÃ³sito',
      'withdrawal' => 'Retiro',
      _ => 'Movimiento',
    };
    final description = tx['description']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final date = DateTime.parse(tx['transaction_date'].toString()).toLocal();
    final dateText =
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';
    final origin =
        accountNames[tx['account_id'].toString()] ?? 'Cuenta no disponible';
    final destination =
        accountNames[tx['destination_account_id'].toString()] ??
        'Cuenta no disponible';
    return Card(
      child: ListTile(
        onTap: onTap,
        leading: Icon(
          income
              ? Icons.arrow_downward
              : expense
              ? Icons.arrow_upward
              : Icons.swap_horiz,
        ),
        title: Text(
          description.isEmpty ? label : description,
          maxLines: 2,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
        subtitle: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('$dateText Â· $label'),
            Text(type == 'transfer' ? '$origin â†’ $destination' : origin),
            Text(
              '${income
                  ? '+'
                  : expense
                  ? 'âˆ’'
                  : ''}${formatMoney(moneyCents(tx['amount']), tx['currency'].toString())}',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: income
                    ? const Color(0xFF397455)
                    : expense
                    ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error
                    : null,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted, primaryColor;
import 'zero_plans_agenda.dart';
import '../../data/payment_agenda_labels.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../utils/money.dart';

class UpcomingPaymentsPanel extends StatefulWidget {
  const UpcomingPaymentsPanel({
    super.key,
    required this.refreshToken,
    required this.onCard,
    required this.onDebt,
    this.onInstallments,
  });
  final Object refreshToken;
  final ValueChanged<Map<String, dynamic>> onCard, onDebt;
  final ValueChanged<Map<String, dynamic>>? onInstallments;
  @override
  State<UpcomingPaymentsPanel> createState() => _UpcomingPaymentsPanelState();
}

class _UpcomingPaymentsPanelState extends State<UpcomingPaymentsPanel> {
  bool loading = true, expanded = false;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;
  List<AgendaItem> items = [];
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant UpcomingPaymentsPanel oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.refreshToken != widget.refreshToken) {
      load();
    }
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
      if (userId == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
      }
      final values = await Future.wait<Object>([
        loadCardStatements(userId),
        statementRows(
          'credit_cards',
          'id,name,currency,closing_day,payment_day,is_active,card_reference,financial_institutions(name)',
          userId,
        ),
        statementRows(
          'debts',
          'id,description,creditor_name,currency,original_amount,status,due_date',
          userId,
        ),
        statementRows(
          'debt_payments',
          'id,debt_id,currency,principal_amount,is_voided',
          userId,
        ),
        loadDebtInstallments(userId),
      ]);
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
        throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
      }
      final agenda = buildPaymentAgenda(
        today: DateTime.now(),
        statements: values[0] as CardStatementData,
        cards: values[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>,
        debts: values[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>,
        debtPayments: values[3] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>,
        installments: values[4] as DebtInstallmentData,
      );
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        items = agenda;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Widget agendaRow(AgendaItem item, DateTime today) {
    final compact = compactLayout(context);
    final days = daysUntil(item.date, today);
    final isCut = item.kind == AgendaKind.cardCut;
    final loan =
        item.kind == AgendaKind.loanMaturity ||
        item.kind == AgendaKind.loanInstallment;
    final coveredMinimum =
        item.kind == AgendaKind.cardPayment && item.minimumRemaining == 0;
    final color = isCut
        ? primaryColor
        : days < 0 &&
              (loan || (!coveredMinimum && item.minimumRemaining != null))
        ? const Color(0xFFB13D32)
        : days <= 0
        ? const Color(0xFF946200)
        : primaryColor;
    final when = days < 0
        ? '${isCut ? 'PasÃ³' : 'VenciÃ³'} hace ${-days} ${days == -1 ? 'dÃ­a' : 'dÃ­as'}'
        : days == 0
        ? 'Hoy'
        : days == 1
        ? 'MaÃ±ana'
        : 'En $days dÃ­as';
    final label = isCut
        ? 'Corte de tarjeta'
        : item.kind == AgendaKind.loanInstallment
        ? 'Cuota de prÃ©stamo'
        : loan
        ? 'Vencimiento de capital'
        : 'Pago de tarjeta';
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: compact ? 8 : 10),
      child: Material(
        color: color.withAlpha(9),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          onTap: () {
            if (item.kind == AgendaKind.loanInstallment) {
              (widget.onInstallments ?? widget.onDebt)(item.entity);
            } else if (loan) {
              widget.onDebt(item.entity);
            } else {
              widget.onCard(item.entity);
            }
          },
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.all(compact ? 10 : 14),
            child: Row(

  List<Widget> agendaGroups(DateTime today) {
    const titles = ['Vencidos', 'Hoy', 'PrÃ³ximos', 'Cortes de tarjeta'];
    final visible = items.take(expanded ? items.length : 5);
    return [
      for (final (group, title) in titles.indexed)
        if (visible.any((item) => agendaUrgency(item, today) == group)) ...[
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
            child: Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
          ),
          AdaptiveColumns(
            minColumnWidth: 380,
            maxColumns: 2,
            spacing: 12,
            children: [
              for (final item in visible.where(
                (item) => agendaUrgency(item, today) == group,
              ))
                agendaRow(item, today),
            ],
          ),
        ],
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Card(
    margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
    child: Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(

              Icon(Icons.event_available_outlined, color: primaryColor),
              const SizedBox(width: 9),

              ),

            const Padding(

import '../../core/status_colors.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/payment_agenda_labels.dart';
import '../../data/zero_plan_repository.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_repository.dart' show statementRows;
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../credit_cards/zero_plans_page.dart';

class ZeroPlansAgenda extends StatefulWidget {
  const ZeroPlansAgenda({
    super.key,
    required this.refreshToken,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final Object refreshToken;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;
  @override
  State<ZeroPlansAgenda> createState() => _ZeroPlansAgendaState();
}

class _ZeroPlansAgendaState extends State<ZeroPlansAgenda> {
  ZeroPlanData? data;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards = [], statements = [];
  String? error;
  bool loading = true, expanded = false;
  int request = 0;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ZeroPlansAgenda oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.refreshToken != widget.refreshToken) load();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final req = ++request;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = zeroUser();
      final values = await Future.wait<Object>([
        loadZeroPlans(uid),
        statementRows(
          'credit_cards',
          'id,name,currency,is_active,card_reference,financial_institutions(name)',
          uid,
        ),
        statementRows(
          'credit_card_statements',
          'id,is_voided,is_archived',
          uid,
        ),
      ]);
      zeroSession(uid);
      if (!mounted || req != request) return;
      setState(() {
        data = values[0] as ZeroPlanData;
        cards = values[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        statements = values[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && req == request)
        setState(() {
          loading = false;
          error = '$e';
        });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (loading)
      return const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
        child: LinearProgressIndicator(),
      );
    if (error != null)
      return ListTile(
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        title: const Text('No se pudieron cargar las cuotas tasa cero'),
        subtitle: Text(error!),
        trailing: IconButton(onPressed: load, icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh)),
      );
    final end = DateTime(
      DateTime.now().year,
      DateTime.now().month,
      DateTime.now().day + 8,
    );
    final plans = {
      for (final p in data!.plans.where((p) => p['is_voided'] != true))
        '${p['id']}': p,
    };
    final rows =
        data!.installments
            .where(
              (i) =>
                  plans.containsKey('${i['plan_id']}') &&
                  data!.remaining(i) > 0 &&
                  DateTime.parse('${i['due_date']}').isBefore(end) &&
                  !statements.any(
                    (s) =>
                        s['id'] == i['statement_id'] &&
                        s['is_voided'] != true &&
                        s['is_archived'] != true,
                  ),
            )
            .toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => '${a['due_date']}'.compareTo('${b['due_date']}'));
    if (rows.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        const Divider(height: 24),
        const Text(
          'Cuotas tasa cero por revisar',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
        ),
        const Text(
          'Vencidas o prÃ³ximas 7 dÃ­as, sin corte vigente vinculado. Si ya estÃ¡n en el estado de cuenta, vincÃºlalas para que no aparezcan tambiÃ©n aquÃ­.',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
        ),
        AdaptiveColumns(
          minColumnWidth: 380,
          maxColumns: 3,
          spacing: 12,
          children: rows.take(expanded ? rows.length : 4).map((i) {
            final p = plans['${i['plan_id']}']!,
                card = cards
                    .where((c) => c['id'] == p['credit_card_id'])
                    .firstOrNull;
            final stateColor = appDueColor(
              DateTime.tryParse('${i['due_date']}'),
            );
            return Card(
              color: stateColor.withValues(alpha: .06),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                side: BorderSide(color: stateColor.withValues(alpha: .3)),
              ),
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined),
                title: Text(
                  '${p['description']} Â· cuota ${i['number']}/${p['total_installments']}',
                ),
                subtitle: Text(
                  '${agendaCardLabel(card, includeName: false)} Â· ${zeroDateLabel(i['due_date'])}\nPendiente: ${formatMoneyCents(data!.remaining(i), '${p['currency']}')}',
                ),
                trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                onTap: card == null
                    ? null
                    : () async {
                        await Navigator.push(
                          context,
                          MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                            builder: (_) => ZeroPlansPage(card: card),
                          ),
                        );
                        if (mounted) widget.onChanged();
                      },
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        ),
        if (rows.length > 4)
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => setState(() => expanded = !expanded),
            child: Text(
              expanded
                  ? 'Mostrar menos'
                  : 'Ver todas las cuotas (${rows.length})',
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../data/transaction_repository.dart';
import '../person_accounts/receipt_draft_field.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../data/debt_installment_repository.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_logic.dart' show shortStatementDate;
import 'debt_installments_page.dart';
import 'debt_card.dart';
import 'debt_form_dialog.dart';
import 'debt_payment_dialog.dart';
import 'debt_payments_page.dart';
import 'debt_edit_dialog.dart';
import 'debt_due_status.dart';
import 'debts_summary.dart';
import 'loan_simulator_dialog.dart';

class DebtsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const DebtsPage({super.key, this.initialSearch = ''});
  final String initialSearch;
  @override
  State<DebtsPage> createState() => _DebtsPageState();
}

class _DebtsPageState extends State<DebtsPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> debts = [];
  Map<String, int> principalPaid = {};
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  bool hasLoaded = false;
  DebtInstallmentData? installmentData;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    searchController.text = widget.initialSearch;
    loadData();
  }

  final searchController = TextEditingController();
  final scrollController = ScrollController(keepScrollOffset: false);

  @override
  void dispose() {
    searchController.dispose();
    scrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String money(int cents, String currency) => formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);
  void message(String text) =>
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));

  String filter = 'active';

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get visibleDebts {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final query = searchController.text.trim().toLowerCase();
    return debts.where((debt) {
      if (query.isNotEmpty) {
        final description = debt['description']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
        final creditor = debt['creditor_name']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
        if (!description.contains(query) && !creditor.contains(query))
          return false;
      }
      final paid = principalPaid[debt['id'].toString()] ?? 0;
      final due = debtDueStatus(debt, paid, now);
      switch (filter) {
        case 'active':
          return ['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status']);
        case 'overdue':
          return due == DebtDueStatus.overdue;
        case 'today':
          return due == DebtDueStatus.today;
        case 'paused':
          return debt['status'] == 'paused';
        case 'paid':
          return debt['status'] == 'paid';
        case 'cancelled':
          return debt['status'] == 'cancelled';
        default:
          return true;
      }
    }).toList();
  }

  Future<void> editDebt(Map<String, dynamic> debt) async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => DebtEditDialog(debt: debt),
    );
    if (data == null || !mounted) return;
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await supabase
          .from('debts')
          .update(data)
          .eq('id', debt['id'])
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .select('id')
          .single();
      if (!mounted) return;
      message('Deuda actualizada.');
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo actualizar: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo actualizar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> addPayment(Map<String, dynamic> debt) async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    if (!['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status'])) {
      message('La deuda no admite abonos en su estado actual.');
      return;
    }
    final pending =
        moneyCents(debt['original_amount']) -
        (principalPaid[debt['id'].toString()] ?? 0);
    if (pending < 0) {
      message('Revisa los abonos: superan el capital original.');
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) return;
      final rows = await readRows(
        'accounts',
        'id, name, currency, is_active',
        user.id,
      );
      final expenses = (await loadUserTransactions(user.id))
          .where(
            (row) =>
                row['transaction_type'] == 'expense' &&
                row['source'] == null &&
                row['currency'] == debt['currency'],
          )
          .toList();
      final accounts = rows
          .where(
            (a) => a['is_active'] == true && a['currency'] == debt['currency'],
          )
          .toList();
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (accounts.isEmpty && expenses.isEmpty) {
        message('Necesitas una cuenta activa en la misma moneda.');
        return;
      }
      final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) => DebtPaymentDialog(
          currency: debt['currency'].toString(),
          remainingCents: pending,
          accounts: accounts,
          expenses: expenses,
          installments: installmentData?.payableFor('${debt['id']}') ?? [],
        ),
      );
      if (data == null || !mounted) return;
      final installmentId = data['installment_id'];
      final receipt = data.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
      final saved = await supabase.rpc(
        data['transaction_id'] == null
            ? 'register_debt_payment_breakdown'
            : 'register_debt_payment_from_expense',
        params: {
          'p_debt_id': debt['id'],
          if (data['transaction_id'] == null)
            'p_account_id': data['account_id'],
          if (data['transaction_id'] != null)
            'p_transaction_id': data['transaction_id'],
          'p_principal_amount': data['principal_amount'],
          'p_interest_amount': data['interest_amount'],
          'p_fee_amount': data['fee_amount'],
          'p_insurance_amount': data['insurance_amount'],
          if (data['transaction_id'] == null)
            'p_payment_date': data['payment_date'],
          'p_reference': data['reference'],
          if (installmentId != null) 'p_installment_id': installmentId,
        },
      );
      if (mounted)
        await attachFinancialReceipt(
          context,
          receipt,
          user.id,
          'debt_payments',
          saved,
        );
      if (!mounted) return;
      message('Abono registrado.');
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo guardar: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> readRows(
    String table,
    String columns,
    String userId,
  ) async {
    final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
      var query = supabase.from(table).select(columns).eq('user_id', userId);
      if (table == 'debt_payments') query = query.eq('is_voided', false);
      final result = await query.order('id').range(offset, offset + 499);
      final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
      rows.addAll(page);
      if (page.length < 500) break;
    }
    return rows;
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) throw Exception('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      final debtRows = await readRows(
        'debts',
        'id, description, creditor_name, currency, original_amount, status, due_date',
        user.id,
      );
      final paymentRows = await readRows(
        'debt_payments',
        'id, debt_id, principal_amount, currency',
        user.id,
      );
      final currencies = {
        for (final debt in debtRows) debt['id'].toString(): debt['currency'],
      };
      final paid = <String, int>{};
      for (final payment in paymentRows) {
        final id = payment['debt_id'].toString();
        if (!currencies.containsKey(id)) continue;
        if (currencies[id] != payment['currency']) {
          throw StateError('Hay un abono con moneda diferente a la deuda.');
        }
        paid[id] = (paid[id] ?? 0) + moneyCents(payment['principal_amount']);
      }
      final schedules = await loadDebtInstallments(user.id);
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != user.id) return;
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) return;
      setState(() {
        hasLoaded = true;
        debts = debtRows;
        principalPaid = paid;
        installmentData = schedules;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          if (!hasLoaded) error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
        if (hasLoaded) message('No se pudieron actualizar las deudas: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> addDebt() async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => const DebtFormDialog(),
    );
    if (data == null || !mounted) return;
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await supabase.from('debts').insert({...data, 'user_id': user.id});
      if (!mounted) return;
      message('Deuda registrada.');
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo guardar: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Widget debtCard(Map<String, dynamic> debt) {
    final paid = principalPaid[debt['id'].toString()] ?? 0;
    final pending = moneyCents(debt['original_amount']) - paid;
    final schedule = installmentData?.payableFor('${debt['id']}') ?? [];
    final next = schedule.isEmpty ? null : schedule.first;
    return DebtCard(
      key: ValueKey(debt['id']),
      nextInstallmentLabel:
          next == null || !['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status'])
          ? null
          : 'Cuota ${next['number']}: ${formatMoneyCents(installmentData!.progress(next).remaining, '${debt['currency']}')} Â· ${shortStatementDate(next['due_date'])}',
      onInstallments: loading || saving
          ? null
          : () async {
              await Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) => DebtInstallmentsPage(debt: debt),
                ),
              );
              if (mounted) {
                await loadData();
              }
            },
      debt: debt,
      paidCents: paid,
      onEdit: saving ? null : () => editDebt(debt),
      onPayment: saving ? null : () => addPayment(debt),
      onHistory: loading || saving
          ? null
          : () async {
              await Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                  builder: (_) =>
                      DebtPaymentsPage(debtId: debt['id'].toString()),
                ),
              );
              if (mounted) await loadData();
            },
      onSimulate: saving
          ? null
          : () {
              showDialog<void>(
                context: context,
                builder: (_) => LoanSimulatorDialog(
                  principalCents: pending,
                  currency: debt['currency'].toString(),
                ),
              );
            },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GuideScope(
    topic: 'debts',
    ready: !loading && error == null,
    child: Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: GuideAnchor(
          id: 'title',
          child: const Text('Deudas y prÃ©stamos'),
        ),
        actions: [

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\debts\debts_summary.dart
// ==========================================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'debt_due_status.dart';

class DebtsSummary extends StatelessWidget {
  const DebtsSummary({
    super.key,
    required this.debts,
    required this.principalPaid,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> debts;
  final Map<String, int> principalPaid;

  String money(int cents, String currency) => formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

  Widget currencyCard(BuildContext context, String currency, DateTime now) {
    int pending = 0, overdue = 0, today = 0, count = 0;
    for (final debt in debts) {
      if (debt['currency'] != currency ||
          ['cancelled', 'paid'].contains(debt['status']))
        continue;
      final paid = principalPaid[debt['id'].toString()] ?? 0;
      final remaining = moneyCents(debt['original_amount']) - paid;
      if (remaining <= 0) continue;
      pending += remaining;
      count++;
      final status = debtDueStatus(debt, paid, now);
      if (status == DebtDueStatus.overdue) overdue += remaining;
      if (status == DebtDueStatus.today) today += remaining;
    }
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              currency == 'USD' ? 'Deudas en dÃ³lares' : 'Deudas en cÃ³rdobas',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const Text('Capital pendiente'),
            Text(
              money(pending, currency),
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
            ),
            const Divider(height: 24),
            Text(
              'Capital vencido: ${money(overdue, currency)}',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: overdue > 0 ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error : null,
              ),
            ),
            Text('Vence hoy: ${money(today, currency)}'),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text('$count deudas con capital pendiente'),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            final nio = currencyCard(context, 'NIO', now);
            final usd = currencyCard(context, 'USD', now);
            return constraints.maxWidth < 600
                ? Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [nio, usd],
                  )
                : Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Expanded(child: nio),
                      Expanded(child: usd),
                    ],
                  );
          },
        ),
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
          child: Text(
            'Incluye capital pendiente de deudas no canceladas, tambiÃ©n las pausadas. No incluye intereses ni comisiones pendientes.',
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\debts\debt_due_status.dart
// ==========================================
import '../../utils/money.dart';

enum DebtDueStatus { none, today, overdue }

DebtDueStatus debtDueStatus(
  Map<String, dynamic> debt,
  int principalPaid,
  DateTime now,
) {
  if (!['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status']))
    return DebtDueStatus.none;
  if (moneyCents(debt['original_amount']) - principalPaid <= 0)
    return DebtDueStatus.none;
  final due = DateTime.tryParse('${debt['due_date']}');
  if (due == null) return DebtDueStatus.none;
  final dueDay = DateTime(due.year, due.month, due.day);
  final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
  if (dueDay.isBefore(today)) return DebtDueStatus.overdue;
  if (dueDay == today) return DebtDueStatus.today;
  return DebtDueStatus.none;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class DebtEditDialog extends StatefulWidget {

  final Map<String, dynamic> debt;
  @override
  State<DebtEditDialog> createState() => _DebtEditDialogState();
}

class _DebtEditDialogState extends State<DebtEditDialog> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late final TextEditingController description, creditor;
  DateTime? dueDate;
  String status = 'active';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    description = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.debt['description']?.toString() ?? '',
    );
    creditor = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.debt['creditor_name']?.toString() ?? '',
    );
    dueDate = DateTime.tryParse('${widget.debt['due_date']}');
    status = widget.debt['status']?.toString() ?? 'active';
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    description.dispose();
    creditor.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String dateText(DateTime date) =>
      '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';

  void save() {
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final date = dueDate;
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      'description': description.text.trim(),
      'creditor_name': creditor.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : creditor.text.trim(),
      'due_date': date == null
          ? null
          : '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
      'status': status,
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    title: const Text('Editar deuda'),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 420,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Form(
          key: formKey,

            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              TextFormField(

                autofocus: true,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'DescripciÃ³n'),
                validator: (value) => (value ?? '').trim().isEmpty
                    ? 'Escribe una descripciÃ³n'
                    : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextFormField(
                controller: creditor,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Acreedor (opcional)',
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: status,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Estado'),
                items: const [
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'active', child: Text('Activa')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'overdue', child: Text('Vencida')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'paused', child: Text('Pausada')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'paid', child: Text('Saldada')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: 'cancelled',
                    child: Text('Cancelada'),
                  ),
                ],
                onChanged: (value) {
                  if (value != null) setState(() => status = value);
                },
              ),
              if (status == 'paid')
                const Text(
                  'La deuda quedarÃ¡ saldada. Sus abonos anteriores se conservan y el cambio de estado no genera un dÃ©bito.',
                ),
              if (status == 'cancelled')
                const Text(
                  'Se excluirÃ¡ del resumen de deudas. Sus abonos anteriores se conservan.',
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.event),
                label: Text(
                  dueDate == null
                      ? 'Agregar vencimiento'
                      : 'Vence: ${dateText(dueDate!)}',
                ),
                onPressed: () async {
                  final initial = dueDate ?? DateTime.now();
                  final selected = await showDatePicker(
                    context: context,
                    initialDate: initial,
                    firstDate: DateTime(
                      initial.year < 1900 ? initial.year : 1900,
                    ),
                    lastDate: DateTime(
                      initial.year > 2200 ? initial.year : 2200,
                      12,
                      31,

                  );
                  if (selected != null && mounted)

        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),

      FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Guardar')),

              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: currency,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Moneda'),
                items: const [
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'NIO', child: Text('CÃ³rdobas (C\$)')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'USD', child: Text('DÃ³lares (\$)')),
                ],
                onChanged: (value) {
                  if (value != null) setState(() => currency = value);
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextFormField(
                controller: amountController,
                keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                  decimal: true,
                ),
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Capital original',
                  helperText: 'Monto prestado, sin incluir intereses.',
                ),
                validator: (value) {
                  final text = (value ?? '').trim();
                  final amount = double.tryParse(text.replaceAll(',', '.'));
                  if (amount == null || !amount.isFinite || amount <= 0)
                    return 'Escribe un monto mayor que cero';
                  if (!RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text))
                    return 'Usa mÃ¡ximo seis decimales, sin separadores de miles';
                  return null;
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cancelar'),
      ),
      FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Guardar')),
    ],
  );
}

import '../../core/status_colors.dart';
import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted;
import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../data/transaction_repository.dart';
import '../person_accounts/receipt_draft_field.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../person_accounts/person_receipts_dialog.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../data/debt_installment_repository.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_repository.dart' show statementRows;
import '../../data/card_statement_logic.dart' show shortStatementDate;
import 'debt_installment_plan_dialog.dart';
import 'debt_payment_dialog.dart';

class DebtInstallmentsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const DebtInstallmentsPage({super.key, required this.debt});
  final Map<String, dynamic> debt;
  @override
  State<DebtInstallmentsPage> createState() => _DebtInstallmentsPageState();
}

class _DebtInstallmentsPageState extends State<DebtInstallmentsPage> {
  DebtInstallmentData? data;
  late Map<String, dynamic> debt;
  bool loading = true, saving = false, history = false;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;
  String get debtId => '${widget.debt['id']}';
  String money(int? n) => formatMoneyCents(n, '${debt['currency']}');
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    debt = widget.debt;
    load();
  }

  void message(String s) {
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(s)));
    }
  }

  String owner() {
    final id = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (id == null) {
      throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
    }
    return id;
  }

  void same(String id) {
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != id) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = owner();
      final results = await Future.wait<Object>([
        loadDebtInstallments(uid),
        supabase
            .from('debts')
            .select('id,description,currency,original_amount,status,due_date')
            .eq('id', debtId)
            .eq('user_id', uid)
            .single(),
      ]);
      same(uid);
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        data = results[0] as DebtInstallmentData;
        debt = Map<String, dynamic>.from(results[1] as Map);
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          loading = false;
          error = '$e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> run(Future<void> Function(String) action) async {
    if (loading || saving) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await action(owner());
      if (mounted) {
        await load();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo completar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> configure([Map<String, dynamic>? i]) => run((uid) async {
    final v = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: i == null,
      builder: (_) => DebtInstallmentPlanDialog(
        currency: '${debt['currency']}',
        installment: i,
        onSaveEdit: i == null
            ? null
            : (values) async {
                same(uid);
                await supabase.rpc(
                  'update_debt_installment',
                  params: {
                    'p_installment_id': i['id'],
                    'p_amount': values['amount'],
                    'p_due_date': values['first_due'],
                    'p_notes': values['notes'],
                  },
                );
              },
      ),
    );
    if (v == null || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    same(uid);
    if (i == null) {
      await supabase.rpc(
        'create_debt_installment_plan',
        params: {
          'p_debt_id': debtId,
          'p_amount': v['amount'],
          'p_first_due': v['first_due'],
          'p_count': v['count'],
          'p_month_day': v['day'],
          'p_last_amount': v['last'],
        },
      );
    }
    message(i == null ? 'Calendario guardado.' : 'Cuota actualizada.');
  });
  int get principalRemaining {
    if (debt['status'] == 'paid') return 0;
    var paid = 0;
    for (final p in data!.payments) {
      if ('${p['debt_id']}' == debtId && p['is_voided'] != true) {
        if (p['currency'] != debt['currency']) {
          throw StateError('Un abono tiene una moneda diferente al prÃ©stamo.');
        }
        paid += moneyCents(p['principal_amount']);
      }
    }
    return moneyCents(debt['original_amount']) - paid;
  }

  Future<void> pay(Map<String, dynamic> i) => run((uid) async {
    final remaining = principalRemaining;
    if (remaining < 0) {
      throw StateError('Los abonos superan el capital original.');
    }
    final rows = await statementRows(
      'accounts',
      'id,name,currency,is_active',
      uid,
    );
    final expenses = (await loadUserTransactions(uid))
        .where(
          (row) =>
              row['transaction_type'] == 'expense' &&
              row['source'] == null &&
              row['currency'] == debt['currency'],
        )
        .toList();
    final accounts = rows
        .where(
          (a) => a['is_active'] == true && a['currency'] == debt['currency'],
        )
        .toList();
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    if (accounts.isEmpty && expenses.isEmpty) {
      message('Necesitas una cuenta activa en ${debt['currency']}.');
      return;
    }
    final v = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => DebtPaymentDialog(
        currency: '${debt['currency']}',
        remainingCents: remaining,
        accounts: accounts,
        expenses: expenses,
        installments: [i],
        initialInstallmentId: '${i['id']}',
        expectedTotalCents: data!.progress(i).remaining,
      ),
    );
    if (v == null || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    same(uid);
    final linked = v['installment_id'];
    final receipt = v.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
    final saved = await supabase.rpc(
      v['transaction_id'] == null
          ? 'register_debt_payment_breakdown'
          : 'register_debt_payment_from_expense',
      params: {
        'p_debt_id': debtId,
        if (v['transaction_id'] == null) 'p_account_id': v['account_id'],
        if (v['transaction_id'] != null)
          'p_transaction_id': v['transaction_id'],
        'p_principal_amount': v['principal_amount'],
        'p_interest_amount': v['interest_amount'],
        'p_fee_amount': v['fee_amount'],
        'p_insurance_amount': v['insurance_amount'],
        if (v['transaction_id'] == null) 'p_payment_date': v['payment_date'],
        'p_reference': v['reference'],
        if (linked != null) 'p_installment_id': linked,
      },
    );
    if (mounted)
      await attachFinancialReceipt(
        context,
        receipt,
        uid,
        'debt_payments',
        saved,
      );
    message('Abono registrado.');
  });
  Future<void> link(Map<String, dynamic> i) => run((uid) async {
    final used = data!.links.map((l) => '${l['payment_id']}').toSet();
    final rows = data!.payments
        .where(
          (p) =>
              '${p['debt_id']}' == debtId &&
              p['currency'] == debt['currency'] &&
              p['is_voided'] != true &&
              !used.contains('${p['id']}'),
        )
        .toList();
    if (rows.isEmpty) {
      message('No hay abonos sin asignar para este prÃ©stamo.');
      return;
    }
    final id = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (c) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Vincular abono existente'),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 420,
          height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .45,
          child: ListView(
            children: rows
                .map(
                  (p) => ListTile(
                    title: Text(money(debtPaymentTotalCents(p))),
                    subtitle: Text(shortStatementDate(p['payment_date'])),
                    onTap: () => Navigator.pop(c, '${p['id']}'),
                  ),
                )
                .toList(),
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (id == null || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    same(uid);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'assign_debt_installment_payment',
      params: {'p_installment_id': i['id'], 'p_payment_id': id},
    );
  });
  Future<bool> confirm(String text) async =>
      await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (c) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Confirmar'),
          content: Text(text),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, false),
              child: const Text('Cancelar'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, true),
              child: const Text('Confirmar'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ) ??
      false;
  Future<void> unlink(String id) => run((uid) async {
    if (!await confirm(
          'El abono seguirÃ¡ registrado. Solo se quita su aplicaciÃ³n a la cuota.',
        ) ||
        !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    same(uid);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'unassign_debt_installment_payment',
      params: {'p_payment_id': id},
    );
  });
  Future<void> archive() => run((uid) async {
    if (!await confirm(
          'Se archivarÃ¡ el calendario vigente, conservando sus cuotas y pagos. La deuda y los abonos reales no cambian.',
        ) ||
        !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    same(uid);
    await supabase.rpc(
      'archive_debt_installment_plan',
      params: {'p_debt_id': debtId},
    );
  });
  Widget installmentCard(Map<String, dynamic> i) {
    final p = data!.progress(i),
        current = i['is_archived'] != true && i['is_voided'] != true;
    final active = ['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status']);
    final links = data!.links.where(
      (l) => '${l['installment_id']}' == '${i['id']}',
    );
    final stateColor = appDueColor(
      DateTime.tryParse('${i['due_date']}'),
      settled: p.settled,
      inactive: !current || !active,
    );
    return Card(
      color: stateColor.withValues(alpha: .06),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        side: BorderSide(color: stateColor.withValues(alpha: .3)),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              'Cuota ${i['number']} Â· ${!current
                  ? 'HistÃ³rica'
                  : p.settled
                  ? 'Cubierta'
                  : 'Pendiente'}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 17),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
              'Vence: ${shortStatementDate(i['due_date'])}',
              style: TextStyle(color: stateColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
            ),
            Text('Programado: ${money(moneyCents(i['amount']))}'),
            Text('Abonos vinculados: ${money(p.paid)}'),
            Text(
              'Pendiente: ${money(p.remaining)}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            if ((i['notes']?.toString() ?? '').isNotEmpty)
              Text('${i['notes']}'),
            if (current)
              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 6,
                children: [
                  if (!p.settled && p.remaining != null && active)
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: saving ? null : () => pay(i),
                      child: const Text('Registrar abono'),
                    ),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: saving ? null : () => link(i),
                    child: const Text('Vincular abono'),
                  ),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: saving ? null : () => configure(i),
                    child: const Text('Editar cuota'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            if (links.isNotEmpty)
              ExpansionTile(
                tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: const Text('Abonos vinculados'),
                children: links.map((l) {
                  final values = data!.payments.where(
                    (p) => '${p['id']}' == '${l['payment_id']}',
                  );
                  final tx = values.isEmpty ? null : values.first;
                  return ListTile(
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    title: Text(
                      tx == null
                          ? 'Abono no disponible'
                          : money(debtPaymentTotalCents(tx)),
                    ),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      tx?['is_voided'] == true
                          ? 'Anulado'
                          : shortStatementDate(tx?['payment_date']),
                    ),
                    leading: tx == null
                        ? null
                        : MovementReceiptsButton(
                            table: 'debt_payments',
                            record: tx,
                            iconOnly: true,
                          ),
                    trailing: IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Quitar vÃ­nculo',
                      onPressed: saving
                          ? null
                          : () => unlink('${l['payment_id']}'),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.link_off),
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final rows =
        data?.installments
            .where(
              (i) =>
                  '${i['debt_id']}' == debtId &&
                  (history ||
                      (i['is_archived'] != true && i['is_voided'] != true)),
            )
            .toList() ??
        <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    rows.sort((a, b) => '${a['due_date']}'.compareTo('${b['due_date']}'));
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Cuotas del prÃ©stamo'),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Actualizar',
            onPressed: loading || saving ? null : load,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 800),
            child: loading
                ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                : error != null
                ? ListView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    children: [
                      Text(error!),
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: load,
                        child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  )
                : RefreshIndicator(
                    onRefresh: load,
                    child: ListView(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          '${debt['description']}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            fontSize: 21,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        const Text(
                          'El calendario contiene pagos esperados, no deuda adicional. Cada abono conserva su desglose real de capital, intereses y comisiones.',
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        FilledButton.icon(
                          onPressed:
                              saving ||
                                  ![
                                    'active',
                                    'overdue',
                                  ].contains(debt['status'])
                              ? null
                              : () => configure(),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                          label: const Text('Configurar cuotas mensuales'),
                        ),
                        CollapsibleFilters(
                          children: [
                            SwitchListTile(
                              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                              title: const Text(
                                'Mostrar calendarios anteriores',
                              ),
                              value: history,
                              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => history = v),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        if (rows.isEmpty)
                          const Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                            child: Text('TodavÃ­a no hay cuotas configuradas.'),
                          ),
                        ...rows.map(installmentCard),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: saving ? null : archive,
                          child: const Text('Archivar calendario vigente'),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'Un abono se vincula completo a una cuota. Vincularlo no descuenta dinero otra vez. Si se anula, deja de cubrirla. '
                          'Si liquidaste el prÃ©stamo anticipadamente, revisa y archiva las cuotas futuras que ya no correspondan.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: appMuted),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/card_statement_logic.dart';

class DebtInstallmentPlanDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const DebtInstallmentPlanDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.currency,
    this.installment,
    this.onSaveEdit,
  });
  final String currency;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? installment;
  final Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic>)? onSaveEdit;
  @override
  State<DebtInstallmentPlanDialog> createState() =>
      _DebtInstallmentPlanDialogState();
}

class _DebtInstallmentPlanDialogState extends State<DebtInstallmentPlanDialog> {
  final keyForm = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final amount = TextEditingController(),
      count = TextEditingController(),
      day = TextEditingController(),
      last = TextEditingController(),
      notes = TextEditingController();
  DateTime first = DateTime.now();
  bool saving = false;
  String? saveError;
  bool get editing => widget.installment != null;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    day.text = '${first.day}';
    final i = widget.installment;
    if (i != null) {
      final text = '${i['amount']}';
      amount.value = TextEditingValue(
        text: text,
        selection: TextSelection(baseOffset: 0, extentOffset: text.length),
      );
      first = statementDate(i['due_date'])!;
      notes.text = i['notes']?.toString() ?? '';
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in [amount, count, day, last, notes]) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  String? valid(String? v, {bool optional = false}) {
    final s = (v ?? '').trim();
    if (optional && s.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    final n = double.tryParse(s.replaceAll(',', '.'));
    return !RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(s) ||
            n == null ||
            !n.isFinite ||
            n <= 0 ||
            n > 999999999999.99
        ? 'Monto positivo, mÃ¡ximo seis decimales, sin separadores de miles.'
        : null;
  }

  Future<void> save() async {
    if (saving || !keyForm.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    final values = <String, dynamic>{
      'amount': double.parse(amount.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')),
      'first_due':
          '${first.year}-${first.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${first.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
      'count': int.tryParse(count.text.trim()),
      'day': int.tryParse(day.text.trim()),
      'last': last.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : double.parse(last.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')),
      'notes': notes.text.trim(),
    };
    final onSaveEdit = widget.onSaveEdit;
    if (onSaveEdit != null) {
      setState(() {
        saving = true;
        saveError = null;
      });
      try {
        await onSaveEdit(values);
      } catch (error) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            saving = false;
            saveError = 'No se pudo guardar la cuota. $error';
          });
        }
        return;
      }
    }
    if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, values);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => PopScope(
    canPop: !saving,
    child: AlertDialog(
      title: Text(editing ? 'Editar cuota' : 'Configurar cuotas mensuales'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 460,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: keyForm,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Usa el monto y las fechas acordados con el banco o acreedor. El calendario no agrega deuda ni calcula intereses.',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: amount,
                  autofocus: editing,
                  enabled: !saving,
                  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                    decimal: true,
                  ),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Monto de cuota Â· ${widget.currency}',
                  ),
                  validator: (v) => valid(v),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                  label: Text(
                    '${editing ? 'Vencimiento' : 'Primera cuota pendiente'}: ${shortStatementDate(first.toIso8601String())}',
                  ),
                  onPressed: saving
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          final d = await showDatePicker(
                            context: context,
                            initialDate: first,
                            firstDate: DateTime(2000),
                            lastDate: DateTime(2100),
                          );
                          if (d != null && mounted) {
                            setState(() {
                              first = d;
                              if (!editing) {
                                day.text = '${d.day}';
                              }
                            });
                          }
                        },
                ),
                if (!editing) ...[
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: count,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Cantidad de cuotas pendientes',
                    ),
                    validator: (v) {
                      final n = int.tryParse((v ?? '').trim());
                      return n == null || n < 1 || n > 600
                          ? 'Indica entre 1 y 600.'
                          : null;
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: day,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'DÃ­a habitual mensual',
                      helperText:
                          'Si no existe ese dÃ­a, se usa el Ãºltimo dÃ­a del mes.',
                      helperMaxLines: 2,
                    ),
                    validator: (v) {
                      final n = int.tryParse((v ?? '').trim());
                      return n == null || n < 1 || n > 31
                          ? 'DÃ­a del 1 al 31.'
                          : null;
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: last,
                    keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                      decimal: true,
                    ),
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Ãšltima cuota, si es diferente (opcional)',
                    ),
                    validator: (v) => valid(v, optional: true),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    'El nuevo calendario reemplaza al vigente y conserva el anterior con sus pagos en el historial. '
                    'La primera fecha se respeta exactamente; el dÃ­a habitual se usa desde la segunda cuota.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: appMuted),
                  ),
                ] else ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: notes,
                    enabled: !saving,
                    maxLines: 2,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Notas'),
                  ),
                ],
                if (saveError != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    saveError!,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [

          onPressed: saving ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context),

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\debts\debt_payments_page.dart
