import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../person_accounts/receipt_history.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../person_accounts/person_receipts_dialog.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../../widgets/void_payment_dialog.dart';

class DebtPaymentsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const DebtPaymentsPage({super.key, required this.debtId});
  final String debtId;
  @override
  State<DebtPaymentsPage> createState() => _DebtPaymentsPageState();
}

class _DebtPaymentsPageState extends State<DebtPaymentsPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> payments = [];
  String description = '', currency = 'NIO';
  int original = 0, principal = 0, interest = 0, fees = 0, insurance = 0;
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;
  bool saving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    loadData();
  }

  String money(int cents) => formatMoneyCents(cents, currency);

  ReceiptFilter receiptFilter = ReceiptFilter.all;
  Map<String, int>? receiptCounts;
  int receiptRequest = 0;

  int countFor(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
      receiptCounts?['debt_payments/${row['id']}'] ?? 0;

  Future<void> refreshReceiptCounts() async {
    final request = ++receiptRequest;
    final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    try {
      final counts = await loadReceiptCounts(
        uid,
        'movement-receipts',
        payments.map((row) => 'debt_payments/${row['id']}'),
      );
      if (mounted && request == receiptRequest)
        setState(() => receiptCounts = counts);
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted && request == receiptRequest)
        setState(() => receiptCounts = null);
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) throw Exception('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      final debt = await supabase
          .from('debts')
          .select('description, currency, original_amount')
          .eq('id', widget.debtId)
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .single();
      final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('debt_payments')
            .select(
              'id, principal_amount, interest_amount, fee_amount, insurance_amount, currency, payment_date, reference, linked_transaction_id, is_voided, void_reason, voided_at',
            )
            .eq('debt_id', widget.debtId)
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .order('payment_date', ascending: false)
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        rows.addAll(page);
        if (page.length < 500) break;
      }
      int capital = 0, interests = 0, commissions = 0;
      for (final payment in rows) {
        if (payment['is_voided'] == true) continue;
        if (payment['currency'] != debt['currency']) {
          throw StateError('Hay un abono con moneda diferente a la deuda.');
        }
        capital += moneyCents(payment['principal_amount']);
        interests += moneyCents(payment['interest_amount']);
        commissions += moneyCents(payment['fee_amount']);
      }
      final originalAmount = moneyCents(debt['original_amount']);
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) return;
      setState(() {
        description = debt['description'].toString();
        currency = debt['currency'].toString();
        original = originalAmount;
        payments = rows;
        principal = capital;
        interest = interests;
        fees = commissions;
        insurance = rows
            .where((p) => p['is_voided'] != true)
            .fold<int>(
              0,
              (total, p) => total + moneyCents(p['insurance_amount'] ?? 0),
            );
        loading = false;
      });
      await refreshReceiptCounts();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> voidPayment(Map<String, dynamic> payment) async {
    if (loading || saving || payment['is_voided'] == true) return;
    final reason = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => const VoidPaymentDialog(),
    );
    if (reason == null || !mounted || loading || saving) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await supabase.rpc(
        'void_debt_payment',
        params: {
          'p_debt_id': widget.debtId,
          'p_payment_id': payment['id'],
          'p_reason': reason,
        },
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Abono anulado.')));
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo anular: ${e.message}')),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo anular: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Widget amountRow(String label, int amount, {bool bold = false}) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 3),
    child: Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(child: Text(label)),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Flexible(
          child: Text(
            money(amount),
            textAlign: TextAlign.right,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontWeight: bold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  Widget paymentCard(Map<String, dynamic> payment) {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse('${payment['payment_date']}')?.toLocal();
    final dateText = date == null
        ? 'Fecha no disponible'
        : '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';
    final capital = moneyCents(payment['principal_amount']);
    final interests = moneyCents(payment['interest_amount']);
    final commissions = moneyCents(payment['fee_amount']);
    final reference = payment['reference']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final voided = payment['is_voided'] == true;

    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(dateText, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
            if (voided) ...[
              Text(
                'Abono anulado',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
              ),
              Text('Motivo: ${payment['void_reason'] ?? 'No especificado'}'),
              const Text('Sin efecto en los saldos ni en los totales.'),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            amountRow('Capital', capital),
            amountRow('Intereses', interests),
            amountRow('Seguro', moneyCents(payment['insurance_amount'] ?? 0)),
            amountRow(
              'Otros cargos y comisiones',
              commissions - moneyCents(payment['insurance_amount'] ?? 0),
            ),
            const Divider(),
            amountRow(
              'Total del abono',
              capital + interests + commissions,
              bold: true,
            ),
            if (reference.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              SelectableText('Referencia: $reference'),
            ],

            MovementReceiptsButton(
              table: 'debt_payments',
              record: payment,
              count: countFor(payment),
              onClosed: refreshReceiptCounts,
            ),
            if (payment['linked_transaction_id'] != null) ...[
              const Text('Movimiento existente asociado'),
              MovementReceiptsButton(
                table: 'transactions',
                record: {'id': payment['linked_transaction_id']},
              ),
            ],
            if (!voided)
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                child: TextButton.icon(
                  onPressed: saving ? null : () => voidPayment(payment),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.cancel_outlined),
                  label: const Text('Anular abono'),
                  style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                    foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(
      title: const Text('Historial de abonos'),
      actions: [
        IconButton(
          tooltip: 'Actualizar',
          onPressed: loading || saving ? null : loadData,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    body: PageFrame(
      maxWidth: 960,
      child: loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : error != null
          ? Center(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Text('No se pudo cargar el historial.'),
                    SelectableText(error!),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: loadData,
                      child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            )
          : RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: loadData,
              child: ListView(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                children: [
                  Text(
                    description,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Card(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          amountRow('Capital original', original),
                          amountRow('Capital abonado', principal),
                          amountRow(
                            'Capital pendiente',
                            original - principal,
                            bold: true,
                          ),
                          const Divider(),
                          amountRow('Intereses pagados', interest),
                          amountRow('Seguro pagado', insurance),
                          amountRow(
                            'Otros cargos y comisiones',
                            fees - insurance,
                          ),
                          amountRow(
                            'Total pagado',
                            principal + interest + fees,
                            bold: true,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                    child: Text(
                      'El capital pendiente no incluye intereses ni comisiones por pagar.',
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text('${payments.length} abonos registrados'),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  if (payments.isEmpty)
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      child: Text(
                        'Esta deuda todavÃ­a no tiene abonos.',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    ),
                  if (receiptCounts != null)
                    CollapsibleFilters(
                      children: [
                        ReceiptFilterField(
                          value: receiptFilter,
                          onChanged: (value) =>
                              setState(() => receiptFilter = value),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ...payments
                      .where(
                        (p) =>
                            receiptCounts == null ||
                            receiptFilter.matches(countFor(p)),
                      )
                      .map(paymentCard),
                ],
              ),
            ),
    ),
  );
}

class DebtPaymentDialog extends StatefulWidget {

  });
  final String currency;
  final int remainingCents;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts, expenses;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> installments;
  final String? initialInstallmentId;
  final int? expectedTotalCents;

  @override
  State<DebtPaymentDialog> createState() => _DebtPaymentDialogState();
}

class _DebtPaymentDialogState extends State<DebtPaymentDialog> {
  final _receipt = ReceiptDraft();
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final principal = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final interest = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final insurance = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final fee = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final reference = TextEditingController();
  DateTime date = DateTime.now();
  String? error;
  String? accountId, installmentId;
  Map<String, dynamic>? expense;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    installmentId =
        widget.initialInstallmentId ??
        (widget.installments.isEmpty
            ? null
            : '${widget.installments.first['id']}');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    principal.dispose();
    interest.dispose();
    fee.dispose();
    insurance.dispose();
    reference.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int cents(TextEditingController controller) =>
      (double.parse(controller.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')) * moneyScale)
          .round();

  Widget amountField(
    String label,
    TextEditingController controller, {
    bool capital = false,
  }) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
    child: TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
      decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: label),
      onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
      validator: (value) {
        final text = (value ?? '').trim();
        final amount = double.tryParse(text.replaceAll(',', '.'));
        if (amount == null || !amount.isFinite || amount < 0)
          return 'Introduce un monto vÃ¡lido';
        if (!RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text))
          return 'Usa mÃ¡ximo seis decimales, sin separadores de miles';
        if (capital && (amount * moneyScale).round() > widget.remainingCents)
          return 'Supera el capital pendiente';
        return null;
      },
    ),
  );

  void save() {
    if (_receipt.picking) return;
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final capital = cents(principal),
        interests = cents(interest),
        fees = cents(fee),
        insured = cents(insurance);
    if (capital + interests + fees + insured <= 0) {
      setState(() => error = 'El abono total debe ser mayor que cero.');
      return;
    }
    if (expense != null &&
        capital + interests + fees + insured !=
            moneyCents(expense!['amount'])) {
      setState(
        () => error = 'El total debe coincidir con el movimiento asociado.',
      );
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      ..._receipt.fields,
      'principal_amount': capital / moneyScale,
      'interest_amount': interests / moneyScale,
      'insurance_amount': insured / moneyScale,
      'fee_amount': fees / moneyScale,
      'payment_date': DateTime(
        date.year,
        date.month,
        date.day,
        12,
      ).toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'reference': reference.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : reference.text.trim(),
      'account_id': accountId,
      'transaction_id': expense?['id'],
      'installment_id': installmentId,
    });
  }

  @override

    final symbol = widget.currency == 'USD' ? '\$' : 'C\$';
    return AlertDialog(

              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                if (widget.expenses.isNotEmpty)
                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    initialValue: '',
                    isExpanded: true,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Movimiento asociado',
                    ),
                    items: [
                      const DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: '',
                        child: Text('Registrar nuevo dÃ©bito'),
                      ),
                      for (final row in widget.expenses)
                        DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: '${row['id']}',
                          child: Text(
                            "${shortStatementDate(row['transaction_date'])} Â· "
                            "${formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(row['amount']), widget.currency)} Â· "
                            "${row['description'] ?? 'Gasto'}",
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                    onChanged: (id) => setState(() {
                      expense = widget.expenses
                          .where((row) => '${row['id']}' == id)
                          .firstOrNull;
                      error = null;
                    }),
                  ),
                if (widget.expenses.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 12),
                if (expense == null)
                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    initialValue: accountId,
                    isExpanded: true,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Cuenta de origen',
                    ),
                    items: widget.accounts
                        .map(
                          (a) => DropdownMenuItem(
                            value: a['id'].toString(),

                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            ),
                          ),

                        .toList(),
                    onChanged: (value) => setState(() => accountId = value),
                    validator: (value) =>

                const SizedBox(height: 12),

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\debts\loan_schedule.dart

import 'dart:math' as math;

class LoanInstallment {
  const LoanInstallment(
    this.number,
    this.date,
    this.principal,
    this.interest,
    this.balance,
  );
  final int number, principal, interest, balance;
  final DateTime date;
  int get total => principal + interest;
}

List<LoanInstallment> buildLoanSchedule({
  required int principalCents,
  required int months,
  required double annualRate,
  required String method,
  required DateTime firstDue,
}) {
  if (principalCents <= 0 || months < 1 || months > 600) {
    throw const FormatException(
      'Introduce capital positivo y un plazo de 1 a 600 meses.',
    );
  }
  if (months > principalCents) {
    throw const FormatException(
      'Reduce el plazo para distribuir el capital en centavos.',
    );
  }
  if (!annualRate.isFinite ||
      annualRate < 0 ||
      !['none', 'flat', 'reducing_balance'].contains(method)) {
    throw const FormatException('La tasa o el mÃ©todo no son vÃ¡lidos.');
  }
  final rate = method == 'none' ? 0.0 : annualRate / 1200;
  final flatInterest = principalCents * rate;
  if (!flatInterest.isFinite)
    throw const FormatException('La tasa es demasiado grande.');
  final rawPayment = method != 'reducing_balance'
      ? 0.0
      : rate == 0
      ? principalCents / months
      : principalCents * rate / (1 - math.pow(1 + rate, -months));
  if (!rawPayment.isFinite)
    throw const FormatException('No se pudo calcular la cuota.');
  final fixedPayment = rawPayment.round();
  final rows = <LoanInstallment>[];
  int balance = principalCents;

  for (var i = 0; i < months && balance > 0; i++) {
    final interest = method == 'none'
        ? 0
        : method == 'flat'
        ? flatInterest.round()
        : (balance * rate).round();
    final capital = method == 'reducing_balance'
        ? i == months - 1
              ? balance
              : (fixedPayment - interest).clamp(0, balance).toInt()
        : principalCents ~/ months + (i < principalCents % months ? 1 : 0);
    if (capital <= 0) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'La cuota redondeada no amortiza capital. Reduce el plazo o revisa la tasa.',
      );
    }
    balance -= capital;
    final month = DateTime(firstDue.year, firstDue.month + i);
    final lastDay = DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1, 0).day;
    final due = DateTime(
      month.year,
      month.month,
      math.min(firstDue.day, lastDay),
    );
    rows.add(LoanInstallment(i + 1, due, capital, interest, balance));
  }
  return rows;
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\debts\loan_simulator_dialog.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'loan_schedule.dart';

class LoanSimulatorDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoanSimulatorDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.principalCents,
    required this.currency,
  });
  final int principalCents;
  final String currency;
  @override
  State<LoanSimulatorDialog> createState() => _LoanSimulatorDialogState();
}

class _LoanSimulatorDialogState extends State<LoanSimulatorDialog> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final rate = TextEditingController(text: '0'),
      months = TextEditingController(text: '12');
  String method = 'reducing_balance';
  DateTime firstDue = DateTime(
    DateTime.now().year,
    DateTime.now().month + 1,
    1,
  );
  List<LoanInstallment> schedule = [];
  String? error;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    rate.dispose();
    months.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String money(int cents) => formatMoneyCents(cents, widget.currency);
  String dateText(DateTime date) =>
      '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';
  void clearResult() => setState(() {
    schedule = [];
    error = null;
  });

  void calculate() {
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    try {
      final result = buildLoanSchedule(
        principalCents: widget.principalCents,
        months: int.parse(months.text.trim()),
        annualRate: method == 'none'
            ? 0
            : double.parse(rate.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')),
        method: method,
        firstDue: firstDue,
      );
      setState(() {
        schedule = result;
        error = null;
      });
    } on FormatException catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        schedule = [];
        error = e.message;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final interest = schedule.fold<int>(0, (sum, row) => sum + row.interest);
    return AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('Simular cuotas'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 620,
        height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.7,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: formKey,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text('Capital a simular: ${money(widget.principalCents)}'),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: method,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Modelo estimado',
                  ),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'reducing_balance',
                      child: Text('Cuota fija sobre saldo'),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'flat',
                      child: Text('InterÃ©s sobre capital inicial'),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'none',
                      child: Text('Sin intereses'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    if (value != null)
                      setState(() {
                        method = value;
                        schedule = [];
                        error = null;
                      });
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: rate,
                  enabled: method != 'none',
                  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                    decimal: true,
                  ),
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Tasa nominal anual (%)',
                  ),
                  onChanged: (_) => clearResult(),
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (method == 'none') return null;
                    final text = (value ?? '').trim();
                    final number = double.tryParse(text.replaceAll(',', '.'));
                    if (number == null || !number.isFinite || number < 0)
                      return 'Introduce una tasa vÃ¡lida';
                    if (!RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,4})?$').hasMatch(text))
                      return 'Usa mÃ¡ximo cuatro decimales';
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: months,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Meses a simular',
                  ),
                  onChanged: (_) => clearResult(),
                  validator: (value) {
                    final number = int.tryParse((value ?? '').trim());
                    return number == null || number < 1 || number > 600
                        ? 'Introduce de 1 a 600 meses'
                        : null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                  label: Text('Primera cuota: ${dateText(firstDue)}'),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final now = DateTime.now();
                    final selected = await showDatePicker(
                      context: context,
                      initialDate: firstDue,
                      firstDate: DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day),
                      lastDate: DateTime(now.year + 50, 12, 31),
                    );
                    if (selected != null && mounted) {
                      setState(() {
                        firstDue = selected;
                        schedule = [];
                        error = null;
                      });
                    }
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                const Text(
                  'EstimaciÃ³n desde el capital pendiente. No incluye intereses ya vencidos, seguros, comisiones ni mora. En el modelo flat, el interÃ©s usa el capital inicial de esta simulaciÃ³n.',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: calculate,
                  child: const Text('Calcular'),
                ),
                if (error != null)
                  Text(
                    error!,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                    ),
                  ),
                if (schedule.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const Divider(height: 24),
                  Text('Intereses estimados: ${money(interest)}'),
                  Text(
                    'Total estimado: ${money(widget.principalCents + interest)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  ...schedule.map(
                    (row) => Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Cuota ${row.number} Â· ${dateText(row.date)} Â· ${money(row.total)}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                          ),
                          Text(
                            'Capital: ${money(row.principal)} Â· Intereses: ${money(row.interest)}',
                          ),
                          Text('Capital restante: ${money(row.balance)}'),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cerrar'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class AppHelpButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppHelpButton({super.key, required this.topic});
  final String topic;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scope = GuideScope.maybeOf(context);
    return GuideAnchor(
      id: 'help',
      child: IconButton(
        tooltip: 'Ayuda y guÃ­a interactiva',
        icon: const Icon(Icons.help_outline),
        onPressed: () async {
          final action = await showModalBottomSheet<String>(
            context: context,
            builder: (ctx) => SafeArea(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                primary: false,
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    if (scope != null)
                      ListTile(
                        leading: const Icon(Icons.explore_outlined),
                        title: const Text('GuÃ­a interactiva'),
                        subtitle: const Text(
                          'Continuar el recorrido paso a paso',
                        ),
                        onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'guide'),
                      ),
                    if (scope != null)
                      ListTile(
                        leading: const Icon(Icons.replay),
                        title: const Text('Repetir guÃ­a desde el inicio'),
                        onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'restart'),
                      ),
                    ListTile(
                      leading: const Icon(Icons.science_outlined),
                      title: const Text('Practicar con un movimiento'),
                      subtitle: const Text('Crea y edita un ejemplo'),
                      onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'practice'),
                    ),
                    ListTile(
                      leading: const Icon(Icons.help_outline),
                      title: const Text('Leer ayuda de esta pantalla'),
                      onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'read'),
                    ),
                    ListTile(
                      leading: const Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined),
                      title: const Text('Manual y todas las guÃ­as'),
                      onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'manual'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
          if (!context.mounted) return;
          if (action == 'guide' || action == 'restart') {
            await scope?.start(restart: action == 'restart');
          }
          if (action == 'practice') {
            await Navigator.push<void>(
              context,
              MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                builder: (_) => const MovementPracticePage(),
              ),
            );
          }
          if (action == 'manual')
            Navigator.push(
              context,
              MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                builder: (_) => AppManualPage(initialTopic: topic),
              ),
            );
          if (action == 'read') {
            final item = appHelp[topic] ?? appHelp['start']!;
            await showDialog<void>(
              context: context,
              builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
                title: Text(item.$1),
                content: SizedBox(
                  width: 520,
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    child: SelectableText(
                      item.$2,
                      key: PageStorageKey('help-dialog-text-$topic'),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                actions: [
                  FilledButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                    child: const Text('Entendido'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../accounts/accounts_page.dart';
import '../transactions/transactions_page.dart';
import '../credit_cards/credit_cards_page.dart';
import '../person_accounts/person_accounts_page.dart';
import '../reports/export_reports_page.dart';
import '../debts/debts_page.dart';
import '../receivable_loans/receivable_loans_page.dart';
import '../budgets/budgets_page.dart';
import '../settings/settings_page.dart';
import 'interactive_guide.dart';

bool hasGuideDestination(String topic) => const {
  'accounts',
  'movements',
  'cards',
  'people',
  'reports',
  'debts',
  'receivables',
  'budgets',
  'settings',
}.contains(topic);
Future<void> openGuideDestination(BuildContext context, String topic) async {
  final Widget page = switch (topic) {
    'accounts' => const AccountsPage(),
    'movements' => const TransactionsPage(),
    'cards' => const CreditCardsPage(),
    'people' => const PersonAccountsPage(),
    'reports' => const ExportReportsPage(),
    'debts' => const DebtsPage(),
    'receivables' => const ReceivableLoansPage(),
    'budgets' => const BudgetsPage(),
    'settings' => const SettingsPage(),
    _ => const CreditCardsPage(),
  };
  await Navigator.push<void>(
    context,
    MaterialPageRoute<void>(
      builder: (_) => GuideLaunch(topic: topic, child: page),
    ),
  );
}

// ==========================================
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

/// Preferencias locales aisladas por usuario y versiÃ³n del recorrido.
class GuideProgress {
  GuideProgress(this.userId);
  final String userId;
  String get _prefix => 'mi_billete.guide.v1.$userId';
  static final Map<String, Object> _memory = {};

  Future<Object?> _read(String key) async {
    try {
      return (await SharedPreferences.getInstance()).get(key) ?? _memory[key];
    } catch (_) {
      return _memory[key];
    }
  }

  Future<void> _write(String key, Object value) async {
    _memory[key] = value;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (value is bool) {
        await prefs.setBool(key, value);
      }
      if (value is String) {
        await prefs.setString(key, value);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      /* La guÃ­a continÃºa si el dispositivo bloquea preferencias. */
    }
  }

  Future<bool> get welcomeSeen async => await _read('$_prefix.welcome') == true;
  Future<void> markWelcome() => _write('$_prefix.welcome', true);
  Future<bool> completed(String topic) async =>
      await _read('$_prefix.$topic.done') == true;
  Future<String?> resumeAt(String topic) async {
    final value = await _read('$_prefix.$topic.step');
    return value is String ? value : null;
  }

  Future<void> saveStep(String topic, String step) =>
      _write('$_prefix.$topic.step', step);
  Future<void> complete(String topic) => _write('$_prefix.$topic.done', true);
  Future<void> restart(String topic) async {
    await _write('$_prefix.$topic.done', false);
    await _write('$_prefix.$topic.step', '');
  }
}

String guideUserId() {
  try {
    return supabase.auth.currentUser?.id ?? 'guest';
  } catch (_) {
    return 'guest';
  }
}

/// Permite abrir una pantalla desde el manual y comenzar cuando haya cargado.
class GuideLaunch extends InheritedWidget {
  const GuideLaunch({super.key, required this.topic, required super.child});
  final String topic;
  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(GuideLaunch oldWidget) => topic != oldWidget.topic;
}

class GuideScope extends StatefulWidget {
  const GuideScope({
    super.key,
    required this.topic,
    required this.child,
    this.ready = true,
    this.welcome = false,
    this.scrollController,
    this.excludedTargets = const {},
    this.userId,
  });
  final String topic;
  final Widget child;
  final bool ready, welcome;
  final ScrollController? scrollController;
  final Set<String> excludedTargets;
  final String? userId;
  static GuideScopeState? maybeOf(BuildContext context) =>
      context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<_GuideHost>()?.state;
  @override
  State<GuideScope> createState() => GuideScopeState();
}

enum _GuideResult { completed, practice }

class GuideScopeState extends State<GuideScope> {
  final _ownScroll = ScrollController();
  final Map<String, GlobalKey> _targets = {};
  bool _running = false, _offered = false, _launched = false;
  VoidCallback? _dismiss;
  bool get available => widget.ready && guideCatalog.containsKey(widget.topic);
  String get topic => widget.topic;
  String get userId => widget.userId ?? guideUserId();
  ScrollController get scroll => widget.scrollController ?? _ownScroll;
  List<GuideStep> get steps => (guideCatalog[topic] ?? const <GuideStep>[])
      .where((s) => !widget.excludedTargets.contains(s.target))
      .toList();

  void register(String id, GlobalKey key) => _targets[id] = key;
  void unregister(String id, GlobalKey key) {
    if (_targets[id] == key) _targets.remove(id);
  }

  BuildContext? targetContext(String id) => _targets[id]?.currentContext;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    _schedule();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(GuideScope oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    _schedule();
  }

  void _schedule() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) async {
      if (!mounted || !available || ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent != true)
        return;
      final launch = context.getInheritedWidgetOfExactType<GuideLaunch>();
      if (!_launched && launch?.topic == topic) {
        _launched = true;
        await start(restart: true);
      } else if (widget.welcome && !_offered && !_running) {
        _offered = true;
        await _welcome();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _welcome() async {
    final uid = userId, progress = GuideProgress(userId);
    if (await progress.welcomeSeen ||
        !mounted ||
        uid != userId ||
        ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent != true ||
        _running)
      return;
    await progress.markWelcome();
    if (!mounted || uid != userId || ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent != true)
      return;
    final begin = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Bienvenido a Mi Billete'),
        content: const Text(
          'Conoce tu app paso a paso. Resaltaremos los controles y explicaremos cada acciÃ³n. Puedes omitir la guÃ­a y volver desde el botÃ³n ?.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Ahora no'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Iniciar guÃ­a'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (begin == true && mounted && uid == userId) await start(restart: true);
  }

  Future<void> start({bool restart = false}) async {
    if (_running || !mounted) return;
    if (!available) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)?.showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Espera a que termine de cargar la pantalla.'),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    _running = true;
    final uid = userId, route = ModalRoute.of(context);
    final progress = GuideProgress(uid), catalog = steps;
    try {
      var index = 0;
      if (!restart && !await progress.completed(topic)) {
        final target = await progress.resumeAt(topic);
        final found = catalog.indexWhere((s) => s.target == target);
        if (found > 0) index = found;
      }
      if (restart) await progress.restart(topic);
      if (!mounted ||
          uid != userId ||
          route?.isCurrent != true ||
          catalog.isEmpty)
        return;
      FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
      final result = await showGeneralDialog<_GuideResult>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        barrierLabel: 'GuÃ­a interactiva',
        barrierColor: Colors.transparent,
        transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
        pageBuilder: (_, __, ___) => _GuideOverlay(
          owner: this,
          steps: catalog,
          initialIndex: index,
          progress: progress,
          userId: uid,
        ),
      );
      if (result != null) await progress.complete(topic);
      if (result == _GuideResult.practice &&
          mounted &&
          uid == userId &&
          route?.isCurrent == true) {
        await Navigator.push<void>(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => const MovementPracticePage()),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      _running = false;
      _dismiss = null;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    final dismiss = _dismiss;
    if (dismiss != null)
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => dismiss());
    _ownScroll.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _GuideHost(
    state: this,
    child: PrimaryScrollController(
      controller: scroll,
      automaticallyInheritForPlatforms: TargetPlatform.values.toSet(),
      child: widget.child,
    ),
  );
}

class _GuideHost extends InheritedWidget {
  const _GuideHost({required this.state, required super.child});
  final GuideScopeState state;
  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(_GuideHost oldWidget) => true;
}

/// No usa PageStorage: nunca mezcla el estado bool de una pestaÃ±a con offsets.
class GuideAnchor extends StatefulWidget {
  const GuideAnchor({super.key, required this.id, required this.child});
  final String id;
  final Widget child;
  @override
  State<GuideAnchor> createState() => _GuideAnchorState();
}

class _GuideAnchorState extends State<GuideAnchor> {
  final _key = GlobalKey();
  GuideScopeState? _owner;
  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final owner = GuideScope.maybeOf(context);
    if (owner != _owner) {
      _owner?.unregister(widget.id, _key);
      _owner = owner;
    }
    _owner?.register(widget.id, _key);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(GuideAnchor oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.id != oldWidget.id) _owner?.unregister(oldWidget.id, _key);
    _owner?.register(widget.id, _key);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _owner?.unregister(widget.id, _key);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      SizedBox(key: _key, child: widget.child);
}

class _GuideOverlay extends StatefulWidget {
  const _GuideOverlay({
    required this.owner,
    required this.steps,
    required this.initialIndex,
    required this.progress,
    required this.userId,
  });
  final GuideScopeState owner;
  final List<GuideStep> steps;
  final int initialIndex;
  final GuideProgress progress;
  final String userId;
  @override
  State<_GuideOverlay> createState() => _GuideOverlayState();
}

class _GuideOverlayState extends State<_GuideOverlay>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  late int _index;
  int _request = 0;
  Rect? _rect;
  bool _moving = true;
  bool get _valid =>
      mounted && widget.owner.mounted && widget.owner.userId == widget.userId;
  GuideStep get _step => widget.steps[_index];
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _index = widget.initialIndex;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    widget.owner._dismiss = _close;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _seek());
  }

  void _close() {
    if (mounted && ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == true)
      Navigator.pop(context);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeMetrics() => WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
    if (mounted) _seek();
  });
  Future<void> _seek() async {
    final request = ++_request;
    if (!_valid) {
      _close();
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _moving = true;
      _rect = null;
    });
    await widget.progress.saveStep(widget.owner.topic, _step.target);
    bool valid() => _valid && request == _request;
    var target = widget.owner.targetContext(_step.target);
    final scroll = widget.owner.scroll;
    // Los ListView construyen sus hijos al desplazarse. BÃºsqueda acotada,
    // con pasos de viewport; no supone que todos los controles estÃ©n montados.
    if (target == null && scroll.hasClients && scroll.positions.length == 1) {
      await scroll.animateTo(
        scroll.position.minScrollExtent,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
        curve: Curves.easeOut,
      );
      for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 18 && valid(); attempt++) {
        await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame;
        target = widget.owner.targetContext(_step.target);
        if (target != null ||
            scroll.position.pixels >= scroll.position.maxScrollExtent - 1)
          break;
        await scroll.animateTo(
          math.min(
            scroll.position.maxScrollExtent,
            scroll.position.pixels + scroll.position.viewportDimension * .65,
          ),
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 70),
          curve: Curves.easeOut,
        );
      }
    }
    if (!valid()) return;
    if (target != null && target.mounted) {
      try {
        await Scrollable.ensureVisible(
          target,
          alignment: .18,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
          curve: Curves.easeOut,
        );
        await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame;
        if (!valid()) return;
        final box = target.findRenderObject();
        if (box is RenderBox && box.hasSize && !box.size.isEmpty) {
          final offset = box.localToGlobal(Offset.zero);
          if (offset.dx.isFinite && offset.dy.isFinite)
            _rect = offset & box.size;
        }
      } catch (_) {
        /* Un control condicional puede desaparecer al reconstruir. */
      }
    }
    if (valid()) setState(() => _moving = false);
  }

  Future<void> _move(int delta) async {
    if (_moving || !_valid) return;
    final next = _index + delta;
    if (next >= widget.steps.length) {
      Navigator.pop(context, _GuideResult.completed);
      return;
    }
    if (next < 0) return;
    setState(() => _index = next);
    await _seek();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _request++;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final media = MediaQuery.of(context), size = media.size;
    final safeTop = media.padding.top + 12,
        safeBottom = media.padding.bottom + 12;
    final usable = math.max(100.0, size.height - safeTop - safeBottom);
    final bounds = Rect.fromLTRB(
      6,
      safeTop,
      size.width - 6,
      size.height - safeBottom,
    );
    final rect = _rect?.inflate(5).intersect(bounds);
    final highlight = rect != null && rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0
        ? rect
        : null;
    final above = highlight != null && highlight.center.dy > size.height * .5;
    return Shortcuts(
      shortcuts: const {
        SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.escape): DismissIntent(),
      },
      child: Actions(
        actions: {
          DismissIntent: CallbackAction<DismissIntent>(
            onInvoke: (_) {
              _close();
              return null;
            },
          ),
        },
        child: Focus(
          autofocus: true,
          child: Material(
            type: MaterialType.transparency,
            child: Stack(
              children: [
                Positioned.fill(
                  child: Semantics(
                    label:
                        'GuÃ­a activa. Las acciones de la pantalla estÃ¡n bloqueadas.',
                    child: CustomPaint(painter: _GuidePainter(highlight)),
                  ),
                ),
                Positioned(
                  left: math.max(12.0, (size.width - 440) / 2),
                  right: math.max(12.0, (size.width - 440) / 2),
                  top: above ? safeTop : null,
                  bottom: above ? null : safeBottom,
                  child: ConstrainedBox(
                    constraints: BoxConstraints(
                      maxHeight: math.min(360, usable * .6),
                    ),
                    child: Card(
                      elevation: 14,
                      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                      ),
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                        child: SingleChildScrollView(
                          primary: false,
                          key: ValueKey(_step.target),
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                            children: [
                              Row(
                                children: [
                                  Icon(
                                    Icons.explore_outlined,
                                    color: primaryColor,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Text(
                                      'Paso ${_index + 1} de ${widget.steps.length}',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  IconButton(
                                    tooltip: 'Omitir guÃ­a',
                                    onPressed: _close,
                                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                              LinearProgressIndicator(
                                value: (_index + 1) / widget.steps.length,
                                color: primaryColor,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
                              Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  Semantics(
                                    liveRegion: true,
                                    child: Text(
                                      _step.title,
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 20,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                  Text(_step.text),
                                  if (_moving)
                                    const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                                      child: LinearProgressIndicator(),
                                    ),
                                  if (!_moving && highlight == null)
                                    Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                                      child: Text(
                                        'Este control aparece cuando hay datos o al elegir esa opciÃ³n. Puedes continuar.',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 14,
                                          color: appMuted,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                              if (!_moving &&
                                  widget.owner.topic == 'movements' &&
                                  _index == widget.steps.length - 1)
                                OutlinedButton.icon(
                                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(
                                    context,
                                    _GuideResult.practice,
                                  ),
                                  icon: const Icon(Icons.science_outlined),
                                  label: const Text(
                                    'Practicar con un movimiento',
                                  ),
                                ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
                              Wrap(
                                alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
                                spacing: 6,
                                runSpacing: 6,
                                children: [
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: _moving || _index == 0
                                        ? null
                                        : () => _move(-1),
                                    child: const Text('Anterior'),
                                  ),
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: _close,
                                    child: const Text('Omitir'),
                                  ),
                                  FilledButton(
                                    onPressed: _moving ? null : () => _move(1),
                                    child: Text(
                                      _index == widget.steps.length - 1
                                          ? 'Finalizar'
                                          : 'Siguiente',
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _GuidePainter extends CustomPainter {
  _GuidePainter(this.target);
  final Rect? target;
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final path = Path()
      ..fillType = PathFillType.evenOdd
      ..addRect(Offset.zero & size);
    if (target != null)
      path.addRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(target!, const Radius.circular(12)),
      );
    canvas.drawPath(path, Paint()..color = const Color(0xB8001714));
    if (target != null)
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(target!, const Radius.circular(12)),
        Paint()
          ..color = const Color(0xFF64E5B6)
          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
          ..strokeWidth = 3,
      );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_GuidePainter oldDelegate) => oldDelegate.target != target;
}

                  'DespuÃ©s puedes editarlo y ver el cambio. '
                  'La simulaciÃ³n se descarta al salir de esta pantalla.',

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import 'note_text_controller.dart';

class NotesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const NotesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<NotesPage> createState() => _NotesPageState();
}

class _NotesPageState extends State<NotesPage> {
  final title = TextEditingController();
  final body = NoteTextController();
  final bodyFocus = FocusNode();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = [];
  bool loading = true, saving = false, editorOpen = false, pinned = false;
  String search = '', baseline = '', owner = '';
  String? selectedId, error;
  bool get dirty => editorOpen && snapshot() != baseline;
  String snapshot() =>
      jsonEncode([title.text, body.text, body.document.toJson(), pinned]);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    owner = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id ?? '';
    title.addListener(changed);
    body.addListener(changed);
    load();
  }

  void changed() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    title.dispose();
    body.dispose();
    bodyFocus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void checkSession() {
    if (owner.isEmpty || supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != owner) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Abre Notas nuevamente.');
    }
  }

  void message(String text) {
    if (mounted)
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      checkSession();
      final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 200) {
        final page = await supabase
            .from('personal_notes')
            .select()
            .eq('user_id', owner)
            .order('is_pinned', ascending: false)
            .order('updated_at', ascending: false)
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 199);
        result.addAll(List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(page));
        if (page.length < 200) break;
      }
      checkSession();
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          rows = result;
          loading = false;
        });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  Future<bool> keepChanges() async {
    if (!dirty) return true;
    final choice = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Cambios sin guardar'),
        content: const Text(
          'Guarda la nota antes de continuar o descarta los cambios.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'cancel'),
            child: const Text('Seguir editando'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'discard'),
            child: const Text('Descartar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, 'save'),
            child: const Text('Guardar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (!mounted) return false;
    if (choice == 'save') return save();
    return choice == 'discard';
  }

  Future<void> open([Map<String, dynamic>? note]) async {
    if (saving || !await keepChanges() || !mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      selectedId = note?['id']?.toString();
      title.text = '${note?['title'] ?? ''}';
      body.load('${note?['body'] ?? ''}', note?['body_format']);
      pinned = note?['is_pinned'] == true;
      editorOpen = true;
      baseline = snapshot();
    });
  }

  Future<bool> save() async {
    if (saving || !editorOpen) return false;
    if (title.text.length > 200 || body.text.length > 20000) {
      message('MÃ¡ximo 200 caracteres de tÃ­tulo y 20,000 de contenido.');
      return false;
    }
    final noteTitle = title.text.trim().isEmpty
        ? 'Nueva nota'
        : title.text.trim();
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      checkSession();
      final data = {
        'title': noteTitle,
        'body': body.text,
        'body_format': body.document.toJson(),
        'is_pinned': pinned,
      };
      final Map<String, dynamic> saved;
      if (selectedId == null) {
        saved = await supabase
            .from('personal_notes')
            .insert({...data, 'user_id': owner})
            .select()
            .single();
      } else {
        saved = await supabase
            .from('personal_notes')
            .update(data)
            .eq('id', selectedId!)
            .eq('user_id', owner)
            .select()
            .single();
      }
      checkSession();
      if (!mounted) return false;
      setState(() {
        selectedId = '${saved['id']}';
        title.text = noteTitle;
        rows.removeWhere((r) => '${r['id']}' == selectedId);
        rows.add(saved);
        rows.sort((a, b) {
          final pin = (b['is_pinned'] == true ? 1 : 0).compareTo(
            a['is_pinned'] == true ? 1 : 0,
          );
          return pin != 0
              ? pin
              : '${b['updated_at']}'.compareTo('${a['updated_at']}');
        });
        baseline = snapshot();
      });
      message('Nota guardada');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> remove() async {
    if (selectedId == null || saving) return;
    final yes = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Eliminar nota'),
        content: Text('Â¿Eliminar â€œ${title.text}â€?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Eliminar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (yes != true || !mounted) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      checkSession();
      await supabase
          .from('personal_notes')
          .delete()
          .eq('id', selectedId!)
          .eq('user_id', owner);
      checkSession();
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          rows.removeWhere((r) => '${r['id']}' == selectedId);
          editorOpen = false;
          selectedId = null;
          baseline = '';
        });
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo eliminar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/note_document.dart';

class NoteTextController extends TextEditingController {
  final document = NoteDocument();
  NoteStyle insertionStyle = const NoteStyle();
  bool _loading = false;
  void load(String text, Object? format) {
    _loading = true;
    document.load(text, format);
    insertionStyle = document.styles.isEmpty
        ? const NoteStyle()
        : document.styles.last;
    value = TextEditingValue(
      text: text,
      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: text.length),
    );
    _loading = false;
  }

  @override
  set value(TextEditingValue next) {
    if (!_loading) {
      if (next.text != text) {
        document.replace(
          next.text,
          insertionStyle,
          selectionStart: selection.isValid ? selection.start : null,
          selectionEnd: selection.isValid ? selection.end : null,
          caret: next.selection.isValid ? next.selection.start : null,
        );
      } else if (next.selection != selection &&
          next.selection.isValid &&
          document.styles.isNotEmpty) {
        final index = next.selection.isCollapsed
            ? next.selection.start - 1
            : next.selection.start;
        insertionStyle = index >= 0 && index < document.styles.length
            ? document.styles[index]
            : const NoteStyle();
      }
    }
    super.value = next;
  }

  NoteStyle get currentStyle {
    if (selection.isValid &&
        !selection.isCollapsed &&
        document.styles.isNotEmpty) {
      final i = selection.isCollapsed ? selection.start - 1 : selection.start;
      if (i >= 0 && i < document.styles.length) return document.styles[i];
    }
    return insertionStyle;
  }

  void apply(NoteStyle Function(NoteStyle) change) {
    insertionStyle = change(currentStyle);
    if (selection.isValid && !selection.isCollapsed) {
      document.format(selection.start, selection.end, change);
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  @override
  TextSpan buildTextSpan({
    required BuildContext context,
    TextStyle? style,
    required bool withComposing,
  }) {
    final spans = <TextSpan>[];
    for (var start = 0; start < text.length;) {
      final run = document.styles[start];
      final composing =
          withComposing &&
          value.composing.isValid &&
          start >= value.composing.start &&
          start < value.composing.end;
      var end = start + 1;
      while (end < text.length &&
          document.styles[end] == run &&
          (!withComposing ||
              !value.composing.isValid ||
              (end >= value.composing.start && end < value.composing.end) ==
                  composing)) {
        end++;
      }
      spans.add(
        TextSpan(
          text: text.substring(start, end),
          style: TextStyle(
            fontWeight: run.bold ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w400,
            color: run.color == null ? null : Color(run.color!),
            fontSize: run.size,
            decoration: composing ? TextDecoration.underline : null,
          ),
        ),
      );
      start = end;
    }
    return TextSpan(style: style, children: spans);
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:archive/archive.dart';
import 'package:excel/excel.dart' show CellIndex, Excel;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:xml/xml.dart';

class OfficeReceiptPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const OfficeReceiptPreview({
    super.key,
    required this.bytes,
    required this.extension,
  });

  final Uint8List bytes;
  final String extension;

  @override
  State<OfficeReceiptPreview> createState() => _OfficeReceiptPreviewState();
}

class _OfficeReceiptPreviewState extends State<OfficeReceiptPreview> {
  static const _maxRows = 200;
  static const _maxColumns = 30;
  String? _word;
  Excel? _excel;
  String? _sheet;
  bool _error = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    try {
      final archive = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(widget.bytes);
      final totalSize = archive.files.fold<int>(
        0,
        (size, file) => size + file.size,
      );
      if (totalSize > 32 * 1024 * 1024 || archive.files.length > 1000) {
        throw const FormatException('Documento demasiado grande.');
      }
      if (widget.extension == 'docx') {
        final file = archive.findFile('word/document.xml');
        if (file == null) throw const FormatException('Documento invÃ¡lido.');
        final document = XmlDocument.parse(
          utf8.decode(file.content as List<int>),
        );
        String paragraphText(XmlElement paragraph) => paragraph.descendants
            .whereType<XmlElement>()
            .where(
              (element) =>
                  const {'t', 'tab', 'br'}.contains(element.name.local),
            )
            .map(
              (element) => switch (element.name.local) {
                'tab' => '\t',
                'br' => '\n',
                _ => element.innerText,
              },
            )
            .join();

        final body = document.rootElement.childElements.firstWhere(
          (element) => element.name.local == 'body',
        );
        final lines = <String>[];
        for (final block in body.childElements) {
          if (block.name.local == 'p') {
            lines.add(paragraphText(block));
          } else if (block.name.local == 'tbl') {
            for (final row in block.childElements.where(
              (element) => element.name.local == 'tr',
            )) {
              lines.add(
                row.childElements
                    .where((element) => element.name.local == 'tc')
                    .map(
                      (cell) => cell.childElements
                          .where((element) => element.name.local == 'p')
                          .map(paragraphText)
                          .join(' '),
                    )
                    .join('  â”‚  '),
              );
            }
          }
        }
        final text = lines.join('\n');
        _word = text.length <= 100000
            ? text
            : '${text.substring(0, 100000)}\n\n[Vista previa recortada]';
      } else {
        _excel = Excel.decodeBytes(widget.bytes);
        _sheet = _excel!.tables.keys.firstOrNull;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      _error = true;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_error) {
      return const Center(
        child: Text(
          'No se pudo mostrar este documento. Puedes descargar el original.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (_word case final word?) {
      return Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          const Text(
            'Vista rÃ¡pida del texto. El original conserva el diseÃ±o y las imÃ¡genes.',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: SelectableText(
                word.trim().isEmpty ? 'No hay texto para mostrar.' : word,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }

    final tables = _excel!.tables;
    final sheet = tables[_sheet];
    if (sheet == null)
      return const Center(child: Text('No hay hojas para mostrar.'));
    final rowCount = sheet.maxRows.clamp(0, _maxRows).toInt();
    final columns = sheet.maxColumns.clamp(0, _maxColumns).toInt();
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        DropdownButton<String>(
          isExpanded: true,
          value: _sheet,
          items: [
            for (final name in tables.keys)
              DropdownMenuItem(
                value: name,
                child: Text(name, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
              ),
          ],
          onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _sheet = value),
        ),
        const Text(
          'Vista rÃ¡pida de celdas. Las fÃ³rmulas se muestran sin calcular.',
        ),
        if (sheet.maxRows > rowCount || sheet.maxColumns > columns)
          Text(
            'Se muestran hasta $_maxRows filas y $_maxColumns columnas por hoja.',
          ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Expanded(
          child: rowCount == 0 || columns == 0
              ? const Center(child: Text('La hoja estÃ¡ vacÃ­a.'))
              : SingleChildScrollView(
                  key: ValueKey(_sheet),
                  primary: false,
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: columns * 130.0 + 48,
                    child: ListView.builder(
                      primary: false,
                      itemCount: rowCount,
                      itemBuilder: (context, row) => Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          SizedBox(
                            width: 48,
                            child: Text(
                              '${row + 1}',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                            ),
                          ),
                          for (var column = 0; column < columns; column++)
                            Container(
                              width: 130,
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: SelectableText(
                                sheet
                                        .cell(
                                          CellIndex.indexByColumnRow(
                                            columnIndex: column,
                                            rowIndex: row,
                                          ),
                                        )
                                        .value
                                        ?.toString() ??
                                    '',
                              ),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/person_account_repository.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import 'person_account_detail_page.dart';
import 'person_account_form_dialog.dart';

class PersonAccountsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonAccountsPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<PersonAccountsPage> createState() => _PersonAccountsPageState();
}

class _PersonAccountsPageState extends State<PersonAccountsPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts = [], entries = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> shares = [];
  String? viewerId;
  bool sharedOnly = false;
  bool loading = true, saving = false, archived = false;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;
  final search = TextEditingController();
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void message(String s) {
    if (mounted)
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(s)));
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final req = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = personUserId();
      final rows = await Future.wait([
        personRows('person_accounts', uid, includeShared: true),
        personRows('person_account_entries', uid, includeShared: true),
        personShares(uid),
      ]);
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted || req != requestId) return;
      rows[0].sort(
        (a, b) => '${a['name']}'.toLowerCase().compareTo(
          '${b['name']}'.toLowerCase(),
        ),
      );
      setState(() {
        viewerId = uid;
        shares = rows[2];
        accounts = rows[0];
        entries = rows[1];
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && req == requestId)
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  bool owns(Map<String, dynamic> a) => a['user_id'] == viewerId;

  String accountName(Map<String, dynamic> a) => owns(a)
      ? '${a['name']}'
      : '${shares.where((s) => s['person_account_id'] == a['id']).firstOrNull?['owner_email'] ?? 'Titular de la cuenta'}';

  int balance(Map<String, dynamic> a) =>
      (owns(a) ? 1 : -1) *
      personAccountBalance(
        entries.where((e) => e['person_account_id'] == a['id']),
      );

  Future<void> respond(Map<String, dynamic> share, bool accept) async {
    if (saving || loading || viewerId == null) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      checkPersonSession(viewerId!);
      await supabase.rpc(
        'person_share_respond',
        params: {'p_share': share['id'], 'p_accept': accept},
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo responder a la invitaciÃ³n: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> create() async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final uid = personUserId();
      final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) => const PersonAccountFormDialog(),
      );
      if (data == null || !mounted) return;
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      final row = await supabase
          .from('person_accounts')
          .insert({...data, 'user_id': uid})
          .select()
          .single();
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted) return;
      await Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) =>
              PersonAccountDetailPage(account: Map<String, dynamic>.from(row)),
        ),
      );
      if (mounted) await load();
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo crear: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final compact = compactLayout(context);
    final gutter = pageGutter(context);
    final label = saving ? 'Guardando...' : 'Agregar persona';
    final VoidCallback? add = loading || saving || error != null
        ? null
        : create;
    final visible = accounts
        .where(
          (a) =>
              (archived || a['is_active'] == true) &&
              (!sharedOnly || !owns(a)) &&
              accountName(
                a,
              ).toLowerCase().contains(search.text.trim().toLowerCase()),
        )
        .toList();
    int payable = 0, receivable = 0;
    String? invalid;
    try {
      for (final a in accounts.where(
        (a) => a['is_active'] == true && (!sharedOnly || !owns(a)),
      )) {
        final b = balance(a);
        if (b > 0)
          payable += b;
        else
          receivable -= b;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      invalid = '$e';
    }
    return GuideScope(
      topic: 'people',
      ready: !loading && error == null,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: GuideAnchor(
            id: 'title',

          ),
