              tooltip: 'Actualizar',
              onPressed: loading || saving ? null : load,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        bottomNavigationBar: compact
            ? GuideAnchor(
                id: 'add',
                child: CompactActionBar(
                  label: label,

                  icon: Icons.person_add_alt_1,
                ),
              )
            : null,
        floatingActionButton: compact
            ? null
            : GuideAnchor(
                id: 'add',
                child: FloatingActionButton.extended(
                  onPressed: add,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.person_add_alt_1),
                  label: Text(label),
                ),
              ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 1160),
              child: loading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : error != null || invalid != null
                  ? ListView(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      children: [
                        const Text('No se pudieron cargar las cuentas.'),
                        SelectableText(error ?? invalid!),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: load,
                          child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    )
                  : RefreshIndicator(
                      onRefresh: load,
                      child: ListView(
                        physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                          gutter,
                          16,
                          gutter,
                          compact ? 24 : 110,
                        ),
                        children: [
                          for (final invite in shares.where(
                            (s) =>
                                s['member_id'] == null &&
                                !accounts.any(
                                  (a) =>
                                      a['id'] == s['person_account_id'] &&
                                      owns(a),
                                ),
                          ))
                            Card(
                              child: Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    Text(
                                      'InvitaciÃ³n de ${invite['owner_email']}',
                                    ),
                                    Wrap(
                                      spacing: 8,
                                      children: [
                                        FilledButton(
                                          onPressed: saving
                                              ? null
                                              : () => respond(invite, true),
                                          child: const Text('Aceptar'),
                                        ),
                                        TextButton(
                                          onPressed: saving
                                              ? null
                                              : () => respond(invite, false),
                                          child: const Text('Rechazar'),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          AdaptiveColumns(
                            minColumnWidth: 135,
                            children: [
                              _summary(
                                'TÃº debes',
                                payable,
                                Icons.north_east,
                                Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                              ),
                              _summary(
                                'Te deben',
                                receivable,
                                Icons.south_west,
                                const Color(0xFF397455),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          const Text(
                            'Totales de cuentas activas. No se suman a las deudas bancarias del dashboard.',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 18),
                          Text(
                            'Personas',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          CollapsibleFilters(
                            children: [
                              SwitchListTile(
                                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                                title: const Text('Solo compartidas conmigo'),
                                value: sharedOnly,
                                onChanged: (value) =>
                                    setState(() => sharedOnly = value),
                              ),
                              GuideAnchor(
                                id: 'filter',
                                child: TextField(
                                  controller: search,
                                  onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                    labelText: 'Buscar persona',
                                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              SwitchListTile(
                                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                                title: const Text('Mostrar archivadas'),
                                value: archived,
                                onChanged: (v) => setState(() => archived = v),
                              ),
                            ],

                            Padding(

                          if (visible.isNotEmpty)
                            AdaptiveColumns(

                                return Card(

                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),

                                        children: [
                                          CircleAvatar(
                                            child: Text(
                                              name.isEmpty

                                                  ),

                                                  const Text('Archivada'),
                                                Text(
                                                  '${personBalanceLabel(b)} Â· ${formatMoneyCents(b.abs(), 'NIO')}',
                                                  style: TextStyle(
                                                    color: color,
                                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,

                                                ),
                                              ],

                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              }).toList(),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _summary(String title, int cents, IconData icon, Color color) =>
      Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: color.withAlpha(20),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Icon(icon, color: color),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(title),
            Text(
              formatMoneyCents(cents, 'NIO'),
              style: TextStyle(
                color: color,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                fontSize: 21,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class PersonAccountDetailPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonAccountDetailPage({super.key, required this.account});
  final Map<String, dynamic> account;
  @override
  State<PersonAccountDetailPage> createState() =>
      _PersonAccountDetailPageState();
}

class _PersonAccountDetailPageState extends State<PersonAccountDetailPage> {
  late Map<String, dynamic> account;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> entries = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> closures = [];
  bool loading = true, saving = false, showVoided = false;
  String? error, viewerId;
  Map<String, dynamic>? access;
  bool get isOwner => viewerId != null && account['user_id'] == viewerId;
  bool get canAdd => isOwner || access?['can_add'] == true;
  String get otherName => isOwner
      ? '${account['name']}'
      : '${access?['owner_email'] ?? 'Titular de la cuenta'}';

  bool canEdit(Map<String, dynamic> entry) =>
      isOwner ||
      access?['can_edit_all'] == true ||
      (access?['can_edit_own'] == true && entry['created_by'] == viewerId);

  Map<String, dynamic> fromViewer(Map<String, dynamic> entry) => isOwner
      ? entry
      : {...entry, 'direction': -int.parse('${entry['direction']}')};

  String entryAuthor(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final author = row['created_by'] ?? row['user_id'];
    if (author == viewerId) return 'TÃº';
    if (author == account['user_id']) return otherName;
    return row['created_by_label'] as String? ?? 'Colaborador anterior';
  }

  int requestId = 0;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    account = widget.account;
    load();
  }

  void message(String s) {
    if (mounted)
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(s)));
  }

  ReceiptFilter receiptFilter = ReceiptFilter.all;
  Map<String, int>? receiptCounts;
  int receiptRequest = 0;

  String receiptFolder(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
      '${account['id']}/${row['id']}';

  Future<void> refreshReceiptCounts() async {
    final request = ++receiptRequest;
    final uid = viewerId;
    if (uid == null) return;
    try {
      final counts = await loadReceiptCounts(
        uid,
        'person-receipts',
        entries.map(receiptFolder),
      );
      if (mounted && request == receiptRequest)
        setState(() => receiptCounts = counts);
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted && request == receiptRequest)
        setState(() => receiptCounts = null);
    }
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final req = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = personUserId();
      final results = await Future.wait<Object>([
        supabase
            .from('person_accounts')
            .select()
            .eq('id', account['id'])
            .single(),
        personRows(
          'person_account_entries',
          uid,
          accountId: '${account['id']}',
          includeShared: true,
        ),
        personRows(
          'person_account_closures',
          uid,
          accountId: '${account['id']}',
          includeShared: true,
        ),
        personShares(uid, accountId: '${account['id']}'),
      ]);
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted || req != requestId) return;
      final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(results[1] as List);
      rows.sort((a, b) {
        final byDate = '${b['entry_date']}'.compareTo('${a['entry_date']}');
        return byDate != 0
            ? byDate
            : '${b['created_at']}:${b['id']}'.compareTo(
                '${a['created_at']}:${a['id']}',
              );
      });
      personAccountBalance(rows);
      setState(() {
        viewerId = uid;
        account = Map<String, dynamic>.from(results[0] as Map);
        access = (results[3] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>).firstOrNull;
        entries = rows;
        closures = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          results[2] as List,
        )..sort((a, b) => '${b['until_date']}'.compareTo('${a['until_date']}'));
        loading = false;
      });
      await refreshReceiptCounts();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && req == requestId)
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  Future<void> run(Future<void> Function(String uid) action) async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await action(personUserId());
      if (mounted) await load();
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo completar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteAccount() async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) {
      message('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      return;
    }
    final id = '${account['id']}';
    var requested = false;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    void finish() {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ++requestId;
      final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
      Navigator.pop(context);
      messenger.showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Cuenta eliminada.')),
      );
    }

    try {
      final preview = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        await supabase.rpc(
              'person_account_delete_preview',
              params: {'p_account_id': id},
            )
            as Map,
      );
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted) return;
      final balance = moneyCents(preview['balance_nio']);
      var confirmation = '';
      final yes = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (dialogContext, dialogSetState) => AlertDialog(
            title: const Text('Eliminar cuenta con persona'),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 440,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '${preview['name']}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Text(
                      '${personBalanceLabel(balance)} Â· ${formatMoneyCents(balance.abs(), 'NIO')}',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      'Se borrarÃ¡n la cuenta, sus ${preview['entry_count']} movimientos (incluidos los anulados) '
                      'y sus ${preview['closure_count']} cierres acordados.',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const Text(
                      'Esta acciÃ³n es permanente. Eliminar este registro no equivale a pagar ni a cobrar el saldo pendiente.',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    TextField(
                      autocorrect: false,
                      enableSuggestions: false,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Escribe ELIMINAR',
                      ),
                      onChanged: (v) => dialogSetState(() => confirmation = v),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
                child: const Text('Cancelar'),
              ),
              FilledButton.icon(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: Theme.of(dialogContext).colorScheme.error,
                ),
                onPressed: confirmation == 'ELIMINAR'
                    ? () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true)
                    : null,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_forever),
                label: const Text('Eliminar definitivamente'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
      if (yes != true || !mounted) return;
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      requested = true;
      await supabase.rpc(
        'delete_person_account',
        params: {
          'p_account_id': id,
          'p_token': preview['token'],
          'p_confirmation': 'ELIMINAR',
        },
      );
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      finish();
    } catch (e) {
      // Si se perdiÃ³ la respuesta del servidor, verificar antes de mostrar un
      // fallo de una cuenta que realmente ya fue eliminada.
      if (requested && supabase.auth.currentUser?.id == uid) {
        try {
          final existing = await supabase
              .from('person_accounts')
              .select('id')
              .eq('id', id)
              .eq('user_id', uid)
              .maybeSingle();
          checkPersonSession(uid);
          if (existing == null) {
            finish();
            return;
          }
        } catch (_) {
          /* Se podrÃ¡ actualizar o volver a intentar. */
        }
      }
      message('No se pudo eliminar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> editAccount() => run((uid) async {
    final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => PersonAccountFormDialog(account: account),
    );
    if (data == null || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    await supabase
        .from('person_accounts')
        .update(data)
        .eq('id', account['id'])
        .eq('user_id', uid)
        .select('id')
        .single();
  });
  Future<void> toggle() => run((uid) async {
    final active = account['is_active'] != true;
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (c) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(active ? 'Activar cuenta' : 'Archivar cuenta'),
        content: Text(
          active
              ? 'PodrÃ¡s volver a registrar movimientos.'
              : 'Se conservarÃ¡n el saldo y el historial. Para corregir o registrar movimientos tendrÃ¡s que activarla.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, true),
            child: const Text('Confirmar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    await supabase
        .from('person_accounts')
        .update({'is_active': active})
        .eq('id', account['id'])
        .eq('user_id', uid)
        .select('id')
        .single();
  });
  Future<void> editEntry([Map<String, dynamic>? entry]) => run((uid) async {
    if (account['is_active'] != true ||
        (entry == null ? !canAdd : !canEdit(entry)))
      return;
    ExchangeRate? defaultRate;
    try {
      defaultRate = (await loadFinancialSettings())?.rate;
    } catch (_) {
      /* La tasa puede introducirse manualmente en el formulario. */
    }
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    if (!mounted) return;
    final draft = await showDialog<PersonEntryDraft>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => PersonEntryDialog(
        personName: otherName,
        entry: entry == null ? null : fromViewer(entry),
        defaultRate: defaultRate,
      ),
    );
    if (draft == null || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    final values = fromViewer(draft.values);
    if (entry == null) {
      final accountId = '${account['id']}';
      final insert = supabase.from('person_account_entries').insert({
        ...values,
        'user_id': account['user_id'],
        'person_account_id': accountId,
      });
      final receipt = draft.receipt;
      if (receipt == null) {
        await insert;
      } else {
        final saved = await insert.select('id').single();
        if (!mounted) return;
        final uploaded = await uploadSavedReceipt(
          context,
          receipt: receipt,
          uid: uid,
          folder: '$accountId/${saved['id']}',
          person: true,
        );
        if (uploaded) message('Movimiento y comprobante guardados.');
        return;
      }
    } else {
      await supabase
          .from('person_account_entries')
          .update(values)
          .eq('id', entry['id'])
          .eq('user_id', account['user_id'])
          .eq('person_account_id', account['id'])
          .eq('is_voided', false)
          .select('id')
          .single();
    }
    message(
      entry == null ? 'Movimiento registrado.' : 'Movimiento actualizado.',
    );
  });
  Future<void> voidEntry(Map<String, dynamic> entry) => run((uid) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (c) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Anular movimiento'),
        content: const Text(
          'DejarÃ¡ de contar en el saldo y se conservarÃ¡ visible en el historial de anulados.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, true),
            child: const Text('Anular'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    await supabase
        .from('person_account_entries')
        .update({'is_voided': true})
        .eq('id', entry['id'])
        .eq('user_id', uid)
        .eq('is_voided', false)
        .select('id')
        .single();
  });
  String dateText(dynamic value) {
    final d = DateTime.tryParse('$value');
    return d == null
        ? '$value'
        : '${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.year}';
  }

  bool isClosed(Map<String, dynamic> row) => closures.any(
    (c) => '${row['entry_date']}'.compareTo('${c['until_date']}') <= 0,
  );

  Future<void> openClosures() async {
    await Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => PersonClosuresPage(account: account),
      ),
    );
    if (mounted) await load();
  }

  Future<void> openChanges([String? entryId]) => showDialog<void>(
    context: context,
    builder: (_) => PersonEntryChangesDialog(
      accountId: '${account['id']}',
      isOwner: isOwner,
      entryId: entryId,
    ),
  );

  Widget entryCard(Map<String, dynamic> row, int running) {
    final visibleRow = fromViewer(row);
    final plus = '${visibleRow['direction']}' == '1',
        voided = row['is_voided'] == true;
    final color = voided
        ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
        : plus
        ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error
        : const Color(0xFF397455);
    return Card(
      key: ValueKey(row['id']),
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(
                  row['kind'] == 'payment'
                      ? Icons.handshake_outlined
                      : row['kind'] == 'opening'
                      ? Icons.history
                      : Icons.shopping_bag_outlined,
                  color: color,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    personEntryLabel(visibleRow),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                  ),
                ),
                PopupMenuButton<String>(
                  tooltip: 'Opciones del movimiento',
                  enabled: !saving,
                  onSelected: (action) {
                    if (action == 'history') {
                      openChanges('${row['id']}');
                    } else if (action == 'edit') {
                      editEntry(row);
                    } else {
                      voidEntry(row);
                    }
                  },
                  itemBuilder: (_) => [
                    const PopupMenuItem(
                      value: 'history',
                      child: Text('Ver cambios'),
                    ),
                    if (!voided &&
                        account['is_active'] == true &&
                        !isClosed(row) &&
                        canEdit(row)) ...[
                      const PopupMenuItem(value: 'edit', child: Text('Editar')),
                      if (isOwner)
                        const PopupMenuItem(
                          value: 'void',
                          child: Text('Anular'),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
            AdaptiveColumns(
              minColumnWidth: 245,
              spacing: 18,
              children: [
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    if ('${row['description'] ?? ''}'.isNotEmpty)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                        child: Text('${row['description']}'),
                      ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      '${dateText(row['entry_date'])}${voided ? ' Â· ANULADO' : ''}${isClosed(row) ? ' Â· CERRADO' : ''}',
                    ),
                    Text('Registrado por: ${entryAuthor(row)}'),
                    Align(
                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                      child: TextButton.icon(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.attach_file),
                        label: Text(
                          (receiptCounts?[receiptFolder(row)] ?? 0) == 0
                              ? 'Comprobantes'
                              : 'Comprobantes (${receiptCounts![receiptFolder(row)]})',
                        ),
                        onPressed: saving
                            ? null
                            : () async {
                                final writable =
                                    !voided &&
                                    account['is_active'] == true &&
                                    !isClosed(row);
                                final editable = writable && canEdit(row);
                                await showDialog<void>(
                                  context: context,
                                  builder: (_) => PersonReceiptsDialog(
                                    accountId: '${account['id']}',
                                    entryId: '${row['id']}',
                                    canAdd:
                                        editable ||
                                        (writable &&
                                            canAdd &&
                                            row['created_by'] == viewerId),
                                    canRemove: editable,
                                  ),
                                );
                                if (mounted) await refreshReceiptCounts();
                              },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerLow,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        '${plus ? '+' : 'âˆ’'}${formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(row['amount']), '${row['currency']}')}',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 20,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          color: color,
                          decoration: voided
                              ? TextDecoration.lineThrough
                              : null,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (row['currency'] == 'USD')
                        Text(
                          'Tasa: C\$${row['exchange_rate']} / \$1 Â· Equivalente: ${formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(row['amount_nio']), 'NIO')}',
                        ),
                      if (!voided)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                          child: Text(
                            'Saldo tras el movimiento: ${personBalanceLabel(running)} ${formatMoneyCents(running.abs(), 'NIO')}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> shareAccount() => run((_) async {
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => PersonShareDialog(accountId: '${account['id']}'),
    );
  });

  void exportAccount() {
    Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => ExportReportsPage(initialPersonId: '${account['id']}'),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget accountSummary(int balance, Color color) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
    children: [
      GuideAnchor(
        id: 'balance',
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: color.withAlpha(16),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                personBalanceLabel(balance),
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: color),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                formatMoneyCents(balance.abs(), 'NIO'),
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 30,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: color,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text('Saldo actual en cÃ³rdobas'),
              if (!isOwner)
                Text(
                  canAdd ||
                          access?['can_edit_own'] == true ||
                          access?['can_edit_all'] == true
                      ? 'Cuenta compartida'
                      : 'Cuenta compartida Â· Solo ver',
                ),
              if (account['is_active'] != true) const Text('Cuenta archivada'),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      OutlinedButton.icon(
        onPressed: saving ? null : () => openChanges(),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.history_rounded),
        label: const Text('Historial de cambios'),
      ),
      if (isOwner) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        GuideAnchor(
          id: 'closures',

              leading: const Icon(Icons.handshake_outlined),
              title: const Text('Cierres acordados'),
              subtitle: Text(
                closures.isEmpty
                    ? 'Revisar y acordar el saldo'
                    : 'Ãšltimo: ${dateText(closures.first['until_date'])} Â· ${personBalanceLabel(moneyCents(closures.first['balance_nio']))} ${formatMoneyCents(moneyCents(closures.first['balance_nio']).abs(), 'NIO')}',
              ),
              trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
              onTap: saving ? null : openClosures,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        Align(
          alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
          child: TextButton.icon(
            style: TextButton.styleFrom(
              foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
            ),
            onPressed: loading || saving ? null : deleteAccount,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
            label: const Text('Eliminar cuenta'),
          ),
        ),
      ],
      if ('${account['notes'] ?? ''}'.isNotEmpty)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
          child: Text('${account['notes']}'),
        ),
    ],
  );

  Widget movementHistory(
    Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> visibleHistory,
    Map<String, int> running,
  ) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
    children: [
      Text(
        'Historial de movimientos',
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 4),
      Text(
        'Ãšltimos movimientos ingresados primero',
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 10),
      CollapsibleFilters(
        children: [
          AdaptiveColumns(
            minColumnWidth: 235,
            children: [
              SwitchListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: const Text('Mostrar anulados'),
                value: showVoided,
                onChanged: (v) => setState(() => showVoided = v),
              ),
              if (receiptCounts != null)
                ReceiptFilterField(
                  value: receiptFilter,
                  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => receiptFilter = value),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 10),
      if (entries.isEmpty)
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Text(
            'Registra la primera compra o el saldo anterior para comenzar.',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
        ),
      if (entries.isNotEmpty && visibleHistory.isEmpty)
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Text('No hay movimientos que coincidan con los filtros.'),
        ),
      for (final row in visibleHistory)
        entryCard(row, running['${row['id']}']!),
    ],
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final compact = compactLayout(context);
    final gutter = pageGutter(context);
    final label = saving ? 'Guardando...' : 'Nuevo movimiento';
    final VoidCallback? add =
        loading || saving || error != null || account['is_active'] != true
        ? null
        : () => editEntry();
    var balance = 0;
    final running = <String, int>{};
    // El saldo por movimiento sigue su fecha contable, aunque el historial
    // se muestre por fecha de registro.
    for (final row in entries.reversed) {
      balance += personAccountBalance([fromViewer(row)]);
      running['${row['id']}'] = balance;
    }
    final history = [...entries]
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final aCreated = DateTime.tryParse('${a['created_at']}');
        final bCreated = DateTime.tryParse('${b['created_at']}');
        if (aCreated != null && bCreated != null) {
          final byCreated = bCreated.compareTo(aCreated);
          if (byCreated != 0) return byCreated;
        } else if (aCreated != null || bCreated != null) {
          return aCreated != null ? -1 : 1;
        }

        final byDate = '${b['entry_date']}'.compareTo('${a['entry_date']}');
        return byDate != 0 ? byDate : '${b['id']}'.compareTo('${a['id']}');
      });
    final visibleHistory = history.where(
      (row) =>
          (showVoided || row['is_voided'] != true) &&
          (receiptCounts == null ||
              receiptFilter.matches(receiptCounts?[receiptFolder(row)] ?? 0)),
    );
    final color = balance > 0
        ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error
        : balance < 0
        ? const Color(0xFF397455)
        : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary;
    return GuideScope(
      topic: 'person_detail',
      ready: !loading && error == null,
      excludedTargets: {if (!canAdd) 'add', if (!isOwner) 'closures'},
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: GuideAnchor(
            id: 'title',
            child: Text(
              otherName,
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            const AppHelpButton(topic: 'people'),
            if (isOwner && !compact) ...[
              IconButton(
                tooltip: 'Compartir cuenta',
                icon: const Icon(Icons.share_outlined),
                onPressed: loading || saving || error != null
                    ? null
                    : shareAccount,
              ),
              IconButton(
                tooltip: 'Exportar estado de cuenta',
                icon: const Icon(Icons.file_download_outlined),
                onPressed: loading || saving || error != null
                    ? null
                    : exportAccount,
              ),
            ],
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Actualizar',
              onPressed: loading || saving ? null : load,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            ),
            if (isOwner)
              PopupMenuButton<String>(
                enabled: !loading && !saving && error == null,
                onSelected: (v) {
                  if (v == 'share')
                    shareAccount();
                  else if (v == 'export')
                    exportAccount();
                  else if (v == 'closures')
                    openClosures();
                  else if (v == 'edit')
                    editAccount();
                  else
                    toggle();
                },
                itemBuilder: (_) => [
                  if (compact) ...[
                    const PopupMenuItem(
                      value: 'share',
                      child: Text('Compartir cuenta'),
                    ),
                    const PopupMenuItem(
                      value: 'export',
                      child: Text('Exportar estado de cuenta'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const PopupMenuItem(
                    value: 'closures',
                    child: Text('Cierres acordados'),
                  ),
                  const PopupMenuItem(
                    value: 'edit',
                    child: Text('Editar persona'),
                  ),
                  PopupMenuItem(
                    value: 'toggle',
                    child: Text(
                      account['is_active'] == true
                          ? 'Archivar cuenta'
                          : 'Activar cuenta',
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
          ],
        ),
        bottomNavigationBar: compact && canAdd
            ? GuideAnchor(
                id: 'add',
                child: CompactActionBar(label: label, onPressed: add),
              )
            : null,
        floatingActionButton: !compact && canAdd
            ? GuideAnchor(
                id: 'add',
                child: FloatingActionButton.extended(
                  onPressed: add,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                  label: Text(label),
                ),
              )
            : null,
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 1240),
              child: loading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : error != null
                  ? ListView(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      children: [
                        SelectableText(error!),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: load,
                          child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    )
                  : RefreshIndicator(
                      onRefresh: load,
                      child: ListView(
                        physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                          gutter,
                          16,
                          gutter,
                          compact ? 24 : 110,
                        ),
                        children: [
                          LayoutBuilder(
                            builder: (context, constraints) {
                              final wide = constraints.maxWidth >= 880;
                              return Wrap(
                                spacing: 24,
                                runSpacing: 18,
                                children: [
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: wide ? 300 : constraints.maxWidth,
                                    child: accountSummary(balance, color),
                                  ),
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: wide
                                        ? constraints.maxWidth - 324
                                        : constraints.maxWidth,
                                    child: movementHistory(
                                      visibleHistory,
                                      running,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class PersonAccountFormDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonAccountFormDialog({super.key, this.account});
  final Map<String, dynamic>? account;
  @override
  State<PersonAccountFormDialog> createState() =>
      _PersonAccountFormDialogState();
}

class _PersonAccountFormDialogState extends State<PersonAccountFormDialog> {
  final key = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late final TextEditingController name, notes;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    name = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.account?['name']?.toString() ?? '',
    );
    notes = TextEditingController(
      text: widget.account?['notes']?.toString() ?? '',
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    name.dispose();
    notes.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    title: Text(
      widget.account == null
          ? 'Nueva cuenta con una persona'
          : 'Editar persona',
    ),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 420,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Form(
          key: key,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextFormField(
                controller: name,
                autofocus: true,
                maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                maxLength: 100,
                textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Nombre de la persona',
                ),
                validator: (v) =>
                    (v ?? '').trim().isEmpty ? 'Escribe un nombre' : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextFormField(
                controller: notes,
                maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                maxLength: 2000,
                maxLines: 3,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Notas (opcional)',
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cancelar'),
      ),
      FilledButton(
        onPressed: () {
          if (key.currentState!.validate())
            Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
              'name': name.text.trim(),
              'notes': notes.text.trim(),
            });
        },
        child: const Text('Guardar'),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\person_accounts\person_closures_page.dart

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show MaxLengthEnforcement;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/person_account_repository.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';

String closureDate(dynamic value) {
  final d = DateTime.parse('$value');
  return '${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${d.year}';
}

String closureIso(DateTime d) =>
    '${d.year}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

class PersonClosuresPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonClosuresPage({super.key, required this.account});
  final Map<String, dynamic> account;
  @override
  State<PersonClosuresPage> createState() => _PersonClosuresPageState();
}

class _PersonClosuresPageState extends State<PersonClosuresPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> closures = [];
  bool loading = true, busy = false;
  String? error;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rows = await personRows(
        'person_account_closures',
        personUserId(),
        accountId: '${widget.account['id']}',
      );
      rows.sort((a, b) => '${b['until_date']}'.compareTo('${a['until_date']}'));
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          closures = rows;
          loading = false;
        });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  Future<void> create() async {
    if (busy || loading) return;
    setState(() => busy = true);
    final notes = TextEditingController();
    try {
      final uid = personUserId(), today = DateTime.now();
      final first = closures.isEmpty
          ? DateTime(2000)
          : DateTime.parse(
              '${closures.first['until_date']}',
            ).add(const Duration(days: 1));
      if (first.isAfter(DateTime(today.year, today.month, today.day)))
        throw StateError(
          'Ya cerraste hasta hoy. PodrÃ¡s cerrar de nuevo en una fecha posterior.',
        );
      final date = await showDatePicker(
        context: context,
        initialDate: today,
        firstDate: first,
        lastDate: today,
      );
      if (date == null || !mounted) return;
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      final preview = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        await supabase.rpc(
              'person_closure_preview',
              params: {
                'p_account_id': widget.account['id'],
                'p_until': closureIso(date),
              },
            )
            as Map,
      );
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted) return;
      final balance = moneyCents(preview['balance_nio']);
      final snapshot = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        preview['snapshot'] as List,
      );
      var acknowledged = false;
      final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (c) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (c, setLocal) => AlertDialog(
            title: const Text('Confirmar saldo acordado'),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 480,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '${preview['name']} Â· Hasta ${closureDate(closureIso(date))} (incluido)',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Text(
                      '${personBalanceLabel(balance)} ${formatMoneyCents(balance.abs(), 'NIO')}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 22,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    const Text(
                      'Cerrar no significa pagar. Se guarda el acuerdo y se protegen los movimientos hasta esta fecha. Las compras siguientes continÃºan sobre este saldo.',
                    ),
                    ExpansionTile(
                      title: Text('Revisar ${snapshot.length} movimientos'),
                      children: snapshot
                          .map(
                            (e) => ListTile(
                              title: Text(personEntryLabel(e)),
                              subtitle: Text(
                                '${closureDate(e['entry_date'])} Â· ${e['description']}${e['is_voided'] == true ? ' Â· ANULADO' : ''}',
                              ),
                              trailing: Text(
                                '${e['direction'].toString() == '1' ? '+' : 'âˆ’'}${formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(e['amount_nio']), 'NIO')}',
                              ),
                            ),
                          )
                          .toList(),
                    ),
                    TextField(
                      controller: notes,
                      maxLengthEnforcement: MaxLengthEnforcement.enforced,
                      maxLength: 2000,
                      maxLines: 3,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Notas del acuerdo (opcional)',
                      ),
                    ),
                    CheckboxListTile(
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                      title: const Text(
                        'Ambos revisamos y aceptamos este saldo',
                      ),
                      value: acknowledged,
                      onChanged: (v) =>
                          setLocal(() => acknowledged = v == true),
                    ),
                    const Text(
                      'Esta es tu constancia manual. La otra persona no recibe ni firma nada desde la app.',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c, false),
                child: const Text('Cancelar'),
              ),
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: acknowledged ? () => Navigator.pop(c, true) : null,
                child: const Text('Guardar cierre'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
      if (confirm != true) return;
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      await supabase.rpc(
        'person_close_account',
        params: {
          'p_account_id': widget.account['id'],
          'p_until': closureIso(date),
          'p_token': preview['token'],
          'p_notes': notes.text.trim(),
          'p_ack': true,
        },
      );
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Cierre guardado. El saldo continÃºa sin duplicarse.'),
        ),
      );
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo guardar: $e')));
    } finally {
      notes.dispose();
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }

  Widget closureCard(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final balance = moneyCents(row['balance_nio']);
    final snapshot = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(row['snapshot'] as List);
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              'Hasta ${closureDate(row['until_date'])}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            Text(
              '${row['name_at_close']} Â· ${personBalanceLabel(balance)} ${formatMoneyCents(balance.abs(), 'NIO')}',
            ),
            Text('Guardado: ${closureDate(row['created_at'])}'),
            if ('${row['notes']}'.isNotEmpty) Text('${row['notes']}'),
            ExpansionTile(
              title: Text('Historial acordado Â· ${snapshot.length} registros'),
              children: snapshot
                  .map(
                    (e) => ListTile(
                      title: Text(personEntryLabel(e)),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        '${closureDate(e['entry_date'])} Â· ${e['description']}\n${formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(e['amount']), '${e['currency']}')} Â· Tasa ${e['exchange_rate']}${e['is_voided'] == true ? ' Â· ANULADO' : ''}',
                      ),
                      trailing: Text(
                        '${e['direction'].toString() == '1' ? '+' : 'âˆ’'}${formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(e['amount_nio']), 'NIO')}',
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                  .toList(),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(
      title: const Text('Cierres acordados'),
      actions: [
        IconButton(
          onPressed: loading || busy ? null : load,
          tooltip: 'Actualizar',
          icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: FilledButton.icon(
          onPressed: loading || busy || error != null ? null : create,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.handshake_outlined),
          label: Text(busy ? 'Procesandoâ€¦' : 'Revisar y guardar cierre'),
        ),
      ),
    ),
    body: SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Center(
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 800),
          child: loading
              ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
              : ListView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '${widget.account['name']}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 22,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Text(
                      'Guarda hasta dÃ³nde revisaron la cuenta y quÃ© saldo aceptaron. No genera un pago ni un saldo inicial adicional. Las correcciones a perÃ­odos cerrados se registran con fecha posterior.',
                    ),
                    if (error != null) ...[
                      SelectableText(error!),
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: load,
                        child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                      ),
                    ] else if (closures.isEmpty)
                      const Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                        child: Text('TodavÃ­a no hay cierres acordados.'),
                      ),
                    ...closures.map(closureCard),
                  ],
                ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\person_accounts\person_entry_changes_dialog.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/person_account_repository.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';

class PersonEntryChangesDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonEntryChangesDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.accountId,
    required this.isOwner,
    this.entryId,
  });

  final String accountId;
  final bool isOwner;
  final String? entryId;

  @override
  State<PersonEntryChangesDialog> createState() =>
      _PersonEntryChangesDialogState();
}

class _PersonEntryChangesDialogState extends State<PersonEntryChangesDialog> {
  static const pageSize = 25;
  final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  bool loading = false;
  bool hasMore = true;
  String? error;
  String? viewerId;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    if (loading || !hasMore) return;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = viewerId ??= personUserId();
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      var query = supabase
          .from('person_entry_changes')
          .select(
            'id, entry_id, action, actor_id, actor_label, actor_is_owner, changed_at, before_values, after_values',
          )
          .eq('person_account_id', widget.accountId);
      if (widget.entryId case final entryId?) {
        query = query.eq('entry_id', entryId);
      }
      if (rows.isNotEmpty) query = query.lt('id', rows.last['id']);
      final page = await query
          .order('id', ascending: false)
          .limit(pageSize + 1);
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        rows.addAll(page.take(pageSize));
        hasMore = page.length > pageSize;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != viewerId) {
          rows.clear();
          hasMore = false;
          error = 'La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Cierra y abre de nuevo esta pantalla.';
        } else {
          error =
              e is PostgrestException &&
                  (e.code == 'PGRST205' || e.code == '42P01')
              ? 'Instala la migraciÃ³n 11 en Supabase para habilitar el historial.'
              : 'No se pudo cargar el historial. Intenta de nuevo.';
        }
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  String actorLabel(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final actor = row['actor_id'];
    if (actor == null) return 'AcciÃ³n del sistema';
    if (actor == viewerId) return 'TÃº';
    if (row['actor_is_owner'] == true) return 'Titular de la cuenta';
    final label = row['actor_label']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    return label.isEmpty ? 'Colaborador' : '$label Â· Colaborador';
  }

  String dateLabel(Object? value, {bool withTime = false}) {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse('$value')?.toLocal();
    if (date == null) return 'Sin fecha';
    String pad(int number) => number.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final day = '${pad(date.day)}/${pad(date.month)}/${date.year}';
    return withTime ? '$day Â· ${pad(date.hour)}:${pad(date.minute)}' : day;
  }

  String movementLabel(Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final direction = int.tryParse('${data['direction']}') ?? 1;
    return personEntryLabel({
      ...data,
      'direction': widget.isOwner ? direction : -direction,
    });
  }

  Widget eventCard(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final before = row['before_values'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
    final after = row['after_values'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final currency = '${after['currency']}';
    final (action, icon) = switch (row['action']) {
      'created' => ('RegistrÃ³ el movimiento', Icons.add_circle_outline),
      'voided' => ('AnulÃ³ el movimiento', Icons.block_outlined),
      _ => ('EditÃ³ el movimiento', Icons.edit_outlined),
    };
    final changes = <(String, String)>[];
    if (before != null) {
      void add(String title, String oldValue, String newValue) {
        if (oldValue != newValue) changes.add((title, '$oldValue â†’ $newValue'));
      }

      add('Movimiento', movementLabel(before), movementLabel(after));
      add(
        'Monto',
        formatRecordMoneyCents(
          moneyCents(before['amount']),
          '${before['currency']}',
        ),
        formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(after['amount']), currency),
      );
      if (before['exchange_rate'] != after['exchange_rate']) {
        add(
          'Tasa de cambio',
          '${before['exchange_rate']}',
          '${after['exchange_rate']}',
        );
      }
      add(
        'Fecha del movimiento',
        dateLabel(before['entry_date']),
        dateLabel(after['entry_date']),
      );
      String description(Map<String, dynamic> values) =>
          (values['description']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty
          ? 'Sin descripciÃ³n'
          : '${values['description']}';
      add('DescripciÃ³n', description(before), description(after));
      add(
        'Estado',
        before['is_voided'] == true ? 'Anulado' : 'Vigente',
        after['is_voided'] == true ? 'Anulado' : 'Vigente',
      );
    }
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(icon, color: theme.colorScheme.primary, size: 20),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(action, style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              '${actorLabel(row)} Â· ${dateLabel(row['changed_at'], withTime: true)}',
              style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              '${movementLabel(after)} Â· ${formatRecordMoneyCents(moneyCents(after['amount']), currency)}',
            ),
            if (widget.entryId == null || before == null) ...[
              Text(
                'Fecha del movimiento Â· ${dateLabel(after['entry_date'])}',
                style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
              ),
              if ('${after['description'] ?? ''}'.isNotEmpty)
                Text(
                  '${after['description']}',
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
            ],
            for (final (title, value) in changes)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                child: Text('$title Â· $value'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    title: Text(
      widget.entryId == null
          ? 'Historial de cambios'
          : 'Cambios del movimiento',
    ),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 580,
      height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .58,
      child: ListView(
        children: [
          Text(
            'Se muestran los cambios registrados desde que se habilitÃ³ el historial.',
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ...rows.map(eventCard),
          if (rows.isEmpty && !loading && error == null)
            const Text('AÃºn no hay cambios registrados.'),
          if (error case final message?) Text(message),
          if (loading)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (error != null && hasMore)
            TextButton(onPressed: load, child: const Text('Reintentar'))
          else if (hasMore && rows.isNotEmpty)
            TextButton(onPressed: load, child: const Text('Cargar mÃ¡s')),
        ],
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cerrar'),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

typedef PersonEntryDraft = ({
  Map<String, dynamic> values,
  PendingReceipt? receipt,

class PersonEntryDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonEntryDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.personName,
    this.entry,
    this.defaultRate,
  });
  final String personName;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? entry;
  final ExchangeRate? defaultRate;
  @override
  State<PersonEntryDialog> createState() => _PersonEntryDialogState();
}

class _PersonEntryDialogState extends State<PersonEntryDialog> {
  final form = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final amount = TextEditingController(),
      rate = TextEditingController(),
      description = TextEditingController();
  PendingReceipt? _receipt;
  bool _pickingReceipt = false;
  String? _receiptError;

  Future<void> _pickReceipt() async {
    setState(() {
      _pickingReceipt = true;
      _receiptError = null;
    });
    try {
      final selection = await PendingReceipt.pick();
      if (mounted && selection != null) setState(() => _receipt = selection);
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => _receiptError = error is FormatException
              ? error.message
              : 'No se pudo leer el archivo. Intenta de nuevo.',
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _pickingReceipt = false);
    }
  }

  String kind = 'purchase', currency = 'NIO';
  int direction = 1;
  DateTime date = DateUtils.dateOnly(DateTime.now());
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final e = widget.entry;
    rate.text = widget.defaultRate?.decimal ?? '';
    if (e != null) {
      kind = '${e['kind']}';
      currency = '${e['currency']}';
      direction = int.parse('${e['direction']}');
      amount.text = '${e['amount']}';
      description.text = '${e['description'] ?? ''}';
      if (currency == 'USD') rate.text = '${e['exchange_rate']}';
      date = DateTime.parse('${e['entry_date']}');
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    amount.dispose();
    rate.dispose();
    description.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  ExchangeRate? get effectiveRate =>
      ExchangeRate.tryParse(currency == 'NIO' ? '1' : rate.text);
  int? get converted {
    final r = effectiveRate,
        n = num.tryParse(amount.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));
    if (r == null || n == null || !n.isFinite || n <= 0 || n > 1000000000)
      return null;
    return r.convert((n * moneyScale).round(), currency, 'NIO');
  }

  String get plus => switch (kind) {
    'payment' => '${widget.personName} te pagÃ³ (+)',
    'opening' => 'Le debÃ­as desde antes (+)',
    _ => 'Compra de ${widget.personName} (+)',
  };
  String get minus => switch (kind) {
    'payment' => 'TÃº le pagaste (âˆ’)',
    'opening' => 'Te debÃ­a desde antes (âˆ’)',
    _ => 'Compra tuya (âˆ’)',
  };
  void save() {
    if (!form.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final cents = converted;
    if (cents == null || cents <= 0 || cents > 100000000000000) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Revisa el monto convertido: debe ser al menos C\$0.01 y no exceder el lÃ­mite.',
          ),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop<PersonEntryDraft>(context, (
      receipt: _receipt,
      values: <String, dynamic>{
        'kind': kind,
        'direction': direction,
        'amount': amount.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
        'currency': currency,
        'exchange_rate': effectiveRate!.decimal,
        'entry_date':
            '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
        'description': description.text.trim(),
      },
    ));
  }

    final cents = converted;
    return GuideScope(

        insetPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(

          vertical: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 24,
        ),
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
          compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
          12,
          compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
          16,
        ),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                widget.entry == null ? 'Nuevo movimiento' : 'Editar movimiento',
              ),
            ),
            const AppHelpButton(topic: 'people'),
          ],
        ),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 740,

            child: Form(
              key: form,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Cuenta con ${widget.personName}',
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  AdaptiveColumns(
                    minColumnWidth: 246,
                    children: [
                      GuideAnchor(
                        id: 'kind',
                        child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                          initialValue: kind,
                          isExpanded: true,

                            labelText: 'QuÃ© vas a registrar',
                          ),
                          items: const [
                            DropdownMenuItem(
                              value: 'purchase',

import 'office_receipt_preview.dart';
