const _types = {
  'jpg': 'image/jpeg',
  'jpeg': 'image/jpeg',
  'png': 'image/png',
  'webp': 'image/webp',
  'heic': 'image/heic',
  'heif': 'image/heif',
  'pdf': 'application/pdf',
  'doc': 'application/msword',
  'docx':
      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
  'xls': 'application/vnd.ms-excel',
  'xlsx': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
  'txt': 'text/plain',
};

Future<bool?> showFilePreview(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String label,
  required String sourceName,
  required Future<Uint8List> Function() load,
  bool allowDownload = false,
  bool expanded = false,
}) {
  final extension = label.split('.').last.toLowerCase();
  final mimeType = _types[extension];
  final isImage = mimeType?.startsWith('image/') ?? false;
  final isPdf = extension == 'pdf';
  final isText = extension == 'txt';
  final isOffice = extension == 'docx' || extension == 'xlsx';
  final supported = isImage || isPdf || isText || isOffice;
  final bytes = supported ? load() : null;

  return showDialog<bool>(
    context: context,
    builder: (context) {
      final preview = supported
          ? FutureBuilder<Uint8List>(
              future: bytes,
              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                if (snapshot.hasError) {
                  return const Center(
                    child: Text('No se pudo cargar el archivo.'),
                  );
                }
                final data = snapshot.data;
                if (data == null) {
                  return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                }
                if (isOffice) {
                  return OfficeReceiptPreview(
                    bytes: data,
                    extension: extension,
                  );
                }
                if (isPdf) {
                  return _PdfFilePreview(
                    bytes: data,
                    sourceName: sourceName,
                    showControls: expanded,
                  );
                }
                if (isText) {
                  return SingleChildScrollView(
                    child: SelectableText(
                      utf8.decode(data, allowMalformed: true),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                return InteractiveViewer(
                  maxScale: 5,
                  child: SizedBox.expand(
                    child: Image.memory(
                      data,
                      fit: BoxFit.contain,
                      errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Center(
                        child: Text(
                          'Este dispositivo no puede mostrar la imagen.',
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            )
          : Text(
              allowDownload
                  ? 'Este formato solo estÃ¡ disponible para descarga.'
                  : 'Este formato no tiene vista previa. Puedes adjuntarlo al guardar.',
            );
      final actions = [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
          child: const Text('Cerrar'),
        ),
        if (allowDownload)
          TextButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.download_outlined),
            label: const Text('Descargar'),
          ),
      ];
      if (!expanded) {
        return AlertDialog(
          insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          title: Text(label, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 760,
            height: supported ? MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .65 : null,
            child: preview,
          ),
          actions: actions,
        );
      }

      final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
      final content = Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 16, end: 4),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    label,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                  ),
                ),
                if (allowDownload) actions.last,
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Cerrar',
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const Divider(height: 1),
          Expanded(child: preview),
        ],
      );
      final compact = size.width < 600 || size.height < 480;
      return Dialog(
        insetPadding: compact ? EdgeInsets.zero : const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
        shape: compact ? const RoundedRectangleBorder() : null,
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: SizedBox.expand(child: content),
      );
    },
  );
}

class _PdfFilePreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PdfFilePreview({
    required this.bytes,
    required this.sourceName,
    required this.showControls,
  });

  final Uint8List bytes;
  final String sourceName;
  final bool showControls;

  @override
  State<_PdfFilePreview> createState() => _PdfFilePreviewState();
}

class _PdfFilePreviewState extends State<_PdfFilePreview> {
  final _controller = PdfViewerController();
  bool _ready = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final viewer = PdfViewer.data(
      widget.bytes,
      sourceName: widget.sourceName,
      controller: widget.showControls ? _controller : null,
      params: PdfViewerParams(
        errorBannerBuilder: (_, _, _, _) =>
            const Center(child: Text('No se pudo mostrar el PDF.')),
        calculateInitialZoom: widget.showControls
            ? (_, controller, _, _) =>
                  (controller.viewSize.width - controller.params.margin * 2) /
                  controller.layout.pageLayouts.first.width
            : null,
        onViewerReady: widget.showControls
            ? (_, _) {
                if (mounted) setState(() => _ready = true);
              }
            : null,
      ),
    );
    if (!widget.showControls) return viewer;

    final canZoom = _ready && _controller.isReady;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Alejar',
              onPressed: canZoom ? () => _controller.zoomDown() : null,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.zoom_out),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Ajustar al ancho',
              onPressed: canZoom
                  ? () => _controller.goTo(
                      _controller.calcMatrixFitWidthForPage(
                        pageNumber: _controller.pageNumber ?? 1,
                      ),
                    )
                  : null,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.fit_screen_outlined),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Acercar',
              onPressed: canZoom ? () => _controller.zoomUp() : null,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.zoom_in),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        Expanded(child: viewer),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// A validated selection held locally until its movement has been saved.
class PendingReceipt {
  const PendingReceipt._(this.label, this._name, this._type, this._bytes);

  final String label, _name, _type;
  final Uint8List _bytes;

  static Future<PendingReceipt?> pick() async {
    final file = await pickReceiptFile();
    if (file == null) return null;
    final dot = file.name.lastIndexOf('.');
    final extension = dot < 0 ? '' : file.name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase();
    final type = _types[extension];
    if (type == null) {
      throw const FormatException('Usa una imagen, PDF, Word, Excel o TXT.');
    }
    final size = await file.length();
    if (size <= 0 || size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'El comprobante debe pesar entre 1 byte y 10 MB.',
      );
    }
    var base = file.name
        .substring(0, dot)
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+'), '_');
    if (base.length > 80) base = base.substring(0, 80);
    if (base.isEmpty) base = 'comprobante';
    final random = Random.secure();
    final id = List.generate(
      16,
      (_) => random.nextInt(256).toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'),
    ).join();
    final bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
    if (bytes.isEmpty || bytes.length > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'El comprobante debe pesar entre 1 byte y 10 MB.',
      );
    }
    return PendingReceipt._(file.name, '${id}_$base.$extension', type, bytes);
  }

  Future<String?> readFirstPdfPage() async {
    if (_type != 'application/pdf') return null;
    final document = await PdfDocument.openData(_bytes, sourceName: _name);
    try {
      if (document.pages.isEmpty) return null;
      return (await document.pages.first.loadText()).fullText;
    } finally {
      await document.dispose();
    }
  }

  Future<void> preview(BuildContext context) async {
    await showFilePreview(
      context,
      label: label,
      sourceName: _name,
      load: () async => _bytes,
    );
  }

  Future<void> upload(StorageFileApi bucket, String folder, String uid) async {
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    await bucket.uploadBinary(
      '$folder/$_name',
      _bytes,
      fileOptions: FileOptions(contentType: _type, upsert: false),
    );
  }
}

class PersonReceiptsDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonReceiptsDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.accountId,
    required this.entryId,
    required this.canAdd,
    required this.canRemove,
  }) : movementTable = null,
       statementDocuments = const {};

  const PersonReceiptsDialog.movement({
    super.key,
    required String table,
    required this.entryId,
    required bool writable,
  }) : movementTable = table,
       statementDocuments = const {},
       accountId = '',
       canAdd = writable,
       canRemove = writable;

  const PersonReceiptsDialog.statement({
    super.key,
    required this.entryId,
    required this.statementDocuments,
  }) : accountId = '',
       movementTable = 'credit_card_statements',
       canAdd = false,
       canRemove = false;

  /// Document IDs and their write permissions, including older per-currency IDs.
  final Map<String, bool> statementDocuments;
  final String accountId, entryId;
  final String? movementTable;
  final bool canAdd, canRemove;

  @override
  State<PersonReceiptsDialog> createState() => _PersonReceiptsDialogState();
}

class _PersonReceiptsDialogState extends State<PersonReceiptsDialog> {
  late final String _uid;
  final _files = <({String folder, String name, bool writable})>[];
  bool _loaded = false;
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _notice;

  bool get _isStatement => widget.statementDocuments.isNotEmpty;
  bool get _canAdd => _isStatement
      ? _loaded &&
            _files.isEmpty &&
            widget.statementDocuments[widget.entryId] == true
      : widget.canAdd;
  String get _folder =>
      '${widget.movementTable ?? widget.accountId}/${widget.entryId}';
  StorageFileApi get _bucket => supabase.storage.from(
    widget.movementTable == null ? 'person-receipts' : 'movement-receipts',
  );

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _uid = personUserId();
    _run(_load);
  }

  Future<void> _run(Future<void> Function() action) async {
    if (_busy) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _notice = null;
    });
    try {
      checkPersonSession(_uid);
      await action();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _notice = 'No se pudo completar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final folders = _isStatement
        ? {
            for (final entry in widget.statementDocuments.entries)
              'credit_card_statements/${entry.key}': entry.value,
          }
        : {_folder: widget.canRemove};
    // Processed holds keep their original folder; no file copying or duplicate upload.
    if (widget.movementTable == 'credit_card_transactions') {
      final holds = await supabase
          .from('credit_card_holds')
          .select('id')
          .eq('user_id', _uid)
          .eq('transaction_id', widget.entryId)
          .eq('status', 'processed');
      checkPersonSession(_uid);
      for (final hold in holds) {
        folders['credit_card_holds/${hold['id']}'] = widget.canRemove;
      }
    }
    final files = <({String folder, String name, bool writable})>[];
    for (final folder in folders.entries) {
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 100) {
        final page = await _bucket.list(
          path: folder.key,
          searchOptions: SearchOptions(limit: 100, offset: offset),
        );
        checkPersonSession(_uid);
        files.addAll(
          page.map(
            (file) =>
                (folder: folder.key, name: file.name, writable: folder.value),
          ),
        );
        if (page.length < 100) break;
      }
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _loaded = true;
      _files
        ..clear()
        ..addAll(files);
    });
  }

  String _label(String name) =>
      name.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{32}_'), '');

  Future<void> _add() => _run(() async {
    final receipt = await PendingReceipt.pick();
    if (receipt == null || !mounted) return;
    if (_isStatement) {
      await _load();
      if (!mounted || !_canAdd) return;
    }
    await receipt.upload(_bucket, _folder, _uid);
    await _load();
  });

  Future<void> _preview(String folder, String name) async {
    final path = '$folder/$name';
    final download = await showFilePreview(
      context,
      label: _label(name),
      sourceName: path,
      load: () => _runPreviewLoad(path),
      allowDownload: true,
    );
    if (download == true && mounted) await _download(folder, name);
  }

  Future<Uint8List> _runPreviewLoad(String path) async {
    checkPersonSession(_uid);
    final bytes = await _bucket.download(path);
    checkPersonSession(_uid);
    return bytes;
  }

  Future<void> _download(String folder, String name) => _run(() async {
    final display = _label(name);
    final dot = display.lastIndexOf('.');
    final ext = display.substring(dot + 1);
    final base = display.substring(0, dot);
    final bytes = await _bucket.download('$folder/$name');
    if (!mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(_uid);
    final saver = FileSaver.instance;
    final String? result;
    if (kIsWeb || defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.linux) {
      result = await saver.saveFile(
        name: base,
        bytes: bytes,
        fileExtension: ext,
        mimeType: MimeType.custom,
        customMimeType: _types[ext]!,
      );
    } else {
      result = await saver.saveAs(
        name: base,
        bytes: bytes,
        fileExtension: ext,
        mimeType: MimeType.custom,
        customMimeType: _types[ext]!,
      );
    }
    if (result != null &&
        (result.isEmpty || result.startsWith('Something went wrong'))) {
      throw StateError('El sistema no pudo guardar el archivo.');
    }
    if (result != null && mounted)
      setState(() => _notice = 'Descarga solicitada.');
  });

  Future<void> _remove(String folder, String name) => _run(() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(_isStatement ? 'Quitar documento' : 'Quitar comprobante'),
        content: Text(_label(name)),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Quitar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(_uid);
    await _bucket.remove(['$folder/$name']);
    await _load();
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    insetPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
      horizontal: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 40,
      vertical: 20,
    ),
    title: Text(_isStatement ? 'Documento del banco' : 'Comprobantes'),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 440,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            if (_busy) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
            if (_notice != null) Text(_notice!),
            if (_files.isEmpty && !_busy && _notice == null)
              Text(
                _isStatement
                    ? 'TodavÃ­a no hay un documento para este corte.'
                    : 'Este movimiento todavÃ­a no tiene comprobantes.',
              ),
            for (final (:folder, :name, :writable) in _files)
              ListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: Text(_label(name)),
                leading: const Icon(Icons.attach_file),
                onTap: _busy ? null : () => _preview(folder, name),
                trailing: Wrap(
                  children: [
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Vista previa',
                      onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _preview(folder, name),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.visibility_outlined),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Descargar',
                      onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _download(folder, name),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.download_outlined),
                    ),
                    if (writable)
                      IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Quitar',
                        onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _remove(folder, name),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            if (_canAdd)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                child: Text(
                  'ImÃ¡genes, PDF, Word, Excel o TXT. Hasta 10 MB por archivo.',
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: _busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cerrar'),
      ),
      IconButton(
        tooltip: 'Actualizar',
        onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _run(_load),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
      ),
      if (_canAdd)
        FilledButton.icon(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : _add,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.upload_file),
          label: Text(_isStatement ? 'Adjuntar documento' : 'Adjuntar'),
        ),
    ],
  );
}

/// Identifies the original record so linked views share the same attachments.
class MovementReceiptsButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const MovementReceiptsButton({
    super.key,
    required this.table,
    required this.record,
    this.iconOnly = false,
    this.count = 0,
    this.onClosed,
  });

  final String table;
  final Map<String, dynamic> record;
  final bool iconOnly;
  final int count;
  final VoidCallback? onClosed;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final id = record['id']?.toString();
    if (id == null || id.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    Future<void> open() async {
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        builder: (_) => PersonReceiptsDialog.movement(
          table: table,
          entryId: id,
          writable: record['is_voided'] != true,
        ),
      );
      if (context.mounted) onClosed?.call();
    }

    return iconOnly
        ? IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Comprobantes',
            onPressed: open,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.attach_file),
          )
        : Align(
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: TextButton.icon(
              onPressed: open,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.attach_file),
              label: Text(count > 0 ? 'Comprobantes ($count)' : 'Comprobantes'),
            ),
          );
  }
}

class PersonShareDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const PersonShareDialog({super.key, required this.accountId});
  final String accountId;

  @override
  State<PersonShareDialog> createState() => _PersonShareDialogState();
}

class _PersonShareDialogState extends State<PersonShareDialog> {
  final email = TextEditingController();
  late final String uid;
  Map<String, dynamic>? share;
  bool add = false, editOwn = false, editAll = false;
  bool busy = true, loaded = false;
  String? error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    uid = personUserId();
    load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    email.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    try {
      final rows = await personShares(uid, accountId: widget.accountId);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        share = rows.firstOrNull;
        email.text = share?['invited_email'] as String? ?? '';
        add = share?['can_add'] == true;
        editOwn = share?['can_edit_own'] == true;
        editAll = share?['can_edit_all'] == true;
        loaded = true;
        error = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => error = '$e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> save({bool remove = false}) async {
    if (busy || !loaded) return;
    setState(() {
      busy = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      await supabase.rpc(
        'person_share_manage',
        params: {
          'p_account': widget.accountId,
          'p_email': email.text.trim(),
          'p_add': add,
          'p_edit_own': editOwn,
          'p_edit_all': editAll,
          'p_share': share?['id'],
          'p_remove': remove,
        },
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pop(context);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          busy = false;
        });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    insetPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
      horizontal: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 40,
      vertical: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 24,
    ),
    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
      compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
      12,
      compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
      16,
    ),
    title: const Text('Compartir cuenta'),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 430,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            if (busy) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
            if (error != null) Text(error!),
            if (!loaded && !busy)
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  setState(() => busy = true);
                  load();
                },
                child: const Text('Reintentar'),
              ),
            if (loaded) ...[
              TextField(
                controller: email,
                enabled: !busy && share == null,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Correo en Mi Billete',
                ),
              ),
              if (share != null)
                Text(
                  share!['member_id'] == null
                      ? 'InvitaciÃ³n pendiente'
                      : 'Acceso activo',
                )
              else
                const Text(
                  'La invitaciÃ³n aparecerÃ¡ en la app de la otra persona.',
                ),
              const Text('Siempre puede ver el saldo y el historial.'),
              CheckboxListTile(
                title: const Text('Agregar movimientos'),
                value: add,
                onChanged: busy
                    ? null
                    : (value) => setState(() => add = value!),
              ),
              CheckboxListTile(
                title: const Text('Editar sus movimientos'),
                value: editOwn,
                onChanged: busy
                    ? null
                    : (value) => setState(() => editOwn = value!),
              ),
              CheckboxListTile(
                title: const Text('Editar cualquier movimiento'),
                value: editAll,
                onChanged: busy
                    ? null
                    : (value) => setState(() => editAll = value!),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cerrar'),
      ),
      if (share != null)
        TextButton(
          onPressed: busy ? null : () => save(remove: true),
          child: const Text('Retirar acceso'),
        ),
      FilledButton(
        onPressed: !loaded || busy ? null : () => save(),
        child: Text(share == null ? 'Invitar' : 'Guardar permisos'),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';

const receiptDraftKey = '_pendingReceipt';

class ReceiptDraft {
  PendingReceipt? file;
  bool picking = false;

  Map<String, dynamic> get fields => {if (file != null) receiptDraftKey: file};
}

class ReceiptDraftField extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReceiptDraftField({super.key, required this.draft});
  final ReceiptDraft draft;

  @override
  State<ReceiptDraftField> createState() => _ReceiptDraftFieldState();
}

class _ReceiptDraftFieldState extends State<ReceiptDraftField> {
  String? error;

  Future<void> pick() async {
    setState(() {
      widget.draft.picking = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final file = await PendingReceipt.pick();
      if (mounted && file != null) widget.draft.file = file;
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        error = e is FormatException
            ? e.message
            : 'No se pudo leer el archivo.';
      }
    } finally {
      widget.draft.picking = false;
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
    children: [
      TextButton.icon(
        onPressed: widget.draft.picking ? null : pick,
        icon: const Icon(Icons.attach_file),
        label: Text(
          widget.draft.picking
              ? 'Leyendoâ€¦'
              : widget.draft.file == null
              ? 'Adjuntar comprobante'
              : 'Cambiar comprobante',
        ),
      ),
      if (widget.draft.file case final file?)
        Wrap(
          crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Text(file.label, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Vista previa',
              onPressed: widget.draft.picking
                  ? null
                  : () => file.preview(context),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.visibility_outlined),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Quitar comprobante',
              onPressed: widget.draft.picking
                  ? null
                  : () => setState(() {
                      widget.draft.file = null;
                      error = null;
                    }),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      if (error case final message?)
        Text(
          message,
          style: TextStyle(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error),
        ),
    ],
  );
}

Future<bool> uploadSavedReceipt(
  BuildContext context, {
  required PendingReceipt receipt,
  required String uid,
  required String folder,
  bool person = false,
}) async {
  final bucket = supabase.storage.from(
    person ? 'person-receipts' : 'movement-receipts',
  );
  while (context.mounted) {
    try {
      await receipt.upload(bucket, folder, uid);
      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      if (!context.mounted || supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid)
        return false;
      final retry = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (dialog) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Registro guardado'),
          content: const Text(
            'No se confirmÃ³ la carga del comprobante. Puedes volver a intentar sin duplicar el registro.',
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialog, false),
              child: const Text('Cerrar'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialog, true),
              child: const Text('Reintentar carga'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      if (retry != true) return false;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

Future<void> attachFinancialReceipt(
  BuildContext context,
  PendingReceipt? receipt,
  String uid,
  String table,
  Object? id,
) async {
  if (receipt == null || !context.mounted) return;
  if (id == null || id.toString().isEmpty) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          'Registro guardado. Abre Comprobantes en el historial para adjuntar el archivo.',
        ),
      ),
    );
    return;
  }
  await uploadSavedReceipt(
    context,
    receipt: receipt,
    uid: uid,
    folder: '$table/$id',
  );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/person_account_repository.dart';

enum ReceiptFilter {
  all('Todos'),
  withReceipt('Con comprobante'),
  withoutReceipt('Sin comprobante');

  const ReceiptFilter(this.label);
  final String label;

  bool matches(int count) => switch (this) {
    all => true,
    withReceipt => count > 0,
    withoutReceipt => count == 0,
  };
}

typedef FinancialReceiptRef = ({String table, String id});

FinancialReceiptRef? financialReceiptRef(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
  final id = row['id']?.toString();
  if (id == null || id.isEmpty) return null;
  final parts = id.split(':');
  return switch (row['source']) {
    'credit_card_payment' => (table: 'credit_card_transactions', id: id),
    'debt_payment' => (table: 'debt_payments', id: id),
    'fx_transfer' => (
      table: row['uses_transaction_receipts'] == true
          ? 'transactions'
          : 'app_fx_transfers',
      id: id,
    ),
    'receivable_loan' when parts.length >= 3 => (
      table: parts[1] == 'payment'
          ? 'receivable_loan_payments'
          : 'receivable_loans',
      id: parts[2],
    ),
    'receivable_loan' => null,
    _ => (table: 'transactions', id: id),
  };
}

String? financialReceiptFolder(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
  final ref = financialReceiptRef(row);
  return ref == null ? null : '${ref.table}/${ref.id}';
}

Future<Map<String, int>> loadReceiptCounts(
  String uid,
  String bucket,
  Iterable<String> folders,
) async {
  final paths = folders.toSet().toList();
  final counts = <String, int>{};
  for (var start = 0; start < paths.length; start += 100) {
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    final rows =
        await supabase.rpc(
              'receipt_counts',
              params: {
                'p_bucket': bucket,
                'p_folders': paths.skip(start).take(100).toList(),
              },
            )
            as List;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    for (final row in rows) {
      counts[row['folder'] as String] = (row['total'] as num).toInt();
    }
  }
  if (bucket == 'movement-receipts') {
    final ids = paths
        .where((p) => p.startsWith('credit_card_transactions/'))
        .map((p) => p.split('/').last)
        .where((id) => RegExp(r'^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$').hasMatch(id))
        .toList();
    for (var start = 0; start < ids.length; start += 100) {
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      final rows =
          await supabase.rpc(
                'hold_receipt_counts',
                params: {
                  'p_transaction_ids': ids.skip(start).take(100).toList(),
                },
              )
              as List;
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      for (final row in rows) {
        final key = 'credit_card_transactions/${row['transaction_id']}';
        counts[key] = (counts[key] ?? 0) + (row['total'] as num).toInt();
      }
    }
  }
  return counts;
}

class ReceiptFilterField extends StatelessWidget {
  const ReceiptFilterField({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final ReceiptFilter value;
  final ValueChanged<ReceiptFilter> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DropdownButtonFormField<ReceiptFilter>(
    initialValue: value,
    isExpanded: true,
    decoration: const InputDecoration(
      labelText: 'Comprobantes',
      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.attach_file),
    ),
    items: [
      for (final filter in ReceiptFilter.values)
        DropdownMenuItem(value: filter, child: Text(filter.label)),
    ],
    onChanged: (filter) {
      if (filter != null) onChanged(filter);
    },
  );
}

class _ReceivableLoansDashboardState extends State<ReceivableLoansDashboard> {

  int requestId = 0;

    super.initState();
    loadData();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ReceivableLoansDashboard oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.refreshToken != widget.refreshToken) {
      loadData();
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final result = await loadReceivableLoanData(user.id);
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != user.id) {
        throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
      }
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        data = result;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

    }
  }

          else if (error != null)

class _ReceivableLoansPageState extends State<ReceivableLoansPage> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> loans = [],
      payments = [],
      accounts = [],
      creditCards = [];
  final search = TextEditingController();
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  String? error;
  String filter = 'pending';
  int requestId = 0;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    loadData();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void message(String text) {
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
    }
  }

  void checkSession(String userId) {
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
      throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Actualiza la pantalla.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final data = await loadReceivableLoanData(user.id);
      final accountRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('accounts')
            .select('id, name, currency, is_active')
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        accountRows.addAll(page);
        if (page.length < 500) {
          break;
        }
      }
      final cardRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('credit_cards')
            .select('id, name, card_reference, is_active')
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        cardRows.addAll(page);
        if (page.length < 500) {
          break;
        }
      }
      for (final l in data.loans.where((l) => l['is_voided'] != true)) {
        receivablePending(l, data.payments);
      }
      checkSession(user.id);
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        loans = data.loans;
        payments = data.payments;
        accounts = accountRows;
        creditCards = cardRows;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> createLoan() async {
    if (loading || saving) {
      return;
    }
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      message('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final data = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        context: context,

      checkSession(user.id);
      final receipt = data.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
      final saved = await supabase.rpc(
        'register_receivable_loan_v2',
        params: data,
      );
      if (receipt != null && mounted) {
        String table = 'receivable_loans';
        Object? id = saved;
        try {
          final row = await supabase
              .from('receivable_loans')
              .select('card_transaction_id')
              .eq('id', saved)

    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {

  Future<void> deleteLoan(Map<String, dynamic> loan) async {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    if (loan['is_voided'] != true) {
      message('Primero anula el prÃ©stamo antes de eliminarlo definitivamente.');

  String accountName(dynamic id) {
    for (final a in accounts) {
      if (a['id'].toString() == id?.toString()) {
        return a['name'].toString();
      }
    }
    return 'Cuenta no disponible';
  }

  String creditCardName(dynamic id) {
    for (final c in creditCards) {
      if (c['id'].toString() == id?.toString()) {
        return c['name'].toString();
      }
    }
    return 'Tarjeta no disponible';
  }

  Future<void> history(Map<String, dynamic> loan) async {
    final rows =
        payments
            .where((p) => p['loan_id'].toString() == loan['id'].toString())
            .toList()
          ..sort(
            (a, b) => DateTime.parse(
              b['payment_date'].toString(),
            ).compareTo(DateTime.parse(a['payment_date'].toString())),
          );
    final currency = loan['currency'].toString();
    final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    Map<String, int>? counts;
    var filter = ReceiptFilter.all;
    int countFor(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
        counts?['receivable_loan_payments/${row['id']}'] ?? 0;
    Future<void> refreshCounts() async {
      if (uid == null) return;
      try {
        counts = await loadReceiptCounts(
          uid,
          'movement-receipts',
          rows.map((row) => 'receivable_loan_payments/${row['id']}'),
        );
      } catch (_) {
        counts = null;
      }
    }

    await refreshCounts();
    if (!mounted || supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid) return;
    final selected = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, update) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text('Cobros Â· ${loan['borrower_name']}'),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 550,
            height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(ctx).height * 0.55,
            child: rows.isEmpty
                ? const Center(child: Text('TodavÃ­a no registras cobros.'))
                : ListView(
                    children: [
                      if (counts != null)
                        CollapsibleFilters(
                          children: [
                            ReceiptFilterField(
                              value: filter,
                              onChanged: (value) =>
                                  update(() => filter = value),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ...rows
                          .where(
                            (p) =>
                                counts == null || filter.matches(countFor(p)),
                          )
                          .map((p) {
                            final voided = p['is_voided'] == true;
                            return Card(
                              child: Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment:
                                      CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                  children: [
                                    Text(
                                      '${receivableDate(DateTime.parse(p['payment_date'].toString()).toLocal())}${voided ? ' Â· Anulado' : ''}',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    Text(
                                      'Capital: ${receivableMoney(moneyCents(p['principal_amount']), currency)}',
                                    ),
                                    Text(
                                      'Intereses: ${receivableMoney(moneyCents(p['interest_amount']), currency)}',
                                    ),
                                    Text(
                                      'Cuenta: ${accountName(p['account_id'])}',
                                    ),
                                    if ((p['reference']?.toString() ?? '')
                                        .isNotEmpty)
                                      SelectableText(
                                        'Referencia: ${p['reference']}',
                                      ),
                                    MovementReceiptsButton(
                                      table: 'receivable_loan_payments',
                                      record: p,
                                      count: countFor(p),
                                      onClosed: () async {
                                        await refreshCounts();
                                        if (ctx.mounted) update(() {});
                                      },
                                    ),
                                    if (voided)
                                      Text('Motivo: ${p['void_reason']}'),
                                    if (!voided)
                                      Align(
                                        alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                                        child: TextButton.icon(
                                          onPressed: () =>
                                              Navigator.pop(ctx, p),
                                          icon: const Icon(
                                            Icons.cancel_outlined,
                                          ),
                                          label: const Text('Anular cobro'),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            );
                          }),
                    ],
                  ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: const Text('Cerrar'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (selected != null && mounted) {
      await voidRecord(payment: selected);
    }
  }

  Widget loanCard(Map<String, dynamic> loan) {
    final currency = loan['currency'].toString();
    final pending = receivablePending(loan, payments);
    final original = moneyCents(loan['principal_amount']);
    final voided = loan['is_voided'] == true;
    final overdue = receivableOverdue(loan, pending, DateTime.now());
    final color = voided
        ? appMuted
        : overdue
        ? appNegative
        : pending == 0
        ? appPositive
        : appDueColor(DateTime.tryParse('${loan['due_date']}'));
    final due = DateTime.tryParse('${loan['due_date']}');
    final hasPayments = payments.any(
      (p) =>
          p['loan_id'].toString() == loan['id'].toString() &&
          p['is_voided'] != true,
    );
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),

import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/exchange_rate.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../data/receivable_loan_logic.dart';

class ReceivableLoansSummary extends StatelessWidget {
  const ReceivableLoansSummary({
    super.key,
    required this.loans,
    required this.payments,
    this.displayCurrency,
    this.exchangeRate,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> loans, payments;
  final String? displayCurrency;
  final ExchangeRate? exchangeRate;
  bool get consolidated => displayCurrency != null && exchangeRate != null;
  Widget currencyCard(BuildContext context, String currency) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final colors = theme.colorScheme;
    int present(int amount, dynamic from) => consolidated
        ? exchangeRate!.convert(amount, from.toString(), currency)
        : amount;
    var pending = 0, overdue = 0, count = 0, interests = 0;
    final active = loans
        .where(
          (l) =>
              l['is_voided'] != true &&
              (consolidated || l['currency'] == currency),
        )
        .toList();
    final ids = active.map((l) => l['id'].toString()).toSet();
    for (final loan in active) {
      final amount = receivablePending(loan, payments);
      pending += present(amount, loan['currency']);
      if (amount > 0) {
        count++;
      }
      if (receivableOverdue(loan, amount, DateTime.now())) {
        overdue += present(amount, loan['currency']);
      }
    }
    for (final p in payments) {
      if (p['is_voided'] != true &&
          (consolidated || p['currency'] == currency) &&
          ids.contains(p['loan_id'].toString())) {
        interests += present(moneyCents(p['interest_amount']), p['currency']);
      }
    }
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: colors.surface,
        border: Border.all(color: colors.outlineVariant),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Text(
            currency == 'USD' ? 'DÃ³lares' : 'CÃ³rdobas',
            style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          FittedBox(
            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: Text(
              receivableMoney(pending, currency),
              style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                color: colors.primary,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
            count == 1 ? '1 prÃ©stamo pendiente' : '$count prÃ©stamos pendientes',
            style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
          ),
          if (overdue > 0) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              'Vencido: ${receivableMoney(overdue, currency)}',
              style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: colors.error),
            ),
          ],
          if (interests != 0) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              'Intereses cobrados: ${receivableMoney(interests, currency)}',
              style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
    children: [
      Text(
        'Capital por cobrar',
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      AdaptiveColumns(
        minColumnWidth: 145,
        spacing: 8,
        children: [
          if (consolidated)
            currencyCard(context, displayCurrency!)
          else ...[
            currencyCard(context, 'NIO'),
            currencyCard(context, 'USD'),
          ],
        ],
      ),
      if (consolidated)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
          child: Text(
            'Total equivalente con la tasa de Configuraciones.',
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
          ),
        ),
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
        child: Text(
          'Disponible como efectivo al recibir el pago.',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
        ),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted;
import '../person_accounts/receipt_draft_field.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/receivable_loan_logic.dart';

String receivableDate(DateTime date) =>
    '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';
String receivableTimestamp(DateTime date) =>
    DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day, 12).toUtc().toIso8601String();
String? receivableAmountValidator(String? value) {
  final text = (value ?? '').trim();
  final amount = double.tryParse(text.replaceAll(',', '.'));
  if (amount == null || !amount.isFinite || amount < 0) {
    return 'Introduce un monto vÃ¡lido';
  }
  return RegExp(r'^\d+([.,]\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text)
      ? null
      : 'Usa mÃ¡ximo seis decimales, sin separadores de miles';
}

double receivableNumber(TextEditingController controller) =>
    double.parse(controller.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'));

class ReceivableLoanFormDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReceivableLoanFormDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.accounts,
    required this.creditCards,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts, creditCards;
  @override
  State<ReceivableLoanFormDialog> createState() =>
      _ReceivableLoanFormDialogState();
}

class _ReceivableLoanFormDialogState extends State<ReceivableLoanFormDialog> {
  final _receipt = ReceiptDraft();
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final borrower = TextEditingController(), amount = TextEditingController();
  final description = TextEditingController(),
      reference = TextEditingController();
  String currency = 'NIO';
  String? sourceId;
  bool historical = false;
  DateTime date = DateTime.now();
  DateTime? due;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    borrower.dispose();
    amount.dispose();
    description.dispose();
    reference.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void save() {
    if (_receipt.picking) return;
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      ..._receipt.fields,
      'p_borrower_name': borrower.text.trim(),
      'p_principal_amount': receivableNumber(amount),
      'p_currency': currency,
      'p_account_id': !historical && sourceId?.startsWith('account:') == true
          ? sourceId!.substring(8)
          : null,
      'p_credit_card_id': !historical && sourceId?.startsWith('credit:') == true
          ? sourceId!.substring(7)
          : null,
      'p_is_historical': historical,
      'p_loan_date': receivableTimestamp(date),
      'p_due_date': due == null
          ? null
          : '${due!.year}-${due!.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${due!.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
      'p_description': description.text.trim(),
      'p_reference': reference.text.trim(),
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final available = widget.accounts
        .where((a) => a['is_active'] == true && a['currency'] == currency)
        .toList();
    final sources = <String, String>{
      for (final a in available)
        'account:${a['id']}': 'Cuenta / dÃ©bito Â· ${a['name']} ($currency)',
      for (final c in widget.creditCards.where((c) => c['is_active'] == true))
        'credit:${c['id']}':
            'CrÃ©dito Â· ${c['name']}${(c['card_reference']?.toString() ?? '').isEmpty ? '' : ' Â· ${c['card_reference']}'}',
    };
    final creditSource = sourceId?.startsWith('credit:') == true;
    return AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('Dinero que prestÃ©'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 460,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: formKey,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                TextFormField(
                  controller: borrower,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                  autofocus: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Persona a quien prestaste',
                  ),
                  validator: (v) =>
                      (v ?? '').trim().isEmpty ? 'Escribe el nombre' : null,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                SwitchListTile.adaptive(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  value: historical,
                  title: const Text('PrÃ©stamo anterior a mis registros'),
                  subtitle: const Text(
                    'No descuenta cuentas ni crea cargos nuevos de tarjeta.',
                  ),
                  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => historical = v),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: currency,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Moneda'),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'NIO',
                      child: Text('CÃ³rdobas (C\$)'),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'USD', child: Text('DÃ³lares (\$)')),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (v) {
                    if (v != null) {
                      setState(() {
                        currency = v;
                        sourceId = null;
                      });
                    }
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: amount,
                  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                    decimal: true,
                  ),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: historical
                        ? 'Capital que todavÃ­a te deben'
                        : 'Capital prestado',
                    helperText: historical
                        ? 'Registra solo lo pendiente al comenzar este historial.'
                        : creditSource
                        ? 'Se crea un cargo vinculado en tu tarjeta, en la moneda seleccionada.'
                        : 'Sale de tu cuenta, sin contarse como gasto.',
                    helperMaxLines: 3,
                  ),
                  validator: (v) {
                    final error = receivableAmountValidator(v);
                    if (error != null) {
                      return error;
                    }
                    return receivableNumber(amount) <= 0
                        ? 'El capital debe ser mayor que cero'
                        : null;
                  },
                ),
                if (!historical) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    key: ValueKey('source-$currency'),
                    initialValue: sourceId,
                    isExpanded: true,

                      labelText: 'De dÃ³nde saliÃ³',
                    ),

                        .map(
                          (e) => DropdownMenuItem(
                            value: e.key,
                            child: Text(
                              e.value,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            ),
                          ),
                        )
                        .toList(),

                        ? 'Selecciona una cuenta o tarjeta activa'

                      'No hay cuentas en esta moneda ni tarjetas de crÃ©dito activas.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFB13D32)),
                    ),
                  if (creditSource)
                    Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),

                        'No registres otra compra manual por este mismo prÃ©stamo. El cargo se crea al guardar.',

                      ),

                  },

                  controller: reference,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Referencia (opcional)',
                  ),

            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        ReceiptDraftField(draft: _receipt),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cancelar'),
        ),
        FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Guardar prÃ©stamo')),
      ],
    );
  }

class ReceivableLoanPaymentDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReceivableLoanPaymentDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.loan,
    required this.pendingCents,
    required this.accounts,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> loan;
  final int pendingCents;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts;
  @override
  State<ReceivableLoanPaymentDialog> createState() =>
      _ReceivableLoanPaymentDialogState();
}

class _ReceivableLoanPaymentDialogState
    extends State<ReceivableLoanPaymentDialog> {
  final _receipt = ReceiptDraft();
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final capital = TextEditingController(text: '0.00'),
      interest = TextEditingController(text: '0.00');
  final reference = TextEditingController();
  String? accountId;
  DateTime date = DateTime.now();
  String? error;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    capital.dispose();
    interest.dispose();
    reference.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void save() {
    if (_receipt.picking) return;
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    final principal = receivableNumber(capital),
        fees = receivableNumber(interest);
    if ((principal * moneyScale).round() > widget.pendingCents) {
      setState(() => error = 'El capital cobrado supera lo pendiente.');
      return;
    }
    if (principal + fees <= 0) {
      setState(() => error = 'El total debe ser mayor que cero.');
      return;
    }
    Navigator.pop(context, <String, dynamic>{
      ..._receipt.fields,
      'p_loan_id': widget.loan['id'],
      'p_account_id': accountId,
      'p_principal_amount': principal,
      'p_interest_amount': fees,
      'p_payment_date': receivableTimestamp(date),
      'p_reference': reference.text.trim(),
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final currency = widget.loan['currency'].toString();
    final loanDate = DateTime.parse(
      widget.loan['loan_date'].toString(),
    ).toLocal();
    final firstDate = DateTime(loanDate.year, loanDate.month, loanDate.day);
    return AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('Registrar dinero recibido'),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 430,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: formKey,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text(
                  widget.loan['borrower_name'].toString(),
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Text(
                  'Capital pendiente: ${receivableMoney(widget.pendingCents, currency)}',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: capital,
                  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                    decimal: true,
                  ),
                  validator: receivableAmountValidator,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Capital devuelto ($currency)',
                    helperText: 'No se cuenta como ingreso.',
                  ),
                ),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => setState(
                    () => capital.text = (widget.pendingCents / moneyScale)
                        .toStringAsFixed(6),
                  ),
                  child: const Text('Cobrar todo el capital pendiente'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: interest,
                  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                    decimal: true,
                  ),
                  validator: receivableAmountValidator,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Intereses cobrados ($currency)',
                    helperText: 'SÃ­ se cuentan como ingreso.',
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: accountId,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Cuenta que recibe el dinero',
                  ),
                  items: widget.accounts
                      .map(
                        (a) => DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: a['id'].toString(),
                          child: Text(
                            a['name'].toString(),
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                      )
                      .toList(),
                  validator: (v) => v == null ? 'Selecciona una cuenta' : null,
                  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => accountId = v),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined),
                  label: Text(receivableDate(date)),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final selected = await showDatePicker(
                      context: context,
                      initialDate: date,
                      firstDate: firstDate,
                      lastDate: DateTime.now(),
                    );
                    if (selected != null && mounted) {
                      setState(() => date = selected);
                    }
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: reference,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Referencia (opcional)',
                  ),
                ),
                if (error != null)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                    child: Text(
                      error!,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        ReceiptDraftField(draft: _receipt),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cancelar'),
        ),
        FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Registrar cobro')),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import '../../data/recurring_share_logic.dart';
import '../../core/status_colors.dart';

class RecurringExpensesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const RecurringExpensesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<RecurringExpensesPage> createState() => _RecurringExpensesPageState();
}

enum _ExpenseAction { adjustment, edit, delete }

class _RecurringExpensesPageState extends State<RecurringExpensesPage> {
  DateTime month = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month);
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> expenses = [], categories = [];
  Set<(String, String)> checkedMonths = {};
  Map<(String, String), Map<String, dynamic>> monthlyExtras = {};
  Map<(String, String), ({int cents, String currency})> monthlyTotals = {};
  bool loading = true, saving = false, showInactive = false;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;
  FinancialSettings? financialSettings;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  void message(String text) {
    if (mounted)
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = personUserId();
      final rows = await Future.wait([
        personRows('recurring_expenses', uid),
        personRows('recurring_expense_checks', uid),
        personRows('categories', uid),
        personRows('recurring_expense_monthly_totals', uid),
        personRows('recurring_expense_fixed_extras', uid),
      ]);
      final settings = await loadFinancialSettings();
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) return;
      rows[0].sort(
        (a, b) => '${a['name']}'.toLowerCase().compareTo(
          '${b['name']}'.toLowerCase(),
        ),
      );
      setState(() {
        expenses = rows[0];
        financialSettings = settings;
        checkedMonths = {
          for (final row in rows[1])
            ('${row['recurring_expense_id']}', '${row['period']}'),
        };
        categories = rows[2];
        monthlyTotals = {
          for (final row in rows[3])
            ('${row['recurring_expense_id']}', '${row['period']}'): (
              cents: moneyCents(row['amount']),
              currency: '${row['currency']}',
            ),
        };
        monthlyExtras = {
          for (final row in rows[4])
            ('${row['recurring_expense_id']}', '${row['period']}'): row,
        };
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId)
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  Future<void> run(Future<void> Function(String) action) async {
    if (saving || loading) return;
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await action(personUserId());
      if (mounted) await load();
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo completar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  bool isVariable(Map<String, dynamic> expense) =>
      expense['tracking_type'] == 'variable';

  bool isChecked(Map<String, dynamic> expense) =>
      checkedMonths.contains(('${expense['id']}', isoDay(month)));

  Future<void> setChecked(Map<String, dynamic> expense, bool checked) async {
    if (saving ||
        loading ||
        error != null ||
        isVariable(expense) ||
        !recurringInMonth(expense, month)) {
      return;
    }
    final id = '${expense['id']}', period = isoDay(month);
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final uid = personUserId();
      final table = supabase.from('recurring_expense_checks');
      if (checked) {
        await table.upsert(
          {'user_id': uid, 'recurring_expense_id': id, 'period': period},
          onConflict: 'recurring_expense_id,period',
          ignoreDuplicates: true,
        );
      } else {
        await table
            .delete()
            .eq('user_id', uid)
            .eq('recurring_expense_id', id)
            .eq('period', period);
      }
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (checked) {
          checkedMonths.add((id, period));
        } else {
          checkedMonths.remove((id, period));
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo guardar la marca del mes: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> edit([Map<String, dynamic>? expense]) => run((uid) async {
    final type = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => SimpleDialog(
        title: Text(
          expense == null
              ? 'Tipo de gasto mensual'
              : 'Editar ${expense['name']}',
        ),
        children: [
          ListTile(
            leading: const Icon(Icons.checklist),
            title: const Text('Fijo'),
            subtitle: const Text('Monto previsto y casilla de pagado'),
            selected: expense != null && !isVariable(expense),
            onTap: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, 'fixed'),
          ),
          ListTile(
            leading: const Icon(Icons.edit_note),
            title: const Text('Variable'),
            subtitle: const Text('Acumulado mensual ingresado a mano'),
            selected: expense != null && isVariable(expense),
            onTap: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, 'variable'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (type == null || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    final variable = type == 'variable';
    final choices = {
      for (final c in categories.where(
        (c) =>
            c['category_type'] == 'expense' &&
            (c['is_active'] == true || c['id'] == expense?['category_id']),
      ))
        '${c['id']}': '${c['name']}',
    };
    if (!variable && choices.isEmpty)
      throw StateError('Primero crea una categorÃ­a activa de gasto.');
    final values = await zeroForm(
      context,
      expense == null ? 'Nuevo gasto mensual' : 'Editar gasto mensual',
      [
        const ZeroField('name', 'Nombre del gasto'),
        if (!variable) ...[
          const ZeroField('amount', 'Monto total mensual', type: 'money'),
          const ZeroField(
            'discount_amount',
            'Descuento (opcional)',
            type: 'money',
            zero: true,
            required: false,
          ),
        ],
        const ZeroField(
          'currency',
          'Moneda',
          type: 'choice',
          options: {'NIO': 'CÃ³rdobas Â· NIO', 'USD': 'DÃ³lares Â· USD'},
        ),
        if (!variable)
          ZeroField(
            'category_id',
            'CategorÃ­a de gasto',
            type: 'choice',
            options: choices,
          ),
        if (!variable)
          ZeroField(
            'due_day',
            'DÃ­a de vencimiento',
            type: 'choice',
            options: {for (var day = 1; day <= 31; day++) '$day': '$day'},
          ),
        const ZeroField('starts_on', 'Desde', type: 'date'),
        if (!variable)
          const ZeroField(
            'ends_on',
            'Hasta (opcional)',
            type: 'date',
            required: false,
          ),
        const ZeroField('is_active', 'Activo', type: 'bool'),
        const ZeroField('notes', 'Notas (opcional)', required: false),
      ],
      initial: {
        'currency': 'NIO',
        'starts_on': isoDay(variable ? month : DateTime.now()),
        'is_active': true,
        ...?expense,
        'due_day': '${expense?['due_day'] ?? 1}',
        'amount': expense != null && (expense['split_count'] as num? ?? 1) > 1
            ? (moneyCents(expense['amount']) +
                      moneyCents(expense['discount_amount'] ?? 0)) /
                  moneyScale
            : expense?['gross_amount'] ?? expense?['amount'] ?? '',
        'discount_amount': expense?['discount_amount'] ?? 0,
      },
      info: variable
          ? 'Es un control informativo. DespuÃ©s podrÃ¡s editar el acumulado del mes en la tarjeta.'
          : 'Monto mensual previsto = monto total âˆ’ descuento. Es una previsiÃ³n; registra tu gasto real en Movimientos. El ajuste del mes se aplica despuÃ©s.',
    );
    if (values == null || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    final total = variable ? 0 : moneyCents(values['amount']);
    final discount = variable ? 0 : moneyCents(values['discount_amount'] ?? 0);
    const people = 1;
    final own = variable ? 0 : recurringOwnShare(total, discount, people);
    final data = {
      ...values,
      'gross_amount': variable ? null : total / moneyScale,
      'discount_amount': discount / moneyScale,
      'split_count': people,
      if (!variable) 'amount': own / moneyScale,
      'tracking_type': type,
      'due_day': variable ? null : int.parse('${values['due_day']}'),
      if (variable) ...{'amount': null, 'category_id': null, 'ends_on': null},
      'notes': values['notes'] ?? '',
    };
    if (expense != null &&
        values['currency'] != expense['currency'] &&
        monthlyExtras.values.any(
          (extra) =>
              extra['recurring_expense_id'] == expense['id'] &&
              moneyCents(extra['amount']) != 0,
        )) {
      throw StateError(
        'Este gasto tiene extras mensuales en su moneda actual. Crea otro gasto para usar otra moneda.',
      );
    }
    if (expense == null) {
      await supabase.from('recurring_expenses').insert({
        ...data,
        'user_id': uid,
      });
    } else {
      await supabase
          .from('recurring_expenses')
          .update(data)
          .eq('id', expense['id'])
          .eq('user_id', uid)
          .select('id')
          .single();
    }
  });

  Future<void> deleteExpense(Map<String, dynamic> expense) async {
    if (saving || loading || error != null) return;
    final owner = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (owner == null) return;
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text('Eliminar ${expense['name']}'),
        content: const Text(
          'Se eliminarÃ¡ el gasto de la lista junto con sus marcas y acumulados de todos los meses. Los registros de Movimientos se conservan.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('Eliminar gasto'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed != true || !mounted || error != null) return;
    await run((uid) async {
      checkPersonSession(owner);
      final deleted = await supabase
          .from('recurring_expenses')
          .delete()
          .eq('id', expense['id'])
          .eq('user_id', uid)
          .select('id')
          .maybeSingle();
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      message(
        deleted == null
            ? 'El gasto ya no estÃ¡ disponible.'
            : 'Gasto eliminado.',
      );
    });
  }

  Widget expenseMenu(Map<String, dynamic> expense) =>
      PopupMenuButton<_ExpenseAction>(
        tooltip: 'Opciones de ${expense['name']}',
        enabled: !saving,
        onSelected: (action) async {
          switch (action) {
            case _ExpenseAction.adjustment:
              await editExtra(expense);
            case _ExpenseAction.edit:
              await edit(expense);
            case _ExpenseAction.delete:
              await deleteExpense(expense);
          }
        },
        itemBuilder: (_) => [
          if (recurringInMonth(expense, month))
            PopupMenuItem(
              value: _ExpenseAction.adjustment,
              child: Text(
                extraCents(expense) != 0
                    ? 'Editar ajuste del mes'
                    : 'Agregar ajuste del mes',
              ),
            ),
          const PopupMenuItem(
            value: _ExpenseAction.edit,
            child: Text('Editar gasto'),
          ),
          const PopupMenuItem(
            value: _ExpenseAction.delete,
            child: Text('Eliminar gasto'),
          ),
        ],
      );

  Future<void> editMonthlyTotal(Map<String, dynamic> expense) async {
    if (saving || loading || error != null) return;
    final id = '${expense['id']}', period = isoDay(month);
    final saved = monthlyTotals[(id, period)];
    final currency = saved?.currency ?? '${expense['currency']}';
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final uid = personUserId();
      final values = await zeroForm(
        context,
        'Acumulado de ${expense['name']}',
        [
          ZeroField(
            'amount',
            'Acumulado base del mes ($currency)',
            type: 'money',
            zero: true,
          ),
        ],
        initial: {
          'amount': (((saved?.cents ?? 0) - extraCents(expense)) / moneyScale)
              .toStringAsFixed(6),
        },
        info:
            'Escribe el acumulado base. Reemplaza al anterior; el ajuste del mes se aplica por separado al total mostrado.',
      );
      if (values == null || !mounted) return;
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      final cents = moneyCents(values['amount']) + extraCents(expense);
      if (cents < 0)
        throw StateError('El ajuste deja el total por debajo de cero.');
      await supabase.rpc(
        'set_recurring_variable_total',
        params: {
          'p_expense': id,
          'p_period': period,
          'p_amount': cents / moneyScale,
          'p_currency': currency,
        },
      );
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (mounted)
        setState(
          () =>
              monthlyTotals[(id, period)] = (cents: cents, currency: currency),
        );
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo guardar el acumulado: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

  Widget variableCard(Map<String, dynamic> expense, {required bool inMonth}) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final total = monthlyTotals[('${expense['id']}', isoDay(month))];
    final amount = formatMoneyCents(
      total?.cents ?? 0,
      total?.currency ?? '${expense['currency']}',
    );
    final notes = '${expense['notes'] ?? ''}'.trim();
    return Card(
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 8, 12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
