            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    '${expense['name']}',
                    style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium,
                  ),
                ),
                expenseMenu(expense),
              ],

            const Text('Gastado este mes'),
            Text(amount, style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge),

              Text(
                'Ajuste del mes: ${formatMoneyCents(extraCents(expense), total?.currency ?? '${expense['currency']}')}',

  }

  Future<void> configureRate() => run((uid) async {
    final values = await zeroForm(
      context,
      'Tasa de cambio del sistema',
      const [ZeroField('rate', 'CÃ³rdobas por un dÃ³lar')],
      initial: {'rate': financialSettings?.rate.decimal ?? ''},
    );
    if (values == null || !mounted) return;
    final rate = ExchangeRate.tryParse('${values['rate']}');
    if (rate == null)
      throw StateError('Ingresa una tasa positiva con hasta seis decimales.');
    await saveFinancialSettings(rate, uid);
  });

  void changeMonth(int offset) {
    setState(() => month = DateTime(month.year, month.month + offset));
  }

  int extraCents(Map<String, dynamic> expense) {
    final extra = monthlyExtras[('${expense['id']}', isoDay(month))];
    return extra == null ? 0 : moneyCents(extra['amount']);
  }

  Future<void> editExtra(Map<String, dynamic> expense) => run((uid) async {
    final period = isoDay(month);
    final extra = monthlyExtras[('${expense['id']}', period)];
    final values = await zeroForm(
      context,
      'Ajuste de ${expense['name']}',
      const [
        ZeroField(
          'amount',
          'Ajuste del mes (+ o âˆ’)',
          type: 'money',
          zero: true,
          signed: true,
        ),
        ZeroField('reason', 'Motivo (opcional)', required: false),
      ],
      initial: {
        'amount':
            ((extra == null ? 0 : moneyCents(extra['amount'])) / moneyScale)
                .toStringAsFixed(6),
        'reason': extra?['reason'] ?? '',
      },
      info:
          'Un valor positivo aumenta el total y uno negativo lo reduce solo en este mes. Ejemplo: -25 para reducir una cuota de 100 a 75. Usa 0 para quitar el ajuste. Registra el pago real en Movimientos.',
    );
    if (values == null || !mounted) return;
    checkPersonSession(uid);
    final baseAmount = isVariable(expense)
        ? (monthlyTotals[('${expense['id']}', period)]?.cents ?? 0) -
              extraCents(expense)
        : moneyCents(expense['amount']);
    if (baseAmount + moneyCents(values['amount']) < 0) {
      throw StateError(
        'El ajuste no puede dejar el total del mes por debajo de cero.',
      );
    }
    await supabase.rpc(
      isVariable(expense)
          ? 'set_recurring_variable_extra'
          : 'set_recurring_fixed_extra',
      params: {
        'p_expense': expense['id'],
        'p_period': period,
        'p_amount': moneyCents(values['amount']) / moneyScale,
        'p_currency': isVariable(expense)
            ? (monthlyTotals[('${expense['id']}', period)]?.currency ??
                  expense['currency'])
            : expense['currency'],
        'p_reason': values['reason'] ?? '',
      },
    );
    checkPersonSession(uid);
  });

  Widget section(
    String title,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> items, {
    bool inMonth = true,
  }) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 22),
    child: Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Text(
          '$title Â· ${items.length}',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        AdaptiveColumns(
          minColumnWidth: 340,
          maxColumns: 3,
          children: [
            for (final item in [
              ...items.where((item) => item['currency'] == 'USD'),
              ...items.where((item) => item['currency'] != 'USD'),
            ])
              if (isVariable(item))
                variableCard(item, inMonth: inMonth)
              else
                serviceCard(item, inMonth: inMonth),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final pending = <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
        paid = <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
        inactive = <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
        variables = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final plannedAmounts = {'NIO': 0, 'USD': 0};
    final pendingAmounts = {'NIO': 0, 'USD': 0};
    final variableAmounts = {'NIO': 0, 'USD': 0};
    final period = isoDay(month);
    var hasVariableTotals = false;
    final variableIds = {
      for (final expense in expenses.where(isVariable)) '${expense['id']}',
    };
    for (final entry in monthlyTotals.entries) {
      if (entry.key.$2 != period || !variableIds.contains(entry.key.$1)) {
        continue;
      }
      final total = entry.value;
      final subtotal = variableAmounts[total.currency];
      if (subtotal == null) continue;
      variableAmounts[total.currency] = subtotal + total.cents;
      hasVariableTotals = true;
    }
    for (final expense in expenses) {
      if (!recurringInMonth(expense, month)) {
        inactive.add(expense);
        continue;
      }
      if (isVariable(expense)) {
        variables.add(expense);
        continue;
      }
      final currency = '${expense['currency']}';
      final amount = moneyCents(expense['amount']) + extraCents(expense);
      plannedAmounts[currency] = plannedAmounts[currency]! + amount;
      if (isChecked(expense)) {
        paid.add(expense);
      } else {
        pending.add(expense);
        pendingAmounts[currency] = pendingAmounts[currency]! + amount;
      }
    }
    pending.sort(
      (a, b) => recurringDue(a, month).compareTo(recurringDue(b, month)),
    );
    final count = pending.length + paid.length;
    final compact = compactLayout(context);
    final add = loading || saving || error != null ? null : () => edit();
    const months = [
      'Enero',
      'Febrero',
      'Marzo',
      'Abril',
      'Mayo',
      'Junio',
      'Julio',
      'Agosto',
      'Septiembre',
      'Octubre',
      'Noviembre',
      'Diciembre',
    ];
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Gastos fijos y suscripciones'),
        actions: [
          const AppHelpButton(topic: 'recurring'),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Actualizar',
            onPressed: loading || saving ? null : load,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: compact
          ? CompactActionBar(label: 'Nuevo gasto mensual', onPressed: add)
          : null,
      floatingActionButton: compact
          ? null
          : FloatingActionButton.extended(
              onPressed: add,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
              label: const Text('Nuevo gasto mensual'),
            ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: widePageMaxWidth),
            child: loading
                ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                : RefreshIndicator(
                    onRefresh: () async {
                      if (!saving) await load();
                    },
                    child: ListView(
                      primary: false,
                      physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                        pageGutter(context),
                        12,
                        pageGutter(context),
                        compact ? 24 : 100,
                      ),
                      children: [
                        if (error case final problem?) ...[
                          const Text('No se pudo cargar la lista mensual.'),
                          SelectableText(problem),
                          TextButton(
                            onPressed: load,
                            child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                          ),
                        ] else ...[
                          Card(
                            margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
                            color: theme.colorScheme.primaryContainer,
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                children: [
                                  Row(
                                    children: [
                                      IconButton(
                                        tooltip: 'Mes anterior',
                                        onPressed: saving
                                            ? null
                                            : () => changeMonth(-1),
                                        icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left),
                                      ),
                                      Expanded(
                                        child: Text(
                                          '${months[month.month - 1]} ${month.year}',
                                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                          style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      IconButton(
                                        tooltip: 'Mes siguiente',
                                        onPressed: saving
                                            ? null
                                            : () => changeMonth(1),
                                        icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                  if (count > 0) ...[
                                    Text(
                                      '${paid.length} de $count gastos fijos marcados como pagados',
                                      style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall,
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (count > 0 ||
                              variables.isNotEmpty ||
                              hasVariableTotals) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            monthlySummary(
                              plannedAmounts,
                              variableAmounts,
                              pendingAmounts,
                            ),
                            if (paid.isNotEmpty) section('Pagados', paid),
                            if (pending.isNotEmpty)
                              section('Pendientes', pending),
                          ],
                          if (variables.isNotEmpty)
                            section('Gastos variables', variables),
                          if (count == 0 &&
                              variables.isEmpty &&
                              !hasVariableTotals)
                            const Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 24),
                              child: Text(
                                'No hay servicios activos para este mes. Puedes agregar agua, luz, internet u otra suscripciÃ³n.',
                              ),
                            ),
                          if (inactive.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 16),
                            CollapsibleFilters(
                              children: [
                                SwitchListTile(
                                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                                  title: const Text(
                                    'Mostrar servicios pausados o fuera del mes',
                                  ),
                                  value: showInactive,
                                  onChanged: (value) =>
                                      setState(() => showInactive = value),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                            if (showInactive)
                              section(
                                'Otros servicios',
                                inactive,
                                inMonth: false,
                              ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/exchange_rate.dart';
import 'expense_report_widgets.dart';

class CategoryExpensesDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  const CategoryExpensesDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.currency,
    required this.expenses,
    this.exchangeRate,
  });
  final String name, currency;
  final ExchangeRate? exchangeRate;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> expenses;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(expenses)
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final first = DateTime.tryParse('${a['transaction_date']}');
        final second = DateTime.tryParse('${b['transaction_date']}');
        if (first == null) return second == null ? 0 : 1;
        if (second == null) return -1;
        return second.compareTo(first);
      });
    int charges = 0, refunds = 0;
    for (final tx in rows) {
      final amount = expenseReportAmount(tx, currency, exchangeRate);
      if (amount < 0) {
        refunds += -amount;
      } else {
        charges += amount;
      }
    }

    return Dialog(
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 580,
        height: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * 0.82,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 8, 8),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      name,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 19,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Cerrar',
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 20),
                children: [
                  ExpenseReportSummary(
                    currency: currency,
                    chargesCents: charges,
                    refundsCents: refunds,
                    count: rows.length,
                    compact: true,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  const Text(
                    'Detalle de movimientos',
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  if (rows.isEmpty)
                    const Text('No hay movimientos para mostrar.'),
                  ...rows.map(
                    (tx) => ExpenseDetailTile(
                      transaction: tx,
                      currency: currency,
                      exchangeRate: exchangeRate,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  @override

      'all',

    int nativeTotal(String currency) => report.totals
        .singleWhere(
          (t) => t.currency == currency && t.label == 'Gasto neto total',
        )
        .cents;
    final rate = exchangeRate;
    final selected = movements.where((m) => inReportRange(m.date, start, end));
    return Card(
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text('Gastos consolidados', style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge),
            Text(
              '${reportDate(start)} â€“ ${reportDate(end)}',
              style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

class ExpenseCategoryCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const ExpenseCategoryCard({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.currency,

int expenseReportAmount(
  Map<String, dynamic> transaction,
  String currency,
  ExchangeRate? exchangeRate,
) {
  final amount = moneyCents(transaction['amount']);
  return exchangeRate?.convert(
        amount,
        transaction['currency'] as String,
        currency,
      ) ??
      amount;
}

class ExpenseDetailTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const ExpenseDetailTile({
    super.key,
    required this.transaction,
    required this.currency,
    this.exchangeRate,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> transaction;
  final String currency;
  final ExchangeRate? exchangeRate;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tx = transaction;
    final card = tx['source'] == 'credit_card';
    final debt = tx['source'] == 'debt_payment';
    final originalCurrency = tx['currency'] as String;
    final originalAmount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    final amount = expenseReportAmount(tx, currency, exchangeRate);
    final refund = originalAmount < 0;
    String component(int cents) => expenseMoney(
      exchangeRate?.convert(cents, originalCurrency, currency) ?? cents,
      currency,
    );
    final color = refund ? const Color(0xFF397455) : primaryColor;
    final description = tx['description']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final reference = tx['reference']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final cardLabel = tx['card_label']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final date = DateTime.tryParse('${tx['transaction_date']}')?.toLocal();
    final dateText = date == null
        ? 'Fecha no disponible'
        : '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/'
              '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';
    const cardTypes = {
      'purchase': 'Compra',
      'interest': 'Intereses',
      'fee': 'ComisiÃ³n',
      'refund': 'DevoluciÃ³n',
    };
    final insurance = debt ? moneyCents(tx['insurance_amount'] ?? 0) : 0;
    final otherFees = debt ? moneyCents(tx['fee_amount']) - insurance : 0;
    final label = debt
        ? 'Abono de deuda'
        : isCardInsuranceExpense(tx)
        ? 'Seguro de tarjeta'
        : card && tx['charge_kind'] == cardRebate
        ? cardRebateLabel
        : card && tx['charge_kind'] == cardPointsRedemption
        ? cardPointsRedemptionLabel
        : card
        ? cardTypes[tx['card_transaction_type']] ?? 'Tarjeta'
        : 'Gasto de cuenta';

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: appSurfaceSubtle,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Icon(
            refund
                ? Icons.undo_rounded
                : debt
                ? Icons.payments_outlined
                : card
                ? Icons.credit_card_outlined
                : Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
            color: color,
            size: 22,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text(
                  description.isEmpty ? label : description,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 5),
                Text(
                  '$dateText Â· $label',
                  style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14),
                ),
                if (card && cardLabel.isNotEmpty)
                  Text(
                    cardLabel,
                    style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                const SizedBox(height: 9),
                Text(
                  expenseMoney(amount, currency),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: color,
                  ),
                ),
                if (originalCurrency != currency)
                  Text(
                    'Original Â· ${expenseMoney(originalAmount, originalCurrency)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                if (debt) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 7),
                  Text(
                    'Capital: ${component(moneyCents(tx['principal_amount']))}',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    'Intereses: ${component(moneyCents(tx['interest_amount']))}',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                  if (insurance != 0)
                    Text(
                      'Seguro: ${component(insurance)}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                  if (otherFees != 0)
                    Text(
                      'Comisiones y otros cargos: ${component(otherFees)}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                ],
                if (reference.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 7),
                  SelectableText(
                    'Referencia: $reference',
                    style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ExportReportsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ExportReportsPage({
    super.key,
    this.initialPersonId,
    this.initialKind,
    this.initialStart,
    this.initialEnd,
  });
  final String? initialKind;
  final DateTime? initialStart, initialEnd;
  final String? initialPersonId;
  @override
  State<ExportReportsPage> createState() => _ExportReportsPageState();
}

class _ExportReportsPageState extends State<ExportReportsPage> {
  String kind = 'movements', currency = 'all';
  IncomeExpenseSelection selection = IncomeExpenseSelection.both;
  bool busy = false, loadingPeople = true, allHistory = true;
  String? personId, peopleError, cardId, accountId, additionalCardFilter;
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>? additionalCards;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> creditCards = [],
      debitCards = [],
      bankAccounts = [];
  final reportOwner = TextEditingController();
  final settlementRate = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    reportOwner.dispose();
    settlementRate.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> people = [];
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    kind = widget.initialKind ?? 'movements';
    start = widget.initialStart ?? start;
    end = widget.initialEnd ?? end;
    personId = widget.initialPersonId;
    if (personId != null) kind = 'person';
    loadPeople();
  }

  String accountBankLabel(Map account) {
    final institution = account['financial_institutions'];
    final bank = institution is Map
        ? institution['name']?.toString().trim() ?? ''
        : '';
    if (bank.isNotEmpty) return bank;
    return account['account_type'] == 'cash' ? 'Efectivo' : 'Banco sin asignar';
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> loadReportAdditionals(
    String cardId,
  ) async {
    return loadAdditionalCards(cardId, personUserId());
  }

  Widget additionalCardSelector() {
    return FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      key: ValueKey(cardId),
      future: additionalCards,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
          return const LinearProgressIndicator(
            semanticsLabel: 'Cargando tarjetas adicionales',
          );
        }
        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return ListTile(
            contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            title: const Text(
              'No se pudieron cargar las tarjetas adicionales.',
            ),
            trailing: TextButton(
              onPressed: busy
                  ? null
                  : () => setState(() {
                      additionalCards = loadReportAdditionals(cardId!);
                    }),
              child: const Text('Reintentar'),
            ),
          );
        }
        final cards = snapshot.data ?? const [];
        return DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
          initialValue: additionalCardFilter ?? 'all',
          isExpanded: true,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
            labelText: 'Tarjeta del movimiento',
          ),
          items: [
            const DropdownMenuItem(
              value: 'all',
              child: Text('Titular y adicionales'),
            ),
            const DropdownMenuItem(value: '', child: Text('Solo titular')),
            for (final card in cards)
              DropdownMenuItem(
                value: '${card['id']}',
                child: Text(
                  'Adicional Â· ${additionalCardLabel(card)}'
                  '${card['is_active'] == true ? '' : ' Â· Inactiva'}',
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
          ],
          onChanged: busy
              ? null
              : (value) => setState(() {
                  additionalCardFilter = value == 'all' ? null : value;
                  clear();
                }),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> loadPeople() async {
    setState(() {
      loadingPeople = true;
      peopleError = null;
    });
    try {
      final uid = personUserId();
      final rows = await personRows('person_accounts', uid);
      final accountRows = await statementRows(
        'accounts',
        'id,name,currency,account_type,financial_institutions(name)',
        uid,
      );
      final cardRows = await supabase
          .from('credit_cards')
          .select('id,name,card_reference,financial_institutions(name)')
          .eq('user_id', uid)
          .order('name');
      final debitRows = await supabase
          .from('debit_cards')
          .select(
            'id,name,network,card_reference,financial_institutions(name),accounts(name,financial_institutions(name))',
          )
          .eq('user_id', uid)
          .order('id');
      String? profileName;
      try {
        final profile = await supabase
            .from('profiles')
            .select('full_name')
            .eq('id', uid)
            .maybeSingle();
        profileName = profile?['full_name']?.toString();
      } catch (_) {
        /* El nombre puede indicarse manualmente para este reporte. */
      }

      String? suggestedPaymentRate;
      try {
        suggestedPaymentRate = (await loadFinancialSettings())?.rate.decimal;
      } catch (_) {
        /* Se puede indicar la tasa manualmente. */
      }
      rows.sort(
        (a, b) => '${a['name']}'.toLowerCase().compareTo(
          '${b['name']}'.toLowerCase(),
        ),
      );
      checkPersonSession(uid);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (reportOwner.text.trim().isEmpty)
          reportOwner.text = profileName?.trim() ?? '';
        if (settlementRate.text.trim().isEmpty && suggestedPaymentRate != null)
          settlementRate.text = suggestedPaymentRate;
        people = rows;
        bankAccounts = accountRows;
        creditCards = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(cardRows);
        debitCards = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(debitRows);
        loadingPeople = false;
        if (!rows.any((p) => '${p['id']}' == personId)) personId = null;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          peopleError = '$e';
          loadingPeople = false;
        });
    }
  }

  DateTime start = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month),
      end = DateTime.now(),
      month = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month);
  ExportReport? report;
  Uint8List? excel, pdf;
  String? error, pdfNotice, preparedUser;
  void clear() {
    report = null;
    excel = null;
    pdf = null;
    error = null;
    pdfNotice = null;
    preparedUser = null;
  }

  void message(String text) {
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
    }
  }

  Future<void> prepare() async {
    if (busy) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      clear();
      busy = true;
    });
    try {
      final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
      if (uid == null) {
        throw StateError('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n.');
      }
      if (kind == 'person' && reportOwner.text.trim().isEmpty)
        throw StateError(
          'Escribe tu nombre para identificar quiÃ©n debe a quiÃ©n.',
        );
      if (kind == 'person' && personId == null)
        throw StateError('Selecciona una persona.');
      final paymentRate = kind == 'person'
          ? ExchangeRate.tryParse(settlementRate.text)
          : null;
      if (kind == 'person' && paymentRate == null)
        throw StateError(
          'Indica una tasa de pago positiva en cÃ³rdobas por dÃ³lar, con mÃ¡ximo seis decimales.',
        );
      final result = kind == 'person'
          ? await loadPersonAccountReport(
              personId!,
              ownerName: reportOwner.text.trim(),
              settlementRate: paymentRate,
              start: allHistory ? null : start,
              end: allHistory ? null : end,
            )
          : await loadExportReport(
              kind: kind,
              selection: selection,
              cardId: cardId,
              additionalCardFilter: additionalCardFilter,
              accountId: accountId,
              currency: currency,
              start: start,
              end: end,
              month: month,
            );
      final xlsx = reportExcel(result);
      Uint8List? pdfData;
      String? note;
      try {
        final regularFont = await rootBundle.load(
          AppearanceController.instance.regularAsset,
        );
        final boldFont = await rootBundle.load(
          AppearanceController.instance.boldAsset,
        );
        Uint8List? logo;
        try {
          logo = (await rootBundle.load(
            'assets/branding/mi_billete_logo.png',
          )).buffer.asUint8List();
        } catch (_) {
          /* El tÃ­tulo de texto funciona sin logo. */
        }
        pdfData = await reportPdf(
          result,
          regularFont: regularFont,
          boldFont: boldFont,
          logo: logo,
        );
      } catch (e) {
        note = 'Excel disponible. No se pudo preparar el PDF: $e';
      }
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != uid) {
        throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³.');
      }
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        report = result;
        excel = xlsx;
        pdf = pdfData;
        pdfNotice = note;
        preparedUser = uid;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => error = '$e');
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => busy = false);
      }
    }
  }

  String exportName() {
    final date = report!.generatedAt;
    final selectedName =
        people
            .where((p) => '${p['id']}' == personId)
            .map((p) => '${p['name']}')
            .firstOrNull ??
        'Persona';
    final suffix = kind == 'person'
        ? '_${selectedName.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+'), '_')}'
        : '';
    return 'MiBillete_${kind}${suffix}_${date.year}${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  Future<void> preview(bool asPdf) async {
    final bytes = asPdf ? pdf : excel;
    if (bytes == null || busy || report == null) return;
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != preparedUser) {
      setState(clear);
      message('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Prepara el reporte nuevamente.');
      return;
    }
    final extension = asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'xlsx';
    final filename = '${exportName()}.$extension';
    await showFilePreview(
      context,
      label: filename,
      sourceName: filename,
      load: () async => bytes,
      expanded: true,
    );
  }

  Future<void> save(bool asPdf) async {
    final bytes = asPdf ? pdf : excel;
    if (bytes == null || busy) {
      return;
    }
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != preparedUser) {
      setState(clear);
      message('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Prepara el reporte nuevamente.');
      return;
    }
    setState(() => busy = true);
    try {
      final name = exportName();
      final mime = asPdf ? MimeType.pdf : MimeType.microsoftExcel;
      if (kIsWeb || defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.linux) {
        final path = await FileSaver.instance.saveFile(
          name: name,
          bytes: bytes,
          fileExtension: asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'xlsx',
          mimeType: mime,
        );
        if (path.isEmpty || path.startsWith('Something went wrong')) {
          throw StateError('El sistema no pudo guardar el archivo.');
        }
        message(
          kIsWeb
              ? 'Archivo preparado para descargar.'
              : 'Archivo guardado en: $path',
        );
      } else {
        final path = await FileSaver.instance.saveAs(
          name: name,
          bytes: bytes,
          fileExtension: asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'xlsx',
          mimeType: mime,
        );
        if (path != null && path.isNotEmpty) {
          if (path.startsWith('Something went wrong')) {
            throw StateError('El sistema no pudo guardar el archivo.');
          }
          message('Archivo guardado.');
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      message('No se pudo descargar o guardar: $e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => busy = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> shareFile(bool asPdf, BuildContext buttonContext) async {
    final bytes = asPdf ? pdf : excel;
    if (bytes == null || busy || report == null) return;
    if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != preparedUser) {
      setState(clear);
      message('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Prepara el reporte nuevamente.');
      return;
    }
    final box = buttonContext.findRenderObject();
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final origin = box is RenderBox && box.hasSize && !box.size.isEmpty
        ? box.localToGlobal(Offset.zero) & box.size
        : Rect.fromLTWH(size.width / 2, size.height / 2, 1, 1);
    final extension = asPdf ? 'pdf' : 'xlsx';
    final filename = '${exportName()}.$extension';
    final mime = asPdf
        ? 'application/pdf'
        : 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet';
    setState(() => busy = true);
    try {
      // Los bytes ya se prepararon al generar el reporte. La llamada nace del
      // botÃ³n de compartir, sin otra consulta ni diÃ¡logo que pierda el gesto web.
      final available = await shareReportFile(
        bytes,
        filename,
        mime,
        report!.title,
        origin,
      );
      if (!available) {
        message(
          'Este navegador no permite compartir este archivo. Abre la app en Safari con HTTPS o usa Descargar.',
        );
      }
      // Cerrar el menÃº sin elegir destino no descarga ni envÃ­a el archivo.
    } catch (_) {
      message(
        'No se pudo abrir Compartir. Usa Descargar y comparte el archivo desde Archivos o Descargas.',
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
    }
  }

  Widget fileActions(bool asPdf) {
    final available = (asPdf ? pdf : excel) != null;
    final label = asPdf ? 'PDF' : 'Excel (.xlsx)';
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(
                  asPdf
                      ? Icons.picture_as_pdf_outlined
                      : Icons.table_chart_outlined,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 10,
              runSpacing: 10,
              children: [
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: busy || !available ? null : () => preview(asPdf),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.visibility_outlined),
                  label: const Text('Vista previa'),
                ),
                FilledButton.icon(
                  onPressed: busy || !available ? null : () => save(asPdf),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.download_outlined),
                  label: const Text('Descargar'),
                ),
                Builder(
                  builder: (buttonContext) => OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: busy || !available
                        ? null
                        : () => shareFile(asPdf, buttonContext),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.share_outlined),
                    label: const Text('Compartir'),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (!available)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                child: Text(
                  'Este formato no estÃ¡ disponible. Revisa el aviso o vuelve a preparar el reporte.',
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

                      children: [fileActions(false), fileActions(true)],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                    child: Text(
                      'En la web, el navegador gestiona la descarga. Compartir muestra los destinos disponibles en tu dispositivo.',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: appMuted),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (pdfNotice != null)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                      child: Text(pdfNotice!),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ...report!.notes.map(
                    (n) => Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                      child: Text(
                        n,
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: appMuted),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted;
import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../widgets/date_period_field.dart';
import '../../data/period_logic.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../core/supabase_client.dart';
import '../../data/transaction_repository.dart';
import '../../data/credit_card_repository.dart';
import '../../data/debt_payment_repository.dart';
import '../../data/expense_report_categories.dart';
import '../../data/exchange_rate.dart';
import '../../data/financial_settings_repository.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import '../../widgets/category_style.dart';
import 'category_expenses_dialog.dart';
import 'expense_report_widgets.dart';

typedef _CategoryRow = ({String key, String currency, int cents, Widget card});

class MonthlyExpensesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const MonthlyExpensesPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<MonthlyExpensesPage> createState() => _MonthlyExpensesPageState();
}

class _MonthlyExpensesPageState extends State<MonthlyExpensesPage> {
  DateTime month = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month);
  DateTime end = DateTime.now();
  String currency = 'both';
  String selectedCategory = 'all';
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> expenses = [];
  Map<String, String> categoryNames = {};
  Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> categoryStyles = {};
  ExchangeRate? exchangeRate;
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;
  int requestId = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    loadData();
  }

  String categoryName(String key) =>
      expenseReportCategoryLabels[key] ??
      categoryNames[key] ??
      'CategorÃ­a no disponible';

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final request = ++requestId;
    final start = month, until = end;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw Exception('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final names = <String, String>{};
      final styles = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
      for (var offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
        final result = await supabase
            .from('categories')
            .select('id, name, icon, color, category_type')
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .order('id')
            .range(offset, offset + 499);
        final page = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(result);
        for (final category in page) {
          final id = category['id'].toString();
          names[id] = category['name'].toString();
          styles[id] = category;
        }
        if (page.length < 500) {
          break;
        }
      }
      final rows = [
        ...await loadUserTransactions(user.id),
        ...await loadUserCardExpenses(user.id),
        ...debtPaymentExpenses(await loadUserDebtPayments(user.id)),
      ];
      ExchangeRate? rate;
      try {
        rate = (await loadFinancialSettings())?.rate;
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('No se pudo cargar la tasa para gastos por categorÃ­a: $e');
      }
      final selected = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (final tx in rows) {
        if (tx['transaction_type'] != 'expense') {
          continue;
        }
        final date = DateTime.tryParse('${tx['transaction_date']}')?.toLocal();
        if (date == null) {
          throw const FormatException('Un gasto tiene una fecha invÃ¡lida.');
        }
        if (includesDay(date, start, until)) {
          selected.add(tx);
        }
      }
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        categoryNames = names;
        categoryStyles = styles;
        expenses = selected;
        exchangeRate = rate;
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == requestId) {
        setState(() {
          error = e.toString();
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  ({Widget summary, List<_CategoryRow> categories}) currencyReport(
    String reportCurrency,
  ) {
    final filteredExpenses = expenses
        .where(
          (tx) =>
              (currency != 'both' || tx['currency'] == reportCurrency) &&
              (selectedCategory == 'all' ||
                  expenseReportCategoryKey(tx) == selectedCategory),
        )
        .toList();
    final rate = currency == 'both' ? null : exchangeRate;
    if (rate == null &&
        filteredExpenses.any((tx) => tx['currency'] != reportCurrency)) {
      return (
        summary: const Text(
          'Se necesita una tasa de cambio vÃ¡lida en Configuraciones para '
          'ver todos los gastos en una sola moneda.',
        ),
        categories: const [],
      );
    }
    final totals = <String, int>{}, counts = <String, int>{};
    int charges = 0, refunds = 0;
    for (final tx in filteredExpenses) {
      final key = expenseReportCategoryKey(tx);
      final amount = expenseReportAmount(tx, reportCurrency, rate);
      if (amount < 0) {
        refunds += -amount;
      } else {
        charges += amount;
      }
      totals[key] = (totals[key] ?? 0) + amount;
      counts[key] = (counts[key] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    final groups = totals.entries;
    final positiveTotal = groups.fold<int>(
      0,
      (sum, group) => sum + (group.value > 0 ? group.value : 0),
    );

    final currencyLabel = reportCurrency == 'NIO' ? 'CÃ³rdobas' : 'DÃ³lares';
    final summary = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Text(currencyLabel, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        ExpenseReportSummary(
          currency: reportCurrency,
          chargesCents: charges,
          refundsCents: refunds,
          count: filteredExpenses.length,
          compact: true,
        ),
        if (filteredExpenses.isEmpty)
          const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
            child: Text('Sin movimientos con estos filtros.'),
          ),
      ],
    );
    return (
      summary: summary,
      categories: groups.map((group) {
        final name = categoryName(group.key);
        final style = categoryStyles[group.key];
        final card = ExpenseCategoryCard(
          name: name,
          currency: reportCurrency,
          amountCents: group.value,
          count: counts[group.key] ?? 0,
          positiveTotalCents: positiveTotal,
          color: group.key == 'uncategorized'
              ? appMuted
              : categoryColor(style?['color']),
          icon: switch (group.key) {
            'debt_costs' => Icons.payments_outlined,
            'card_refunds' => Icons.undo_rounded,
            'card_insurance' => Icons.shield_outlined,
            'card_purchases' ||
            'card_interest' ||
            'card_fees' ||
            'card_other' => Icons.credit_card_outlined,
            'uncategorized' => Icons.help_outline_rounded,
            _ => categoryIcon(style?['icon']),
          },
          onTap: () => showDialog<void>(
            context: context,
            builder: (_) => CategoryExpensesDialog(
              name: name,
              currency: reportCurrency,
              exchangeRate: rate,
              expenses: filteredExpenses
                  .where((tx) => expenseReportCategoryKey(tx) == group.key)
                  .toList(),
            ),
          ),
        );
        return (
          key: group.key,
          currency: reportCurrency,
          cents: group.value,
          card: card,
        );
      }).toList(),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final categoryOptions =
        {
          for (final entry in categoryStyles.entries)
            if (entry.value['category_type'] == 'expense') entry.key,
          'debt_costs',
          ...expenses.map(expenseReportCategoryKey),
          if (selectedCategory != 'all') selectedCategory,
        }.where((key) => key != 'uncategorized').toList()..sort(
          (a, b) => categoryName(
            a,
          ).toLowerCase().compareTo(categoryName(b).toLowerCase()),
        );

    final reports = [
      if (!loading && error == null)
        for (final reportCurrency
            in currency == 'both' ? const ['NIO', 'USD'] : [currency])
          currencyReport(reportCurrency),
    ];
    final categories = [for (final report in reports) ...report.categories];
    final rate = exchangeRate;
    final mixedCurrencies =
        categories.map((entry) => entry.currency).toSet().length > 1;
    final missingRate = mixedCurrencies && rate == null;
    // Compare exact USD equivalents with a shared denominator.
    BigInt dollarOrder(_CategoryRow entry) =>
        BigInt.from(entry.cents) *
        BigInt.from(
          entry.currency == 'USD' ? rate?.micros ?? 1000000 : 1000000,
        );
    categories.sort((a, b) {
      if (missingRate && a.currency != b.currency) {
        return a.currency.compareTo(b.currency);
      }
      final byAmount = dollarOrder(b).compareTo(dollarOrder(a));
      if (byAmount != 0) return byAmount;
      final byCategory = a.key.compareTo(b.key);
      return byCategory != 0 ? byCategory : a.currency.compareTo(b.currency);
    });
    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Gastos por categorÃ­a'),
        actions: [
          const AppHelpButton(topic: 'reports'),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Actualizar',
            onPressed: loading ? null : loadData,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 1240),
            child: RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: () async {
                if (!loading) await loadData();
              },
              child: ListView(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                  pageGutter(context),
                  12,
                  pageGutter(context),
                  32,
                ),
                children: [
                  CollapsibleFilters(
                    summary: currency == 'both'
                        ? 'Ambas monedas'
                        : currency == 'NIO'
                        ? 'CÃ³rdobas'
                        : 'DÃ³lares',
                    children: [
                      DatePeriodField(
                        minColumnWidth: 136,
                        start: month,
                        end: end,
                        enabled: !loading,
                        onChanged: (range) {
                          setState(() {
                            month = range.start;
                            end = range.end;
                          });
                          loadData();
                        },
                      ),
                      AdaptiveColumns(
                        minColumnWidth: 148,
                        children: [
                          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                            initialValue: currency,
                            isExpanded: true,
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Moneda',
                            ),
                            items: const [
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                value: 'both',
                                child: Text('Ambas monedas'),
                              ),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                value: 'NIO',
                                child: Text('CÃ³rdobas (C\$)'),
                              ),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                value: 'USD',
                                child: Text('DÃ³lares (\$)'),
                              ),
                            ],
                            onChanged: loading
                                ? null
                                : (value) {
                                    if (value != null) {
                                      setState(() => currency = value);
                                    }
                                  },
                          ),
                          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                            initialValue: selectedCategory,
                            isExpanded: true,
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'CategorÃ­a',
                            ),
                            items: [
                              const DropdownMenuItem(
                                value: 'all',
                                child: Text('Todas las categorÃ­as'),
                              ),
                              for (final key in categoryOptions)
                                DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: key,
                                  child: Text(
                                    categoryName(key),
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              const DropdownMenuItem(
                                value: 'uncategorized',
                                child: Text('Sin categorÃ­a'),
                              ),
                            ],
                            onChanged: loading
                                ? null
                                : (value) {
                                    if (value != null)
                                      setState(() => selectedCategory = value);
                                  },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  if (loading)
                    const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  else if (error case final problem?) ...[
                    const Text('No se pudo cargar el reporte.'),
                    SelectableText(problem),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: loadData,
                      child: const Text('Reintentar'),
                    ),
                  ] else ...[
                    Text(
                      'Resumen de gastos',
                      style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    const Text(
                      'El gasto neto es el total de cargos menos las devoluciones.',
                    ),
                    if (exchangeRate case final rate? when currency != 'both')
                      Text('Tasa configurada Â· \$ 1 = C\$ ${rate.decimal}'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    AdaptiveColumns(
                      minColumnWidth: 300,
                      children: [for (final report in reports) report.summary],
                    ),
                    if (categories.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 24),
                      Text(
                        'DistribuciÃ³n por categorÃ­a',
                        style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      const Text(
                        'Cada porcentaje representa la parte del gasto neto positivo en su moneda.',
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      if (missingRate)
                        const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                          child: Text(
                            'Configura una tasa de cambio para ordenar juntas '
                            'las categorÃ­as en cÃ³rdobas y dÃ³lares.',
                          ),
                        ),
                      for (final entry in categories) entry.card,
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    Text(

    if (saving) return;

      await action();

      if (mounted)
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'No se pudo guardar la apariencia. Intenta nuevamente.',
            ),
          ),
        );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
    }
  }

import 'appearance_page.dart';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class SettingsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsPage({super.key});
  @override
  State<SettingsPage> createState() => _SettingsPageState();
}

class _SettingsPageState extends State<SettingsPage> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final controller = TextEditingController();
  String? ownerId, error;
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  FinancialSettings? current;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    final userId = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    try {
      final result = await loadFinancialSettings();
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      if (supabase.auth.currentUser?.id != userId) {
        throw StateError('La sesiÃ³n cambiÃ³. Abre nuevamente Configuraciones.');
      }
      setState(() {
        ownerId = userId;
        current = result;
        controller.text = result?.rate.decimal ?? '';
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          loading = false;
          error = '$e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> save() async {
    if (loading ||
        saving ||
        ownerId == null ||
        !formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      return;
    }
    final rate = ExchangeRate.tryParse(controller.text)!;
    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      await saveFinancialSettings(rate, ownerId!);
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Tasa guardada. El inicio recalcularÃ¡ los totales.'),
        ),
      );
      Navigator.pop(context);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('No se pudo guardar: $e')));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> openChangeName() async {
    final name = await Navigator.push<String>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const ChangeNamePage()),
    );
    if (mounted && name != null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Nombre actualizado.')));
    }
  }

  Widget accountAction(String title, IconData icon, VoidCallback onTap) =>
      ListTile(
        leading: Icon(icon),
        title: Text(title),
        trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded),
        onTap: saving ? null : onTap,
        enabled: !saving,
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => PopScope(
    canPop: !saving,
    child: GuideScope(
      topic: 'settings',
      ready: !loading && error == null,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          actions: const [AppHelpButton(topic: 'settings')],

        ),
        body: Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
            child: ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              children: [
                Card(
                  child: accountAction(
                    'Colores y fuente',
                    Icons.palette_outlined,
                    () => Navigator.of(context).push(
                      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                        builder: (_) => const AppearancePage(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Text('Cuenta', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Card(
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      accountAction(
                        'Cambiar nombre',
                        Icons.badge_outlined,
                        openChangeName,
                      ),
                      const Divider(height: 1),
                      accountAction(
                        'Correo electrÃ³nico',
                        Icons.email_outlined,
                        () {
                          Navigator.push<void>(
                            context,
                            MaterialPageRoute(
                              builder: (_) => const ChangeEmailPage(),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                      const Divider(height: 1),
                      accountAction(
                        'Cambiar contraseÃ±a',
                        Icons.lock_reset_rounded,
                        () {
                          Navigator.push<void>(
                            context,
                            MaterialPageRoute(
                              builder: (_) => const ChangePasswordPage(),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                Text('Finanzas', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                if (loading)
                  const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                else if (error != null) ...[
                  const Text('No se pudo cargar la configuraciÃ³n.'),
                  SelectableText(error!),
                  TextButton(onPressed: load, child: const Text('Reintentar')),
                ] else
                  Card(

import 'dart:async';

import '../../data/card_statement_repository.dart' show statementRows;
import '../../data/debt_installment_repository.dart' show loadDebtInstallments;
import '../../data/person_account_repository.dart';
import '../../data/receivable_loan_repository.dart';
import 'obligation_statistics.dart';

Future<ObligationData> loadObligationData() async {
  final uid = personUserId();
  final (
    cards,
    cardMovements,
    debts,
    installmentData,
    loans,
    people,
    entries,
  ) = await (
    statementRows(
      'credit_cards',
      'id,name,currency,opening_balance,opening_balance_nio,opening_balance_usd,card_reference,card_tier,card_product,limit_exchange_rate,financial_institutions(name)',
      uid,
    ),
    statementRows(
      'credit_card_transactions',
      'id,credit_card_id,transaction_type,amount,currency,transaction_date,is_voided,is_receivable_funding',
      uid,
    ),
    statementRows(
      'debts',
      'id,description,currency,original_amount,status',
      uid,
    ),
    loadDebtInstallments(uid),
    loadReceivableLoanData(uid),
    personRows('person_accounts', uid, includeShared: true),
    personRows('person_account_entries', uid, includeShared: true),
  ).wait;
  checkPersonSession(uid);
  return ObligationData(
    userId: uid,
    cards: cards,
    cardMovements: cardMovements,
    debts: debts,
    debtPayments: installmentData.payments,
    installmentData: installmentData,
    loans: loans.loans,
    loanPayments: loans.payments,
    people: people,
    personEntries: entries,
  );
}

import '../../data/debt_installment_logic.dart';
import '../../data/payment_agenda_labels.dart';
import '../../data/period_logic.dart' show isoDay;
import '../../data/exchange_rate.dart';
import '../../data/person_account_logic.dart';
import '../../data/receivable_loan_logic.dart';
import '../../features/credit_cards/credit_card_balances.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';

typedef Rows = List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
typedef Amount = MapEntry<String, int>;

class ObligationData {
  const ObligationData({
    required this.userId,
    required this.cards,
    required this.cardMovements,
    required this.debts,
    required this.debtPayments,
    this.installmentData,
    required this.loans,
    required this.loanPayments,
    required this.people,
    required this.personEntries,
  });

  final String userId;
  final DebtInstallmentData? installmentData;
  final Rows cards,
      cardMovements,
      debts,
      debtPayments,
      loans,
      loanPayments,
      people,
      personEntries;
}

class ObligationSection {
  const ObligationSection(
    this.title,
    this.snapshot,
    this.activity,
    this.ranking, {
    this.note,
  });
  final String title;
  final List<Amount> snapshot, activity, ranking;
  final String? note;
}

List<ObligationSection> obligationStatistics(
  ObligationData data,
  ExchangeRate rate,
  String currency,
  DateTime start,
  DateTime end,
  DateTime now,
) {
  DateTime day(DateTime value) => DateTime(value.year, value.month, value.day);
  bool inRange(Object? value) {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse('$value')?.toLocal();
    return date != null &&
        !day(date).isBefore(day(start)) &&
        !day(date).isAfter(day(end));
  }

  int convert(int cents, Object? source) =>
      rate.convert(cents, '$source', currency);
  int field(Map<String, dynamic> row, String key) => moneyCents(row[key] ?? 0);
  Iterable<Map<String, dynamic>> valid(Rows rows) =>
      rows.where((row) => row['is_voided'] != true);
  Amount amount(String label, int cents) => MapEntry(label, cents);
  int sum(List<Amount> rows) =>
      rows.fold<int>(0, (total, row) => total + row.value);

  final cardRanking = <Amount>[];
  var cardCredit = 0,
      cardCharges = 0,
      cardPayments = 0,
      cardRefunds = 0,
      unknownCards = 0;
  final cardIds = data.cards.map((card) => card['id']).toSet();
  for (final card in data.cards) {
    var debt = 0, credit = 0;
    var known = true;
    for (final source in cardCurrencies) {
      final balance = cardBalance(card, data.cardMovements, source);
      if (balance == null) {
        known = false;
      } else if (balance > 0) {
        debt += convert(balance, source);
      } else if (balance < 0) {
        credit += convert(-balance, source);
      }
    }
    if (!known) {
      unknownCards++;
      continue;
    }
    if (debt > 0)
      cardRanking.add(amount(agendaCardLabel(card, includeName: false), debt));
    cardCredit += credit;
  }
  for (final row in valid(data.cardMovements)) {
    if (!cardIds.contains(row['credit_card_id']) ||
        !inRange(row['transaction_date']))
      continue;
    final type = row['transaction_type'];
    if (!cardEffects.containsKey(type)) continue;
    final cents = convert(field(row, 'amount'), row['currency']);
    if (type == 'payment') {
      cardPayments += cents;
    } else if (type == 'refund') {
      cardRefunds += cents;
    } else {
      cardCharges += cents;
    }
  }

  final debtRanking = <Amount>[];
  var debtPrincipalPaid = 0, debtCosts = 0;
  for (final debt in data.debts.where((row) => row['status'] != 'cancelled')) {
    var paid = 0;
    for (final row in valid(
      data.debtPayments,
    ).where((row) => row['debt_id'] == debt['id'])) {
      if (row['currency'] != debt['currency']) {
        throw StateError('Un abono tiene una moneda distinta a su deuda.');
      }
      final principal = field(row, 'principal_amount');
      paid += principal;
      if (inRange(row['payment_date'])) {
        debtPrincipalPaid += convert(principal, row['currency']);
        debtCosts += convert(
          field(row, 'interest_amount') + field(row, 'fee_amount'),
          row['currency'],
        );
      }
    }
    final pending = field(debt, 'original_amount') - paid;
    if (pending > 0 && debt['status'] != 'paid')
      debtRanking.add(
        amount('${debt['description']}', convert(pending, debt['currency'])),
      );
  }

  final loanRanking = <Amount>[];
  var overdueLoans = 0, issued = 0, collected = 0, loanInterest = 0;
  for (final loan in valid(data.loans)) {
    final payments = valid(
      data.loanPayments,
    ).where((row) => row['loan_id'] == loan['id']);
    final pending = receivablePending(loan, payments);
    final converted = convert(pending, loan['currency']);
    if (pending > 0) {
      loanRanking.add(amount('${loan['borrower_name']}', converted));
      if (receivableOverdue(loan, pending, now)) overdueLoans += converted;
    }
    if (inRange(loan['loan_date']) && loan['is_historical'] != true) {
      issued += convert(field(loan, 'principal_amount'), loan['currency']);
    }
    for (final row in payments.where((row) => inRange(row['payment_date']))) {
      collected += convert(field(row, 'principal_amount'), row['currency']);
      loanInterest += convert(field(row, 'interest_amount'), row['currency']);
    }
  }

  final personRanking = <Amount>[];
  var owed = 0, receivable = 0, personIncrease = 0, personDecrease = 0;
  for (final person in data.people.where((row) => row['is_active'] == true)) {
    final own = person['user_id'] == data.userId;
    final direction = own ? 1 : -1;
    final entries = valid(
      data.personEntries,
    ).where((row) => row['person_account_id'] == person['id']);
    final balance = convert(personAccountBalance(entries) * direction, 'NIO');
    final name = own ? '${person['name']}' : '${person['name']} Â· Compartida';
    if (balance > 0) {
      owed += balance;
      personRanking.add(amount('$name Â· Le debes', balance));
    } else if (balance < 0) {
      receivable -= balance;
      personRanking.add(amount('$name Â· Te debe', -balance));
    }
    for (final row in entries.where((row) => inRange(row['entry_date']))) {
      final delta = convert(personAccountBalance([row]) * direction, 'NIO');
      if (delta > 0) personIncrease += delta;
      if (delta < 0) personDecrease -= delta;
    }
  }

  final overdueInstallments = <Amount>[];
  var unknownInstallments = 0;
  final schedule = data.installmentData;
  if (schedule != null) {
    for (final debt in data.debts.where(
      (debt) => ['active', 'overdue'].contains(debt['status']),
    )) {
      for (final row in schedule.currentFor('${debt['id']}')) {
        final due = DateTime.tryParse('${row['due_date']}');
        if (due == null || !day(due).isBefore(day(now))) continue;
        final pending = schedule.progress(row).remaining;
        if (pending == null) {
          unknownInstallments++;
        } else if (pending > 0) {
          overdueInstallments.add(
            amount(
              '${debt['description']} Â· Cuota ${row['number']} Â· ${isoDay(due)}',
              convert(pending, row['currency']),
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return [
    ObligationSection(
      'Tarjetas de crÃ©dito',
      [
        amount('Deuda registrada', sum(cardRanking)),
        amount('Saldo a favor', cardCredit),
      ],
      [
        amount('Cargos', cardCharges),
        amount('Pagos', cardPayments),
        amount('Devoluciones y crÃ©ditos', cardRefunds),
      ],
      cardRanking,
      note: unknownCards == 0
          ? null
          : '$unknownCards tarjetas con saldo por revisar. Los saldos mostrados incluyen las tarjetas con saldo calculable.',
    ),
    ObligationSection(
      'Deudas y prÃ©stamos recibidos',
      [amount('Capital pendiente', sum(debtRanking))],
      [
        amount('Capital abonado', debtPrincipalPaid),
        amount('Intereses y cargos pagados', debtCosts),
      ],
      debtRanking,
    ),
    ObligationSection(
      'PrÃ©stamos por cobrar',
      [
        amount('Capital por cobrar', sum(loanRanking)),
        amount('Capital vencido', overdueLoans),
      ],
      [
        amount('Capital prestado', issued),
        amount('Capital recuperado', collected),
        amount('Intereses cobrados', loanInterest),
      ],
      loanRanking,
    ),
    ObligationSection(
      'Cuentas con personas',
      [amount('Les debes', owed), amount('Te deben', receivable)],
      [
        amount('Aumentos del saldo a tu cargo', personIncrease),
        amount('Reducciones del saldo a tu cargo', personDecrease),
      ],
      personRanking,
      note:
          'Incluye cuentas activas propias y compartidas, vistas desde tu lado.',
    ),
    if (schedule != null)
      ObligationSection(
        'Cuotas vencidas',
        [amount('Monto pendiente vencido', sum(overdueInstallments))],
        const [],
        overdueInstallments,
        note:
            '${overdueInstallments.length} cuotas pendientes con fecha anterior a hoy.'
            '${unknownInstallments == 0 ? '' : ' $unknownInstallments cuotas con saldo por revisar.'}',
      ),
  ];
}
