import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show primaryColor;

const incomeColor = Color(0xFF277354);
const expenseColor = Color(0xFFB14838);
List<Color> get categoryColors => [
  primaryColor,
  Color(0xFFB14838),
  Color(0xFF277354),
  Color(0xFF7554A3),
  Color(0xFF986416),
  Color(0xFF417885),
];

class StatisticsBars extends StatelessWidget {
  const StatisticsBars({super.key, required this.rows, required this.currency});
  final List<({String label, int cents, Color color})> rows;
  final String currency;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final maximum = rows.fold(1, (max, row) => math.max(max, row.cents.abs()));
    return Column(
      children: [
        for (final row in rows)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 2,
                  children: [
                    Text(row.label),
                    Text(formatMoneyCents(row.cents, currency)),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: row.cents.abs() / maximum,
                  color: row.color,
                  minHeight: 7,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class ExpensePie extends StatelessWidget {
  const ExpensePie({
    super.key,
    required this.categories,
    required this.currency,
  });
  final List<MapEntry<String, int>> categories;
  final String currency;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final total = categories.fold(0, (sum, entry) => sum + entry.value);
    final items = categories.take(5).toList();
    if (categories.length > 5) {
      items.add(
        MapEntry(
          'Otras categorÃ­as',
          categories.skip(5).fold(0, (sum, entry) => sum + entry.value),
        ),
      );
    }
    if (items.isEmpty || total <= 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final legend = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 5, right: 8),
                  child: Icon(Icons.circle, size: 9, color: categoryColors[i]),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(items[i].key),
                      Text(
                        '${formatMoneyCents(items[i].value, currency)} Â· ${(100 * items[i].value / total).toStringAsFixed(1)} %',
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
    if (items.length == 1) {
      return Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          legend,
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: 1,
            color: categoryColors.first,
            minHeight: 7,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }

    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final scale = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(14) / 14;
        final horizontal = constraints.maxWidth >= 340 * scale;
        final diameter = math.min(
          constraints.maxWidth,
          horizontal ? 112.0 : 128.0,
        );
        final pie = SizedBox.square(
          dimension: diameter,
          child: CustomPaint(
            painter: _PiePainter(
              items.map((entry) => entry.value / total).toList(),
            ),
          ),
        );
        if (horizontal) {
          return Row(
            children: [
              pie,
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(child: legend),
            ],
          );
        }
        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Center(child: pie),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            legend,
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _PiePainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _PiePainter(this.shares);
  final List<double> shares;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final rect = Offset.zero & size;
    var start = -math.pi / 2;
    for (var i = 0; i < shares.length; i++) {
      final sweep = shares[i] * 2 * math.pi;
      canvas.drawArc(
        rect,
        start,
        sweep,
        true,
        Paint()..color = categoryColors[i],
      );
      start += sweep;
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _PiePainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.shares != shares;
}

/// GrÃ¡fico mensual de barras para comparar la evoluciÃ³n de un importe.
class MonthlyBarChart extends StatelessWidget {
  const MonthlyBarChart({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.values,
    required this.currency,
    required this.color,
    this.detail,
  });

  final String title;
  final List<({String label, int cents})> values;
  final String currency;
  final Color color;
  final String? detail;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final nonEmpty = values.any((value) => value.cents != 0);
    return Card(
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
            if (detail != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 3),
              Text(detail!, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            if (!nonEmpty)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 30),
                child: Text(
                  'No hay datos para mostrar en este perÃ­odo.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              )
            else
              SizedBox(
                height: 230,
                child: CustomPaint(
                  painter: _MonthlyBarsPainter(
                    values: values,
                    currency: currency,
                    color: color,
                    textColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    gridColor: Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                  ),
                  child: const SizedBox.expand(),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _MonthlyBarsPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _MonthlyBarsPainter({
    required this.values,
    required this.currency,
    required this.color,
    required this.textColor,
    required this.gridColor,
  });

  final List<({String label, int cents})> values;
  final String currency;
  final Color color, textColor, gridColor;

  String compact(int cents) {
    final amount = cents.abs() / 100;
    final symbol = currency == 'USD' ? r'$' : r'C$';
    if (amount >= 1000000) return '$symbol${(amount / 1000000).toStringAsFixed(1)} M';
    if (amount >= 1000) return '$symbol${(amount / 1000).toStringAsFixed(0)} mil';
    return '$symbol${amount.toStringAsFixed(0)}';
  }

  void drawText(Canvas canvas, String value, Offset offset, TextStyle style,
      {double? maxWidth}) {
    final painter = TextPainter(
      text: TextSpan(text: value, style: style),
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      maxLines: 1,
      ellipsis: 'â€¦',
    )..layout(maxWidth: maxWidth ?? double.infinity);
    painter.paint(canvas, offset);
  }

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    if (values.isEmpty) return;
    const left = 48.0, right = 8.0, top = 18.0, bottom = 34.0;
    final chartWidth = math.max(1.0, size.width - left - right);
    final chartHeight = math.max(1.0, size.height - top - bottom);
    final maxValue = values.fold<int>(1, (m, v) => math.max(m, v.cents.abs()));
    final grid = Paint()
      ..color = gridColor.withAlpha(110)
      ..strokeWidth = 1;
    final axisStyle = TextStyle(color: textColor, fontSize: 9);
    for (var i = 0; i <= 3; i++) {
      final y = top + chartHeight * i / 3;
      canvas.drawLine(Offset(left, y), Offset(size.width - right, y), grid);
      final value = (maxValue * (3 - i) / 3).round();
      drawText(canvas, compact(value), Offset(0, y - 6), axisStyle,
          maxWidth: left - 7);
    }
    final slot = chartWidth / values.length;
    final barWidth = math.min(34.0, slot * .58);
    final barPaint = Paint()..color = color.withAlpha(190);
    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      final value = values[i];
      final barHeight = chartHeight * value.cents.abs() / maxValue;
      final x = left + slot * i + (slot - barWidth) / 2;
      final y = top + chartHeight - barHeight;
      final rect = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
        Rect.fromLTWH(x, y, barWidth, barHeight),
        const Radius.circular(5),
      );
      canvas.drawRRect(rect, barPaint);
      canvas.drawCircle(
        Offset(x + barWidth / 2, y),
        4,
        Paint()..color = color.withAlpha(225),
      );
      final label = value.label;
      final labelStyle = TextStyle(color: textColor, fontSize: 9);
      final labelPainter = TextPainter(
        text: TextSpan(text: label, style: labelStyle),
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        maxLines: 1,
        ellipsis: 'â€¦',
      )..layout(maxWidth: math.max(22, slot - 2));
      labelPainter.paint(
        canvas,
        Offset(left + slot * i + (slot - labelPainter.width) / 2,
            size.height - bottom + 9),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _MonthlyBarsPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.values != values ||
      oldDelegate.currency != currency ||
      oldDelegate.color != color ||
      oldDelegate.textColor != textColor ||
      oldDelegate.gridColor != gridColor;
}

  Future<void> load() async {
    final id = ++request;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      failed = false;
    });
    try {
      final (result, settings, obligationData) = await (
        loadIncomeExpenseData(),
        loadFinancialSettings(),
        loadObligationData().then<ObligationData?>(
          (data) => data,
          onError: (Object _) => null,
        ),
      ).wait;
      if (!mounted || id != request) return;
      setState(() {
        movements = result.movements;
        rate = settings?.rate;
        obligations = obligationData;
        categories = {
          for (final category in result.categories)
            '${category['id']}': '${category['name']}',
        };
        loading = false;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted || id != request) return;
      setState(() {
        failed = true;
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  List<({String label, int cents})> _months(
    int Function(DateTime start, DateTime end) total,
  ) {
    final result = <({String label, int cents})>[];
    var month = DateTime(range.start.year, range.start.month);
    final last = DateTime(range.end.year, range.end.month);
    const labels = [
      'Ene', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Abr', 'May', 'Jun',
      'Jul', 'Ago', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dic',
    ];
    while (!month.isAfter(last)) {
      final monthEnd = DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1, 0);
      final start = range.start.isAfter(month) ? range.start : month;
      final end = range.end.isBefore(monthEnd) ? range.end : monthEnd;
      result.add((
        label: labels[month.month - 1],
        cents: total(start, end),
      ));
      month = DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1);
    }
    return result;
  }

  List<Widget> monthlyIncomeExpenseCharts(ExchangeRate exchangeRate) {
    int total(DateTime start, DateTime end, {required bool income}) {
      var cents = 0;
      for (final movement in movements) {
        final day = DateUtils.dateOnly(movement.date);
        if (day.isBefore(start) || day.isAfter(end)) continue;
        final amount = income ? movement.income : movement.expense;
        if (amount == 0) continue;
        cents += exchangeRate.convert(amount, movement.currency, currency);
      }
      return cents;
    }

    return [
      MonthlyBarChart(
        title: 'Ingresos por mes',
        detail: 'EvoluciÃ³n mensual de los ingresos registrados',
        values: _months((start, end) => total(start, end, income: true)),
        currency: currency,
        color: const Color(0xFF277354),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      MonthlyBarChart(
        title: 'Gastos por mes',
        detail: 'Gasto neto mensual, descontando devoluciones',
        values: _months((start, end) => total(start, end, income: false)),
        currency: currency,
        color: const Color(0xFFB14838),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
    ];
  }

  List<Widget> monthlyCardCharts(ExchangeRate exchangeRate) {
    final data = obligations;
    if (data == null) return const [];

    int consumption(DateTime start, DateTime end) {
      var total = 0;
      for (final movement in data.cardMovements) {
        final date = DateTime.tryParse('${movement['transaction_date']}')
            ?.toLocal();
        if (date == null) continue;
        final day = DateUtils.dateOnly(date);
        if (day.isBefore(start) || day.isAfter(end)) continue;
        final amount = cardSpendingCents(movement);
        if (amount == 0) continue;
        total += exchangeRate.convert(
          amount,
          '${movement['currency']}',
          currency,
        );
      }
      return total;
    }

    int outstanding(DateTime start, DateTime end) {
      if (end.isBefore(start)) return 0;
      var total = 0;
      final transactions = data.cardMovements.where((movement) {
        final date = DateTime.tryParse('${movement['transaction_date']}')
            ?.toLocal();
        return date != null && !DateUtils.dateOnly(date).isAfter(end);
      }).toList();
      for (final card in data.cards) {
        for (final sourceCurrency in const ['NIO', 'USD']) {
          final balance = cardBalance(card, transactions, sourceCurrency);
          if (balance == null || balance <= 0) continue;
          total += exchangeRate.convert(
          balance,
          sourceCurrency,
          currency,
        );
        }
      }
      return total;
    }

    return [
      MonthlyBarChart(
        title: 'Consumo mensual de tarjetas',
        detail: 'Compras, intereses y cargos menos devoluciones',
        values: _months(consumption),
        currency: currency,
        color: primaryColor,
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      MonthlyBarChart(
        title: 'Deuda pendiente de tarjetas',
        detail: 'Saldo acumulado al cierre de cada mes, incluyendo el saldo inicial',
        values: _months(outstanding),
        currency: currency,
        color: const Color(0xFF7554A3),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
    ];
  }

  Widget overviewPanels(List<Widget> panels) => LayoutBuilder(
    builder: (context, constraints) {
      final count = panelColumnCount(
        context,
        constraints.maxWidth,
      ).clamp(1, panels.length).toInt();
      return stackedPanels([
        for (var column = 0; column < count; column++)
          [
            for (var index = column; index < panels.length; index += count)
              panels[index],
          ],
      ]);
    },
  );

  int panelColumnCount(BuildContext context, double width) {
    final scale = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(14) / 14;
    if (width >= 1120 * scale) return 3;
    if (width >= 690 * scale) return 2;
    return 1;
  }

  Widget stackedPanels(List<List<Widget>> columns) => Row(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      for (var index = 0; index < columns.length; index++) ...[
        if (index > 0) const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              for (final (position, panel) in columns[index].indexed) ...[
                if (position > 0) const SizedBox(height: 12),
                panel,
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ],
  );

  Widget obligationPanels(ExchangeRate exchangeRate) {
    final data = obligations;
    if (data == null) {
      return panel(
        'Tarjetas, deudas, prÃ©stamos y personas',
        OutlinedButton(onPressed: load, child: const Text('Reintentar')),
        detail: 'No se pudieron cargar estos saldos.',
      );
    }
    final List<ObligationSection> sections;
    try {
      sections = obligationStatistics(
        data,
        exchangeRate,
        currency,
        range.start,
        range.end,
        DateTime.now(),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return panel(
        'Tarjetas, deudas, prÃ©stamos y personas',
        const Text(
          'No se pudieron calcular los saldos. Revisa los movimientos registrados.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final panels = sections.map(obligationPanel).toList();
    final cards = panels[0];
    final debts = panels[1];
    final loans = panels[2];
    final people = panels[3];
    final overdue = panels.skip(4);
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        return stackedPanels(switch (panelColumnCount(
          context,
          constraints.maxWidth,
        )) {
          3 => [
            [cards],
            [debts, ...overdue],
            [loans, people],
          ],
          2 => [
            [cards, loans],
            [debts, ...overdue, people],
          ],
          _ => [
            [cards, debts, ...overdue, loans, people],
          ],
        });
      },
    );
  }

  Widget obligationPanel(ObligationSection section) {
    final ranking = [...section.ranking]
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));
    return panel(
      section.title,
      Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            'Saldos actuales',
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall,
          ),
          for (final row in section.snapshot)
            Text('${row.key}: ${formatMoneyCents(row.value, currency)}'),
          if (section.activity.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'Movimientos del perÃ­odo',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            if (section.activity.every((row) => row.value == 0))
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                child: Text('Sin movimientos en el perÃ­odo'),
              )
            else
              StatisticsBars(
                currency: currency,
                rows: [
                  for (final row in section.activity)
                    (
                      label: row.key,
                      cents: row.value,
                      color: categoryColors[0],
                    ),
                ],
              ),
          ],
          if (ranking.isNotEmpty) ...[
            Text(
              section.activity.isEmpty
                  ? 'Cuotas con mayor saldo pendiente'
                  : 'Mayores saldos actuales',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            StatisticsBars(
              currency: currency,
              rows: [
                for (final row in ranking.take(8))
                  (label: row.key, cents: row.value, color: expenseColor),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
      detail: section.note,
    );
  }
}

// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\features\statistics\statistics_summary.dart
// ==========================================
import '../../data/exchange_rate.dart';
import '../../data/expense_report_categories.dart';
import '../../data/export_report_models.dart';

class StatisticsSummary {
  StatisticsSummary({
    required Iterable<ExportMovement> movements,
    required Map<String, String> categories,
    required DateTime start,
    required DateTime end,
    required String currency,
    required ExchangeRate rate,
  }) {
    final first = _day(start), last = _day(end);
    dayCount = last.difference(first).inDays + 1;
    final byCategory = <String, int>{};
    final incomeByCategory = <String, int>{};
    for (final row in movements) {
      if (row.income == 0 && row.expense == 0) {
        continue;
      }
      final day = _day(row.date);
      if (day.isBefore(first) || day.isAfter(last)) continue;
      movementCount++;
      final rowIncome = rate.convert(row.income, row.currency, currency);
      final rowExpense = rate.convert(row.expense, row.currency, currency);
      final name = _categoryName(row, categories);
      if (row.income > 0) {
        incomeCount++;
        if (rowIncome > 0)
          incomeByCategory.update(
            name,
            (value) => value + rowIncome,
            ifAbsent: () => rowIncome,
          );
      }
      income += rowIncome;
      netExpenses += rowExpense;
      if (row.expense < 0) refunds -= rowExpense;
      if (row.expense > 0) {
        grossExpenses += rowExpense;
        expenseCount++;
        if (rowExpense > largestExpense) largestExpense = rowExpense;
        if (rowExpense > 0)
          byCategory.update(
            name,
            (amount) => amount + rowExpense,
            ifAbsent: () => rowExpense,
          );
      }
    }
    expenseCategories = _rank(byCategory);
    incomeCategories = _rank(incomeByCategory);
  }

  // Mantiene la misma clasificaciÃ³n automÃ¡tica del reporte Gastos por categorÃ­a.
  // Los movimientos de cuentas sin categorÃ­a asignada siguen siendo autÃ©nticos
  // gastos pendientes de clasificar.
  static String _categoryName(
    ExportMovement movement,
    Map<String, String> categories,
  ) {
    final id = movement.categoryId?.trim();
    if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty && id != 'null') {
      return categories[id] ?? 'CategorÃ­a no disponible';
    }

    final type = movement.values.length > 1
        ? movement.values[1]?.toString() ?? ''
        : '';
    final automaticKey = switch (type) {
      'Abono de prÃ©stamo' => 'debt_costs',
      'Compra con tarjeta' => 'card_purchases',
      'Intereses de tarjeta' => 'card_interest',
      'ComisiÃ³n de tarjeta' => 'card_fees',
      'Seguro de tarjeta' => 'card_insurance',
      'DevoluciÃ³n de tarjeta' => 'card_refunds',
      'Retiro de efectivo' => 'card_fees',
      'Ajuste de tarjeta por revisar' => 'card_other',
      _ => 'uncategorized',
    };
    return expenseReportCategoryLabels[automaticKey] ?? 'Sin categorÃ­a';
  }

  int income = 0, netExpenses = 0, grossExpenses = 0, refunds = 0;
  int movementCount = 0, incomeCount = 0, expenseCount = 0, largestExpense = 0;
  late final int dayCount;
  int get dailyNetExpense => (netExpenses / dayCount).round();
  late final List<MapEntry<String, int>> incomeCategories;

  static List<MapEntry<String, int>> _rank(Map<String, int> values) =>
      values.entries.toList()..sort((a, b) {
        final amount = b.value.compareTo(a.value);
        return amount == 0 ? a.key.compareTo(b.key) : amount;
      });
  int get balance => income - netExpenses;
  late final List<MapEntry<String, int>> expenseCategories;

  static DateTime _day(DateTime value) =>
      DateTime.utc(value.year, value.month, value.day);
}

import '../../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted;
import '../../utils/card_cash_advance.dart';
import '../../widgets/mobile_navigation.dart';
import '../person_accounts/receipt_history.dart';

import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../utils/entry_order.dart';
import '../help/app_help.dart';

class TransactionsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const TransactionsPage({super.key, this.initialAccountId});
  final String? initialAccountId;
  @override
  State<TransactionsPage> createState() => _TransactionsPageState();
}

class _TransactionsPageState extends State<TransactionsPage> {
  bool loading = true, saving = false;
  String? error;
  TransactionFilter filter = const TransactionFilter();
  int requestId = 0;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts = [], categories = [], transactions = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> cardPayments = [], debtPayments = [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    filter = TransactionFilter(accountId: widget.initialAccountId);
    loadData();
  }

  void message(String text) =>
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));

  ReceiptFilter receiptFilter = ReceiptFilter.all;
  Map<String, int>? receiptCounts;
  int receiptRequest = 0;

  Future<void> refreshReceiptCounts() async {
    final request = ++receiptRequest;
    final uid = supabase.auth.currentUser?.id;
    if (uid == null) return;
    try {
      final counts = await loadReceiptCounts(
        uid,
        'movement-receipts',
        allMovements.map(financialReceiptFolder).whereType<String>(),
      );
      if (mounted && request == receiptRequest)
        setState(() => receiptCounts = counts);
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted && request == receiptRequest)
        setState(() => receiptCounts = null);
    }
  }

  Future<void> loadData() async {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final request = ++requestId;
    setState(() {
      loading = true;
      error = null;
    });
    try {
      final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null) {
        throw Exception('Debes iniciar sesiÃ³n nuevamente.');
      }
      final accountRows = await supabase
          .from('accounts')
          .select('id, name, currency, is_active')
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .order('name');
      final categoryRows = await supabase
          .from('categories')
          .select('id, name, category_type, is_active, icon, color')
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .order('name');
      final transactionRows = await loadUserTransactions(user.id);
      final paymentRows = await loadUserCardPayments(user.id);
      final debtPaymentRows = await loadUserDebtPayments(user.id);
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        accounts = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(accountRows);
        categories = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(categoryRows);
        transactions = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(transactionRows);
        cardPayments = paymentRows;
        debtPayments = debtPaymentRows;
        loading = false;
      });
      await refreshReceiptCounts();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted || request != requestId) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        error = e.toString();
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  String typeLabel(String? type) => switch (type) {
    'income' => 'Ingreso',
    'expense' => 'Gasto',
    'transfer' => 'Transferencia',
    'deposit' => 'DepÃ³sito',
    'withdrawal' => 'Retiro',
    'card_payment' => 'Pago de tarjeta',
    'debt_payment' => 'Abono de deuda',
    'adjustment' => 'Ajuste',
    _ => type ?? 'Movimiento',
  };

  String accountName(String? id) {
    for (final account in accounts) {
      if (account['id'].toString() == id) {
        return account['name']?.toString() ?? 'Cuenta';
      }
    }
    return 'Cuenta no disponible';
  }

  Map<String, dynamic>? categoryFor(dynamic id) {
    if (id == null) {
      return null;
    }
    for (final category in categories) {
      if (category['id'].toString() == id.toString()) {
        return category;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  String categoryName(String? id) => categoryFor(id)?['name']?.toString() ?? '';

  Future<void> addTransaction([Map<String, dynamic>? transaction]) async {
    if (saving || loading) {
      return;
    }
    final editing = transaction != null;
    if (editing &&
        ![
          'income',
          'expense',
          'transfer',
        ].contains(transaction['transaction_type'])) {
      message(
        'La ediciÃ³n estÃ¡ disponible para ingresos, gastos y transferencias.',
      );
      return;
    }
    final availableAccounts = accounts
        .where(
          (a) =>
              a['is_active'] == true ||
              (editing &&
                  (a['id'].toString() ==
                          transaction['account_id']?.toString() ||
                      a['id'].toString() ==
                          transaction['destination_account_id']?.toString())),
        )
        .toList();
    if (availableAccounts.isEmpty) {
      message('Primero crea una cuenta activa.');
      return;
    }
    final result = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => TransactionFormDialog(
        transaction: transaction,
        accounts: availableAccounts,
        categories: categories
            .where(
              (c) =>
                  c['is_active'] == true ||
                  (editing &&
                      c['id'].toString() ==
                          transaction['category_id']?.toString()),
            )
            .toList(),
      ),
    );
    if (result == null || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final fx =
          transaction?['source'] == 'fx_transfer' ||
          result['destination_currency'] != null;
      final table = fx ? 'app_fx_transfers' : 'transactions';
      if (transaction == null) {
        final receipt = result.remove(receiptDraftKey) as PendingReceipt?;
        final payload = <String, dynamic>{...result, 'user_id': user.id};
        if (fx) {
          payload.remove('transaction_type');
          payload.remove('category_id');
        }
        final insert = supabase.from(table).insert(payload);
        if (receipt == null) {
          await insert;
        } else {
          final saved = await insert.select('id').single();
          if (mounted)
            await attachFinancialReceipt(
              context,
              receipt,
              user.id,
              table,
              saved['id'],
            );
        }
      } else {
        final changes = <String, dynamic>{
          for (final key in [
            'account_id',
            'destination_account_id',
            'amount',
            if (!fx) ...['transaction_type', 'currency', 'category_id'],
            'description',
            if (!fx) 'expense_kind',
            'reference',
            if (fx) ...['exchange_rate', 'destination_amount'],
          ])
            key: result[key],
        };
        final originalDate = DateTime.parse(
          transaction['transaction_date'].toString(),
        ).toLocal();
        final selectedDate = DateTime.parse(
          result['transaction_date'].toString(),
        ).toLocal();
        if (originalDate.year != selectedDate.year ||
            originalDate.month != selectedDate.month ||
            originalDate.day != selectedDate.day) {
          changes['transaction_date'] = result['transaction_date'];
        }
        if (fx && transaction['source'] != 'fx_transfer') {
          await supabase.rpc(
            'convert_transaction_to_fx',
            params: {
              'p_id': transaction['id'],
              'p_account_id': result['account_id'],
              'p_destination_account_id': result['destination_account_id'],
              'p_amount': result['amount'],
              'p_currency': result['currency'],
              'p_destination_currency': result['destination_currency'],
              'p_exchange_rate': result['exchange_rate'],
              'p_transaction_date': changes['transaction_date'],
              'p_description': result['description'],
              'p_reference': result['reference'],
            },
          );
        } else {
          final updated = await supabase
              .from(table)
              .update(changes)
              .eq('id', transaction['id'])
              .eq('user_id', user.id)
              .select('id');
          if (updated.isEmpty) {
            throw StateError(
              'No se actualizÃ³: puede que ya no exista o falten permisos.',
            );
          }
        }
      }
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      message(
        editing
            ? 'Movimiento actualizado.'
            : 'Movimiento guardado correctamente.',
      );
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        message('Error de base de datos: ${e.message}');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        message('No se pudo guardar: $e');
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteTransaction(Map<String, dynamic> tx) async {
    if (saving || loading) {
      return;
    }
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Eliminar movimiento'),
        content: const Text(
          'Â¿Eliminar este movimiento? Se actualizarÃ¡n los saldos de las cuentas involucradas. '
          'Esta acciÃ³n no se puede deshacer.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancelar'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Eliminar'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed != true || !mounted || saving || loading) {
      return;
    }
    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => saving = true);
    try {
      final deleted = await supabase
          .from(
            tx['source'] == 'fx_transfer' ? 'app_fx_transfers' : 'transactions',
          )
          .delete()
          .eq('id', tx['id'])
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .select('id');
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      message(
        deleted.isEmpty
            ? 'No se eliminÃ³: puede que ya no exista o falten permisos.'
            : 'Movimiento eliminado.',
      );
      await loadData();
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        message('No se pudo eliminar: ${e.message}');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        message('No se pudo eliminar: $e');
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => saving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get allMovements {
    final rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
      ...transactions,
      ...cardPayments.map((payment) {
        final card = payment['credit_cards'];
        return <String, dynamic>{
          ...payment,
          'transaction_type': 'card_payment',
          'description': card is Map<String, dynamic>
              ? 'Pago de tarjeta: ${agendaCardLabel(card, includeName: false)}'
              : 'Pago de tarjeta',
          'source': 'credit_card_payment',
        };
      }),
      ...debtPayments.where((p) => p['account_id'] != null).map((payment) {
        final debt = payment['debts'];
        final name = debt is Map ? debt['description']?.toString() ?? '' : '';
        return <String, dynamic>{
          ...payment,
          'transaction_type': 'debt_payment',
          'transaction_date': payment['payment_date'],
          'amount': debtPaymentTotalCents(payment) / moneyScale,
          'description': name.isEmpty
              ? 'Abono de deuda'
              : 'Abono de deuda: $name',
          'source': 'debt_payment',
        };
      }),
    ];
    rows.sort(compareNewestMovement);
    return rows;
  }

  Widget _transactionCard(Map<String, dynamic> tx) {
    final external = [
      'credit_card_payment',
      'debt_payment',
      'receivable_loan',
      cashAdvanceDepositSource,
    ].contains(tx['source']);
    return TransactionTile(
      transaction: tx,
      receiptCount: receiptCounts?[financialReceiptFolder(tx)] ?? 0,
      label: tx['expense_kind'] == 'card_insurance'
          ? 'Seguro de tarjeta'
          : typeLabel(tx['transaction_type']?.toString()),
      account: accountName(tx['account_id']?.toString()),
      destination: accountName(tx['destination_account_id']?.toString()),
      category: categoryName(tx['category_id']?.toString()),
      categoryStyle: categoryFor(tx['category_id']),
      onTap: saving
          ? null
          : () async {
              await showDialog<void>(
                context: context,
                builder: (dialogContext) => TransactionDetailsDialog(
                  transaction: tx,
                  account: accountName(tx['account_id']?.toString()),
                  destination: accountName(
                    tx['destination_account_id']?.toString(),
                  ),
                  category: categoryName(tx['category_id']?.toString()),
                  onEdit: external
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                          addTransaction(tx);
                        },
                  onDelete: external
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                          deleteTransaction(tx);
                        },
                ),
              );
              if (mounted) await refreshReceiptCounts();
            },
    );
  }

  // Sin agrupar por fecha efectiva: un registro retroactivo reciÃ©n ingresado
  // debe conservarse antes de los registros anteriores.
  List<Widget> _historyRows(List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows) {
    return [
      const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        child: Text(
          'Movimientos mÃ¡s recientes primero',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
        ),
      ),
      for (final row in rows) _transactionCard(row),
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final compact = compactLayout(context);
    final gutter = pageGutter(context);
    final VoidCallback? add = saving || loading || error != null
        ? null
        : () => addTransaction();
    final label = saving ? 'Guardando...' : 'Nuevo movimiento';
    final movements = allMovements;
    final visibleTransactions = movements
        .where(
          (row) =>
              filter.matches(row) &&
              (receiptCounts == null ||
                  receiptFilter.matches(
                    receiptCounts?[financialReceiptFolder(row)] ?? 0,
                  )),
        )
        .toList();
    return GuideScope(
      topic: 'movements',
      ready: !loading && error == null,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: GuideAnchor(id: 'title', child: const Text('Movimientos')),
          actions: [
            const AppHelpButton(topic: 'movements'),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'CategorÃ­as',
              icon: const Icon(Icons.category_outlined),
              onPressed: loading || saving
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      await Navigator.push(
                        context,
                        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                          builder: (_) => const CategoriesPage(),
                        ),
                      );
                      if (mounted) {
                        await loadData();
                      }
                    },
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Actualizar',
              onPressed: loading || saving ? null : loadData,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        bottomNavigationBar: compact
            ? Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  GuideAnchor(
                    id: 'add',
                    child: CompactActionBar(label: label, onPressed: add),
                  ),

// ==========================================
class TransactionFilter {
  const TransactionFilter({
    this.type = 'all',
    this.accountId,
    this.query = '',
    this.start,
    this.end,
  });
  final String type, query;
  final String? accountId;
  final DateTime? start, end;

  bool get isActive =>
      type != 'all' ||
      accountId != null ||
      query.trim().isNotEmpty ||
      start != null ||
      end != null;

  TransactionFilter copyWith({
    String? type,
    String? accountId,
    String? query,
    DateTime? start,
    DateTime? end,
    bool clearAccount = false,
    bool clearDates = false,
  }) => TransactionFilter(
    type: type ?? this.type,
    accountId: clearAccount ? null : accountId ?? this.accountId,
    query: query ?? this.query,
    start: clearDates ? null : start ?? this.start,
    end: clearDates ? null : end ?? this.end,
  );

  bool matches(Map<String, dynamic> tx) {
    if (type == 'insurance'
        ? tx['expense_kind'] != 'card_insurance'
        : type != 'all' && tx['transaction_type'] != type) {
      return false;
    }
    if (accountId != null) {
      final originMatches = tx['account_id']?.toString() == accountId;
      final destinationMatches =
          tx['transaction_type'] == 'transfer' &&
          tx['destination_account_id']?.toString() == accountId;
      if (!originMatches && !destinationMatches) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    final text = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (text.isNotEmpty) {
      final found = [
        tx['description'],
        tx['reference'],
      ].any((value) => (value?.toString() ?? '').toLowerCase().contains(text));
      if (!found) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    if (start != null || end != null) {
      final date = DateTime.tryParse('${tx['transaction_date']}')?.toLocal();
      if (date == null) {
        return false;
      }
      final day = DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day);
      final from = start;
      final until = end;
      if (from != null &&
          day.isBefore(DateTime(from.year, from.month, from.day))) {
        return false;
      }
      if (until != null &&
          day.isAfter(DateTime(until.year, until.month, until.day))) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
}

import '../../widgets/collapsible_filters.dart';
import '../../widgets/adaptive_layout.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'transaction_filter.dart';
import '../person_accounts/receipt_history.dart';

class TransactionFiltersBar extends StatefulWidget {
  const TransactionFiltersBar({
    super.key,
    required this.accounts,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.receiptFilter,
    this.onReceiptChanged,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts;
  final TransactionFilter value;
  final ValueChanged<TransactionFilter> onChanged;
  final ReceiptFilter? receiptFilter;
  final ValueChanged<ReceiptFilter>? onReceiptChanged;
  @override
  State<TransactionFiltersBar> createState() => _TransactionFiltersBarState();
}

class _TransactionFiltersBarState extends State<TransactionFiltersBar> {
  late final TextEditingController searchController;
  TransactionFilter get filter => widget.value;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    searchController = TextEditingController(text: filter.query);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant TransactionFiltersBar oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (searchController.text != filter.query) {
      searchController.value = TextEditingValue(
        text: filter.query,
        selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: filter.query.length),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  DateTimeRange? get range {
    final start = filter.start;
    final end = filter.end;
    if (start == null || end == null) {
      return null;
    }
    final first = DateTime(start.year, start.month, start.day);
    final last = DateTime(end.year, end.month, end.day);
    if (first.isAfter(last)) {
      return null;
    }
    return DateTimeRange(start: first, end: last);
  }

  Future<void> chooseDates() async {
    final currentRange = range;
    var firstDate = DateTime(2000);
    var lastDate = DateTime(2100, 12, 31);
    if (currentRange != null) {
      if (currentRange.start.isBefore(firstDate)) {
        firstDate = currentRange.start;
      }
      if (currentRange.end.isAfter(lastDate)) {
        lastDate = currentRange.end;
      }
    }
    final selected = await showDateRangePicker(
      context: context,
      firstDate: firstDate,
      lastDate: lastDate,
      initialDateRange: currentRange,
    );
    if (selected == null || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(start: selected.start, end: selected.end));
  }

  String day(DateTime date) =>
      '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/'
      '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';

  String get dateLabel {
    final start = filter.start;
    final end = filter.end;
    if (start != null && end != null) {
      return '${day(start)} â€“ ${day(end)}';
    }
    if (start != null) {
      return 'Desde ${day(start)}';
    }
    if (end != null) {
      return 'Hasta ${day(end)}';
    }
    return 'Todas las fechas';
  }

  static const typeLabels = {
    'all': 'Todos',
    'income': 'Ingresos',
    'expense': 'Gastos',
    'insurance': 'Seguro de tarjeta',
    'transfer': 'Transferencias',
    'deposit': 'DepÃ³sitos',
    'withdrawal': 'Retiros',
    'card_payment': 'Pagos de tarjeta',
    'debt_payment': 'Abonos de deudas',
    'adjustment': 'Ajustes',
  };

  Widget removable(String label, VoidCallback clear) => InputChip(
    label: Text(label, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
    deleteButtonTooltipMessage: 'Quitar filtro: $label',
    onDeleted: clear,
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accountId = filter.accountId;
    final missingAccount =
        accountId != null &&
        !widget.accounts.any((a) => a['id'].toString() == accountId);
    final receipt = widget.receiptFilter;
    final activeReceipt = receipt != null && receipt != ReceiptFilter.all;
    final accountName = widget.accounts
        .where((a) => '${a['id']}' == accountId)
        .firstOrNull?['name'];
    final chips = [
      if (filter.query.trim().isNotEmpty)
        removable(
          'BÃºsqueda: ${filter.query.trim()}',
          () => widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(query: '')),
        ),
      if (filter.type != 'all')
        removable(
          typeLabels[filter.type] ?? filter.type,
          () => widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(type: 'all')),
        ),
      if (accountId != null)
        removable(
          '${accountName ?? 'Cuenta no disponible'}',
          () => widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(clearAccount: true)),
        ),
      if (filter.start != null || filter.end != null)
        removable(
          dateLabel,
          () => widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(clearDates: true)),
        ),
      if (activeReceipt)
        removable(
          receipt.label,
          () => widget.onReceiptChanged?.call(ReceiptFilter.all),
        ),
    ];

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        CollapsibleFilters(
          summary: dateLabel,
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: searchController,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Buscar descripciÃ³n o referencia',
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
                suffixIcon: filter.query.isEmpty
                    ? null
                    : IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Limpiar bÃºsqueda',
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                        onPressed: () =>
                            widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(query: '')),
                      ),
              ),
              onChanged: (value) =>
                  widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(query: value)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            AdaptiveColumns(
              minColumnWidth: 235,
              children: [
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  key: ValueKey('type-${filter.type}'),
                  initialValue: filter.type,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Tipo de movimiento',
                  ),
                  items: [
                    for (final type in typeLabels.entries)
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: type.key,
                        child: Text(type.value),
                      ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    if (value != null) {
                      widget.onChanged(filter.copyWith(type: value));
                    }
                  },
                ),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: chooseDates,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.date_range),
                  label: Text(dateLabel),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            AdaptiveColumns(
              minColumnWidth: 235,
              children: [
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  key: ValueKey('account-$accountId'),
                  initialValue: accountId ?? 'all',
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Cuenta'),
                  items: [
                    const DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: 'all',
                      child: Text('Todas las cuentas'),
                    ),
                    ...widget.accounts.map(
                      (account) => DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: account['id'].toString(),
                        child: Text(
                          '${account['name']} (${account['currency']})'
                          '${account['is_active'] == true ? '' : ' Â· Inactiva'}',
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (missingAccount)
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: accountId,
                        child: const Text('Cuenta no disponible'),
                      ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    if (value == null) {
                      return;
                    }
                    widget.onChanged(
                      filter.copyWith(
                        accountId: value,
                        clearAccount: value == 'all',
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
                if (receipt != null && widget.onReceiptChanged != null)
                  ReceiptFilterField(
                    key: ValueKey(receipt),
                    value: receipt,
                    onChanged: widget.onReceiptChanged!,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (chips.isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 6,
            runSpacing: 4,
            crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
            children: [
              ...chips,
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  widget.onChanged(const TransactionFilter());
                  if (activeReceipt)
                    widget.onReceiptChanged?.call(ReceiptFilter.all);
                },
                child: const Text('Limpiar filtros'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

  String? destinationAccountId;
  String? categoryId;
  DateTime transactionDate = DateTime.now();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final tx = widget.transaction;
    if (tx == null) {
      if (widget.accounts.isNotEmpty)
        accountId = widget.accounts.first['id'].toString();
      return;
    }
    transactionType = tx['expense_kind'] == 'card_insurance'
        ? 'insurance'
        : tx['transaction_type'].toString();
    accountId = tx['account_id'].toString();
    destinationAccountId = tx['destination_account_id']?.toString();
    categoryId = tx['category_id']?.toString();
    amountController.text = tx['amount'].toString();
    rateController.text = tx['exchange_rate']?.toString() ?? '';
    descriptionController.text = tx['description']?.toString() ?? '';
    referenceController.text = tx['reference']?.toString() ?? '';
    transactionDate = DateTime.parse(
      tx['transaction_date'].toString(),
    ).toLocal();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    rateController.dispose();
    amountController.dispose();
    descriptionController.dispose();
    referenceController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String get selectedCurrency {
    for (final account in widget.accounts) {
      if (account['id'].toString() == accountId) {
        return account['currency']?.toString() ?? 'NIO';
      }
    }
    return 'NIO';
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get filteredCategories => widget.categories
      .where(
        (c) =>
            c['category_type'] ==
            (transactionType == 'insurance' ? 'expense' : transactionType),
      )
      .toList();

  bool get canChangeTransferCurrency =>
      !editingFx &&
      (widget.transaction?['transaction_type'] == 'transfer' ||
          widget.transaction?['transaction_type'] == 'expense');

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get availableDestinations =>
      widget.accounts.where((a) {
        if (a['id'].toString() == accountId) return false;
        if (editingFx) {
          return a['currency'] == widget.transaction?['destination_currency'];
        }
        return !editing ||
            widget.practice ||
            canChangeTransferCurrency ||
            a['currency'] == selectedCurrency;
      }).toList();

  String get destinationCurrency =>
      widget.accounts
          .where((a) => '${a['id']}' == destinationAccountId)
          .map((a) => '${a['currency']}')
          .firstOrNull ??
      selectedCurrency;
  bool get crossCurrency =>
      transactionType == 'transfer' &&
      destinationAccountId != null &&
      destinationCurrency != selectedCurrency;
  int? get receivedCents {
    try {
      return transferReceivedCents(
        moneyCents(amountController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')),
        selectedCurrency,
        destinationCurrency,
        double.parse(rateController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.')),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  void save() {
    if (_receipt.picking) return;
    if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final amount = double.tryParse(
      amountController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
    );
    if (amount == null || !amount.isFinite || amount <= 0) return;

    if (transactionType == 'transfer') {
      if (destinationAccountId == null) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Selecciona la cuenta de destino.')),
        );
        return;
      }
      if (!availableDestinations.any(
        (a) => a['id'].toString() == destinationAccountId,
      )) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Selecciona otra cuenta como destino.')),
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    Navigator.of(context).pop(<String, dynamic>{
      ..._receipt.fields,
      if (crossCurrency) ...{
        'destination_amount': receivedCents! / moneyScale,
        'destination_currency': destinationCurrency,
        'exchange_rate': double.parse(
          rateController.text.trim().replaceAll(',', '.'),
        ),
      },
      'account_id': accountId,
      'destination_account_id': transactionType == 'transfer'
          ? destinationAccountId
          : null,
      'category_id': transactionType == 'transfer' ? null : categoryId,
      'transaction_type': transactionType == 'insurance'
          ? 'expense'
          : transactionType,
      if (transactionType != 'transfer')
        'expense_kind': transactionType == 'insurance'
            ? 'card_insurance'
            : null,
      'amount': amount,
      'currency': selectedCurrency,
      'transaction_date': DateTime(
        transactionDate.year,
        transactionDate.month,
        transactionDate.day,
        12,
      ).toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'description': descriptionController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : descriptionController.text.trim(),
      'reference': referenceController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : referenceController.text.trim(),
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GuideScope(
      topic: 'movement_form',
      ready: true,
      excludedTargets: {
        if (transactionType != 'transfer') 'destination',
        if (!crossCurrency) 'rate',
      },
      child: AlertDialog(
        insetPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 40,
          vertical: compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 24,
        ),
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
          compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
          12,
          compactLayout(context) ? 16 : 24,
          16,
        ),
        title: Row(

            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                widget.practice
                    ? (editing
                          ? 'Editar movimiento de prÃ¡ctica'
                          : 'Nuevo movimiento de prÃ¡ctica')
                    : (editing ? 'Editar movimiento' : 'Nuevo movimiento'),
              ),
            ),
            if (!widget.practice) const AppHelpButton(topic: 'movements'),
          ],
        ),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 680,
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Form(

                children: [

                    children: [

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../utils/money.dart';
import '../../widgets/category_style.dart';

class TransactionTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const TransactionTile({
    super.key,
    this.receiptCount = 0,
    required this.transaction,
    required this.label,
    required this.account,
    required this.destination,
    required this.category,
    this.categoryStyle,
    this.onTap,
  });

  final Map<String, dynamic> transaction;
  final int receiptCount;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? categoryStyle;
  final String label, account, destination, category;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final colors = theme.colorScheme;
    final type = transaction['transaction_type'];
    final income = type == 'income' || type == 'deposit';
    final expense = [
      'expense',
      'withdrawal',
      'card_payment',
      'debt_payment',
    ].contains(type);
    final external = [
      'credit_card_payment',
      'debt_payment',
      'receivable_loan',
    ].contains(transaction['source']);
    final color = income
        ? const Color(0xFF397455)
        : expense
        ? colors.error
        : colors.primary;
    final icon = switch (type) {
      'card_payment' => Icons.credit_card_outlined,
      'debt_payment' => Icons.payments_outlined,
      'transfer' => Icons.swap_horiz_rounded,
      'income' || 'deposit' => Icons.south_west_rounded,
      'expense' || 'withdrawal' => Icons.north_east_rounded,
      _ => Icons.receipt_long_outlined,
    };
    final styledCategory = categoryStyle;
    final useCategory =
        styledCategory != null && (type == 'income' || type == 'expense');
    final visualColor = useCategory
        ? categoryColor(styledCategory['color'], income: income)
        : color;
    final visualIcon = useCategory
        ? categoryIcon(styledCategory['icon'])
        : icon;
    final description = transaction['description']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final accountLabel = type == 'transfer'
        ? '$account â†’ $destination'
        : account;
    final currency = transaction['currency']?.toString() ?? 'NIO';
    final cents = moneyCents(transaction['amount']);
    final date = DateTime.tryParse(
      '${transaction['transaction_date']}',
    )?.toLocal();
    final dateLabel = date == null
        ? 'Sin fecha'
        : '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${date.year}';
    final sign = income
        ? '+'
        : expense
        ? 'âˆ’'
        : '';
    const paymentPrefix = 'Pago de tarjeta: ';
    final paymentCard =
        type == 'card_payment' && description.startsWith(paymentPrefix)
        ? description.substring(paymentPrefix.length)
        : null;
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final compactPayment =
            paymentCard != null &&
            constraints.maxWidth < MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(520);
        final title = compactPayment || description.isEmpty
            ? label
            : description;
        final subtitle = [
          if (description.isNotEmpty && !compactPayment) label,
          if (category.isNotEmpty) category,
        ].join(' Â· ');
        return Card(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: onTap,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Icon(visualIcon, color: visualColor, size: 19),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(title, style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          '$sign${formatRecordMoneyCents(cents, currency)}',
                          textAlign: TextAlign.end,
                          style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                            color: color,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (onTap != null)
                        Icon(
                          Icons.chevron_right_rounded,
                          color: colors.onSurfaceVariant,
                          size: 20,
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  if (compactPayment) ...[
                    Text(paymentCard, style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  ],
                  Text(dateLabel, style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall),
                  Text(accountLabel),
                  if (subtitle.isNotEmpty)
                    Text(subtitle, style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall),
                  if (external)
                    Align(
                      alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
                      child: TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: onTap,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.link_rounded, size: 18),
                        label: Text(
                          type == 'withdrawal'
                              ? 'Ver prÃ©stamo vinculado'
                              : 'Ver pago vinculado',
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  if (receiptCount > 0) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text.rich(
                      TextSpan(
                        children: [
                          WidgetSpan(
                            alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.middle,
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.attach_file,
                              color: colors.onSurfaceVariant,
                              size: 16,
                            ),
                          ),
                          TextSpan(
                            text: receiptCount == 1
                                ? '  1 comprobante'
                                : '  $receiptCount comprobantes',
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
import 'package:cross_file/cross_file.dart';

Future<bool> shareReportFile(
  Uint8List bytes,
  String filename,
  String mime,
  String title,
  Rect origin,
) async {
  final result = await Share.shareXFiles(
    [XFile.fromData(bytes, mimeType: mime, name: filename)],
    fileNameOverrides: [filename],
    subject: title,
    sharePositionOrigin: origin,
  );
  return result.status.name != 'unavailable';
}

// ==========================================
// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\services\report_share_web.dart
// ==========================================
import 'dart:js_interop';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:web/web.dart' as web;

@JS('navigator.canShare')
external JSBoolean _canShare(JSObject data);
@JS('navigator.share')
external JSPromise<JSAny?> _share(JSObject data);

Future<bool> shareReportFile(
  Uint8List bytes,
  String filename,
  String mime,
  String title,
  Rect origin,
) async {
  // File se construye sin lectura asÃ­ncrona: navigator.share conserva el toque.
  final file = web.File(
    [bytes.toJS].toJS,
    filename,
    web.FilePropertyBag(type: mime),
  );
  final data =
      {
            'files': [file],
            'title': title,
          }.jsify()!
          as JSObject;
  try {
    if (!_canShare(data).toDart) return false;
    await _share(data).toDart;
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    // Cerrar la hoja del sistema no es un error ni provoca una descarga.
    if (error.toString().contains('AbortError')) return true;
    return false;
  }
}

import 'money.dart';

const cardCashAdvance = 'cash_advance';
const cardCashAdvanceLabel = 'Retiro de efectivo';
const cardCashAdvanceFeeLabel = 'ComisiÃ³n por retiro de efectivo';
const cashAdvanceDepositSource = 'card_cash_advance_deposit';

bool isCardCashAdvance(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
    row['charge_kind'] == cardCashAdvance;

int cardCashAdvanceFee(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
    moneyCents(row['cash_advance_fee'] ?? 0);

int cardCashAdvancePrincipal(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
    moneyCents(row['amount']) - cardCashAdvanceFee(row);

String cardCashAdvanceBreakdown(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
  final currency = '${row['currency']}';
  return 'Efectivo: ${formatRecordMoneyCents(cardCashAdvancePrincipal(row), currency)}'
      ' Â· ComisiÃ³n: ${formatRecordMoneyCents(cardCashAdvanceFee(row), currency)}';
}

// ==========================================
// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\utils\entry_order.dart
// ==========================================
/// Orden del historial por ingreso: las ediciones no cambian de posiciÃ³n.
/// Fecha del movimiento se usa solo como respaldo para datos antiguos sin creaciÃ³n.
int compareNewestEntry(Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {
  DateTime? entered(Map<String, dynamic> row) =>
      DateTime.tryParse('${row['created_at']}') ??
      DateTime.tryParse('${row['transaction_date'] ?? row['payment_date']}');
  final first = entered(a), second = entered(b);
  if (first == null && second != null) return 1;
  if (second == null && first != null) return -1;
  final byDate = first == null ? 0 : second!.compareTo(first);
  if (byDate != 0) return byDate;
  final byId = '${b['id']}'.compareTo('${a['id']}');
  return byId != 0 ? byId : '${b['source']}'.compareTo('${a['source']}');
}

/// Orden por el dÃ­a local que se muestra en Movimientos.
/// En un mismo dÃ­a se conserva el orden de ingreso.
int compareNewestMovement(Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {
  int? movementDay(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse(
      '${row['transaction_date'] ?? row['payment_date']}',
    )?.toLocal();
    return date == null
        ? null
        : date.year * 10000 + date.month * 100 + date.day;
  }

  final first = movementDay(a), second = movementDay(b);
  if (first == null && second != null) return 1;
  if (second == null && first != null) return -1;
  final byDay = first == null ? 0 : second!.compareTo(first);
  return byDay == 0 ? compareNewestEntry(a, b) : byDay;
}

// ==========================================
// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\utils\money.dart
// ==========================================
/// Historical API name retained; values now use millionths, not cents.
const int moneyScale = 1000000;
const int maxExactMoneyUnits = 9007199254740991;

int moneyCents(dynamic value) {
  var text = '$value'.trim().replaceAll(',', '.');
  if (text.contains(RegExp(r'[eE]'))) {
    final n = num.tryParse(text);
    if (n == null || !n.isFinite)
      throw FormatException('Monto invÃ¡lido: $value');
    final fixed = n.toStringAsFixed(6);
    if (num.tryParse(fixed) != n) {
      throw FormatException('Usa hasta seis decimales: $value');
    }
    text = fixed;
  }
  if (!RegExp(r'^-?\d+(\.\d{1,6})?$').hasMatch(text)) {
    throw FormatException('Monto invÃ¡lido; usa hasta seis decimales: $value');
  }
  final negative = text.startsWith('-');
  final parts = (negative ? text.substring(1) : text).split('.');
  final whole = BigInt.parse(parts[0]);
  final fraction = BigInt.parse(
    parts.length == 1 ? '0' : parts[1].padRight(6, '0'),
  );
  final units = whole * BigInt.from(moneyScale) + fraction;
  if (units > BigInt.from(maxExactMoneyUnits)) {
    throw FormatException('El monto excede el rango de precisiÃ³n admitido.');
  }
  return (negative ? -units : units).toInt();
}

Map<String, int> calculateBalances(
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> accounts,
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> transactions, {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> cardPayments = const [],
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> debtPayments = const [],
}) {
  final balances = <String, int>{
    for (final a in accounts)
      a['id'].toString(): moneyCents(a['opening_balance']),
  };
  for (final tx in transactions) {
    final type = tx['transaction_type'];
    // El esquema no indica la direcciÃ³n de un ajuste; no inventar su efecto.
    if (type == 'adjustment') {
      throw StateError(
        'Hay ajustes registrados. Debemos definir su efecto antes de calcular el saldo.',
      );
    }
    final origin = tx['account_id'].toString();
    final destination = tx['destination_account_id']?.toString();
    final amount = moneyCents(tx['amount']);
    if (balances.containsKey(origin)) {
      switch (type) {
        case 'income':
        case 'deposit':
          balances[origin] = balances[origin]! + amount;
          break;
        case 'expense':
        case 'withdrawal':
        case 'transfer':
          balances[origin] = balances[origin]! - amount;
          break;
        default:
          throw StateError('Tipo de movimiento desconocido: $type');
      }
    }
    if (type == 'transfer' && balances.containsKey(destination)) {
      balances[destination!] =
          balances[destination]! +
          moneyCents(tx['destination_amount'] ?? tx['amount']);
    }
  }
  final currencies = {
    for (final account in accounts)
      account['id'].toString(): account['currency'],
  };
  for (final payment in cardPayments) {
    final accountId = payment['account_id']?.toString();
    if (!balances.containsKey(accountId)) continue;
    if (currencies[accountId] !=
        (payment['account_debit_currency'] ?? payment['currency'])) {
      throw StateError(
        'La moneda del dÃ©bito del pago no coincide con su cuenta.',
      );
    }
    balances[accountId!] =
        balances[accountId]! -
        moneyCents(payment['account_debit_amount'] ?? payment['amount']);
  }
  for (final payment in debtPayments) {
    final accountId = payment['account_id']?.toString();
    if (!balances.containsKey(accountId)) continue;
    if (currencies[accountId] != payment['currency']) {
      throw StateError(
        'Un abono de deuda tiene una moneda diferente a su cuenta.',
      );
    }
    balances[accountId!] =
        balances[accountId]! - debtPaymentTotalCents(payment);
  }
  return balances;
}

int debtPaymentTotalCents(Map<String, dynamic> payment) =>
    moneyCents(payment['principal_amount']) +
    moneyCents(payment['interest_amount']) +
    moneyCents(payment['fee_amount']);

// Amounts are stored in millionths. Round only after summing, for display.
// Round to the nearest cent; exact halves round away from zero.
int totalUnitsRounded(int units) {
  const unitsPerCent = moneyScale ~/ 100;
  final absolute = units.abs();
  final cents = absolute ~/ unitsPerCent;
  final remainder = absolute % unitsPerCent;
  final rounded =
      (cents + (remainder >= unitsPerCent ~/ 2 ? 1 : 0)) * unitsPerCent;
  return units < 0 ? -rounded : rounded;
}

String formatAmountCents(int cents) =>
    formatRecordAmountCents(totalUnitsRounded(cents));

String formatRecordAmountCents(int cents) {
  final absolute = cents.abs();
  final whole = (absolute ~/ moneyScale).toString().replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))'),
    (match) => '${match[1]},',
  );
  var decimals = (absolute % moneyScale).toString().padLeft(6, '0');
  while (decimals.length > 2 && decimals.endsWith('0')) {
    decimals = decimals.substring(0, decimals.length - 1);
  }

  return '${cents < 0 ? '-' : ''}$whole.$decimals';
}

String formatMoneyCents(int? cents, String currency) {
  if (cents == null) {
    return 'Por revisar';
  }

  final symbol = currency == 'USD' ? '\$' : 'C\$';
  return '$symbol${formatAmountCents(cents)}';
}

// Individual records retain their original precision (up to six decimals).
String formatRecordMoneyCents(int? cents, String currency) {
  if (cents == null) return 'Por revisar';
  final symbol = currency == 'USD' ? r'$' : r'C$';
  return '$symbol${formatRecordAmountCents(cents)}';
}

class AccountShareSection extends StatelessWidget {
  const AccountShareSection({super.key, required this.account});
  final Map<String, dynamic> account;
  Future<void> copy(BuildContext context, String text) async {
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    try {
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
      if (context.mounted)
        messenger.showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Datos copiados.')),
        );
    } catch (_) {
      if (context.mounted)
        messenger.showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('No se pudo copiar. IntÃ©ntalo de nuevo.'),
          ),
        );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final number = '${account['account_number'] ?? ''}',
        holder = '${account['account_holder'] ?? ''}',
        iban = normalizeAccountIban('${account['account_iban'] ?? ''}');
    final missing = missingAccountShareFields(account),
        text = buildAccountShareText(account);
    Widget datum(String title, String value) => Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Text(
            title,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          SelectableText(
            value.isEmpty ? 'Sin registrar' : value,
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerLow,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          const Text(
            'Datos de la cuenta',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          datum('Titular de la cuenta', holder),
          datum('NÃºmero de cuenta', number),
          if (iban.isNotEmpty) datum('Cuenta IBAN', iban),
          datum('Moneda', shareCurrency('${account['currency'] ?? ''}')),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: missing.isEmpty ? () => copy(context, text) : null,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_outlined),
            label: const Text('Copiar'),
          ),
          if (missing.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
              child: Text(
                'Completa ${missing.join(', ')} en Editar cuenta para copiar la ficha completa.',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
