import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

bool compactLayout(BuildContext context) =>
    MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width < 650;

double pageGutter(BuildContext context) => compactLayout(context) ? 12 : 24;

/// Use the monitor's width while keeping very wide windows readable.
const double widePageMaxWidth = 1680;

/// Keeps the same children mounted when the viewport switches column count.
class AdaptiveColumns extends StatelessWidget {
  const AdaptiveColumns({
    super.key,
    required this.children,
    required this.minColumnWidth,
    this.maxColumns = 2,
    this.spacing = 12,
  });

  final List<Widget> children;
  final double minColumnWidth;
  final int maxColumns;
  final double spacing;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => LayoutBuilder(
    builder: (context, constraints) {
      if (children.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
      final available = constraints.maxWidth;
      final limit = children.length < maxColumns ? children.length : maxColumns;
      final textScale = (MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(14) / 14).clamp(
        1.0,
        1.8,
      );
      final columnWidth = minColumnWidth * textScale;
      final columns = ((available + spacing) / (columnWidth + spacing))
          .floor()
          .clamp(1, limit)
          .toInt();
      final width = columns == 1
          ? available
          : ((available - spacing * (columns - 1)) / columns).floorToDouble();
      return Wrap(
        spacing: spacing,
        runSpacing: spacing,
        children: [
          for (final child in children) SizedBox(width: width, child: child),
        ],
      );
    },
  );
}

class CompactActionBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const CompactActionBar({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.onPressed,
    this.icon = Icons.add,
  });

      top: false,
      minimum: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 12),
      child: SizedBox(
        width: double.infinity,
        child: FilledButton.icon(
          onPressed: onPressed,
          icon: Icon(icon),
          label: Text(label, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:package_info_plus/package_info_plus.dart';

/// Version reported by this build, rather than a hard-coded display string.
class AppVersionFooter extends StatefulWidget {
  const AppVersionFooter({super.key});
  @override
  State<AppVersionFooter> createState() => _AppVersionFooterState();
}

class _AppVersionFooterState extends State<AppVersionFooter> {
  late Future<PackageInfo> information;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    information = PackageInfo.fromPlatform();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 14),
    child: FutureBuilder<PackageInfo>(
      future: information,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final info = snapshot.data;
        final version = info?.version.trim() ?? '';
        final build = info?.buildNumber.trim() ?? '';
        return Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done)
              Center(
                child: const Text(
                  'Consultando versiÃ³nâ€¦',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                ),
              )
            else if (snapshot.hasError || version.isEmpty)
              Row(
                children: [
                  const Expanded(
                    child: Center(
                      child: Text(
                        'VersiÃ³n no disponible',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Reintentar',
                    onPressed: () => setState(
                      () => information = PackageInfo.fromPlatform(),
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh, size: 18),
                  ),
                ],
              )
            else
              Center(
                child: Text(
                  'VersiÃ³n $version${build.isEmpty ? '' : '.$build'}',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

String bankKey(String name) {
  final value = name
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('Ã¡', 'a')
      .replaceAll('Ã©', 'e')
      .replaceAll('Ã­', 'i')
      .replaceAll('Ã³', 'o')
      .replaceAll('Ãº', 'u')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]'), '');
  if (value.contains('lafise') || value.contains('bancentro')) return 'lafise';
  if (value.contains('avanz')) return 'avanz';
  if (value.contains('ficohsa')) return 'ficohsa';
  if (value.contains('atlantida')) return 'atlantida';
  if (value.contains('bdf') || value.contains('bancodefinanzas')) return 'bdf';
  if (value.contains('bfp') ||
      value.contains('produzcamos') ||
      value.contains('fomento')) {
    return 'bfp';
  }
  if (value.contains('banpro') ||
      value.contains('promerica') ||
      value.contains('bancodelaproduccion')) {
    return 'banpro';
  }
  if (value.contains('bac') || value.contains('americacentral')) return 'bac';
  return '';
}

  'atlantida' => const [Color(0xFF991B23), Color(0xFFDC242D)],
  'bfp' => const [Color(0xFF005780), Color(0xFF009B96)],
  _ => [appPrimaryDeep, primaryColor],
};

class BankLogo extends StatelessWidget {
  const BankLogo({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    this.width = 110,
    this.height = 32,
    this.fallbackIcon = Icons.account_balance_outlined,
  });
  final String name;
  final double width, height;
  final IconData fallbackIcon;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final key = bankKey(name);
    final path = switch (key) {
      'banpro' => 'assets/banks/banpro.webp',
      'atlantida' => 'assets/banks/atlantida.png',
      'bac' ||
      'lafise' ||
      'avanz' ||
      'bdf' ||
      'ficohsa' ||
      'bfp' => 'assets/banks/$key.svg',
      _ => null,
    };
    return SizedBox(
      width: width,
      height: height,
      child: path == null
          ? Icon(fallbackIcon, color: primaryColor)
          : path.endsWith('.svg')
          ? SvgPicture.asset(path, fit: BoxFit.contain, semanticsLabel: name)
          : Image.asset(path, fit: BoxFit.contain, semanticLabel: name),
    );
  }
}

class DatePeriodField extends StatelessWidget {
  const DatePeriodField({
    super.key,
    required this.start,
    required this.end,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.minColumnWidth = 164,
  });
  final DateTime start, end;
  final ValueChanged<DateTimeRange> onChanged;
  final bool enabled;
  final double minColumnWidth;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
    child: Builder(
      builder: (context) {
        Widget button(String label, DateTime date, bool from) =>
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              onPressed: !enabled
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final selected = await showDatePicker(
                        context: context,
                        initialDate: date,
                        firstDate: from ? DateTime(1900) : start,
                        lastDate: from ? end : DateTime(2200),
                      );
                      if (selected != null)
                        onChanged(
                          DateTimeRange(
                            start: from ? selected : start,
                            end: from ? end : selected,
                          ),
                        );
                    },
              icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined),
              label: Text(
                '$label\n${isoDay(date)}',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
            );
        return AdaptiveColumns(
          minColumnWidth: minColumnWidth,
          children: [
            button('Fecha inicial', start, true),
            button('Fecha final', end, false),
          ],
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../features/accounts/accounts_page.dart';
import '../features/transactions/transactions_page.dart';

final dashboardScaffoldKey = GlobalKey<ScaffoldState>();

class MobileNavigation extends StatelessWidget {
  const MobileNavigation({super.key, required this.index, this.onReturn});
  final int index;
  final VoidCallback? onReturn;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => NavigationBar(
    height: 62,
    selectedIndex: index,
    destinations: const [
      NavigationDestination(icon: Icon(Icons.home_outlined), label: 'Inicio'),
      NavigationDestination(icon: Icon(Icons.swap_horiz), label: 'Movimientos'),
      NavigationDestination(
        icon: Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined),
        label: 'Cuentas',
      ),
      NavigationDestination(icon: Icon(Icons.menu), label: 'MÃ¡s'),
    ],
    onDestinationSelected: (value) async {
      if (value == index) return;
      final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
      if (value == 0 || value == 3) {
        navigator.popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
        if (value == 3) {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            dashboardScaffoldKey.currentState?.openDrawer();
          });
        }
        return;
      }
      final route = MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) =>
            value == 1 ? const TransactionsPage() : const AccountsPage(),
      );
      if (index == 0) {
        await navigator.push(route);
        if (context.mounted) onReturn?.call();
      } else {
        navigator.pushReplacement(route);
      }
    },
  );
}

// ==========================================
// FILE: C:\Users\Calderon2bc\Documents\Git\finanzas_personales\lib\widgets\responsive_wallet.dart
// ==========================================
import '../core/app_theme.dart' show appMuted, primaryColor;
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show PointerDeviceKind;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';

/// Billetera horizontal con navegaciÃ³n por tarjeta en celular.
class ResponsiveWallet extends StatefulWidget {
  const ResponsiveWallet({
    super.key,
    required this.items,
    required this.selectedId,
    required this.title,
    required this.icon,
    required this.labelFor,
    required this.itemBuilder,
    this.onSelected,
    this.desktopItemWidth = 320,
    this.showNextOnMobile = false,
    this.uniformMobileHeight = false,
    this.revealSelectionOnDesktop = false,
  });
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> items;
  final String? selectedId;
  final String title;
  final IconData icon;
  final String Function(Map<String, dynamic>) labelFor;
  final Widget Function(Map<String, dynamic>, bool) itemBuilder;
  final ValueChanged<String>? onSelected;
  final double desktopItemWidth;
  final bool showNextOnMobile;
  final bool uniformMobileHeight;
  final bool revealSelectionOnDesktop;

  @override
  State<ResponsiveWallet> createState() => _ResponsiveWalletState();
}

class _ResponsiveWalletState extends State<ResponsiveWallet> {
  late final controller = ScrollController(
    keepScrollOffset: !widget.revealSelectionOnDesktop,
  );
  final measurements = <String, double>{};
  int visibleIndex = 0;
  double? mobilePageWidth;
  int? lastSelectedIndex;
  bool aligning = false;
  bool selectionScheduled = false;
  bool canScrollLeft = false;
  bool canScrollRight = false;
  bool checkingScrollEdges = false;
  (String?, int, double, int)? desktopSelection;
  VoidCallback? pendingDesktopReveal;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    controller.addListener(trackVisible);
    controller.addListener(updateScrollEdges);
  }

  void trackVisible() {
    final width = mobilePageWidth;
    if (!mounted ||
        width == null ||
        !controller.hasClients ||
        widget.items.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    final index = (controller.offset / width)
        .round()
        .clamp(0, widget.items.length - 1)
        .toInt();
    if (index != visibleIndex) {
      setState(() => visibleIndex = index);
    }
    if (widget.showNextOnMobile && !aligning) {
      selectVisibleCard(width);
    }
  }

  void selectVisibleCard(double extent) {
    final onSelected = widget.onSelected;
    if (selectionScheduled ||
        onSelected == null ||
        '${widget.items[visibleIndex]['id']}' == widget.selectedId) {
      return;
    }
    selectionScheduled = true;
    final previousSelection = widget.selectedId;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      selectionScheduled = false;
      if (!mounted ||
          mobilePageWidth != extent ||
          widget.selectedId != previousSelection ||
          visibleIndex >= widget.items.length ||
          ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == false) {
        return;
      }
      final selected = widget.onSelected;
      final id = '${widget.items[visibleIndex]['id']}';
      if (selected == null || id == widget.selectedId) return;

      // The scroll position already follows the gesture.
      lastSelectedIndex = visibleIndex;
      selected(id);
    });
    WidgetsBinding.instance.ensureVisualUpdate();
  }

  void alignMobilePage(double width, int index) {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted ||
          !controller.hasClients ||
          mobilePageWidth != width ||
          lastSelectedIndex != index)
        return;
      final target = (index * width)
          .clamp(0.0, controller.position.maxScrollExtent)
          .toDouble();
      if ((controller.offset - target).abs() < 0.5) return;
      aligning = true;
      try {
        controller.jumpTo(target);
      } finally {
        aligning = false;
      }
    });
  }

  void revealDesktopSelection(double extent, double width, int index) {
    final selection = (widget.selectedId, index, extent, widget.items.length);
    if (desktopSelection == selection) return;
    desktopSelection = selection;
    pendingDesktopReveal = null;
    if (index < 0) return;
    pendingDesktopReveal = () {
      if (!mounted ||
          desktopSelection != selection ||
          widget.selectedId != selection.$1 ||
          !controller.hasClients) {
        return;
      }
      final position = controller.position;
      if (!position.hasContentDimensions || !position.hasViewportDimension) {
        return;
      }
      pendingDesktopReveal = null;
      final left = index * extent;
      final right = left + width;
      final viewportLeft = position.pixels;
      final viewportRight = viewportLeft + position.viewportDimension;
      final target =
          (left < viewportLeft - 0.5
                  ? left
                  : right > viewportRight + 0.5
                  ? right - position.viewportDimension
                  : viewportLeft)
              .clamp(position.minScrollExtent, position.maxScrollExtent)
              .toDouble();
      if ((target - viewportLeft).abs() > 0.5) controller.jumpTo(target);
    };
    scheduleDesktopReveal();
  }

  void scheduleDesktopReveal() {
    if (pendingDesktopReveal == null) return;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.ensureVisualUpdate();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) pendingDesktopReveal?.call();
    });
  }

  bool selectSettledPage(ScrollEndNotification notification) {
    if (notification.depth != 0 ||
        widget.showNextOnMobile ||
        aligning ||
        mobilePageWidth == null ||
        widget.onSelected == null ||
        widget.items.isEmpty)
      return false;
    final previousSelection = widget.selectedId;
    final index = (notification.metrics.pixels / mobilePageWidth!)
        .round()
        .clamp(0, widget.items.length - 1)
        .toInt();
    final id = '${widget.items[index]['id']}';
    if (id != widget.selectedId) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (!mounted ||
            mobilePageWidth == null ||
            widget.selectedId != previousSelection ||
            ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == false ||
            visibleIndex >= widget.items.length ||
            '${widget.items[visibleIndex]['id']}' != id)
          return;
        widget.onSelected?.call(id);
      });
    }
    return false;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.removeListener(trackVisible);
    controller.removeListener(updateScrollEdges);
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void updateScrollEdges() {
    if (checkingScrollEdges || mobilePageWidth != null) return;
    checkingScrollEdges = true;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.ensureVisualUpdate();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      checkingScrollEdges = false;
      if (!mounted || !controller.hasClients || mobilePageWidth != null) {
        return;
      }
      final position = controller.position;
      if (!position.hasContentDimensions) return;
      final left = position.extentBefore > 0.5;
      final right = position.extentAfter > 0.5;
      if (left == canScrollLeft && right == canScrollRight) return;
      setState(() {
        canScrollLeft = left;
        canScrollRight = right;
      });
    });
  }

  Widget edgeArrow(BuildContext context, int direction, double itemExtent) {
    final colors = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return Material(
      color: colors.surface.withAlpha(218),
      elevation: 2,
      shadowColor: colors.shadow.withAlpha(40),
      shape: CircleBorder(side: BorderSide(color: colors.outlineVariant)),
      child: IconButton(
        tooltip: direction < 0 ? 'Anteriores' : 'Siguientes',
        onPressed: () => move(direction, itemExtent),
        color: colors.primary,
        icon: Icon(
          direction < 0
              ? Icons.chevron_left_rounded
              : Icons.chevron_right_rounded,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void move(int direction, double itemExtent) {
    if (!controller.hasClients) {
      return;
    }
    final start = mobilePageWidth == null
        ? controller.offset
        : (controller.offset / itemExtent).round() * itemExtent;
    final target = (start + direction * itemExtent)
        .clamp(0.0, controller.position.maxScrollExtent)
        .toDouble();
    controller.animateTo(
      target,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 280),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final routeIsCurrent =
        !widget.revealSelectionOnDesktop ||
        (ModalRoute.isCurrentOf(context) ?? true);
    if (widget.items.isEmpty || !routeIsCurrent) {
      desktopSelection = null;
      pendingDesktopReveal = null;
    }
    if (widget.items.isEmpty) {
      mobilePageWidth = null;
      lastSelectedIndex = null;
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, box) {
        final mobile = box.maxWidth < 650;
        // Fit complete cards across the available desktop width.
        final desktopColumns =
            ((box.maxWidth + 14) / (widget.desktopItemWidth + 14))
                .round()
                .clamp(2, 5)
                .toInt();
        final desktopWidth =
            (box.maxWidth - 14 * (desktopColumns - 1)) / desktopColumns;
        final peek =
            mobile && widget.showNextOnMobile && widget.items.length > 1
            ? (box.maxWidth * 0.15).clamp(0.0, 64.0).toDouble()
            : 0.0;
        final mobileGap = peek > 0 ? 8.0 : 0.0;
        final itemWidth = mobile
            ? box.maxWidth - peek - mobileGap
            : desktopWidth;
        final itemExtent = itemWidth + (mobile ? mobileGap : 14);
        final selectedIndex = widget.items.indexWhere(
          (item) => '${item['id']}' == widget.selectedId,
        );
        if (mobile && itemWidth > 0) {
          desktopSelection = null;
          pendingDesktopReveal = null;
          final targetIndex = selectedIndex < 0 ? 0 : selectedIndex;
          if (mobilePageWidth != itemExtent ||
              lastSelectedIndex != targetIndex) {
            mobilePageWidth = itemExtent;
            lastSelectedIndex = targetIndex;
            visibleIndex = targetIndex;
            alignMobilePage(itemExtent, targetIndex);
          }
        } else {
          mobilePageWidth = null;
          lastSelectedIndex = null;
          if (widget.revealSelectionOnDesktop && routeIsCurrent) {
            revealDesktopSelection(itemExtent, itemWidth, selectedIndex);
          }
        }
        final showDesktopArrows =
            !mobile && widget.items.length > desktopColumns;
        if (showDesktopArrows) updateScrollEdges();
        final index = visibleIndex.clamp(0, widget.items.length - 1).toInt();
        final activeId = '${widget.items[index]['id']}';
        final naturalCardHeight = mobile && !widget.uniformMobileHeight;
        final cards = Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: naturalCardHeight
              ? CrossAxisAlignment.start
              : CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: widget.items
              .asMap()
              .entries
              .map(
                (entry) => Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                    right: entry.key == widget.items.length - 1
                        ? peek + mobileGap
                        : (mobile ? mobileGap : 14),
                  ),
                  child: SizedBox(
                    width: itemWidth,
                    child: _WalletItemExtent(
                      key: ValueKey('measure-${entry.value['id']}'),
                      id: '${entry.value['id']}',
                      measurements: measurements,
                      child: widget.itemBuilder(
                        entry.value,
                        '${entry.value['id']}' == widget.selectedId,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              )
              .toList(),
        );
        final strip = SingleChildScrollView(
          controller: controller,
          primary: false,
          physics: mobile
              ? peek > 0
                    ? _WalletPagePhysics(
                        itemExtent,
                        parent: const ClampingScrollPhysics(),
                      )
                    : const PageScrollPhysics(parent: ClampingScrollPhysics())
              : const ClampingScrollPhysics(),
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
          child: naturalCardHeight ? cards : IntrinsicHeight(child: cards),
        );
        final scrollBehavior = ScrollConfiguration.of(context);
        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(widget.icon, color: primaryColor, size: 23),
                const SizedBox(width: 9),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    widget.title,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (mobile && widget.items.length > 1) ...[
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Anteriores',
                    onPressed: index == 0 ? null : () => move(-1, itemExtent),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left_rounded),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Siguientes',
                    onPressed: index == widget.items.length - 1
                        ? null
                        : () => move(1, itemExtent),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
              mobile && widget.items.length > 1
                  ? '${index + 1} de ${widget.items.length} Â· Desliza o usa las flechas'
                  : 'Selecciona una tarjeta para ver sus detalles.',
              style: TextStyle(color: appMuted, fontSize: 14),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Stack(
              children: [
                ClipRect(
                  child: _WalletViewport(
                    activeId: naturalCardHeight ? activeId : null,
                    measurements: measurements,
                    bottomPadding: 12,
                    child: NotificationListener<ScrollMetricsNotification>(
                      onNotification: (notification) {
                        if (notification.depth == 0) {
                          updateScrollEdges();
                          scheduleDesktopReveal();
                        }
                        return false;
                      },
                      child: NotificationListener<ScrollEndNotification>(
                        onNotification: selectSettledPage,
                        child: mobile && widget.showNextOnMobile
                            ? ScrollConfiguration(
                                behavior: scrollBehavior.copyWith(
                                  dragDevices: {
                                    ...scrollBehavior.dragDevices,
                                    PointerDeviceKind.mouse,
                                  },
                                ),
                                child: strip,
                              )
                            : strip,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (showDesktopArrows && canScrollLeft)
                  Positioned(
                    top: 0,
                    bottom: 12,
                    left: 4,
                    child: Center(child: edgeArrow(context, -1, itemExtent)),
                  ),
                if (showDesktopArrows && canScrollRight)
                  Positioned(
                    top: 0,
                    bottom: 12,
                    right: 4,
                    child: Center(child: edgeArrow(context, 1, itemExtent)),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _WalletPagePhysics extends ScrollPhysics {
  const _WalletPagePhysics(this.extent, {super.parent});

  final double extent;

  @override
  _WalletPagePhysics applyTo(ScrollPhysics? ancestor) =>
      _WalletPagePhysics(extent, parent: buildParent(ancestor));

  @override
  Simulation? createBallisticSimulation(
    ScrollMetrics position,
    double velocity,
  ) {
    if ((position.pixels <= position.minScrollExtent && velocity <= 0) ||
        (position.pixels >= position.maxScrollExtent && velocity >= 0)) {
      return super.createBallisticSimulation(position, velocity);
    }
    final tolerance = toleranceFor(position);
    var page = position.pixels / extent;
    if (velocity.abs() > tolerance.velocity) {
      page += velocity.sign * 0.5;
    }
    final target = (page.round() * extent)
        .clamp(position.minScrollExtent, position.maxScrollExtent)
        .toDouble();
    if ((target - position.pixels).abs() < tolerance.distance) return null;
    return ScrollSpringSimulation(
      spring,
      position.pixels,
      target,
      velocity,
      tolerance: tolerance,
    );
  }
}

/// Records natural card height in the same layout pass as the viewport.
/// No post-frame callback, setState, or size animation moves the outer list.
class _WalletItemExtent extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
  const _WalletItemExtent({
    super.key,
    required this.id,
    required this.measurements,
    required super.child,
  });
  final String id;
  final Map<String, double> measurements;
  @override
  RenderObject createRenderObject(BuildContext context) =>
      _RenderWalletItemExtent(id, measurements);
  @override
  void updateRenderObject(
    BuildContext context,
    _RenderWalletItemExtent renderObject,
  ) {
    renderObject.configure(id, measurements);
  }
}

class _RenderWalletItemExtent extends RenderProxyBox {
  _RenderWalletItemExtent(this.id, this.measurements);
  String id;
  Map<String, double> measurements;
  void configure(String value, Map<String, double> sizes) {
    if (id == value && identical(measurements, sizes)) return;
    id = value;
    measurements = sizes;
    markNeedsLayout();
  }

  @override
  void performLayout() {
    super.performLayout();
    measurements[id] = size.height;
  }
}

/// Keeps the horizontal Scrollable at one stable position in the widget tree.
/// The row measures its cards naturally; only the visible card determines the
/// outer height. ClipRect prevents taller neighbouring cards painting outside.
class _WalletViewport extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
  const _WalletViewport({
    required this.activeId,
    required this.measurements,
    required this.bottomPadding,
    required super.child,
  });
  final String? activeId;
  final Map<String, double> measurements;
  final double bottomPadding;
  @override
  RenderObject createRenderObject(BuildContext context) =>
      _RenderWalletViewport(activeId, measurements, bottomPadding);
  @override
  void updateRenderObject(
    BuildContext context,
    _RenderWalletViewport renderObject,
  ) {
    renderObject.configure(activeId, measurements, bottomPadding);
  }
}

class _RenderWalletViewport extends RenderProxyBox {
  _RenderWalletViewport(this.activeId, this.measurements, this.bottomPadding);
  String? activeId;
  Map<String, double> measurements;
  double bottomPadding;
  void configure(String? id, Map<String, double> sizes, double padding) {
    if (activeId == id &&
        identical(measurements, sizes) &&
        bottomPadding == padding)
      return;
    activeId = id;
    measurements = sizes;
    bottomPadding = padding;
    markNeedsLayout();
  }

  @override
  void performLayout() {
    final content = child;
    if (content == null) {
      size = constraints.smallest;
      return;
    }
    content.layout(
      constraints.copyWith(minHeight: 0, maxHeight: double.infinity),
      parentUsesSize: true,
    );
    final measured = activeId == null ? null : measurements[activeId];
    size = constraints.constrain(
      Size(
        content.size.width,
        measured == null ? content.size.height : measured + bottomPadding,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

Future<void> showTotalDetails(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String title,
  required String scope,
  required int total,
  required String currency,
  required List<TotalPart> parts,
}) => showDialog<void>(
  context: context,
  builder: (context) {
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    return AlertDialog(
      title: Text(title),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 620,
        height: size.height * .55,
        child: ListView.builder(
          itemCount: parts.length + 1,
          itemBuilder: (context, index) {
            if (index == 0) {
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(scope),
                    Text(
                      formatMoneyCents(total, currency),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
                    ),
                    if (parts.isEmpty)
                      const Text('No hay registros para este total.'),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }
            final part = parts[index - 1];
            return ListTile(
              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              title: Text(part.label),
              subtitle: Text(formatMoneyCents(part.cents, part.currency)),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Cerrar'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  },
);

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class VoidPaymentDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const VoidPaymentDialog({super.key, this.deleteFromMovements = false});

  final bool deleteFromMovements;
  @override
  State<VoidPaymentDialog> createState() => _VoidPaymentDialogState();
}

class _VoidPaymentDialogState extends State<VoidPaymentDialog> {
  final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final reason = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    reason.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String get actionLabel =>
      widget.deleteFromMovements ? 'Eliminar pago' : 'Anular pago';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(
    title: Text(actionLabel),
    content: SizedBox(
      width: 420,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Form(
          key: formKey,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text(
                widget.deleteFromMovements
                    ? 'Se quitarÃ¡ el pago de los movimientos vigentes y se recalcularÃ¡n los saldos relacionados. El registro quedarÃ¡ en Anulados. Esta acciÃ³n solo afecta a Mi Billete.'
                    : 'Se anularÃ¡ el registro y se recalcularÃ¡n los saldos relacionados. Esto no realiza una devoluciÃ³n bancaria.',
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextFormField(
                controller: reason,
                autofocus: true,
                maxLines: 3,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: widget.deleteFromMovements
                      ? 'Motivo (opcional)'
                      : 'Motivo',
                ),
                validator: (value) =>
                    !widget.deleteFromMovements && (value ?? '').trim().isEmpty
                    ? 'Escribe el motivo'
                    : null,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
    actions: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        child: const Text('Cancelar'),
      ),
      FilledButton(
        onPressed: () {
          if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
          final note = reason.text.trim();
          Navigator.pop(
            context,
            note.isEmpty ? 'Eliminado desde Movimientos de tarjeta' : note,
          );
        },
        child: Text(actionLabel),
      ),
    ],
  );
}
